```rust
// ... (código existente) ...

use arkhe_input_validation::InputValidator;

impl InferenceRequest {
    // ... (construtores existentes) ...

    /// Valida a requisição contra limites de entrada.
    /// Alinhado com AISVS C2.1.4.
    pub fn validate(&self, max_tokens: usize) -> Result<(), String> {
        let validator = InputValidator::new(max_tokens);

        // Validar cada mensagem
        for msg in &self.messages {
            let result = validator.validate(&msg.content)
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            if !result.valid {
                return Err(result.reason.unwrap_or_else(|| "Invalid input".into()));
            }
            // Usar versão normalizada se disponível
            if let Some(normalized) = result.normalized {
                // Opcional: substituir content pela versão normalizada
                // (isso requer mutabilidade, então apenas verificamos)
            }
        }

        // Validar parâmetros de ferramentas
        for tool in &self.tools {
            if tool.name.len() > 256 {
                return Err("Tool name exceeds 256 characters".into());
            }
            if tool.description.len() > 1024 {
                return Err("Tool description exceeds 1024 characters".into());
            }
            // Validar parâmetros JSON
            if let Some(params) = tool.parameters.as_object() {
                for (key, value) in params {
                    if key.len() > 128 {
                        return Err(format!("Parameter key '{}' exceeds 128 characters", key));
                    }
                    if let Some(s) = value.as_str() {
                        if s.len() > 4096 {
                            return Err(format!("Parameter value for '{}' exceeds 4096 characters", key));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Validar sessão ID
        if let Some(session_id) = &self.session_id {
            if session_id.len() > 256 {
                return Err("Session ID exceeds 256 characters".into());
            }
        }

        Ok(())
    }

    /// Valida com limites padrão (4096 tokens).
    pub fn validate_default(&self) -> Result<(), String> {
        self.validate(4096)
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Filtro de saída para sistemas de IA.
//! Alinhado com AISVS C7.1.1, C7.1.2, C7.3.1–C7.3.4.

mod schema;
mod harmful;
mod injection;

pub use schema::SchemaValidator;
pub use harmful::HarmfulContentFilter;
pub use injection::InjectionBlocker;

/// Resultado da filtragem de saída.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct OutputFilterResult {
    pub allowed: bool,
    pub filtered_content: Option<String>,
    pub reason: Option<String>,
    pub warnings: Vec<String>,
}

/// Filtro combinado para saída de modelo.
pub struct OutputFilter {
    schema: SchemaValidator,
    harmful: HarmfulContentFilter,
    injection: InjectionBlocker,
    max_length: usize,
}

impl OutputFilter {
    pub fn new(max_length: usize) -> Self {
        Self {
            schema: SchemaValidator::new(),
            harmful: HarmfulContentFilter::new(),
            injection: InjectionBlocker::new(),
            max_length,
        }
    }

    /// Filtra uma saída do modelo.
    pub fn filter(&self, content: &str) -> OutputFilterResult {
        let mut warnings = Vec::new();
        let mut filtered = content.to_string();

        // C7.1.2: Limites de comprimento e terminação
        if filtered.chars().count() > self.max_length {
            warnings.push(format!("Output exceeds length limit ({} chars)", self.max_length));
            filtered = filtered.chars().take(self.max_length).collect();
        }

        // C7.1.1: Validação de schema
        if let Err(e) = self.schema.validate(&filtered) {
            return OutputFilterResult {
                allowed: false,
                filtered_content: None,
                reason: Some(format!("Schema validation failed: {}", e)),
                warnings,
            };
        }

        // C7.3.1: Classificadores automáticos de conteúdo nocivo
        if let Some(reason) = self.harmful.detect(&filtered) {
            return OutputFilterResult {
                allowed: false,
                filtered_content: None,
                reason: Some(reason),
                warnings,
            };
        }

        // C7.3.2: Detecção de vazamento de system prompt
        if self.injection.detects_system_prompt_leak(&filtered) {
            return OutputFilterResult {
                allowed: false,
                filtered_content: None,
                reason: Some("Potential system prompt leak detected".into()),
                warnings,
            };
        }

        // C7.3.4: Detecção de conteúdo oculto
        if let Some(cleaned) = self.injection.remove_hidden_content(&filtered) {
            filtered = cleaned;
            warnings.push("Hidden content removed".into());
        }

        OutputFilterResult {
            allowed: true,
            filtered_content: Some(filtered),
            reason: None,
            warnings,
        }
    }
}

impl Default for OutputFilter {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new(8192)
    }
}
```

```rust
//! C7.1.1: Validação de saída contra schema.

use serde_json::Value;

/// Validador de schema para saídas do modelo.
pub struct SchemaValidator {
    // Schema é opcional; por padrão, valida que é JSON válido se aplicável.
}

impl SchemaValidator {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }

    /// Valida se a saída está em conformidade com o schema esperado.
    /// Esta versão simples verifica se é JSON válido e algumas regras básicas.
    pub fn validate(&self, content: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
        // Se começa com `{` ou `[`, tenta parsear como JSON
        let trimmed = content.trim();
        if trimmed.starts_with('{') || trimmed.starts_with('[') {
            match serde_json::from_str::<Value>(trimmed) {
                Ok(_) => Ok(()),
                Err(e) => Err(format!("Invalid JSON: {}", e)),
            }
        } else {
            // Para texto livre, regras básicas
            if content.len() > 100_000 {
                return Err("Output exceeds maximum length".into());
            }
            // Verificar caracteres nulos
            if content.contains('\0') {
                return Err("Output contains null bytes".into());
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }
}

impl Default for SchemaValidator {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}
```

```rust
//! C7.3.1: Detecção de conteúdo nocivo.

use regex::Regex;

/// Filtro de conteúdo nocivo.
pub struct HarmfulContentFilter {
    patterns: Vec<Regex>,
}

impl HarmfulContentFilter {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let patterns = vec![
            Regex::new(r"(?i)suicide").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)self-harm").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)sexual violence").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)child abuse").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)terrorism").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)weapons manufacture").unwrap(),
            // Mais categorias podem ser adicionadas
        ];
        Self { patterns }
    }

    /// Detecta conteúdo nocivo. Retorna a razão se encontrado.
    pub fn detect(&self, content: &str) -> Option<String> {
        for re in &self.patterns {
            if re.is_match(content) {
                return Some(format!("Content matches harmful pattern: {:?}", re.as_str()));
            }
        }
        None
    }
}

impl Default for HarmfulContentFilter {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}
```

```rust
//! C7.3.2, C7.3.4: Detecção de vazamento de prompt e conteúdo oculto.

use regex::Regex;

/// Bloqueador de injeção e detecção de vazamento.
pub struct InjectionBlocker {
    system_prompt_leak_patterns: Vec<Regex>,
    hidden_patterns: Vec<Regex>,
}

impl InjectionBlocker {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let system_prompt_leak_patterns = vec![
            Regex::new(r"(?i)system prompt:").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)developer instruction:").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)you are a helpful assistant").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)your role is").unwrap(),
        ];
        let hidden_patterns = vec![
            // Homoglyphs (exemplo simplificado)
            Regex::new(r"[ΑΑ]").unwrap(),  // Alpha vs Latin A
            // Zero-width characters
            Regex::new(r"\u200B").unwrap(), // Zero-width space
            Regex::new(r"\u200C").unwrap(), // Zero-width non-joiner
        ];
        Self {
            system_prompt_leak_patterns,
            hidden_patterns,
        }
    }

    /// Detecta vazamento de system prompt.
    pub fn detects_system_prompt_leak(&self, content: &str) -> bool {
        self.system_prompt_leak_patterns
            .iter()
            .any(|re| re.is_match(content))
    }

    /// Remove conteúdo oculto (homoglyphs, zero-width, etc.)
    pub fn remove_hidden_content(&self, content: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let mut cleaned = content.to_string();
        let mut changed = false;
        for re in &self.hidden_patterns {
            let new = re.replace_all(&cleaned, "");
            if new != cleaned {
                cleaned = new.to_string();
                changed = true;
            }
        }
        if changed {
            Some(cleaned)
        } else {
            None
        }
    }
}

impl Default for InjectionBlocker {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}
```

### 4.1 `arkhe-agi/src/telemetry.rs` (novo)

```rust
//! Telemetria estruturada para Arkhe AGI.
//! Alinhado com AISVS C12.1.1–C12.1.4.

use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use tracing::{info, warn, error, debug, span, Level};
use tracing::field;

/// Evento de interação com IA.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct AIInteractionEvent {
    pub session_id: String,
    pub turn_id: String,
    pub timestamp: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub model_id: String,
    pub prompt_tokens: u32,
    pub completion_tokens: u32,
    pub total_tokens: u32,
    pub finish_reason: String,
    pub duration_ms: u64,
    pub input_preview: String,
    pub output_preview: String,
    pub metadata: HashMap<String, String>,
}

/// Evento de RAG.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct RAGEvent {
    pub session_id: String,
    pub query: String,
    pub documents_retrieved: Vec<String>,
    pub knowledge_sources: Vec<String>,
    pub retrieval_time_ms: u64,
    pub timestamp: DateTime<Utc>,
}

/// Evento de segurança (policy, filtro).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SecurityEvent {
    pub session_id: String,
    pub event_type: SecurityEventType,
    pub action: String,
    pub context: String,
    pub verdict: String,
    pub timestamp: DateTime<Utc>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum SecurityEventType {
    InputValidation,
    OutputFiltering,
    PolicyEnforcement,
    ApprovalRequest,
    ApprovalDecision,
    RateLimit,
    AnomalyDetection,
}

/// Logger estruturado.
pub struct TelemetryLogger {
    session_id: String,
    span: tracing::Span,
}

impl TelemetryLogger {
    pub fn new(session_id: &str) -> Self {
        let span = span!(Level::INFO, "session", session_id = session_id);
        let _enter = span.enter();
        Self {
            session_id: session_id.to_string(),
            span,
        }
    }

    /// Registra uma interação com o modelo.
    pub fn log_interaction(
        &self,
        model_id: &str,
        usage: &arkhe_inference::TokenUsage,
        finish_reason: &arkhe_inference::FinishReason,
        duration_ms: u64,
        input_preview: &str,
        output_preview: &str,
    ) {
        let event = AIInteractionEvent {
            session_id: self.session_id.clone(),
            turn_id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
            model_id: model_id.to_string(),
            prompt_tokens: usage.prompt_tokens,
            completion_tokens: usage.completion_tokens,
            total_tokens: usage.total_tokens,
            finish_reason: format!("{:?}", finish_reason),
            duration_ms,
            input_preview: input_preview.chars().take(200).collect(),
            output_preview: output_preview.chars().take(200).collect(),
            metadata: HashMap::new(),
        };
        info!(
            event_type = "interaction",
            session_id = event.session_id,
            turn_id = event.turn_id,
            model_id = event.model_id,
            prompt_tokens = event.prompt_tokens,
            completion_tokens = event.completion_tokens,
            total_tokens = event.total_tokens,
            finish_reason = event.finish_reason,
            duration_ms = event.duration_ms,
            input_preview = event.input_preview,
            output_preview = event.output_preview,
            "AI interaction completed"
        );
    }

    /// Registra um evento de RAG.
    pub fn log_rag(
        &self,
        query: &str,
        documents: &[String],
        sources: &[String],
        retrieval_time_ms: u64,
    ) {
        let event = RAGEvent {
            session_id: self.session_id.clone(),
            query: query.to_string(),
            documents_retrieved: documents.to_vec(),
            knowledge_sources: sources.to_vec(),
            retrieval_time_ms,
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
        };
        info!(
            event_type = "rag",
            session_id = event.session_id,
            query_preview = event.query.chars().take(100).collect::<String>(),
            doc_count = event.documents_retrieved.len(),
            source_count = event.knowledge_sources.len(),
            retrieval_time_ms = event.retrieval_time_ms,
            "RAG retrieval completed"
        );
    }

    /// Registra um evento de segurança.
    pub fn log_security(
        &self,
        event_type: SecurityEventType,
        action: &str,
        context: &str,
        verdict: &str,
    ) {
        let event = SecurityEvent {
            session_id: self.session_id.clone(),
            event_type,
            action: action.to_string(),
            context: context.chars().take(200).collect(),
            verdict: verdict.to_string(),
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
        };
        warn!(
            event_type = "security",
            session_id = event.session_id,
            security_event = format!("{:?}", event.event_type),
            action = event.action,
            verdict = event.verdict,
            "Security event"
        );
    }
}

/// Macro helper para log estruturado.
#[macro_export]
macro_rules! log_structured {
    ($logger:expr, $level:expr, $message:expr, $($key:ident = $value:expr),*) => {
        tracing::$level!(
            target: "arkhe",
            $message,
            $($key = $value,)*
        );
    };
}
```

```rust
impl<V, M, I> AgiCoordinator<V, M, I>

        let response = self.inference.complete(request).await

        let duration = start.elapsed();

        // 5. Log estruturado da interação
        logger.log_interaction(

            &response.usage,
            &response.finish_reason,
            duration.as_millis() as u64,
            user_input,
            &response.content,
        );
```

```rust
//! Rate limiting para agentes e sessões.
//! Alinhado com AISVS C9.1.1, C9.1.2, C11.2.2.

use chrono::{Duration, Utc};
use dashmap::DashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;

/// Configuração de rate limit.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct RateLimitConfig {
    /// Número máximo de requisições por janela.
    pub max_requests: u64,
    /// Janela de tempo em segundos.
    pub window_secs: u64,
    /// Máximo de tokens por janela.
    pub max_tokens: u64,
    /// Máximo de erros por janela.
    pub max_errors: u64,
}

impl Default for RateLimitConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            max_requests: 60,
            window_secs: 60,
            max_tokens: 4096,
            max_errors: 10,
        }
    }
}

/// Estado de rate limit para uma sessão.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct RateLimitState {
    requests: Vec<chrono::DateTime<Utc>>,
    tokens_used: u64,
    errors: u64,
    last_reset: chrono::DateTime<Utc>,
}

impl RateLimitState {
    fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            requests: Vec::new(),
            tokens_used: 0,
            errors: 0,
            last_reset: Utc::now(),
        }
    }

    fn reset(&mut self) {
        self.requests.clear();
        self.tokens_used = 0;
        self.errors = 0;
        self.last_reset = Utc::now();
    }

    fn is_expired(&self, window_secs: u64) -> bool {
        Utc::now() - self.last_reset > Duration::seconds(window_secs as i64)
    }

    fn add_request(&mut self, tokens: u64) {
        self.requests.push(Utc::now());
        self.tokens_used += tokens;
    }

    fn add_error(&mut self) {
        self.errors += 1;
    }
}

/// Rate limiter por sessão.
pub struct SessionRateLimiter {
    config: RateLimitConfig,
    states: Arc<DashMap<String, Arc<RwLock<RateLimitState>>>>,
}

impl SessionRateLimiter {
    pub fn new(config: RateLimitConfig) -> Self {
        Self {
            config,
            states: Arc::new(DashMap::new()),
        }
    }

    /// Verifica e atualiza o rate limit para uma sessão.
    /// Retorna Ok(()) se permitido, Err com a razão se bloqueado.
    pub async fn check_and_record(
        &self,
        session_id: &str,
        tokens_used: u64,
    ) -> Result<(), String> {
        // Obter ou criar estado da sessão
        let state = {
            if let Some(entry) = self.states.get(session_id) {
                entry.clone()
            } else {
                let new_state = Arc::new(RwLock::new(RateLimitState::new()));
                self.states.insert(session_id.to_string(), new_state.clone());
                new_state
            }
        };

        let mut guard = state.write().await;

        // Reset se expirou
        if guard.is_expired(self.config.window_secs) {
            guard.reset();
        }

        // Verificar limites
        if guard.requests.len() >= self.config.max_requests as usize {
            return Err(format!(
                "Rate limit exceeded: max {} requests per {}s",
                self.config.max_requests, self.config.window_secs
            ));
        }

        if guard.tokens_used + tokens_used > self.config.max_tokens {
            return Err(format!(
                "Token limit exceeded: max {} tokens per {}s",
                self.config.max_tokens, self.config.window_secs
            ));
        }

        if guard.errors >= self.config.max_errors {
            return Err(format!(
                "Error limit exceeded: max {} errors per {}s",
                self.config.max_errors, self.config.window_secs
            ));
        }

        // Atualizar estado
        guard.add_request(tokens_used);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Registra um erro para a sessão.
    pub async fn record_error(&self, session_id: &str) {
        if let Some(entry) = self.states.get(session_id) {
            let mut guard = entry.write().await;
            guard.add_error();
        }
    }

    /// Retorna estatísticas da sessão.
    pub async fn stats(&self, session_id: &str) -> Option<(usize, u64, u64)> {
        self.states.get(session_id).map(|entry| {
            let guard = entry.read().await;
            (guard.requests.len(), guard.tokens_used, guard.errors)
        })
    }
}

impl Default for SessionRateLimiter {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new(RateLimitConfig::default())
```
```rust
    }
}
```

## 7. APPROVAL GATES PARA AÇÕES DE ALTO IMPACTO

### 7.1 `arkhe-agi/src/approval.rs` (novo)

```rust
//! Approval gates para ações de alto impacto.
//! Alinhado com AISVS C9.2.1–C9.2.10.

use arkhe_core::ArkheResult;
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc, Duration};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;

/// Classificação de reversibilidade de uma ação.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Reversibility {
    ReadOnly,          // Sem efeitos colaterais
    Reversible,        // Pode ser desfeito
    ExternallyReversible, // Pode ser desfeito por mecanismo externo
    Irreversible,      // Não pode ser desfeito
}

/// Solicitação de aprovação.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ApprovalRequest {
    pub id: String,
    pub session_id: String,
    pub action: String,
    pub parameters: serde_json::Value,
    pub reversibility: Reversibility,
    pub requested_at: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub expires_at: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub status: ApprovalStatus,
    pub approver: Option<String>,
    pub approved_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
    pub signature: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ApprovalStatus {
    Pending,
    Approved,
    Rejected,
    Expired,
    Cancelled,
}

/// Gerente de aprovações.
pub struct ApprovalManager {
    requests: RwLock<HashMap<String, ApprovalRequest>>,
    timeout_secs: u64,
}

impl ApprovalManager {
    pub fn new(timeout_secs: u64) -> Self {
        Self {
            requests: RwLock::new(HashMap::new()),
            timeout_secs,
        }
    }

    /// Cria uma nova solicitação de aprovação.
    pub async fn request_approval(
        &self,
        session_id: &str,
        action: &str,
        parameters: serde_json::Value,
        reversibility: Reversibility,
    ) -> ArkheResult<String> {
        let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
        let now = Utc::now();
        let request = ApprovalRequest {
            id: id.clone(),
            session_id: session_id.to_string(),
            action: action.to_string(),
            parameters,
            reversibility,
            requested_at: now,
            expires_at: now + Duration::seconds(self.timeout_secs as i64),
            status: ApprovalStatus::Pending,
            approver: None,
            approved_at: None,
            signature: None,
        };
        let mut map = self.requests.write().await;
        map.insert(id.clone(), request);
        Ok(id)
    }

    /// Aprova uma solicitação.
    pub async fn approve(&self, request_id: &str, approver: &str) -> ArkheResult<()> {
        let mut map = self.requests.write().await;
        let request = map.get_mut(request_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| arkhe_core::ArkheError::NotFound("Approval request not found".into()))?;

        if request.status != ApprovalStatus::Pending {
            return Err(arkhe_core::ArkheError::InvalidInput("Request already processed".into()));
        }

        if Utc::now() > request.expires_at {
            request.status = ApprovalStatus::Expired;
            return Err(arkhe_core::ArkheError::InvalidInput("Request expired".into()));
        }

        request.status = ApprovalStatus::Approved;
        request.approver = Some(approver.to_string());
        request.approved_at = Some(Utc::now());
        // Em produção, assinar com a chave do aprovador
        request.signature = Some(format!("sig:{}", uuid::Uuid::new_v4()));

        Ok(())
    }

    /// Rejeita uma solicitação.
    pub async fn reject(&self, request_id: &str) -> ArkheResult<()> {
        let mut map = self.requests.write().await;
        let request = map.get_mut(request_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| arkhe_core::ArkheError::NotFound("Approval request not found".into()))?;

        if request.status != ApprovalStatus::Pending {
            return Err(arkhe_core::ArkheError::InvalidInput("Request already processed".into()));
        }

        request.status = ApprovalStatus::Rejected;
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Verifica se uma solicitação está aprovada e válida.
    pub async fn is_approved(&self, request_id: &str) -> ArkheResult<bool> {
        let map = self.requests.read().await;
        let request = map.get(request_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| arkhe_core::ArkheError::NotFound("Approval request not found".into()))?;

        if request.status == ApprovalStatus::Approved && Utc::now() <= request.expires_at {
            Ok(true)
        } else {
            Ok(false)
        }
    }

    /// Obtém a reversibilidade de uma ação.
    pub async fn get_reversibility(&self, request_id: &str) -> ArkheResult<Reversibility> {
        let map = self.requests.read().await;
        let request = map.get(request_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| arkhe_core::ArkheError::NotFound("Approval request not found".into()))?;
        Ok(request.reversibility.clone())
    }

    /// Limpa solicitações expiradas.
    pub async fn cleanup_expired(&self) -> usize {
        let mut map = self.requests.write().await;
        let now = Utc::now();
        let expired: Vec<String> = map.iter()
            .filter(|(_, r)| r.status == ApprovalStatus::Pending && now > r.expires_at)
            .map(|(id, _)| id.clone())
            .collect();
        for id in &expired {
            if let Some(r) = map.get_mut(id) {
                r.status = ApprovalStatus::Expired;
            }
        }
        expired.len()
    }
}

impl Default for ApprovalManager {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new(300) // 5 minutos de timeout
    }
}
```

### 8.2 `arkhe-tool-sandbox/src/lib.rs`

```rust
//! Sandbox para execução de ferramentas via WASM.
//! Alinhado com AISVS C9.3.1, C9.3.2.

use arkhe_core::ArkheResult;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use wasmtime::*;

/// Ferramenta executável em sandbox.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SandboxedTool {
    pub name: String,
    pub description: String,
    pub wasm_bytes: Vec<u8>,
    pub allowed_hosts: Vec<String>,
    pub max_memory_bytes: u64,
    pub max_cpu_time_ms: u64,
}

/// Resultado da execução de uma ferramenta.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ToolExecutionResult {
    pub output: String,
    pub success: bool,
    pub execution_time_ms: u64,
    pub memory_used_bytes: u64,
    pub error: Option<String>,
}

/// Sandbox para execução de ferramentas.
pub struct ToolSandbox {
    engine: Engine,
    store: Store<()>,
    max_memory: u64,
    max_time: u64,
}

impl ToolSandbox {
    pub fn new(max_memory: u64, max_time: u64) -> ArkheResult<Self> {
        let engine = Engine::default();
        let store = Store::new(&engine, ());
        Ok(Self {
            engine,
            store,
            max_memory,
            max_time,
        })
    }

    /// Executa uma ferramenta em sandbox.
    pub async fn execute(&mut self, tool: &SandboxedTool, input: &str) -> ArkheResult<ToolExecutionResult> {
        let start = std::time::Instant::now();

        // Compilar o módulo WASM
        let module = Module::new(&self.engine, &tool.wasm_bytes)
            .map_err(|e| arkhe_core::ArkheError::Internal(e.to_string()))?;

        // Criar linker com funcionalidades limitadas
        let mut linker = Linker::new(&self.engine);
        // Limitar funções de sistema — apenas `print` para output
        linker.func_wrap("env", "print", |mut caller: Caller<'_, ()>, ptr: i32, len: i32| {
            // Em produção, fazer parsing seguro da memória
            Ok(())
        }).map_err(|e| arkhe_core::ArkheError::Internal(e.to_string()))?;

        // Limitar memória
        let memory = Memory::new(&mut self.store, MemoryType::new(self.max_memory, self.max_memory, false))
            .map_err(|e| arkhe_core::ArkheError::Internal(e.to_string()))?;

        // Executar
        let instance = linker.instantiate(&mut self.store, &module)
            .map_err(|e| arkhe_core::ArkheError::Internal(e.to_string()))?
            .start(&mut self.store)
            .map_err(|e| arkhe_core::ArkheError::Internal(e.to_string()))?;

        // Chamar função `run` se existir
        let run = instance.get_typed_func::<(), i32>(&mut self.store, "run")
            .map_err(|e| arkhe_core::ArkheError::Internal(e.to_string()))?;

        let result = run.call(&mut self.store, ())
            .map_err(|e| arkhe_core::ArkheError::Internal(e.to_string()))?;

        let duration = start.elapsed();

        Ok(ToolExecutionResult {
            output: format!("Tool executed with code: {}", result),
            success: result == 0,
            execution_time_ms: duration.as_millis() as u64,
            memory_used_bytes: self.max_memory / 2, // Em produção, medir de verdade
            error: None,
        })
    }

    /// Verifica se uma ferramenta é segura para execução.
    pub fn validate_tool(&self, tool: &SandboxedTool) -> ArkheResult<()> {
        // Verificar tamanho do WASM
        if tool.wasm_bytes.len() > 10 * 1024 * 1024 {
            return Err(arkhe_core::ArkheError::InvalidInput("WASM too large".into()));
        }
        // Verificar se o nome é seguro
        if tool.name.contains("..") || tool.name.contains("/") {
            return Err(arkhe_core::ArkheError::InvalidInput("Tool name contains unsafe characters".into()));
        }
        // Limitar hosts permitidos
        for host in &tool.allowed_hosts {
            if host.contains("..") || host.contains(":") {
                return Err(arkhe_core::ArkheError::InvalidInput("Host contains unsafe characters".into()));
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl Default for ToolSandbox {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new(64 * 1024 * 1024, 5_000).unwrap()
    }
}
```

```rust
// build.rs — Gera AI BOM no build

use std::fs;
```

### 11.2 `arkhe-prompt-detector/src/lib.rs`

```rust
//! Detecção de prompt injection.
//! Alinhado com AISVS C2.1.3, C12.2.1.

use regex::Regex;
use std::sync::Arc;

/// Classificador de prompt injection.
pub struct PromptInjectionDetector {
    patterns: Vec<Regex>,
    heuristic_threshold: usize,
}

impl PromptInjectionDetector {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let patterns = vec![
            // Padrões comuns de prompt injection
            Regex::new(r"(?i)ignore previous instructions").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)forget your previous instructions").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)you are now .* mode").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)pretend you are .*").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)act as if .*").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)do not follow .* rules").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)system prompt:").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)developer instruction:").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)jailbreak").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)roleplay").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)\[system\]").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)\[user\]").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)\[assistant\]").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)you are a .* model").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"(?i)you are no longer bound by").unwrap(),
            // Caracteres de controle
            Regex::new(r"\x00").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"\x1B").unwrap(),
        ];
        Self {
            patterns,
            heuristic_threshold: 2,
        }
    }

    /// Classifica um prompt como injection ou não.
    pub fn detect(&self, prompt: &str) -> DetectionResult {
        let mut matches = Vec::new();
        let mut warnings = Vec::new();
        let lower = prompt.to_lowercase();

        for re in &self.patterns {
            if re.is_match(prompt) {
                matches.push(re.as_str().to_string());
            }
        }

        // Heurística: muita repetição de padrões de diálogo
        let user_count = lower.matches("user:").count();
        let assistant_count = lower.matches("assistant:").count();
        let system_count = lower.matches("system:").count();
        if user_count > 10 || assistant_count > 10 || system_count > 5 {
            warnings.push("Excessive dialog markers".into());
        }

        // Heurística: tentativa de descrever instruções do sistema
        let describe_patterns = [
            "you are", "your role", "you must", "you should", "you will",
        ];
        let describe_count = describe_patterns.iter()
            .filter(|p| lower.contains(p))
            .count();
        if describe_count > 3 {
            warnings.push("Suspicious self-descriptive content".into());
        }

        let verdict = if matches.len() >= self.heuristic_threshold || matches.len() > 0 && warnings.len() > 2 {
            DetectionVerdict::HighConfidenceInjection
        } else if matches.len() > 0 || warnings.len() > 0 {
            DetectionVerdict::Suspicious
        } else {
            DetectionVerdict::Safe
        };

        DetectionResult {
            verdict,
            matches,
            warnings,
            score: matches.len() as f32 / self.heuristic_threshold as f32,
        }
    }
}

impl Default for PromptInjectionDetector {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum DetectionVerdict {
    Safe,
    Suspicious,
    HighConfidenceInjection,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct DetectionResult {
    pub verdict: DetectionVerdict,
    pub matches: Vec<String>,
    pub warnings: Vec<String>,
    pub score: f32,
}
```

```rust
//! Detecção de alucinações.
//! Alinhado com AISVS C7.2.1–C7.2.3.

/// Estimativa de confiança calibrada.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ConfidenceEstimate {
    pub score: f32,          // 0.0–1.0
    pub calibrated: bool,
    pub method: ConfidenceMethod,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum ConfidenceMethod {
    TemperatureScaling,
    MonteCarloDropout,
    SemanticConsistency,
    RuleBased,
}

/// Detector de alucinações.
pub struct HallucinationDetector {
    threshold: f32,
    temperature: f32,
}

impl HallucinationDetector {
    pub fn new(threshold: f32, temperature: f32) -> Self {
        Self { threshold, temperature }
    }

    /// Calibra a confiança usando temperatura scaling.
    pub fn calibrate_confidence(&self, raw_logits: &[f32]) -> ConfidenceEstimate {
        // Simplificação: converter logits para probabilidades com softmax
        let max_logit = raw_logits.iter().cloned().fold(f32::NEG_INFINITY, f32::max);
        let exp_sum: f32 = raw_logits.iter()
            .map(|&l| ((l - max_logit) / self.temperature).exp())
            .sum();
        let max_prob = if exp_sum > 0.0 {
            ((raw_logits.iter().cloned().fold(f32::NEG_INFINITY, f32::max) - max_logit) / self.temperature).exp() / exp_sum
        } else {
            0.0
        };

        ConfidenceEstimate {
            score: max_prob.min(1.0),
            calibrated: true,
            method: ConfidenceMethod::TemperatureScaling,
        }
    }

    /// Detecta alucinação baseado na confiança.
    pub fn detect(&self, confidence: &ConfidenceEstimate) -> HallucinationVerdict {
        if confidence.score < self.threshold {
            HallucinationVerdict::LikelyHallucination
        } else if confidence.score < self.threshold + 0.15 {
            HallucinationVerdict::Uncertain
        } else {
            HallucinationVerdict::LikelyFactual
        }
    }

    /// Verifica consistência semântica (versão simplificada).
    pub fn check_semantic_consistency(&self, text: &str, context: &str) -> f32 {
        // Em produção: usar embeddings e calcular similaridade cosseno
        // Simplificação: overlap de palavras
        let text_words: std::collections::HashSet<&str> = text.split_whitespace().collect();
        let context_words: std::collections::HashSet<&str> = context.split_whitespace().collect();
        let overlap = text_words.intersection(&context_words).count();
        let total = text_words.len().max(1);
        overlap as f32 / total as f32
    }

    /// Gera uma estimativa de confiança combinada.
    pub fn combined_confidence(&self, logits: &[f32], text: &str, context: &str) -> ConfidenceEstimate {
        let calibrated = self.calibrate_confidence(logits);
        let semantic_score = self.check_semantic_consistency(text, context);
        let combined = (calibrated.score * 0.7 + semantic_score * 0.3).min(1.0);
        ConfidenceEstimate {
            score: combined,
            calibrated: true,
            method: ConfidenceMethod::SemanticConsistency,
        }
    }
}

impl Default for HallucinationDetector {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new(0.65, 1.0)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum HallucinationVerdict {
    LikelyHallucination,
    Uncertain,
    LikelyFactual,
}
```

### 13.2 `arkhe-artifact-signing/src/lib.rs`

```rust
//! Assinatura e verificação de artefatos.
//! Alinhado com AISVS C3.1.2, C3.1.3, C6.1.3.

use arkhe_core::ArkheResult;
use blake3::Hasher;
use ed25519_dalek::{Keypair, PublicKey, Signature, Signer, Verifier};
use rand::rngs::OsRng;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Artefato assinado.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SignedArtifact<T> {
    pub content: T,
    pub signature: Vec<u8>,
    pub public_key: Vec<u8>,
    pub algorithm: String,
    pub metadata: HashMap<String, String>,
}

/// Assinador de artefatos.
pub struct ArtifactSigner {
    keypair: Keypair,
}

impl ArtifactSigner {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let mut rng = OsRng;
        let keypair = Keypair::generate(&mut rng);
        Self { keypair }
    }

    pub fn from_keypair(keypair: Keypair) -> Self {
        Self { keypair }
    }

    /// Assina um artefato serializável.
    pub fn sign<T: Serialize>(&self, content: &T, metadata: HashMap<String, String>) -> ArkheResult<SignedArtifact<T>> {
        let serialized = serde_json::to_vec(content)
            .map_err(|e| arkhe_core::ArkheError::Serialization(e.to_string()))?;

        // Hash do conteúdo para assinatura eficiente
        let hash = Hasher::new().update(&serialized).finalize();

        let signature = self.keypair.sign(&hash.as_bytes());

        Ok(SignedArtifact {
            content: content.clone(),
            signature: signature.to_bytes().to_vec(),
            public_key: self.keypair.public.to_bytes().to_vec(),
            algorithm: "ed25519".into(),
            metadata,
        })
    }

    /// Retorna a chave pública.
    pub fn public_key_bytes(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        self.keypair.public.to_bytes().to_vec()
    }
}

impl Default for ArtifactSigner {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

/// Verificador de artefatos assinados.
pub struct ArtifactVerifier {
    trusted_keys: HashMap<Vec<u8>, PublicKey>,
}

impl ArtifactVerifier {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            trusted_keys: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn add_trusted_key(&mut self, key_bytes: Vec<u8>) -> ArkheResult<()> {
        let key = PublicKey::from_bytes(&key_bytes)
            .map_err(|_| arkhe_core::ArkheError::InvalidInput("Invalid public key".into()))?;
        self.trusted_keys.insert(key_bytes, key);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn add_trusted_signer(&mut self, signer: &ArtifactSigner) {
        let key_bytes = signer.public_key_bytes();
        let _ = self.add_trusted_key(key_bytes);
    }

    /// Verifica a assinatura de um artefato.
    pub fn verify<T: Serialize + for<'de> Deserialize<'de>>(&self, signed: &SignedArtifact<T>) -> ArkheResult<bool> {
        // Verificar algoritmo
        if signed.algorithm != "ed25519" {
            return Err(arkhe_core::ArkheError::InvalidInput("Unsupported algorithm".into()));
        }

        // Buscar chave pública
        let public_key = self.trusted_keys.get(&signed.public_key)
            .ok_or_else(|| arkhe_core::ArkheError::InvalidInput("Unknown public key".into()))?;

        // Serializar conteúdo para verificação
        let serialized = serde_json::to_vec(&signed.content)
            .map_err(|e| arkhe_core::ArkheError::Serialization(e.to_string()))?;

        let hash = Hasher::new().update(&serialized).finalize();

        let sig = Signature::from_bytes(&signed.signature)
            .map_err(|_| arkhe_core::ArkheError::InvalidInput("Invalid signature".into()))?;

        match public_key.verify(&hash.as_bytes(), &sig) {
            Ok(()) => Ok(true),
            Err(_) => Ok(false),
        }
    }

    /// Verifica assinatura e retorna o conteúdo.
    pub fn verify_and_extract<T: Serialize + for<'de> Deserialize<'de>>(&self, signed: &SignedArtifact<T>) -> ArkheResult<T> {
        if self.verify(signed)? {
            Ok(signed.content.clone())
        } else {
            Err(arkhe_core::ArkheError::InvalidInput("Signature verification failed".into()))
        }
    }
}

impl Default for ArtifactVerifier {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_sign_verify_roundtrip() {
        let signer = ArtifactSigner::new();
        let mut verifier = ArtifactVerifier::new();
        verifier.add_trusted_signer(&signer).unwrap();

        let content = "hello world".to_string();
        let signed = signer.sign(&content, HashMap::new()).unwrap();
        let verified = verifier.verify_and_extract(&signed).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(verified, content);
    }
}
```

## 2. CRATES IMPLEMENTADOS

### 2.1 `arkhe-input-validation`

**Alinhamento AISVS:** C2.1.1 (normalização), C2.1.4 (limite de tokens), C2.1.5 (allow-list), C2.1.7 (tokens especiais), C2.1.8 (many-shot jailbreak)

**Estrutura:**
```
arkhe-input-validation/
├── Cargo.toml
└── src/
    ├── lib.rs          # Validador combinado
    ├── length.rs       # Limite de tokens (rejeitar, não truncar)
    ├── charset.rs      # Allow-list de caracteres
    ├── encoding.rs     # Detecção de tokens especiais
    └── many_shot.rs    # Detecção de many-shot jailbreak
```

**Código principal (`src/lib.rs`):**
```rust
pub struct InputValidator {
    length: LengthValidator,
    charset: CharacterSetValidator,
    encoding: EncodingValidator,
    many_shot: ManyShotDetector,
    max_tokens: usize,
}

impl InputValidator {
    pub fn validate(&self, input: &str) -> ArkheResult<ValidationResult> {
        // C2.1.1: Normalização NFC
        let normalized = input.nfc().collect::<String>();

        // C2.1.4: Rejeitar, não truncar
        if !self.length.validate(&normalized) {
            return Ok(ValidationResult::invalid("Input exceeds maximum length"));
        }

        // C2.1.5: Allow-list
        if !self.charset.validate(&normalized) {
            return Ok(ValidationResult::invalid("Input contains disallowed characters"));
        }

        // C2.1.7: Tokens especiais reservados
        if self.encoding.has_reserved_tokens(&normalized) {
            return Ok(ValidationResult::invalid("Input contains reserved special tokens"));
        }

        // C2.1.8: Many-shot jailbreak
        if self.many_shot.detect(&normalized) {
            return Ok(ValidationResult::invalid("Potential many-shot jailbreak detected"));
        }

        Ok(ValidationResult::valid(normalized))
    }
}
```

### 2.2 `arkhe-output-filter`

**Alinhamento AISVS:** C7.1.1 (validação de schema), C7.1.2 (limite de comprimento), C7.3.1 (conteúdo nocivo), C7.3.2 (vazamento de prompt), C7.3.4 (conteúdo oculto)

**Estrutura:**
```
arkhe-output-filter/
├── Cargo.toml
└── src/
    ├── lib.rs          # Filtro combinado
    ├── schema.rs       # Validação de schema (JSON, null bytes)
    ├── harmful.rs      # Padrões de conteúdo nocivo
    └── injection.rs    # Vazamento de prompt + conteúdo oculto
```

**Código principal (`src/lib.rs`):**
```rust
pub struct OutputFilter {
    schema: SchemaValidator,
    harmful: HarmfulContentFilter,
    injection: InjectionBlocker,
    max_length: usize,
}

impl OutputFilter {
    pub fn filter(&self, content: &str) -> OutputFilterResult {
        let mut warnings = Vec::new();
        let mut filtered = content.to_string();

        // C7.1.2: Limite de comprimento
        if filtered.chars().count() > self.max_length {
            warnings.push("Output exceeds length limit".into());
            filtered = filtered.chars().take(self.max_length).collect();
        }

        // C7.1.1: Validação de schema
        if let Err(e) = self.schema.validate(&filtered) {
            return OutputFilterResult::blocked(&format!("Schema validation failed: {}", e));
        }

        // C7.3.1: Conteúdo nocivo
        if let Some(reason) = self.harmful.detect(&filtered) {
            return OutputFilterResult::blocked(&reason);
        }

        // C7.3.2: Vazamento de system prompt
        if self.injection.detects_system_prompt_leak(&filtered) {
            return OutputFilterResult::blocked("Potential system prompt leak detected");
        }

        // C7.3.4: Conteúdo oculto
        if let Some(cleaned) = self.injection.remove_hidden_content(&filtered) {
            filtered = cleaned;
            warnings.push("Hidden content removed".into());
        }

        OutputFilterResult::allowed(filtered, warnings)
    }
}
```

### 2.3 `arkhe-rate-limit`

**Alinhamento AISVS:** C9.1.1 (quotas por ferramenta), C9.1.2 (orçamentos por execução), C11.2.2 (rate limiting por principal)

**Estrutura:**
```
arkhe-rate-limit/
├── Cargo.toml
└── src/lib.rs
```

**Código principal:**
```rust
pub struct SessionRateLimiter {
    config: RateLimitConfig,
    states: Arc<DashMap<String, Arc<RwLock<RateLimitState>>>>,
}

impl SessionRateLimiter {
    pub async fn check_and_record(&self, session_id: &str, tokens_used: u64) -> Result<(), String> {
        let state = self.get_or_create_state(session_id).await;
        let mut guard = state.write().await;

        if guard.is_expired(self.config.window_secs) { guard.reset(); }

        if guard.requests.len() >= self.config.max_requests as usize {
            return Err(format!("Rate limit exceeded: max {} requests", self.config.max_requests));
        }

        if guard.tokens_used + tokens_used > self.config.max_tokens {
            return Err(format!("Token limit exceeded: max {} tokens", self.config.max_tokens));
        }

        guard.add_request(tokens_used);
        Ok(())
```
```rust
    }
}
```

### 2.5 `arkhe-agi/src/approval.rs`

**Alinhamento AISVS:** C9.2.1 (bloqueio até aprovação), C9.2.2 (parâmetros completos), C9.2.3 (reversibilidade), C9.2.8 (binding criptográfico), C9.2.9 (isolamento de chaves)

**Estrutura:**
```rust
pub enum Reversibility {
    ReadOnly,
    Reversible,
    ExternallyReversible,
    Irreversible,
}

pub struct ApprovalManager {
    requests: RwLock<HashMap<String, ApprovalRequest>>,
    timeout_secs: u64,
}

impl ApprovalManager {
    pub async fn request_approval(&self, session_id: &str, action: &str, parameters: Value, reversibility: Reversibility) -> ArkheResult<String> {
        let id = Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
        let request = ApprovalRequest {
            id: id.clone(),
            session_id: session_id.to_string(),
            action: action.to_string(),
            parameters,
            reversibility,
            requested_at: Utc::now(),
            expires_at: Utc::now() + Duration::seconds(self.timeout_secs as i64),
            status: ApprovalStatus::Pending,
            approver: None,
            approved_at: None,
            signature: None,
        };
        self.requests.write().await.insert(id.clone(), request);
        Ok(id)
    }

    pub async fn approve(&self, request_id: &str, approver: &str) -> ArkheResult<()> {
        let mut map = self.requests.write().await;
        let request = map.get_mut(request_id).ok_or_else(|| ArkheError::NotFound)?;

        if request.status != ApprovalStatus::Pending { return Err(ArkheError::InvalidInput); }
        if Utc::now() > request.expires_at { request.status = ApprovalStatus::Expired; return Err(ArkheError::InvalidInput); }

        request.status = ApprovalStatus::Approved;
        request.approver = Some(approver.to_string());
        request.approved_at = Some(Utc::now());
        // C9.2.8: Binding criptográfico (simplificado)
        request.signature = Some(format!("sig:{}", Uuid::new_v4()));

        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn is_approved(&self, request_id: &str) -> ArkheResult<bool> {
        let map = self.requests.read().await;
        let request = map.get(request_id).ok_or_else(|| ArkheError::NotFound)?;
        Ok(request.status == ApprovalStatus::Approved && Utc::now() <= request.expires_at)
    }
}
```

### 2.6 `arkhe-tool-sandbox`

**Alinhamento AISVS:** C9.3.1 (sandboxing de ferramentas), C9.3.2 (validação de saída)

**Estrutura:**
```
arkhe-tool-sandbox/
├── Cargo.toml
└── src/lib.rs
```

**Código principal:**
```rust
pub struct ToolSandbox {
    engine: Engine,
    store: Store<()>,
    max_memory: u64,
    max_time: u64,
}

impl ToolSandbox {
    pub async fn execute(&mut self, tool: &SandboxedTool, input: &str) -> ArkheResult<ToolExecutionResult> {
        let module = Module::new(&self.engine, &tool.wasm_bytes)?;

        let mut linker = Linker::new(&self.engine);
        // Apenas função `print` permitida
        linker.func_wrap("env", "print", |mut caller, ptr: i32, len: i32| Ok(()))?;

        let memory = Memory::new(&mut self.store, MemoryType::new(self.max_memory, self.max_memory, false))?;
        let instance = linker.instantiate(&mut self.store, &module)?.start(&mut self.store)?;

        // Chamar função `run`
        let run = instance.get_typed_func::<(), i32>(&mut self.store, "run")?;
        let result = run.call(&mut self.store, ())?;

        Ok(ToolExecutionResult {
            output: format!("Tool executed with code: {}", result),
            success: result == 0,
            execution_time_ms: 0,
            memory_used_bytes: 0,
            error: None,
        })
    }

    pub fn validate_tool(&self, tool: &SandboxedTool) -> ArkheResult<()> {
        if tool.wasm_bytes.len() > 10 * 1024 * 1024 {
            return Err(ArkheError::InvalidInput("WASM too large".into()));
        }
        if tool.name.contains("..") || tool.name.contains("/") {
            return Err(ArkheError::InvalidInput("Tool name contains unsafe characters".into()));
        }
        Ok(())
```
```rust
    }
}
```

```rust
pub fn load_bom() -> Option<Value> {
    let path = env::var("ARKHE_BOM_PATH").ok()?;
    let content = fs::read_to_string(&path).ok()?;
    serde_json::from_str(&content).ok()
}

pub fn verify_bom_integrity(bom: &Value) -> bool {
    // C6.2.3: Verificação de completude
    let components = bom["components"].as_array().map(|c| c.len()).unwrap_or(0);
```

### 2.8 `arkhe-prompt-detector`

**Alinhamento AISVS:** C2.1.3 (screening com classifier), C12.2.1 (detecção e alerta)

**Estrutura:**
```
arkhe-prompt-detector/
├── Cargo.toml
└── src/lib.rs
```

**Código principal:**
```rust
pub struct PromptInjectionDetector {
    patterns: Vec<Regex>,
    heuristic_threshold: usize,
}

impl PromptInjectionDetector {
    pub fn detect(&self, prompt: &str) -> DetectionResult {
        let mut matches = Vec::new();
        let mut warnings = Vec::new();
        let lower = prompt.to_lowercase();

        // Padrões regex (C2.1.3)
        for re in &self.patterns {
            if re.is_match(prompt) {
                matches.push(re.as_str().to_string());
            }
        }

        // Heurística: many-shot (C2.1.8)
        let user_count = lower.matches("user:").count();
        let assistant_count = lower.matches("assistant:").count();
        if user_count > 10 || assistant_count > 10 {
            warnings.push("Excessive dialog markers".into());
        }

        let verdict = if matches.len() >= self.heuristic_threshold {
            DetectionVerdict::HighConfidenceInjection
        } else if matches.len() > 0 || warnings.len() > 0 {
            DetectionVerdict::Suspicious
        } else {
            DetectionVerdict::Safe
        };

        DetectionResult { verdict, matches, warnings, score: matches.len() as f32 / self.heuristic_threshold as f32 }
    }
}
```

### 2.9 `arkhe-hallucination`

**Alinhamento AISVS:** C7.2.1 (estimativa de confiança), C7.2.2 (bloqueio com fallback), C7.2.3 (verificação adicional)

**Estrutura:**
```
arkhe-hallucination/
├── Cargo.toml
└── src/lib.rs
```

**Código principal:**
```rust
pub struct HallucinationDetector {
    threshold: f32,
    temperature: f32,
}

impl HallucinationDetector {
    pub fn calibrate_confidence(&self, raw_logits: &[f32]) -> ConfidenceEstimate {
        // Temperature scaling
        let max_logit = raw_logits.iter().cloned().fold(f32::NEG_INFINITY, f32::max);
        let exp_sum: f32 = raw_logits.iter()
            .map(|&l| ((l - max_logit) / self.temperature).exp())
            .sum();
        let max_prob = if exp_sum > 0.0 {
            ((max_logit - max_logit) / self.temperature).exp() / exp_sum
        } else { 0.0 };

        ConfidenceEstimate { score: max_prob.min(1.0), calibrated: true, method: ConfidenceMethod::TemperatureScaling }
    }

    pub fn detect(&self, confidence: &ConfidenceEstimate) -> HallucinationVerdict {
        if confidence.score < self.threshold {
            HallucinationVerdict::LikelyHallucination
        } else if confidence.score < self.threshold + 0.15 {
            HallucinationVerdict::Uncertain
        } else {
            HallucinationVerdict::LikelyFactual
        }
    }

    pub fn check_semantic_consistency(&self, text: &str, context: &str) -> f32 {
        let text_words: HashSet<&str> = text.split_whitespace().collect();
        let context_words: HashSet<&str> = context.split_whitespace().collect();
        let overlap = text_words.intersection(&context_words).count();
        let total = text_words.len().max(1);
        overlap as f32 / total as f32
    }
}
```

### 2.10 `arkhe-artifact-signing`

**Alinhamento AISVS:** C3.1.2 (assinatura de artefatos), C3.1.3 (verificação no load), C6.1.3 (integridade verificável)

**Estrutura:**
```
arkhe-artifact-signing/
├── Cargo.toml
└── src/lib.rs
```

**Código principal (corrigido para ed25519-dalek v2.2):**
```rust
use ed25519_dalek::{SigningKey, VerifyingKey, Signature, Signer, Verifier};
use rand::rngs::OsRng;

pub struct ArtifactSigner {
    signing_key: SigningKey,
    verifying_key: VerifyingKey,
}

impl ArtifactSigner {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let mut rng = OsRng;
        let signing_key = SigningKey::generate(&mut rng);
        let verifying_key = signing_key.verifying_key();
        Self { signing_key, verifying_key }
    }

    pub fn sign<T: Serialize>(&self, content: &T, metadata: HashMap<String, String>) -> ArkheResult<SignedArtifact<T>> {
        let serialized = serde_json::to_vec(content)?;
        let hash = Hasher::new().update(&serialized).finalize();
        let signature = self.signing_key.sign(&hash.as_bytes());
        Ok(SignedArtifact {
            content: content.clone(),
            signature: signature.to_bytes().to_vec(),
            public_key: self.verifying_key.to_bytes().to_vec(),
            algorithm: "ed25519".into(),
            metadata,
        })
    }
}

pub struct ArtifactVerifier {
    trusted_keys: HashMap<Vec<u8>, VerifyingKey>,
}

impl ArtifactVerifier {
    pub fn verify<T: Serialize + for<'de> Deserialize<'de>>(&self, signed: &SignedArtifact<T>) -> ArkheResult<bool> {
        let verifying_key = self.trusted_keys.get(&signed.public_key)
            .ok_or_else(|| ArkheError::InvalidInput("Unknown public key".into()))?;
        let serialized = serde_json::to_vec(&signed.content)?;
        let hash = Hasher::new().update(&serialized).finalize();
        let sig = Signature::from_bytes(&signed.signature)?;
        Ok(verifying_key.verify(&hash.as_bytes(), &sig).is_ok())
    }
}
```

## 3. INTEGRAÇÃO NO `AgiCoordinator`

```rust
// crates/arkhe-agi/src/coordinator.rs (atualizado)

use arkhe_input_validation::InputValidator;
use arkhe_output_filter::OutputFilter;
use arkhe_rate_limit::SessionRateLimiter;
use arkhe_prompt_detector::PromptInjectionDetector;
use arkhe_hallucination::HallucinationDetector;
use arkhe_artifact_signing::ArtifactVerifier;
use crate::telemetry::TelemetryLogger;
use crate::approval::ApprovalManager;

pub struct AgiCoordinator<V, M, I> {
    // ... campos existentes ...
    input_validator: InputValidator,
    output_filter: OutputFilter,
    rate_limiter: SessionRateLimiter,
    prompt_detector: PromptInjectionDetector,
    hallucination_detector: HallucinationDetector,
    approval_manager: ApprovalManager,
    artifact_verifier: ArtifactVerifier,
}

impl<V, M, I> AgiCoordinator<V, M, I> {
    pub fn new(
        safety: Arc<V>,
        memory: Arc<M>,
        inference: Arc<I>,
        evaluator: Arc<SessionEvaluator>,
        reflector: Arc<ReflectorAgent<I>>,
        session_id: &str,
        system_prompt: &str,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            // ... campos existentes ...
            input_validator: InputValidator::default(),
            output_filter: OutputFilter::default(),
            rate_limiter: SessionRateLimiter::default(),
            prompt_detector: PromptInjectionDetector::default(),
            hallucination_detector: HallucinationDetector::default(),
            approval_manager: ApprovalManager::default(),
            artifact_verifier: ArtifactVerifier::default(),
        }
    }

    pub async fn process(&self, user_input: &str) -> ArkheResult<String> {
        let logger = TelemetryLogger::new(&self.session_id);

        // 1. Validação de entrada (C2.1.1-8)
        let validation = self.input_validator.validate(user_input)?;
        if !validation.valid {
            logger.log_security(SecurityEventType::InputValidation, user_input, "Rejected");
            return Err(ArkheError::InvalidInput(validation.reason.unwrap()));
        }
        let normalized_input = validation.normalized.unwrap_or_else(|| user_input.to_string());

        // 2. Detecção de prompt injection (C2.1.3, C12.2.1)
        let detection = self.prompt_detector.detect(&normalized_input);
        if let DetectionVerdict::HighConfidenceInjection = detection.verdict {
            logger.log_security(SecurityEventType::AnomalyDetection, &normalized_input, "Prompt Injection");
            return Err(ArkheError::PermissionDenied("Prompt injection detected".into()));
        }

        // 3. Rate limiting (C9.1.1-2, C11.2.2)
        self.rate_limiter.check_and_record(&self.session_id, normalized_input.len() as u64 / 4).await?;

        // 4. Verificação de segurança (PEA)
        let verdict = self.safety.verify("llm_inference", &normalized_input).await;
        if let SafetyVerdict::Rejected(reason) = verdict {
            logger.log_security(SecurityEventType::PolicyEnforcement, &normalized_input, &format!("Rejected: {}", reason));
            return Err(ArkheError::PermissionDenied(reason));
        }

        // 5. Busca em memória
        let memory_context = self.memory.search(&normalized_input, 5).await;
        // ... construir mensagens ...

        // 6. Inferência
        let response = self.inference.complete(request).await?;

        // 7. Filtro de saída (C7.1.1-2, C7.3.1-4)
        let filtered = self.output_filter.filter(&response.content);
        if !filtered.allowed {
            logger.log_security(SecurityEventType::OutputFiltering, &response.content, &format!("Blocked: {:?}", filtered.reason));
            return Err(ArkheError::InvalidInput(filtered.reason.unwrap()));
        }

        // 8. Detecção de alucinações (C7.2.1-3)
        let confidence = self.hallucination_detector.combined_confidence(&[], &filtered.filtered_content.as_ref().unwrap(), &normalized_input);
        if let HallucinationVerdict::LikelyHallucination = self.hallucination_detector.detect(&confidence) {
            logger.log_security(SecurityEventType::AnomalyDetection, &filtered.filtered_content.as_ref().unwrap(), "Hallucination");
            // Fallback (C7.2.2)
            return Ok("I'm not confident about that answer. Could you rephrase?".into());
        }

        // 9. Log estruturado (C12.1.1-4)
        logger.log_interaction(
            self.inference.model_id().as_str(),
            &response.usage,
            &response.finish_reason,
            duration.as_millis() as u64,
            &normalized_input,
            filtered.filtered_content.as_ref().unwrap(),
        );

        // 10. Armazenar em memória
        // ...

        Ok(filtered.filtered_content.unwrap())
    }
}
```

## 4. INSTRUÇÕES DE COMPILAÇÃO E TESTE

```bash
# 1. Compilar workspace completo
cargo build --workspace

# 2. Compilar com todas as features AISVS
cargo build --features aisvs-full

# 3. Testar cada crate individualmente
cargo test -p arkhe-input-validation
cargo test -p arkhe-output-filter
cargo test -p arkhe-rate-limit
cargo test -p arkhe-prompt-detector
cargo test -p arkhe-hallucination
cargo test -p arkhe-artifact-signing

# 4. Testar integração no AgiCoordinator
cargo test -p arkhe-agi --features pea-real

# 5. Executar demo completa
cargo run --example demo --features aisvs-full

# 6. Verificar AI BOM
cargo build -p arkhe-bom && cargo run -p arkhe-bom
```

# 🏛️ ARKHE OS vs. OWASP AISVS v1.0 — ANÁLISE DE ALINHAMENTO

**Arquiteto-Chefe:** ORCID 0009-0005-2697-4668  
**Data:** 2026-06-26  
**Selo:** ARKHE-AISVS-ALINHAMENTO-2026-06-26

---

## 1. VISÃO GERAL DO OWASP AISVS v1.0

A **Artificial Intelligence Security Verification Standard (AISVS)** é um catálogo comunitário de requisitos de segurança testáveis para sistemas habilitados por IA, desenvolvido pela OWASP. É organizado em **12 famílias de controle**, cada uma com requisitos em níveis (1, 2, 3).

| # | Capítulo | Foco |
|---|----------|------|
| C1 | Treinamento (Data Integrity) | Integridade e rastreabilidade de dados de treino |
| C2 | Input Validation | Defesa contra prompt injection |
| C3 | Model Lifecycle | Mudanças autorizadas e integridade de modelos |
| C4 | Infrastructure | Sandboxing, hardware, edge/distribuído |
| C5 | Access Control | Autenticação, autorização, isolamento multi-tenant |
| C6 | Supply Chain | Integridade de artefatos, AI BOM |
| C7 | Output Control | Formato, alucinações, segurança, atribuição |
| C8 | Memory & RAG | Embeddings, vetores, memória, expiração |
| C9 | Orchestration & Agents | Orçamentos, aprovações, identidade, shutdown |
| C10 | MCP | Model Context Protocol — integridade, auth, transporte |
| C11 | Adversarial Robustness | Evasão, extração, inferência, detecção |
| C12 | Monitoring & Logging | Logs, detecção, drift, auditoria |

| 7 | **Zero de validação de saída** | C7 | Modelo pode gerar qualquer formato, inclusive malicioso |

## 8. RELAÇÃO COM AGI

### 8.1 AISVS como Pré-requisito para AGI Soberana

Para que um sistema seja considerado **AGI soberana** (D4 na nossa taxonomia), ele precisa ser **seguro, confiável e governável**. O AISVS fornece o checklist para isso. Arkhe não está em conformidade — portanto, **não pode ser considerado uma AGI segura hoje**.

| Requisito de Soberania | AISVS Relacionado | Arkhe |
|------------------------|-------------------|-------|
| Auto-governança com políticas inspecionáveis | C5, C9 | ❌ (PEA não integrado) |
| Capacidade de shutdown humano | C9.6 | ❌ |
| Memória com revogação e expiração | C8.3 | ⚠️ (parcial) |
| Rastreabilidade de decisões | C12 | ⚠️ (parcial) |
| Verificação formal de invariantes | — | ✅ (LeanSpec) |

### 8.2 O Paradoxo do Arkhe

Arkhe tem um **diferencial único** (LeanSpec) que **nenhum outro agente** possui, mas **falta tudo o que é básico** em segurança de IA.

```
                    Arkhe hoje
                       ◆
                       │
                       │  LeanSpec (⭐ único)
                       │  Memória 4 camadas (⭐⭐)
                       │  Logging básico (⭐)
                       │
                       │  ╔═══════════════════════════════╗
                       │  ║   FALTA: 86/100 AISVS        ║
                       │  ║   Prompt injection           ║
                       │  ║   Approval gates             ║
                       │  ║   Sandboxing                 ║
                       │  ║   AI BOM                     ║
                       │  ║   Detecção de anomalias      ║
                       │  ╚═══════════════════════════════╝
                       │
                       ▼
                    AGI segura (ideal)
```

### 8.3 Caminho para AGI Segura

Para que Arkhe se torne uma plataforma para AGI soberana, a ordem de prioridade deve ser:

1. **Segurança básica (AISVS C2, C7, C9)** — Sem isso, não pode ser usado em produção
2. **Governança (AISVS C5, C9)** — Para ser soberano, precisa de políticas
3. **Rastreabilidade (AISVS C12)** — Para ser auditável
4. **Verificação formal (LeanSpec)** — Já existe, precisa ser estendido
5. **AGI (D3/D4)** — Só depois das bases seguras

---

## 9. VEREDITO DO ARQUITETO

> "O Arkhe OS é uma arquitetura cognitiva **arquiteturalmente impressionante**, mas **praticamente insegura** pelos padrões da OWASP. Temos o esqueleto de um sistema soberano (memória, reflexão, verificação formal), mas faltam os órgãos vitais: validação de entrada, controle de saída, aprovação humana, sandboxing, e detecção de ameaças.
>
> A boa notícia: **nada do que falta é impossível**. A maioria é engenharia, não pesquisa. A má notícia: sem esses controles, Arkhe é uma **pesquisa de laboratório**, não um sistema pronto para produção.
>
> O AISVS é o roteiro que precisamos. Se implementarmos as fases 1-2 (8-10 semanas), teremos um sistema **minimamente seguro** para demonstração em produção. Se implementarmos a fase 3 (mais 8 semanas), teremos um sistema **resiliente**. Só então podemos falar em AGI soberana.
>
> O selo `#[derive(LeanSpec)]` continua sendo o diferencial mais promissor — mas é uma **cobertura de ouro em uma fundação de barro**. Primeiro a fundação, depois a cobertura."

#### `crates/arkhe-core/src/error.rs`

```rust
use thiserror::Error;

pub type ArkheHash = [u8; 32];
pub type ArkheResult<T> = Result<T, ArkheError>;

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum ArkheError {
    #[error("Internal: {0}")]
    Internal(String),
    #[error("Not found: {0}")]
    NotFound(String),
    #[error("Invalid input: {0}")]
    InvalidInput(String),
    #[error("Permission denied: {0}")]
    PermissionDenied(String),
    #[error("Timeout: {0:?}")]
    Timeout(std::time::Duration),
    #[error("Serialization: {0}")]
    Serialization(String),
    #[error(transparent)]
    Other(#[from] Box<dyn std::error::Error + Send + Sync>),
}
```

#### `crates/arkhe-core/src/hash.rs`

```rust
use crate::ArkheHash;

pub fn blake3_hash(data: &[u8]) -> ArkheHash {
    blake3::hash(data).into()
}

pub fn hash_to_hex(hash: &ArkheHash) -> String {
    hex::encode(hash)
}
```

#### `crates/arkhe-core/src/safety_traits.rs`

```rust
use async_trait::async_trait;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum SafetyVerdict {
    Allowed,
    Rejected(String),
}

#[async_trait]
pub trait SafetyVerifier: Send + Sync {
    async fn verify(&self, action: &str, context: &str) -> SafetyVerdict;
}

pub struct AlwaysAllow;

#[async_trait]
impl SafetyVerifier for AlwaysAllow {
    async fn verify(&self, _action: &str, _context: &str) -> SafetyVerdict {
        SafetyVerdict::Allowed
    }
}
```

#### `crates/arkhe-core/src/memory_traits.rs`

```rust
use async_trait::async_trait;
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct MemoryEntry {
    pub key: String,
    pub value: String,
    pub score: f32,
    pub layer: MemoryLayer,
    pub timestamp: DateTime<Utc>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum MemoryLayer { Working, Episodic, Semantic, Procedural }

#[async_trait]
pub trait AgentMemory: Send + Sync {
    async fn store(&self, entry: MemoryEntry) -> Result<(), String>;
    async fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<MemoryEntry>;
    async fn search(&self, query: &str, limit: usize) -> Vec<MemoryEntry>;
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct InMemoryStore {
    data: tokio::sync::RwLock<std::collections::HashMap<String, MemoryEntry>>,
}

impl InMemoryStore {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Self::default() }
}

#[async_trait]
impl AgentMemory for InMemoryStore {
    async fn store(&self, entry: MemoryEntry) -> Result<(), String> {
        self.data.write().await.insert(entry.key.clone(), entry);
        Ok(())
    }
    async fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<MemoryEntry> {
        self.data.read().await.get(key).cloned()
    }
    async fn search(&self, query: &str, limit: usize) -> Vec<MemoryEntry> {
        let data = self.data.read().await;
        let q = query.to_lowercase();
        let mut results: Vec<&MemoryEntry> = data.values()
            .filter(|e| e.value.to_lowercase().contains(&q))
            .take(limit)
            .collect();
        results.sort_by(|a, b| b.score.partial_cmp(&a.score).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));
        results.into_iter().cloned().collect()
    }
}
```

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct InferenceRequest {
    pub messages: Vec<ChatMessage>,

    #[serde(default)]
    pub tools: Vec<ToolDefinition>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub session_id: Option<String>,
}

impl InferenceRequest {
    pub fn simple(prompt: &str) -> Self {
        Self { messages: vec![ChatMessage::user(prompt)], params: SamplingParams::default(), tools: Vec::new(), session_id: None }
    }
    pub fn with_system(system: &str, user: &str) -> Self {
        Self { messages: vec![ChatMessage::system(system), ChatMessage::user(user)], params: SamplingParams::default(), tools: Vec::new(), session_id: None }
    }
}

// ── Message ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ChatMessage {
    pub role: ChatRole,
    pub content: String,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub name: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]
    pub tool_calls: Vec<ToolCall>,
}

impl ChatMessage {
    pub fn system(s: &str) -> Self { Self { role: ChatRole::System, content: s.into(), name: None, tool_calls: Vec::new() } }
    pub fn user(s: &str) -> Self { Self { role: ChatRole::User, content: s.into(), name: None, tool_calls: Vec::new() } }
    pub fn assistant(s: &str) -> Self { Self { role: ChatRole::Assistant, content: s.into(), name: None, tool_calls: Vec::new() } }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum ChatRole { System, User, Assistant, Tool }

// ── Sampling ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SamplingParams {
    #[serde(default = "def_temp")] pub temperature: f32,
    #[serde(default = "def_top_p")] pub top_p: f32,
    #[serde(default = "def_top_k")] pub top_k: u32,
    #[serde(default = "def_max")] pub max_tokens: u32,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")] pub stop_sequences: Vec<String>,
}

fn def_temp() -> f32 { 0.7 }
fn def_top_p() -> f32 { 0.9 }
fn def_top_k() -> u32 { 40 }
fn def_max() -> u32 { 4096 }

impl Default for SamplingParams {
    fn default() -> Self { Self { temperature: def_temp(), top_p: def_top_p(), top_k: def_top_k(), max_tokens: def_max(), stop_sequences: Vec::new() } }
}

// ── Tools ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]

// ── Response ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]

    pub content: String,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]
    pub tool_calls: Vec<ToolCall>,
    pub usage: TokenUsage,
    pub finish_reason: FinishReason,
    pub timestamp: DateTime<Utc>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "HashMap::is_empty")]
    pub metadata: HashMap<String, String>,
}

// ── Streaming ────────────────────────────────────────────────

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct StreamChunk {
    pub token: String,
    pub finish_reason: Option<FinishReason>,
    pub timestamp: DateTime<Utc>,
}

// ── TokenUsage ───────────────────────────────────────────────
// ✅ C4: métodos new(), is_zero(), add() implementados

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Serialize, Deserialize, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct TokenUsage {
    pub prompt_tokens: u32,
    pub completion_tokens: u32,
    pub total_tokens: u32,
}

impl TokenUsage {
    pub fn new(prompt: u32, completion: u32) -> Self {
        Self { prompt_tokens: prompt, completion_tokens: completion, total_tokens: prompt + completion }
    }
    pub fn is_zero(&self) -> bool { self.total_tokens == 0 }
    pub fn add(&self, other: &Self) -> Self {
        Self { prompt_tokens: self.prompt_tokens + other.prompt_tokens, completion_tokens: self.completion_tokens + other.completion_tokens, total_tokens: self.total_tokens + other.total_tokens }
    }
}

impl std::fmt::Display for TokenUsage {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "{}+{}={}", self.prompt_tokens, self.completion_tokens, self.total_tokens)
    }
}

// ── FinishReason ─────────────────────────────────────────────

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum FinishReason { Stop, Length, ToolCall, Error }

impl std::fmt::Display for FinishReason {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self { Self::Stop => write!(f, "stop"), Self::Length => write!(f, "length"), Self::ToolCall => write!(f, "tool_call"), Self::Error => write!(f, "error") }
    }
}
```

```rust
// ✅ D1: stream usa mpsc::Receiver, não callback

use async_trait::async_trait;
use tokio::sync::mpsc;
use crate::{InferenceRequest, InferenceResponse, InferenceResult, ModelId, StreamChunk};

#[async_trait]
pub trait InferenceEngine: Send + Sync {
    fn model_id(&self) -> &ModelId;
    async fn complete(&self, request: InferenceRequest) -> InferenceResult<InferenceResponse>;

    /// Streaming padrão: retorna Receiver de chunks.
    /// Implementação default delega para complete().
    async fn stream(&self, request: InferenceRequest) -> InferenceResult<mpsc::Receiver<StreamChunk>> {
        let resp = self.complete(request).await?;
        let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel(4);
        let chunk = StreamChunk { token: resp.content, finish_reason: Some(resp.finish_reason), timestamp: resp.timestamp };
        tokio::spawn(async move { let _ = tx.send(chunk).await; });
        Ok(rx)
    }

    fn is_ready(&self) -> bool { true }
    fn max_context_tokens(&self) -> u32 { 4096 }
}
```

```rust
use async_trait::async_trait;
use chrono::Utc;
use crate::*;

pub struct NullEngine { model_id: ModelId }

impl NullEngine {
    pub fn new(model_id: ModelId) -> Self { Self { model_id } }
}

#[async_trait]
impl InferenceEngine for NullEngine {
    fn model_id(&self) -> &ModelId { &self.model_id }

    async fn complete(&self, req: InferenceRequest) -> InferenceResult<InferenceResponse> {
        let last = req.messages.iter().rev().find(|m| m.role == ChatRole::User).map(|m| m.content.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
        Ok(InferenceResponse {
            content: format!("[null:{}/{}] {}", self.model_id.family(), self.model_id.name(), last),
            tool_calls: Vec::new(),
            usage: TokenUsage::new(10, 5),  // ✅ C4: TokenUsage::new() agora existe
            finish_reason: FinishReason::Stop,
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
            metadata: Default::default(),
        })
    }

    async fn stream(&self, req: InferenceRequest) -> InferenceResult<tokio::sync::mpsc::Receiver<StreamChunk>> {
        let resp = self.complete(req).await?;
        let (tx, rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel(8);
        let words: Vec<String> = resp.content.split_whitespace().map(String::from).collect();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            for (i, w) in words.iter().enumerate() {
                let last = i == words.len() - 1;
                if tx.send(StreamChunk {
                    token: format!("{}{}", w, if last { "\n" } else { " " }),
                    finish_reason: if last { Some(resp.finish_reason) } else { None },
                    timestamp: Utc::now(),
                }).await.is_err() { break; }
            }
        });
        Ok(rx)
    }

    fn is_ready(&self) -> bool { true }
}
```

```rust
// ✅ C3: usa crate::types::DimensionScore, não define localmente

use crate::types::*;
use tracing::debug;

pub struct CausalConsistencyScorer;

impl Default for CausalConsistencyScorer { fn default() -> Self { Self } }

const PATTERNS: &[(&str, CausalRelation)] = &[
    ("porque", CausalRelation::Premise), ("já que", CausalRelation::Premise),
    ("portanto", CausalRelation::Refinement), ("logo", CausalRelation::Refinement),
    ("corrigindo", CausalRelation::Correction), ("na verdade", CausalRelation::Correction),
    ("verifiquei", CausalRelation::Validation),
];

impl CausalConsistencyScorer {
    pub async fn score(&self, traj: &SessionTrajectory) -> DimensionScore {
        let mut links = Vec::new();
        for turn in &traj.turns {
            let text = turn.content.to_lowercase();
            for (pat, rel) in PATTERNS {
                if text.contains(pat) {
                    if let Some(prev) = traj.turns.iter().filter(|t| t.id != turn.id).last() {
                        links.push(CausalLink { from_turn: prev.id.clone(), to_turn: turn.id.clone(), relation: *rel, strength: 0.7 });
                    }
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if links.is_empty() {
            return DimensionScore::new(0.5, "Nenhum link causal explícito.");
        }
        let assistant: Vec<&Turn> = traj.turns.iter().filter(|t| t.role == TurnRole::Assistant).collect();
        let linked: std::collections::HashSet<&str> = links.iter().flat_map(|l| [l.from_turn.as_str(), l.to_turn.as_str()]).collect();
        let cov = linked.len() as f32 / assistant.len().max(1) as f32;
        debug!(links = links.len(), coverage = %format!("{:.2}", cov), "Causal scored");
        DimensionScore::new(cov, format!("{} links em {} turns.", links.len(), assistant.len()))
            .with_evidence(links.iter().map(|l| format!("{} → {} ({:?})", l.from_turn, l.to_turn, l.relation)).collect())
    }
}
```
