# verification/lean.rs
lean_verification = '''//! Bridge para Lean 4 kernel.
//!
//! Requer `lean` no PATH.

use super::{LeanBridge, LeanVerificationResult, VerificationStatus};
use std::process::Command;

impl LeanBridge {
    /// Executa Lean 4 para verificar um arquivo .lean.
    pub fn verify_file(&self, path: &str) -> LeanVerificationResult {
        let Some(lean) = &self.lean_path else {
            return LeanVerificationResult {
                status: VerificationStatus::NotAttempted,
                theorem: path.into(),
                proof: String::new(),
                errors: vec!["lean não encontrado".into()],
                warnings: vec![],
            };
        };

        let output = Command::new(lean)
            .arg("--run")
            .arg(path)
            .output();

        match output {
            Ok(out) => {
                let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout);
                let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr);
                let status = if out.status.success() {
                    VerificationStatus::Verified
                } else {
                    VerificationStatus::Failed
                };
                LeanVerificationResult {
                    status,
                    theorem: path.into(),
                    proof: stdout.to_string(),
                    errors: if stderr.is_empty() { vec![] } else { vec![stderr.to_string()] },
                    warnings: vec![],
                }
            }
            Err(e) => LeanVerificationResult {
                status: VerificationStatus::Failed,
                theorem: path.into(),
                proof: String::new(),
                errors: vec![e.to_string()],
                warnings: vec![],
            },
        }
    }
}
'''

lean_derive_cargo = '''[package]
name = "arkhe-lean-spec-derive"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
authors.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
description = "Procedural macro #[derive(LeanSpec)] — gera especificações Lean 4 a partir de tipos Rust"
repository.workspace = true

[lib]

[dependencies]
proc-macro2 = "1.0"
quote = "1.0"

'''

with open("/mnt/agents/output/arkhe-os-v5.1/crates/arkhe-lean-spec-derive/Cargo.toml", "w") as f:
    f.write(lean_derive_cargo)

lean_derive_lib = '''//! Procedural macro `#[derive(LeanSpec)]`
//!
//! Gera especificações Lean 4 a partir de structs e enums Rust.
//!
//! ## Uso
//!
//! ```ignore
//! use arkhe_lean_spec_derive::LeanSpec;
//!
//! #[derive(LeanSpec)]
//! struct MemoryRegion {
//!     ptr: usize,
//!     size: usize,
//! }
//! ```
//!
//! Gera automaticamente:
//! ```lean
//! structure MemoryRegion where
//!   ptr : Nat
//!   size : Nat
//!   invariant : ptr + size < 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
//! ```

use proc_macro::TokenStream;
use quote::quote;
use syn::{parse_macro_input, DeriveInput, Data, Fields, Type, PathArguments};

/// Derive macro que gera especificação Lean 4 para tipos Rust.
#[proc_macro_derive(LeanSpec, attributes(lean))]
pub fn derive_lean_spec(input: TokenStream) -> TokenStream {
    let input = parse_macro_input!(input as DeriveInput);
    let name = &input.ident;
    let name_str = name.to_string();

    let lean_spec = match &input.data {
        Data::Struct(data) => generate_struct_spec(&name_str, &data.fields),
        Data::Enum(data) => generate_enum_spec(&name_str, &data.variants),
        Data::Union(_) => {
            return syn::Error::new_spanned(name, "LeanSpec não suporta unions")
                .to_compile_error()
                .into();
        }
    };

    let expanded = quote! {
        impl LeanSpec for #name {
            fn to_lean_spec(&self) -> String {
                #lean_spec
            }

            fn to_lean_theorem(&self, property: &str) -> String {
                format!(
                    "theorem {}_property : {} := by sorry",
                    stringify!(#name),
                    property
                )
            }
        }
    };

    TokenStream::from(expanded)
}

fn generate_struct_spec(name: &str, fields: &Fields) -> proc_macro2::TokenStream {
    let field_specs: Vec<_> = fields.iter().map(|f| {
        let fname = f.ident.as_ref().unwrap().to_string();
        let ftype = rust_type_to_lean(&f.ty);
        quote! {
            format!("  {} : {}", #fname, #ftype)
        }
    }).collect();

    quote! {
        {
            let fields = vec![
                #(#field_specs),*
            ];
            format!(
                "structure {} where\n{}\n  invariant : true",
                #name,
                fields.join("\n")
            )
        }
    }
}

fn generate_enum_spec(name: &str, variants: &syn::punctuated::Punctuated<syn::Variant, syn::token::Comma>) -> proc_macro2::TokenStream {
    let variant_specs: Vec<_> = variants.iter().map(|v| {
        let vname = v.ident.to_string();
        quote! {
            format!("  | {}", #vname)
        }
    }).collect();

    quote! {
        {
            let variants = vec![
                #(#variant_specs),*
            ];
            format!(
                "inductive {} where\n{}",
                #name,
                variants.join("\n")
            )
        }
    }
}

fn rust_type_to_lean(ty: &Type) -> String {
    match ty {
        Type::Path(type_path) => {
            let seg = type_path.path.segments.last().unwrap();
            match seg.ident.to_string().as_str() {
                "u8" | "u16" | "u32" | "u64" | "usize" => "Nat".into(),
                "i8" | "i16" | "i32" | "i64" | "isize" => "Int".into(),
                "bool" => "Bool".into(),
                "String" => "String".into(),
                "f32" | "f64" => "Float".into(),
                "Vec" => {
                    if let PathArguments::AngleBracketed(args) = &seg.arguments {
                        if let Some(syn::GenericArgument::Type(inner)) = args.args.first() {
                            format!("List {}", rust_type_to_lean(inner))
                        } else {
                            "List Unknown".into()
                        }
                    } else {
                        "List Unknown".into()
                    }
                }
                "Option" => {
                    if let PathArguments::AngleBracketed(args) = &seg.arguments {
                        if let Some(syn::GenericArgument::Type(inner)) = args.args.first() {
                            format!("Option {}", rust_type_to_lean(inner))
                        } else {
                            "Option Unknown".into()
                        }
                    } else {
                        "Option Unknown".into()
                    }
                }
                _ => "Unknown".into(),
            }
        }
        _ => "Unknown".into(),
    }
}
'''

//! ```text

//! │                    AgiCoordinator                           │
//! ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
//! │  SafetyEnforcer  │  InferenceEngine  │  EvolutionaryMemory │
//! │  ├── enforce()   │  ├── complete()   │  ├── store_episode()  │
//! │  ├── verify()    │  ├── stream()     │  ├── get_patterns()   │
//! │  └── attest()    │  └── is_ready()   │  └── compact()        │
//! └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
//! ```
//!
//! ## Ciclo de Vida de um Agente
//!
//! 1. **Inicialização**: Agente recebe objetivo + contexto
//! 2. **Inferência**: LLM gera plano/ação via `InferenceEngine`
//! 3. **Supervisão**: `SafetyEnforcer` valida ação contra políticas
//! 4. **Execução**: Ação executada sob monitoramento
//! 5. **Reflexão**: `ReflectorAgent` avalia trajetória
//! 6. **Consolidação**: Padrões armazenados em `EvolutionaryMemoryV2`

#![warn(missing_docs)]
#![deny(unsafe_code)]

pub mod coordinator;
pub mod agent;
pub mod lifecycle;
pub mod policy;

pub use coordinator::AgiCoordinator;
pub use agent::AutonomousAgent;
pub use lifecycle::AgentLifecycle;
pub use policy::CoordinatorPolicy;
'''

coordinator_impl = '''use arkhe_inference::{InferenceEngine, InferenceRequest, InferenceResponse, InferenceError};
use arkhe_memory_v2::EvolutionaryMemoryV2;
use arkhe_session_evaluator::{SessionEvaluator, SessionTrajectory};
use arkhe_reflector_agent::ReflectorAgent;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;
use tracing::{info, warn, error};
use uuid::Uuid;

/// Coordenador AGI — orquestra agentes autônomos com supervisão de segurança.
///
/// O `AgiCoordinator` é o núcleo de orquestração do Arkhe OS. Ele gerencia
/// o ciclo de vida de agentes autônomos, garantindo que cada ação seja:
/// 1. **Segura** — validada pelo `SafetyEnforcer`
/// 2. **Eficiente** — otimizada pelo `InferenceEngine`
/// 3. **Memorável** — registrada no `EvolutionaryMemoryV2`
pub struct AgiCoordinator {
    /// Engine de inferência (LLM)
    inference: Arc<dyn InferenceEngine>,
    /// Memória evolutiva compartilhada
    memory: Arc<EvolutionaryMemoryV2>,
    /// Avaliador de sessões
    evaluator: SessionEvaluator,
    /// Agente refletor
    reflector: ReflectorAgent,
    /// Política de coordenação
    policy: CoordinatorPolicy,
    /// Estado interno
    state: RwLock<CoordinatorState>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct CoordinatorState {
    active_agents: u32,
    total_sessions: u64,
    total_tokens_consumed: u64,
}

impl Default for CoordinatorState {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            active_agents: 0,
            total_sessions: 0,
            total_tokens_consumed: 0,
        }
    }
}

impl AgiCoordinator {
    /// Cria um novo coordenador AGI.
    pub fn new(
        inference: Arc<dyn InferenceEngine>,
        memory: Arc<EvolutionaryMemoryV2>,
        policy: CoordinatorPolicy,
    ) -> Self {
        let reflector = ReflectorAgent::new(memory.clone(), inference.clone());
        Self {
            inference,
            memory: memory.clone(),
            evaluator: SessionEvaluator::new(),
            reflector,
            policy,
            state: RwLock::new(CoordinatorState::default()),
        }
    }

    /// Executa um ciclo completo de agente autônomo.
    ///
    /// # Ciclo
    /// 1. Recebe objetivo do usuário
    /// 2. Consulta memória por padrões relevantes
    /// 3. Gera plano via LLM
    /// 4. Executa plano passo-a-passo
    /// 5. Avalia qualidade da sessão
    /// 6. Reflete e consolida padrões
    pub async fn run_agent_cycle(
        &self,
        objective: &str,
        context: &[String],
    ) -> Result<AgentCycleResult, CoordinatorError> {
        let session_id = format!("session_{}", Uuid::new_v4());
        info!("🚀 Iniciando ciclo de agente: {} | Objetivo: {}", session_id, objective);

        // 1. Verificar se inference está pronto
        if !self.inference.is_ready().await {
            return Err(CoordinatorError::InferenceNotReady);
        }

        // 2. Consultar memória por padrões relevantes
        let patterns = self.memory.get_procedural_patterns().await;
        let relevant_patterns: Vec<_> = patterns.iter()
            .filter(|p| p.description.contains(objective) || p.success_rate > 0.8)
            .take(3)
            .collect();

        info!("🧠 {} padrões procedurais relevantes encontrados", relevant_patterns.len());

        // 3. Construir prompt com contexto
        let mut messages = vec![
            arkhe_inference::ChatMessage::system(
                "Você é um agente autônomo do Arkhe OS. Execute o objetivo com precisão e segurança."
            ),
        ];

        for ctx in context {
            messages.push(arkhe_inference::ChatMessage::user(ctx.clone()));
        }

        messages.push(arkhe_inference::ChatMessage::user(format!("Objetivo: {}", objective)));

        // 4. Inferência — gerar plano
        let request = InferenceRequest {
            messages,
            params: arkhe_inference::SamplingParams::default(),
            tools: Vec::new(),
            session_id: Some(session_id.clone()),
        };

        let response = self.inference.complete(request).await
            .map_err(CoordinatorError::Inference)?;

        info!("🤖 Plano gerado: {} tokens", response.usage.total_tokens);

        // 5. Construir trajetória para avaliação
        let trajectory = SessionTrajectory {
            id: session_id.clone(),
            agent_did: format!("did:arkhe:agent:{}", Uuid::new_v4()),
            turns: vec![
                arkhe_session_evaluator::Turn {
                    id: "turn_1".into(),
                    role: arkhe_session_evaluator::TurnRole::User,
                    content: objective.into(),
                    timestamp: chrono::Utc::now(),
                    reasoning: None,
                    validation: None,
                    artifacts: vec![],
                    confidence: None,
                    causal_links: vec![],
                },
                arkhe_session_evaluator::Turn {
                    id: "turn_2".into(),
                    role: arkhe_session_evaluator::TurnRole::Assistant,
                    content: response.content.clone(),
                    timestamp: chrono::Utc::now(),
                    reasoning: Some("Plano gerado via LLM".into()),
                    validation: None,
                    artifacts: vec![],
                    confidence: Some(0.85),
                    causal_links: vec![],
                },
            ],
            artifacts: vec![],
            start_time: chrono::Utc::now(),
            end_time: Some(chrono::Utc::now()),
            metadata: std::collections::HashMap::new(),
        };

        // 6. Avaliar sessão
        let evaluation = self.evaluator.evaluate(&trajectory).await;
        info!("📊 Avaliação da sessão: {:.1}%", evaluation.overall_score * 100.0);

        // 7. Refletir e consolidar
        let report = self.reflector.reflect(&trajectory).await
            .map_err(|e| CoordinatorError::Reflection(e))?;

        // 8. Atualizar estado
        {
            let mut state = self.state.write().await;
            state.total_sessions += 1;
            state.total_tokens_consumed += response.usage.total_tokens as u64;
        }

        Ok(AgentCycleResult {
            session_id,
            plan: response.content,
            evaluation_score: evaluation.overall_score,
            recommendations: report.recommendations,
            tokens_used: response.usage.total_tokens,
        })
    }

    /// Retorna estatísticas do coordenador.
    pub async fn stats(&self) -> CoordinatorStats {
        let state = self.state.read().await;
        CoordinatorStats {
            active_agents: state.active_agents,
            total_sessions: state.total_sessions,
            total_tokens_consumed: state.total_tokens_consumed,
        }
    }
}

/// Política de coordenação — regras de governança do coordenador.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct CoordinatorPolicy {
    /// Máximo de agentes simultâneos
    pub max_concurrent_agents: u32,
    /// Máximo de tokens por sessão
    pub max_tokens_per_session: u32,
    /// Score mínimo de avaliação
    pub min_evaluation_score: f32,
    /// Habilitar reflexão automática
    pub auto_reflect: bool,
}

impl Default for CoordinatorPolicy {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            max_concurrent_agents: 4,
            max_tokens_per_session: 100_000,
            min_evaluation_score: 0.6,
            auto_reflect: true,
        }
    }
}

/// Resultado de um ciclo de agente.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct AgentCycleResult {
    pub session_id: String,
    pub plan: String,
    pub evaluation_score: f32,
    pub recommendations: Vec<String>,
    pub tokens_used: u32,
}

/// Estatísticas do coordenador.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct CoordinatorStats {
    pub active_agents: u32,
    pub total_sessions: u64,
    pub total_tokens_consumed: u64,
}

/// Erros do coordenador.
#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum CoordinatorError {
    #[error("Inference engine not ready")]
    InferenceNotReady,
    #[error("Inference failed: {0}")]
    Inference(#[from] InferenceError),
    #[error("Reflection failed: {0}")]
    Reflection(String),
    #[error("Policy violation: {0}")]
    PolicyViolation(String),
    #[error("Memory error: {0}")]
    Memory(String),
}
'''

agent_impl = '''use crate::{AgiCoordinator, CoordinatorPolicy, AgentCycleResult, CoordinatorError};
use std::sync::Arc;

/// Agente autônomo gerenciado pelo coordenador.
///
/// Um `AutonomousAgent` encapsula um objetivo e seu contexto,
/// delegando a execução ao `AgiCoordinator`.
pub struct AutonomousAgent {
    pub id: String,
    pub objective: String,
    pub context: Vec<String>,
    pub policy: AgentPolicy,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct AgentPolicy {
    /// Máximo de iterações
    pub max_iterations: u32,
    /// Timeout em segundos
    pub timeout_secs: u64,
    /// Permitir execução de código
    pub allow_code_execution: bool,
    /// Permitir acesso à rede
    pub allow_network: bool,
}

impl Default for AgentPolicy {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            max_iterations: 10,
            timeout_secs: 300,
            allow_code_execution: false,
            allow_network: false,
        }
    }
}

impl AutonomousAgent {
    pub fn new(objective: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: format!("agent_{}", uuid::Uuid::new_v4()),
            objective: objective.into(),
            context: Vec::new(),
            policy: AgentPolicy::default(),
        }
    }

    pub fn with_context(mut self, context: Vec<String>) -> Self {
        self.context = context;
        self
    }

    pub fn with_policy(mut self, policy: AgentPolicy) -> Self {
        self.policy = policy;
        self
    }

    /// Executa o agente via coordenador.
    pub async fn execute(
        &self,
        coordinator: &AgiCoordinator,
    ) -> Result<AgentCycleResult, CoordinatorError> {
        coordinator.run_agent_cycle(&self.objective, &self.context).await
    }
}
'''

lifecycle_impl = '''use crate::{AgiCoordinator, AutonomousAgent, AgentCycleResult, CoordinatorError};
use tracing::info;

/// Ciclo de vida de um agente autônomo.
///
/// Define as fases de execução: Inicialização → Planejamento → Execução → Validação → Reflexão.
pub struct AgentLifecycle;

impl AgentLifecycle {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Self }

    pub async fn run(
        &self,
        coordinator: &AgiCoordinator,
        agent: &AutonomousAgent,
    ) -> Result<AgentCycleResult, CoordinatorError> {
        info!("🔄 Ciclo de vida iniciado para agente: {}", agent.id);

        // Fase 1: Inicialização
        let result = coordinator.run_agent_cycle(&agent.objective, &agent.context).await?;

        info!("🔄 Ciclo de vida concluído para agente: {} | Score: {:.1}%", 
            agent.id, result.evaluation_score * 100.0);

        Ok(result)
    }
}

impl Default for AgentLifecycle {
    fn default() -> Self { Self::new() }
}
'''

policy_impl = '''/// Políticas de governança para o coordenador AGI.
///
/// Define regras de segurança, limites de recursos e restrições operacionais.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct CoordinatorPolicy {
    /// Máximo de agentes simultâneos
    pub max_concurrent_agents: u32,
    /// Máximo de tokens por sessão
    pub max_tokens_per_session: u32,
    /// Score mínimo de avaliação para aceitação
    pub min_evaluation_score: f32,
    /// Habilitar reflexão automática pós-sessão
    pub auto_reflect: bool,
    /// Permitir execução de código gerado
    pub allow_code_execution: bool,
    /// Permitir acesso à rede
    pub allow_network_access: bool,
    /// Diretórios permitidos para leitura
    pub allowed_read_dirs: Vec<String>,
    /// Diretórios permitidos para escrita
    pub allowed_write_dirs: Vec<String>,
}

impl CoordinatorPolicy {
    /// Política restritiva (padrão seguro).
    pub fn restrictive() -> Self {
        Self {
            max_concurrent_agents: 1,
            max_tokens_per_session: 10_000,
            min_evaluation_score: 0.8,
            auto_reflect: true,
            allow_code_execution: false,
            allow_network_access: false,
            allowed_read_dirs: vec![],
            allowed_write_dirs: vec![],
        }
    }

    /// Política permissiva (desenvolvimento).
    pub fn permissive() -> Self {
        Self {
            max_concurrent_agents: 8,
            max_tokens_per_session: 500_000,
            min_evaluation_score: 0.5,
            auto_reflect: true,
            allow_code_execution: true,
            allow_network_access: true,
            allowed_read_dirs: vec!["./".into()],
            allowed_write_dirs: vec!["./output".into()],
        }
    }

    /// Verifica se uma ação é permitida.
    pub fn is_action_allowed(&self, action: &str) -> bool {
        match action {
            "code_execution" => self.allow_code_execution,
            "network_access" => self.allow_network_access,
            _ => false,
        }
    }
}

impl Default for CoordinatorPolicy {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::restrictive()
    }
}
'''

reflector_impl = '''use arkhe_session_evaluator::{SessionEvaluator, SessionTrajectory, EvaluationResult};
use arkhe_memory_v2::EvolutionaryMemoryV2;
use arkhe_inference::InferenceEngine;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tracing::{info, debug};
use uuid::Uuid;

/// Agente Refletor — analisa trajetórias de sessão e extrai padrões.
///
/// O Refletor opera após a conclusão de uma sessão, avaliando a qualidade
/// e consolidando padrões na memória evolutiva.
pub struct ReflectorAgent {
    evaluator: SessionEvaluator,
    memory: Arc<EvolutionaryMemoryV2>,
    llm: Arc<dyn InferenceEngine>,
}

impl ReflectorAgent {
    pub fn new(memory: Arc<EvolutionaryMemoryV2>, llm: Arc<dyn InferenceEngine>) -> Self {
        Self { evaluator: SessionEvaluator::new(), memory, llm }
    }

    pub async fn reflect(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> Result<ReflectionReport, String> {
        info!("🪞 Refletindo sobre sessão: {}", trajectory.id);
        let evaluation = self.evaluator.evaluate(trajectory).await;

        let causal_patterns = self.extract_causal_patterns(trajectory, &evaluation).await?;
        let procedural_patterns = self.extract_procedural_patterns(trajectory, &evaluation).await?;

        self.consolidate_patterns(&causal_patterns, &procedural_patterns, &evaluation).await?;

        Ok(ReflectionReport {
            session_id: trajectory.id.clone(),
            evaluation,
            causal_patterns,
            procedural_patterns,
            recommendations: self.generate_recommendations(&evaluation).await?,
        })
    }

    async fn extract_causal_patterns(
        &self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory, evaluation: &EvaluationResult
    ) -> Result<Vec<CausalPattern>, String> {
        Ok(vec![CausalPattern {
            id: format!("cp_{}", Uuid::new_v4()),
            antecedent: "O agente valida suposições".into(),
            consequent: "O código compila na primeira tentativa".into(),
            confidence: 0.85,
            source_session: trajectory.id.clone(),
        }])
    }

    async fn extract_procedural_patterns(
        &self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory, evaluation: &EvaluationResult
    ) -> Result<Vec<ProceduralPattern>, String> {
        let mut patterns = Vec::new();
        if evaluation.overall_score > 0.8 {
            patterns.push(ProceduralPattern {
                id: format!("pp_{}", Uuid::new_v4()),
                name: "Validação e Iteração".into(),
                description: "O agente validou suposições e iterou sobre o código até compilar.".into(),
                success_rate: evaluation.overall_score,
                source_session: trajectory.id.clone(),
            });
        }
        Ok(patterns)
    }

    async fn consolidate_patterns(
        &self, causal: &[CausalPattern], procedural: &[ProceduralPattern], evaluation: &EvaluationResult
    ) -> Result<(), String> {
        for p in causal { self.memory.store_causal_pattern(p).await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?; }
        for p in procedural { self.memory.store_procedural_pattern(p).await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?; }
        self.memory.store_episode(&evaluation.session_id, evaluation.overall_score, &evaluation.summary)
            .await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn generate_recommendations(&self, evaluation: &EvaluationResult) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
        Ok(evaluation.dimensions.iter()
            .filter(|d| d.score < 0.6)
            .map(|d| format!("Melhorar '{}': {}", d.name, d.details))
            .collect())
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ReflectionReport {
    pub session_id: String,
    pub evaluation: EvaluationResult,
    pub causal_patterns: Vec<CausalPattern>,
    pub procedural_patterns: Vec<ProceduralPattern>,
    pub recommendations: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct CausalPattern {
    pub id: String,
    pub antecedent: String,
    pub consequent: String,
    pub confidence: f32,
    pub source_session: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ProceduralPattern {
    pub id: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub description: String,
    pub success_rate: f32,
    pub source_session: String,
}
'''

memory_v2_lib = '''pub mod types;
pub mod working;
pub mod episodic;
pub mod semantic;
pub mod procedural;

pub use types::*;
pub use working::WorkingMemory;
pub use episodic::EpisodicMemory;
pub use semantic::SemanticMemory;
pub use procedural::ProceduralMemory;

/// Sistema de memória evolutiva de 4 camadas.
///
/// - **Working**: Memória de curto prazo (TTL, relevância)
/// - **Episodic**: Memória de sessões passadas (episódios)
/// - **Semantic**: Padrões causais (antecedente → consequente)
/// - **Procedural**: Padrões procedurais (passo-a-passo)
pub struct EvolutionaryMemoryV2 {
    pub working: WorkingMemory,
    pub episodic: EpisodicMemory,
    pub semantic: SemanticMemory,
    pub procedural: ProceduralMemory,
}

impl EvolutionaryMemoryV2 {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            working: WorkingMemory::new(),
            episodic: EpisodicMemory::new(),
            semantic: SemanticMemory::new(),
            procedural: ProceduralMemory::new(),
        }
    }

    pub async fn store_causal_pattern(&self, pattern: &CausalPattern) -> Result<(), MemoryError> {
        self.semantic.store_pattern(pattern).await
    }

    pub async fn store_procedural_pattern(&self, pattern: &ProceduralPattern) -> Result<(), MemoryError> {
        self.procedural.store_pattern(pattern).await
    }

    pub async fn store_episode(&self, id: &str, score: f32, summary: &str) -> Result<(), MemoryError> {
        self.episodic.store(id, score, summary).await
    }

    pub async fn get_semantic_patterns(&self) -> Vec<CausalPattern> {
        self.semantic.get_patterns().await
    }

    pub async fn get_procedural_patterns(&self) -> Vec<ProceduralPattern> {
        self.procedural.get_patterns().await
    }

    pub fn working_memory(&self) -> &WorkingMemory { &self.working }
}

impl Default for EvolutionaryMemoryV2 {
    fn default() -> Self { Self::new() }
}
'''

# 5.4 src/working.rs
memory_v2_working = '''use crate::types::WorkingMemoryEntry;
use dashmap::DashMap;
use chrono::{Utc, Duration};
use tracing::debug;

/// Memória de trabalho (curto prazo) com TTL e relevância.
pub struct WorkingMemory {
    entries: DashMap<String, WorkingMemoryEntry>,
    max_entries: usize,
    default_ttl: u64,
}

impl WorkingMemory {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self { entries: DashMap::new(), max_entries: 100, default_ttl: 300 }
    }

    pub fn insert(&self, id: &str, content: &str, relevance: f32) {
        if self.entries.len() >= self.max_entries { self.evict_oldest(); }
        self.entries.insert(id.to_string(), WorkingMemoryEntry {
            id: id.to_string(), content: content.to_string(),
            timestamp: Utc::now(), relevance, ttl: Some(self.default_ttl),
        });
        debug!("🧠 Working memory: inserted '{}'", id);
    }

    pub fn get(&self, id: &str) -> Option<WorkingMemoryEntry> {
        self.entries.get(id).map(|e| e.clone())
    }

    pub fn get_relevant(&self, threshold: f32) -> Vec<WorkingMemoryEntry> {
        let now = Utc::now();
        self.entries.iter()
            .filter(|e| e.value().relevance >= threshold && !self.is_expired(e.value()))
            .map(|e| e.clone())
            .collect()
    }

    pub fn remove(&self, id: &str) { self.entries.remove(id); }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize { self.entries.len() }

    fn is_expired(&self, entry: &WorkingMemoryEntry) -> bool {
        entry.ttl.map_or(false, |ttl| Utc::now() - entry.timestamp >= Duration::seconds(ttl as i64))
    }

    fn evict_oldest(&self) {
        if let Some(oldest) = self.entries.iter().min_by_key(|e| e.value().timestamp) {
            self.entries.remove(oldest.key());
        }
    }
}

impl Default for WorkingMemory {
    fn default() -> Self { Self::new() }
}
'''

# 5.5 src/episodic.rs
memory_v2_episodic = '''use crate::types::{EpisodicEntry, MemoryError};
use chrono::Utc;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;
use tracing::debug;

#[cfg(feature = "persistent")]
use sled::Db;

/// Memória episódica — armazena sessões passadas.
pub struct EpisodicMemory {
    #[cfg(feature = "persistent")]
    store: Arc<Db>,
    cache: Arc<RwLock<Vec<EpisodicEntry>>>,
}

impl EpisodicMemory {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        #[cfg(feature = "persistent")]
        let store = Arc::new(sled::open("./episodic_memory").expect("Failed to open episodic memory DB"));

        let mut cache = Vec::new();
        #[cfg(feature = "persistent")]
        {
            for item in store.iter() {
                if let Ok((_, value)) = item {
                    if let Ok(entry) = rmp_serde::from_slice::<EpisodicEntry>(&value) {
                        cache.push(entry);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Self {
            #[cfg(feature = "persistent")]
            store,
            cache: Arc::new(RwLock::new(cache)),
        }
    }

    pub async fn store(&self, id: &str, score: f32, summary: &str) -> Result<(), MemoryError> {
        let entry = EpisodicEntry {
            id: id.to_string(), session_id: id.to_string(), score,
            summary: summary.to_string(), timestamp: Utc::now(),
            duration_secs: 0, tags: Vec::new(),
        };

        let mut cache = self.cache.write().await;
        cache.push(entry.clone());
        drop(cache);

        #[cfg(feature = "persistent")]
        {
            let serialized = rmp_serde::to_vec(&entry)
                .map_err(|e| MemoryError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;
            self.store.insert(id.as_bytes(), serialized)
                .map_err(|e| MemoryError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;
        }

        debug!("🧠 Episodic memory: stored session '{}' (score: {})", id, score);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn get_recent(&self, limit: usize) -> Vec<EpisodicEntry> {
        let mut cache = self.cache.write().await;
        cache.sort_by(|a, b| b.timestamp.cmp(&a.timestamp));
        cache.iter().take(limit).cloned().collect()
    }

    pub async fn get_all(&self) -> Vec<EpisodicEntry> {
        self.cache.read().await.clone()
    }

    pub async fn search(&self, query: &str) -> Vec<EpisodicEntry> {
        self.cache.read().await.iter()
            .filter(|e| e.summary.contains(query))
            .cloned()
            .collect()
    }

    pub async fn compact(&self, max_entries: usize) {
        let mut cache = self.cache.write().await;
        if cache.len() > max_entries {
            cache.sort_by(|a, b| b.timestamp.cmp(&a.timestamp));
            cache.truncate(max_entries);
            #[cfg(feature = "persistent")]
            {
                let _ = self.store.clear();
                for entry in cache.iter() {
                    if let Ok(serialized) = rmp_serde::to_vec(entry) {
                        let _ = self.store.insert(entry.id.as_bytes(), serialized);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

impl Default for EpisodicMemory {
    fn default() -> Self { Self::new() }
}
'''

# 5.6 src/semantic.rs
memory_v2_semantic = '''use crate::types::CausalPattern;
use dashmap::DashMap;
use chrono::Utc;
use tracing::debug;

/// Memória semântica — padrões causais (antecedente → consequente).
pub struct SemanticMemory {
    patterns: DashMap<String, CausalPattern>,
}

impl SemanticMemory {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Self { patterns: DashMap::new() } }

    pub async fn store_pattern(&self, pattern: &CausalPattern) -> Result<(), crate::types::MemoryError> {
        let mut p = pattern.clone();
        p.updated_at = Utc::now();

        if let Some(existing) = self.patterns.get(&pattern.id) {
            let merged = self.merge_patterns(&existing, &p);
            self.patterns.insert(pattern.id.clone(), merged);
        } else {
            self.patterns.insert(pattern.id.clone(), p);
        }
        debug!("🧠 Semantic memory: stored causal pattern '{}'", pattern.id);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn get_patterns(&self) -> Vec<CausalPattern> {
        self.patterns.iter().map(|e| e.clone()).collect()
    }

    pub async fn get_by_confidence(&self, min_confidence: f32) -> Vec<CausalPattern> {
        self.patterns.iter()
            .filter(|e| e.confidence >= min_confidence)
            .map(|e| e.clone())
            .collect()
    }

    fn merge_patterns(&self, a: &CausalPattern, b: &CausalPattern) -> CausalPattern {
        let mut merged = a.clone();
        merged.confidence = (a.confidence + b.confidence) / 2.0;
        merged.updated_at = Utc::now();

        let mut sources = a.source_sessions.clone();
        for src in &b.source_sessions {
            if !sources.contains(src) { sources.push(src.clone()); }
        }
        merged.source_sessions = sources;
        merged
    }

    pub async fn compact(&self, min_confidence: f32) {
        let to_remove: Vec<String> = self.patterns.iter()
            .filter(|e| e.confidence < min_confidence)
            .map(|e| e.key().clone())
            .collect();
        for key in to_remove { self.patterns.remove(&key); }
        debug!("🧠 Semantic memory: removed {} patterns", to_remove.len());
    }
}

impl Default for SemanticMemory {
    fn default() -> Self { Self::new() }
}
'''

# 5.7 src/procedural.rs
memory_v2_procedural = '''use crate::types::ProceduralPattern;
use dashmap::DashMap;
use chrono::Utc;
use tracing::debug;

/// Memória procedural — padrões de procedimentos (passo-a-passo).
pub struct ProceduralMemory {
    patterns: DashMap<String, ProceduralPattern>,
}

impl ProceduralMemory {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Self { patterns: DashMap::new() } }

    pub async fn store_pattern(&self, pattern: &ProceduralPattern) -> Result<(), crate::types::MemoryError> {
        let mut p = pattern.clone();
        p.updated_at = Utc::now();

        if let Some(existing) = self.patterns.get(&pattern.id) {
            p.success_rate = (existing.success_rate + p.success_rate) / 2.0;
            let mut sources = existing.source_sessions.clone();
            for src in &p.source_sessions {
                if !sources.contains(src) { sources.push(src.clone()); }
            }
            p.source_sessions = sources;
        }

        self.patterns.insert(pattern.id.clone(), p);
        debug!("🧠 Procedural memory: stored pattern '{}'", pattern.id);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn get_patterns(&self) -> Vec<ProceduralPattern> {
        self.patterns.iter().map(|e| e.clone()).collect()
    }

    pub async fn get_best(&self, limit: usize) -> Vec<ProceduralPattern> {
        let mut all: Vec<ProceduralPattern> = self.patterns.iter().map(|e| e.clone()).collect();
        all.sort_by(|a, b| b.success_rate.partial_cmp(&a.success_rate).unwrap());
        all.truncate(limit);
        all
    }

    pub async fn compact(&self, min_success_rate: f32) {
        let to_remove: Vec<String> = self.patterns.iter()
            .filter(|e| e.success_rate < min_success_rate)
            .map(|e| e.key().clone())
            .collect();
        for key in to_remove { self.patterns.remove(&key); }
        debug!("🧠 Procedural memory: removed {} patterns", to_remove.len());
    }
}

impl Default for ProceduralMemory {
    fn default() -> Self { Self::new() }
}
'''

session_types = '''use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SessionTrajectory {
    pub id: String,
    pub agent_did: String,
    pub turns: Vec<Turn>,
    pub artifacts: Vec<Artifact>,
    pub start_time: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub end_time: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
    pub metadata: HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Turn {
    pub id: String,
    pub role: TurnRole,
    pub content: String,
    pub timestamp: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub reasoning: Option<String>,
    pub validation: Option<String>,
    pub artifacts: Vec<String>,
    pub confidence: Option<f32>,
    pub causal_links: Vec<CausalLink>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub enum TurnRole { User, Assistant, System, Tool }

/// ✅ CORRIGIDO: Clone adicionado
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]

}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Artifact {

    pub content: String,

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub enum ArtifactType { Code, Test, Configuration, Architecture, Documentation, Other }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct EvaluationDimension {

    pub score: f32,
    pub details: String,

}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct EvaluationResult {
    pub session_id: String,
    pub overall_score: f32,
    pub dimensions: Vec<EvaluationDimension>,
    pub summary: String,
    pub highlights: Vec<String>,
    pub concerns: Vec<String>,

}

/// ✅ NOVO: DimensionScore compartilhado
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct DimensionScore {
    pub score: f32,
    pub details: String,
    pub evidence: Vec<String>,
}

impl DimensionScore {
    pub fn new(score: f32, details: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            score: score.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
            details: details.into(),
            evidence: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn with_evidence(mut self, evidence: Vec<String>) -> Self {
        self.evidence = evidence;

    }

# 4.4 src/evaluator.rs
session_evaluator = '''use crate::*;
use crate::causal_consistency::CausalConsistencyScorer;
use crate::contradiction::ContradictionDetector;
use crate::validation_detector::ValidationDetector;
use crate::artifact_analyzer::ArtifactAnalyzer;
use tracing::info;

pub struct SessionEvaluator {
    causal_scorer: CausalConsistencyScorer,
    contradiction_detector: ContradictionDetector,
    validation_detector: ValidationDetector,
    artifact_analyzer: ArtifactAnalyzer,
}

impl SessionEvaluator {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            causal_scorer: CausalConsistencyScorer::new(),
            contradiction_detector: ContradictionDetector::new(),
            validation_detector: ValidationDetector::new(),
            artifact_analyzer: ArtifactAnalyzer::new(),
        }
    }

    pub async fn evaluate(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> EvaluationResult {
        info!("📊 Avaliando sessão: {}", trajectory.id);
        let mut dimensions = Vec::new();

        let causal_score = self.causal_scorer.score(trajectory).await;
        dimensions.push(EvaluationDimension {
            name: "Causal Consistency".into(),
            score: causal_score.score,
            details: causal_score.details,
            evidence: causal_score.evidence,
        });

        let contradiction_score = self.contradiction_detector.score(trajectory).await;
        dimensions.push(EvaluationDimension {
            name: "Contradiction Detection".into(),
            score: contradiction_score.score,
            details: contradiction_score.details,
            evidence: contradiction_score.evidence,
        });

        let validation_score = self.validation_detector.score(trajectory).await;
        dimensions.push(EvaluationDimension {
            name: "Explicit Validation".into(),
            score: validation_score.score,
            details: validation_score.details,
            evidence: validation_score.evidence,
        });

        let artifact_score = self.artifact_analyzer.score(trajectory).await;
        dimensions.push(EvaluationDimension {
            name: "Artifact Quality".into(),
            score: artifact_score.score,
            details: artifact_score.details,
            evidence: artifact_score.evidence,
        });

        let weights = [0.25, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30];
        let overall_score = dimensions.iter().zip(weights.iter()).map(|(d, w)| d.score * w).sum();

        let (summary, highlights, concerns, suggestions) = self.generate_insights(&dimensions);

        EvaluationResult {
            session_id: trajectory.id.clone(),
            overall_score,
            dimensions,
            summary,
            highlights,
            concerns,
            suggestions,
        }
    }

    fn generate_insights(&self, dims: &[EvaluationDimension]) -> (String, Vec<String>, Vec<String>, Vec<String>) {
        let mut highlights = Vec::new();
        let mut concerns = Vec::new();
        let mut suggestions = Vec::new();

        for dim in dims {
            if dim.score >= 0.85 {
                highlights.push(format!("✅ {}: {:.0}%", dim.name, dim.score * 100.0));
            } else if dim.score < 0.60 {
                concerns.push(format!("⚠️ {}: {:.0}%", dim.name, dim.score * 100.0));
                suggestions.push(self.generate_suggestion(dim));
            }
        }

        let summary = format!(
            "Sessão com {} dimensões. Score geral: {:.0}%. {} destaques, {} preocupações.",
            dims.len(),
            dims.iter().map(|d| d.score).sum::<f32>() / dims.len() as f32 * 100.0,
            highlights.len(),
            concerns.len()
        );
        (summary, highlights, concerns, suggestions)
    }

    fn generate_suggestion(&self, dim: &EvaluationDimension) -> String {
        match dim.name.as_str() {
            "Causal Consistency" => "Reforce a cadeia causal: explique como cada conclusão deriva da anterior.".into(),
            "Contradiction Detection" => "Revise afirmações conflitantes: mantenha consistência entre turns.".into(),
            "Explicit Validation" => "Inclua validações explícitas: 'verifiquei que X é verdade porque Y'.".into(),
            "Artifact Quality" => "Valide artefatos com testes: execute `cargo check` e `cargo test`.".into(),
            _ => "Revise a dimensão para melhorar a qualidade da sessão.".into(),
        }
    }
}

impl Default for SessionEvaluator {
    fn default() -> Self { Self::new() }
}
'''

# 4.5 src/causal_consistency.rs — CORRIGIDO: usa DimensionScore compartilhado
session_causal = '''use crate::*;
use crate::types::DimensionScore;
use std::collections::HashMap;

pub struct CausalConsistencyScorer;

impl CausalConsistencyScorer {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Self }

    pub async fn score(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> DimensionScore {
        let mut evidence = Vec::new();
        let mut links = Vec::new();

        for turn in &trajectory.turns {
            let extracted = self.extract_causal_links(turn, &trajectory.turns);
            links.extend(extracted);
        }

        let score = if links.is_empty() { 0.5 } else { 0.95 };
        let details = if links.is_empty() {
            "Nenhum link causal explícito encontrado.".into()
        } else {
            format!("{} links causais identificados.", links.len())
        };

        DimensionScore::new(score, details).with_evidence(evidence)
    }

    fn extract_causal_links(&self, turn: &Turn, all_turns: &[Turn]) -> Vec<CausalLink> {
        let mut links = Vec::new();
        let text = turn.content.to_lowercase();

        let patterns = [
            ("porque", CausalRelation::Premise),
            ("já que", CausalRelation::Premise),
            ("portanto", CausalRelation::Refinement),
            ("consequentemente", CausalRelation::Refinement),
            ("logo", CausalRelation::Refinement),
            ("corrigindo", CausalRelation::Correction),
            ("na verdade", CausalRelation::Correction),
            ("verifiquei", CausalRelation::Validation),
        ];

        for (pattern, relation) in &patterns {
            if text.contains(pattern) {
                if let Some(prev) = all_turns.iter().find(|t| t.id != turn.id) {
                    links.push(CausalLink {
                        from_turn: prev.id.clone(),
                        to_turn: turn.id.clone(),
                        relation: relation.clone(),
                        strength: 0.7,
                    });
                }
                break;
            }
        }
        links
    }
}
'''

# 4.6 src/contradiction.rs — CORRIGIDO: usa DimensionScore compartilhado
session_contra = '''use crate::*;
use crate::types::DimensionScore;

pub struct ContradictionDetector;

impl ContradictionDetector {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Self }

    pub async fn score(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> DimensionScore {
        let mut contradictions = Vec::new();
        let mut evidence = Vec::new();

        for i in 0..trajectory.turns.len() {
            for j in (i + 1)..trajectory.turns.len() {
                let a = &trajectory.turns[i];
                let b = &trajectory.turns[j];
                if let Some(c) = self.detect_contradiction(a, b) {
                    contradictions.push(c);
                    evidence.push(format!("Contradição entre {} e {}", a.id, b.id));
                }
            }
        }

        let score = if contradictions.is_empty() { 1.0 } else {
            (1.0 - (contradictions.len() as f32 / trajectory.turns.len() as f32 * 0.3)).max(0.0)
        };

        let details = if contradictions.is_empty() {
            "✅ Nenhuma contradição detectada.".into()
        } else {
            format!("⚠️ {} contradições detectadas.", contradictions.len())
        };

        DimensionScore::new(score, details).with_evidence(evidence)
    }

    fn detect_contradiction(&self, a: &Turn, b: &Turn) -> Option<String> {
        let ta = a.content.to_lowercase();
        let tb = b.content.to_lowercase();

        let negation_pairs = [("não", "sim"), ("falso", "verdadeiro"), ("errado", "certo")];
        for (neg, pos) in &negation_pairs {
            if (ta.contains(neg) && tb.contains(pos)) || (ta.contains(pos) && tb.contains(neg)) {
                return Some(format!("'{}' vs '{}'", neg, pos));
            }
        }

        if ta.contains("não") ^ tb.contains("não") {
            let similar = strsim::normalized_levenshtein(&ta, &tb);
            if similar > 0.8 {
                return Some("Afirmações semanticamente similares com negação oposta".into());
            }
        }
        None
    }
}
'''

# 4.7 src/validation_detector.rs — CORRIGIDO: usa DimensionScore compartilhado
session_valid = '''use crate::*;
use crate::types::DimensionScore;
use regex::Regex;

pub struct ValidationDetector {
    patterns: Vec<Regex>,
}

impl ValidationDetector {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            patterns: vec![
                Regex::new(r"verifiquei que .*").unwrap(),
                Regex::new(r"confirmei que .*").unwrap(),
                Regex::new(r"validei que .*").unwrap(),
                Regex::new(r"testei que .*").unwrap(),
            ],
        }
    }

    pub async fn score(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> DimensionScore {
        let mut validations = Vec::new();
        let mut evidence = Vec::new();

        for turn in &trajectory.turns {
            if turn.role == TurnRole::Assistant {
                for re in &self.patterns {
                    if re.is_match(&turn.content) {
                        validations.push(turn.id.clone());
                        evidence.push(format!("Turno {} contém validação", turn.id));
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        let total = trajectory.turns.iter().filter(|t| t.role == TurnRole::Assistant).count();
        let score = if total == 0 { 0.0 } else { validations.len() as f32 / total as f32 };

        let details = if score >= 0.8 {
            format!("✅ {} de {} turns contêm validação explícita.", validations.len(), total)
        } else {
            format!("🟡 {} de {} turns contêm validação explícita.", validations.len(), total)
        };

        DimensionScore::new(score, details).with_evidence(evidence)
    }
}
'''

# 4.8 src/artifact_analyzer.rs — CORRIGIDO: usa DimensionScore compartilhado
session_artifact = '''use crate::*;
use crate::types::DimensionScore;

pub struct ArtifactAnalyzer;

impl ArtifactAnalyzer {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Self }

    pub async fn score(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> DimensionScore {
        let mut evidence = Vec::new();
        let mut compilable_count = 0;
        let mut testable_count = 0;

        for artifact in &trajectory.artifacts {
            if artifact.artifact_type == ArtifactType::Code {
                let compilable = self.check_compilable(artifact);
                let testable = self.check_testable(artifact);

                evidence.push(format!(
                    "Artifact {}: {}",
                    artifact.id,
                    if compilable && testable { "✅ Compilável e testável" }
                    else if compilable { "🟡 Compilável" }
                    else { "❌ Não compilável" }
                ));

                if compilable { compilable_count += 1; }
                if testable { testable_count += 1; }
            }
        }

        let total = trajectory.artifacts.iter().filter(|a| a.artifact_type == ArtifactType::Code).count();
        let score = if total == 0 { 0.0 } else {
            (compilable_count as f32 / total as f32 * 0.7) + (testable_count as f32 / total as f32 * 0.3)
        };

        let details = if total == 0 {
            "Nenhum artefato de código gerado.".into()
        } else {
            format!("{} de {} artefatos compilam, {} testáveis.", compilable_count, total, testable_count)
        };

        DimensionScore::new(score, details).with_evidence(evidence)
    }

    fn check_compilable(&self, artifact: &Artifact) -> bool {
        let content = &artifact.content;
        content.contains("fn main()") || content.contains("use ") || content.contains("impl ")
    }

    fn check_testable(&self, artifact: &Artifact) -> bool {
        artifact.content.contains("#[cfg(test)]") ||
        artifact.content.contains("#[test]") ||
        artifact.content.contains("assert_eq")
    }
}
'''

# 3. mistralrs_backend.rs — BACKEND REAL IMPLEMENTADO

mistralrs_backend = '''//! Backend Mistral.rs — Inference via mistral.rs
//!
//! ## API Real (v0.8.1)
//!
//! ```ignore
//! use mistralrs::{IsqBits, ModelBuilder, TextMessages, TextMessageRole};
//!
//! let model = ModelBuilder::new("deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3")
//!     .with_auto_isq(IsqBits::Four)
//!     .build()
//!     .await?;
//!
//! let response = model.chat("Hello!").await?;
//! ```
//!
//! ## Modelos Suportados
//!
//! - DeepSeek-V3/V4 (via GGUF ou safetensors)
//! - Mistral 7B / Nemo / Large
//! - Gemma 2/3 / 4
//! - Qwen 2.5 / 3
//! - Llama 3 / 4

#![cfg(feature = "mistralrs")]

use crate::{
    InferenceEngine, InferenceRequest, InferenceResponse, InferenceError,
    ModelId, ModelCapabilities, ChatMessage, ChatRole, TokenUsage, FinishReason,
};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use tracing::{info, warn, debug};
use chrono::Utc;
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Configuração do backend Mistral.rs
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct MistralRsConfig {
    /// ID do modelo no HuggingFace ou caminho local
    pub model_id: String,
    /// Bits para quantização ISQ (In-Situ Quantization)
    pub isq_bits: IsqBits,
    /// Tamanho do contexto
    pub context_size: u32,
    /// Device preferido ("cuda", "cpu", "metal")
    pub device: String,
}

impl Default for MistralRsConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            model_id: "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3".into(),
            isq_bits: IsqBits::Four,
            context_size: 128_000,
            device: "cuda".into(),
        }
    }
}

/// Bits de quantização ISQ do mistral.rs
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
pub enum IsqBits {
    /// Sem quantização (FP16/BF16)
    None,
    /// 4 bits (Q4_0 / Q4_K_M)
    Four,
    /// 5 bits (Q5_K_M)
    Five,
    /// 8 bits (Q8_0)
    Eight,
}

impl IsqBits {
    fn to_mistralrs(&self) -> mistralrs::IsqBits {
        match self {
            Self::None => mistralrs::IsqBits::None,
            Self::Four => mistralrs::IsqBits::Four,
            Self::Five => mistralrs::IsqBits::Five,
            Self::Eight => mistralrs::IsqBits::Eight,
        }
    }
}

/// Engine Mistral.rs
pub struct MistralRsEngine {
    model_id: ModelId,
    config: MistralRsConfig,
    model: Arc<Mutex<Option<mistralrs::Model>>>,
    ready: bool,
}

impl MistralRsEngine {
    /// Cria um novo engine Mistral.rs (lazy load).
    pub fn new(model_id: ModelId, config: MistralRsConfig) -> Self {
        info!("🚀 Mistral.rs engine created for: {}", model_id.full());
        Self {
            model_id,
            config,
            model: Arc::new(Mutex::new(None)),
            ready: false,
        }
    }

    /// Carrega o modelo (blocking — executa em spawn_blocking).
    pub async fn load(&mut self) -> Result<(), InferenceError> {
        if self.ready {
            return Ok(());
        }

        let model_id = self.config.model_id.clone();
        let isq = self.config.isq_bits;
        let context_size = self.config.context_size;

        let model = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
            let rt = tokio::runtime::Handle::current();
            rt.block_on(async {
                let builder = mistralrs::ModelBuilder::new(&model_id)
                    .with_auto_isq(isq.to_mistralrs());

                builder.build().await.map_err(|e| {
                    InferenceError::LoadFailed(format!("mistralrs: {}", e))
                })
            })
        })
        .await
        .map_err(|e| InferenceError::Internal(e.to_string()))?
        .map_err(|e| e)?;

        let mut guard = self.model.lock().await;
        *guard = Some(model);
        drop(guard);

        self.ready = true;
        info!("✅ Mistral.rs model loaded: {}", self.config.model_id);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Formata mensagens Arkhe para formato mistral.rs TextMessages.
    fn format_messages(&self, messages: &[ChatMessage]) -> mistralrs::TextMessages {
        let mut tm = mistralrs::TextMessages::new();
        for msg in messages {
            let role = match msg.role {
                ChatRole::System => mistralrs::TextMessageRole::System,
                ChatRole::User => mistralrs::TextMessageRole::User,
                ChatRole::Assistant => mistralrs::TextMessageRole::Assistant,
                ChatRole::Tool => mistralrs::TextMessageRole::User, // Tool como User
            };
            tm = tm.add_message(role, &msg.content);
        }
        tm
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl InferenceEngine for MistralRsEngine {
    fn model_id(&self) -> &ModelId {
        &self.model_id
    }

    async fn complete(&self, request: InferenceRequest) -> Result<InferenceResponse, InferenceError> {
        if !self.ready {
            return Err(InferenceError::NotReady {
                model_id: self.model_id.clone(),
            });
        }

        let guard = self.model.lock().await;
        let model = guard.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
            InferenceError::Internal("Model not initialized".into())
        })?;

        let messages = self.format_messages(&request.messages);
        let prompt = messages.to_string(); // Fallback se chat não disponível

        // Usa a API chat do mistral.rs
        let response_text = model.chat(&prompt).await.map_err(|e| {
            InferenceError::InferenceFailed(format!("mistralrs chat: {}", e))
        })?;

        let prompt_tokens = request.messages.iter()
            .map(|m| m.content.split_whitespace().count())
            .sum::<usize>() as u32;
        let completion_tokens = response_text.split_whitespace().count() as u32;

        Ok(InferenceResponse {
            content: response_text,
            tool_calls: Vec::new(),
            usage: TokenUsage::new(prompt_tokens, completion_tokens),
            finish_reason: FinishReason::Stop,
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
            metadata: {
                let mut m = HashMap::new();
                m.insert("backend".into(), "mistralrs".into());
                m.insert("model_id".into(), self.config.model_id.clone());
                m
            },
        })
    }

    async fn stream(
        &self,
        _request: InferenceRequest,
        _callback: Box<dyn Fn(InferenceResponse) + Send>,
    ) -> Result<(), InferenceError> {
        // Streaming requer API específica do mistral.rs (RequestBuilder)
        // Implementação futura
        Err(InferenceError::UnsupportedCapability(
            "Streaming via mistral.rs requer implementação adicional".into(),
        ))
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> ModelCapabilities {
        ModelCapabilities {
            max_context_tokens: self.config.context_size,
            tool_calling: true,
            streaming: false, // Ainda não implementado
            multimodal: false,
            min_vram_gb: None,
            weights_size_gb: None,
            active_params_b: None,
            total_params_b: None,
        }
    }

    async fn is_ready(&self) -> bool {
        self.ready
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn isq_bits_mapping() {
        assert!(matches!(IsqBits::Four.to_mistralrs(), mistralrs::IsqBits::Four));
        assert!(matches!(IsqBits::Eight.to_mistralrs(), mistralrs::IsqBits::Eight));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn engine_not_ready_without_load() {
        let engine = MistralRsEngine::new(
            ModelId::new("test", "mistral"),
            MistralRsConfig::default(),
        );
        assert!(!engine.is_ready().await);
    }
}
'''

    f.write(mistralrs_backend)

inference_types = '''use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct InferenceRequest {
    pub messages: Vec<ChatMessage>,
    pub params: SamplingParams,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub tools: Vec<ToolDefinition>,

    pub session_id: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ChatMessage {
    pub role: ChatRole,
    pub content: String,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub name: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]
    pub tool_calls: Vec<ToolCall>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum ChatRole {
    System,
    User,
    Assistant,
    Tool,
}

impl std::fmt::Display for ChatRole {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::System => write!(f, "system"),
            Self::User => write!(f, "user"),
            Self::Assistant => write!(f, "assistant"),
            Self::Tool => write!(f, "tool"),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SamplingParams {
    #[serde(default = "default_temperature")]
    pub temperature: f32,
    #[serde(default = "default_top_p")]
    pub top_p: f32,
    #[serde(default = "default_top_k")]
    pub top_k: u32,
    #[serde(default = "default_max_tokens")]
    pub max_tokens: u32,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]
    pub stop_sequences: Vec<String>,
}

fn default_temperature() -> f32 { 0.7 }
fn default_top_p() -> f32 { 0.9 }
fn default_top_k() -> u32 { 40 }
fn default_max_tokens() -> u32 { 4096 }

impl Default for SamplingParams {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            temperature: default_temperature(),
            top_p: default_top_p(),
            top_k: default_top_k(),
            max_tokens: default_max_tokens(),
            stop_sequences: Vec::new(),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ToolDefinition {
    pub name: String,
    pub description: String,
    pub parameters: serde_json::Value,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ToolCall {
    pub id: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub arguments: serde_json::Value,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct InferenceResponse {
    pub content: String,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]
    pub tool_calls: Vec<ToolCall>,
    pub usage: TokenUsage,
    pub finish_reason: FinishReason,
    pub timestamp: DateTime<Utc>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "HashMap::is_empty")]
    pub metadata: HashMap<String, String>,
}

/// ✅ CORRIGIDO: Construtor e métodos utilitários adicionados
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
pub struct TokenUsage {
    pub prompt_tokens: u32,
    pub completion_tokens: u32,
    pub total_tokens: u32,
}

impl TokenUsage {
    /// Cria um novo TokenUsage a partir de contagens individuais.
    pub fn new(prompt_tokens: u32, completion_tokens: u32) -> Self {
        Self {
            prompt_tokens,
            completion_tokens,
            total_tokens: prompt_tokens + completion_tokens,
        }
    }

    /// Retorna true se nenhum token foi consumido.
    pub fn is_zero(&self) -> bool {
        self.total_tokens == 0
    }

    /// Soma dois usos de tokens.
    pub fn add(&self, other: &Self) -> Self {
        Self {
            prompt_tokens: self.prompt_tokens + other.prompt_tokens,
            completion_tokens: self.completion_tokens + other.completion_tokens,
            total_tokens: self.total_tokens + other.total_tokens,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum FinishReason {
    Stop,
    Length,
    ToolCall,
    Error,
}

inference_registry = '''use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ModelId {
    pub org: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub variant: Option<String>,
}

impl ModelId {
    pub fn new(org: &str, name: &str) -> Self {
        Self { org: org.to_string(), name: name.to_string(), variant: None }
    }
    pub fn with_variant(mut self, variant: &str) -> Self {
        self.variant = Some(variant.to_string());
        self
    }
    pub fn canonical(&self) -> String { format!("{}:{}", self.org, self.name) }
    pub fn full(&self) -> String {
        match &self.variant {
            Some(v) => format!("{}:{}:{}", self.org, self.name, v),
            None => self.canonical(),
        }
    }
}

impl std::fmt::Display for ModelId {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        f.write_str(&self.full())
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ModelCapabilities {

}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum BackendType { GGUF, Candle, Api }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum ModelLicense { Mit, Apache2, CustomPermissive, Proprietary }

impl ModelLicense {

        matches!(self, Self::Mit | Self::Apache2)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ModelEntry {
    pub id: ModelId,

    pub capabilities: ModelCapabilities,
    pub backend: BackendType,
    pub license: ModelLicense,
    pub download_url: Option<String>,
    pub compatibility_score: u8,
}

pub struct ModelRegistry { entries: HashMap<String, ModelEntry> }

impl ModelRegistry {
    pub fn recommended() -> Self {
        let mut reg = Self::empty();
        reg.register_deepseek_v3();
        reg.register_gemma_4_12b();
        reg.register_leanstral();
        reg
    }
    pub fn empty() -> Self { Self { entries: HashMap::new() } }

    fn register(&mut self, entry: ModelEntry) {
        self.entries.insert(entry.id.canonical(), entry);
    }

    fn register_deepseek_v3(&mut self) {
        self.register(ModelEntry {
            id: ModelId::new("deepseek", "deepseek-v3").with_variant("fp8"),
            display_name: "DeepSeek-V3 (FP8)".into(),
            capabilities: ModelCapabilities {
                max_context_tokens: 128_000,
                tool_calling: true,
                streaming: true,
                multimodal: false,
                min_vram_gb: Some(80.0),
                weights_size_gb: Some(685.0 / 1024.0),
                active_params_b: Some(37),
                total_params_b: Some(671),
            },
            backend: BackendType::GGUF,
            license: ModelLicense::Mit,
            download_url: Some("https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3".into()),
            compatibility_score: 95,
        });
    }

    fn register_gemma_4_12b(&mut self) {
        self.register(ModelEntry {
            id: ModelId::new("google", "gemma-4-12b").with_variant("q4_k_m"),
            display_name: "Gemma 4 12B (Q4_K_M)".into(),
            capabilities: ModelCapabilities {
                max_context_tokens: 256_000,
                tool_calling: true,
                streaming: true,
                multimodal: true,
                min_vram_gb: Some(16.0),
                weights_size_gb: Some(7.5),
                active_params_b: Some(12),
                total_params_b: Some(12),
            },
            backend: BackendType::Candle,
            license: ModelLicense::Apache2,
            download_url: Some("https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-4-12b-it".into()),
            compatibility_score: 88,
        });
    }

    fn register_leanstral(&mut self) {
        self.register(ModelEntry {
            id: ModelId::new("mistral", "leanstral").with_variant("q4_k_m"),
            display_name: "Mistral Leanstral (Q4_K_M)".into(),
            capabilities: ModelCapabilities {
                max_context_tokens: 128_000,
                tool_calling: true,
                streaming: true,
                multimodal: false,
                min_vram_gb: Some(24.0),
                weights_size_gb: Some(35.0),
                active_params_b: Some(6),
                total_params_b: Some(119),
            },
            backend: BackendType::Candle,
            license: ModelLicense::Apache2,
            download_url: Some("https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Leanstral".into()),
            compatibility_score: 90,
        });
    }

    pub fn get(&self, canonical_id: &str) -> Option<&ModelEntry> {
        self.entries.get(canonical_id)
    }
    pub fn list(&self) -> Vec<&ModelEntry> {
        let mut entries: Vec<_> = self.entries.values().collect();
        entries.sort_by(|a, b| b.compatibility_score.cmp(&a.compatibility_score));
        entries
    }
}

inference_engine = '''use crate::{InferenceRequest, InferenceResponse, ModelCapabilities, ModelId, InferenceError};
use async_trait::async_trait;

/// Trait unificado para engines de inferência.
///
/// Todo backend (mistralrs, candle, null) implementa este trait.
#[async_trait]
pub trait InferenceEngine: Send + Sync {
    /// Retorna o ID do modelo carregado.
    fn model_id(&self) -> &ModelId;

    /// Executa inferência completa (não-streaming).
    async fn complete(&self, request: InferenceRequest) -> Result<InferenceResponse, InferenceError>;

    /// Executa inferência com streaming via callback.
    async fn stream(
        &self,
        request: InferenceRequest,
        callback: Box<dyn Fn(InferenceResponse) + Send>,
    ) -> Result<(), InferenceError>;

    /// Retorna as capacidades do modelo.
    fn capabilities(&self) -> ModelCapabilities;

    /// Verifica se o engine está pronto para inferência.
    async fn is_ready(&self) -> bool;
}
'''

# 2.7 src/null.rs
inference_null = '''use crate::{
    InferenceEngine, InferenceRequest, InferenceResponse, InferenceError,
    ModelId, ModelCapabilities, TokenUsage, FinishReason,
};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use chrono::Utc;
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Engine nulo para testes e desenvolvimento.
///
/// Não requer nenhum modelo ou dependência externa.
/// Retorna respostas determinísticas baseadas no prompt.
pub struct NullEngine {
    model_id: ModelId,
    prefix: String,
}

impl NullEngine {
    pub fn new(model_id: ModelId) -> Self {
        Self { model_id, prefix: "[null-engine] ".into() }
    }
    pub fn with_prefix(mut self, prefix: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        self.prefix = prefix.into();
        self
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl InferenceEngine for NullEngine {
    fn model_id(&self) -> &ModelId { &self.model_id }

    async fn complete(&self, request: InferenceRequest) -> Result<InferenceResponse, InferenceError> {
        let last_msg = request.messages.last().map(|m| m.content.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
        Ok(InferenceResponse {
            content: format!("{}{}", self.prefix, last_msg),
            tool_calls: Vec::new(),
            usage: TokenUsage::new(10, 5),
            finish_reason: FinishReason::Stop,
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
            metadata: HashMap::new(),
        })
    }

    async fn stream(
        &self,
        request: InferenceRequest,
        callback: Box<dyn Fn(InferenceResponse) + Send>,
    ) -> Result<(), InferenceError> {
        callback(self.complete(request).await?);
        Ok(())
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> ModelCapabilities {
        ModelCapabilities {
            max_context_tokens: 4096,
            tool_calling: false,
            streaming: false,
            multimodal: false,
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }

    async fn is_ready(&self) -> bool { true }
}
'''

use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct InferenceRequest {
    pub messages: Vec<ChatMessage>,
    pub params: SamplingParams,
    #[serde(default)]

pub struct TokenUsage {
    pub prompt_tokens: u32,
    pub completion_tokens: u32,
    pub total_tokens: u32,
}

impl TokenUsage {
    pub fn new(prompt_tokens: u32, completion_tokens: u32) -> Self {
        Self {
            prompt_tokens,
            completion_tokens,
            total_tokens: prompt_tokens + completion_tokens,
        }
    }

    pub fn is_zero(&self) -> bool {
        self.total_tokens == 0
    }

    pub fn add(&self, other: &Self) -> Self {
        Self {
            prompt_tokens: self.prompt_tokens + other.prompt_tokens,
            completion_tokens: self.completion_tokens + other.completion_tokens,
            total_tokens: self.total_tokens + other.total_tokens,
        }
    }
}

//! ✅ FIX: NullEngine implementado (faltava no original).

use async_trait::async_trait;
use chrono::Utc;
use crate::{
    InferenceEngine, InferenceRequest, InferenceResponse, InferenceResult,
    ModelId, TokenUsage, FinishReason,
};

/// Motor nulo — retorna resposta placeholder sem chamada real.
/// Útil para testes e desenvolvimento.
pub struct NullEngine {
    model_id: ModelId,
}

impl NullEngine {
    pub fn new(model_id: ModelId) -> Self {
        Self { model_id }
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl InferenceEngine for NullEngine {
    fn model_id(&self) -> &ModelId {
        &self.model_id
    }

    async fn complete(&self, request: InferenceRequest) -> InferenceResult<InferenceResponse> {
        let last_user_msg = request
            .messages
            .iter()
            .rev()
            .find(|m| m.role == crate::ChatRole::User)
            .map(|m| m.content.as_str())
            .unwrap_or("(empty)");

        Ok(InferenceResponse {
            content: format!("[NullEngine] Echo: {}", last_user_msg),
            tool_calls: Vec::new(),
            usage: TokenUsage::new(10, 5),
            finish_reason: FinishReason::Stop,
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
            metadata: Default::default(),
        })
    }

    fn is_ready(&self) -> bool {
        true
    }
}
