//! Arkhe Inference — Camada de inferência local-first para Arkhe OS.
//!
//! ## Filosofia
//!
//! - Modelos rodam localmente sempre que possível
//! - APIs centrais são fallback, não padrão
//! - Cada backend é feature-gated

#![warn(missing_docs)]
#![deny(unsafe_code)]

pub mod error;
pub mod types;
pub mod registry;
pub mod engine;
pub mod null;

#[cfg(feature = "mistralrs")]
pub mod mistralrs_backend;

#[cfg(feature = "candle")]
pub mod candle_backend;

#[cfg(feature = "gguf")]
pub mod gguf_backend;

pub use error::InferenceError;
pub use types::{
    InferenceRequest, InferenceResponse, ChatMessage, ChatRole,
    TokenUsage, FinishReason, SamplingParams, ToolDefinition, ToolCall,
};
pub use registry::{ModelId, ModelRegistry, ModelCapabilities, BackendType, ModelLicense};
pub use engine::InferenceEngine;
pub use null::NullEngine;

/// Resultado tipado de inferência.
pub type InferenceResult<T> = Result<T, InferenceError>;

### 1.3 `src/error.rs`

```rust
use arkhe_core::ArkheError;
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum InferenceError {
    #[error("Model not found: {0}")]
    ModelNotFound(String),

    #[error("Model load failed: {0}")]
    LoadFailed(String),

    #[error("Inference failed: {0}")]
    InferenceFailed(String),

    #[error("Context length exceeded: requested {requested}, max {max}")]
    ContextOverflow { requested: usize, max: usize },

    #[error("Unsupported capability: {0:?}")]
    UnsupportedCapability(String),

    #[error("Backend not available: {0}. Enable feature '{1}' in Cargo.toml")]
    BackendNotAvailable(String, String),

    #[error("Timeout after {0:?}")]
    Timeout(std::time::Duration),

    #[error("Engine not ready: {model_id}")]
    NotReady { model_id: ModelId },

    #[error("Invalid request: {0}")]
    InvalidRequest(String),

    #[error("Internal inference error: {0}")]
    Internal(String),

    #[error(transparent)]
    Core(#[from] ArkheError),
}
```

use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct InferenceRequest {
    pub messages: Vec<ChatMessage>,
    pub params: SamplingParams,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub tools: Vec<ToolDefinition>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub session_id: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ChatMessage {
    pub role: ChatRole,
    pub content: String,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub name: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]
    pub tool_calls: Vec<ToolCall>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum ChatRole {
    System,
    User,
    Assistant,
    Tool,
}

impl std::fmt::Display for ChatRole {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::System => write!(f, "system"),
            Self::User => write!(f, "user"),
            Self::Assistant => write!(f, "assistant"),
            Self::Tool => write!(f, "tool"),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SamplingParams {
    #[serde(default = "default_temperature")]
    pub temperature: f32,
    #[serde(default = "default_top_p")]
    pub top_p: f32,
    #[serde(default = "default_top_k")]
    pub top_k: u32,
    #[serde(default = "default_max_tokens")]
    pub max_tokens: u32,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]
    pub stop_sequences: Vec<String>,
}

fn default_temperature() -> f32 { 0.7 }
fn default_top_p() -> f32 { 0.9 }
fn default_top_k() -> u32 { 40 }
fn default_max_tokens() -> u32 { 4096 }

impl Default for SamplingParams {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            temperature: default_temperature(),
            top_p: default_top_p(),
            top_k: default_top_k(),
            max_tokens: default_max_tokens(),
            stop_sequences: Vec::new(),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ToolDefinition {
    pub name: String,
    pub description: String,
    pub parameters: serde_json::Value,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ToolCall {
    pub id: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub arguments: serde_json::Value,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct InferenceResponse {
    pub content: String,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]
    pub tool_calls: Vec<ToolCall>,
    pub usage: TokenUsage,
    pub finish_reason: FinishReason,
    pub timestamp: DateTime<Utc>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "HashMap::is_empty")]

}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
pub struct TokenUsage {
    pub prompt_tokens: u32,
    pub completion_tokens: u32,
    pub total_tokens: u32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum FinishReason {
    Stop,
    Length,
    ToolCall,

}

### 1.5 `src/registry.rs`

```rust
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ModelId {
    pub org: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub variant: Option<String>,
}

impl ModelId {
    pub fn new(org: &str, name: &str) -> Self {
        Self { org: org.to_string(), name: name.to_string(), variant: None }
    }
    pub fn with_variant(mut self, variant: &str) -> Self {
        self.variant = Some(variant.to_string());
        self
    }
    pub fn canonical(&self) -> String { format!("{}:{}", self.org, self.name) }
    pub fn full(&self) -> String {
        match &self.variant {
            Some(v) => format!("{}:{}:{}", self.org, self.name, v),
            None => self.canonical(),
        }
    }
}

impl std::fmt::Display for ModelId {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        f.write_str(&self.full())
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ModelCapabilities {
    pub max_context_tokens: u32,
    pub tool_calling: bool,
    pub streaming: bool,
    pub multimodal: bool,
    pub min_vram_gb: Option<f32>,
    pub weights_size_gb: Option<f32>,
    pub active_params_b: Option<u32>,
    pub total_params_b: Option<u32>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum BackendType { GGUF, Candle, Api }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum ModelLicense { Mit, Apache2, CustomPermissive, Proprietary }

impl ModelLicense {
    pub fn is_commercially_free(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, Self::Mit | Self::Apache2)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ModelEntry {
    pub id: ModelId,
    pub display_name: String,
    pub capabilities: ModelCapabilities,
    pub backend: BackendType,
    pub license: ModelLicense,
    pub download_url: Option<String>,

}

pub struct ModelRegistry { entries: HashMap<String, ModelEntry> }

impl ModelRegistry {
    pub fn recommended() -> Self {

        reg.register_deepseek_v3();
        reg.register_gemma_4_12b();
        reg.register_leanstral();
        reg
    }
    pub fn empty() -> Self { Self { entries: HashMap::new() } }

    fn register(&mut self, entry: ModelEntry) {
        self.entries.insert(entry.id.canonical(), entry);
    }

    fn register_deepseek_v3(&mut self) {
        self.register(ModelEntry {
            id: ModelId::new("deepseek", "deepseek-v3").with_variant("fp8"),
            display_name: "DeepSeek-V3 (FP8)".into(),
            capabilities: ModelCapabilities {
                max_context_tokens: 128_000,
                tool_calling: true,
                streaming: true,
                multimodal: false,
                min_vram_gb: Some(80.0),
                weights_size_gb: Some(685.0 / 1024.0),
                active_params_b: Some(37),
                total_params_b: Some(671),
            },
            backend: BackendType::GGUF,
            license: ModelLicense::Mit,
            download_url: Some("https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3".into()),
            compatibility_score: 95,
        });
    }

    fn register_gemma_4_12b(&mut self) {
        self.register(ModelEntry {
            id: ModelId::new("google", "gemma-4-12b").with_variant("q4_k_m"),
            display_name: "Gemma 4 12B (Q4_K_M)".into(),
            capabilities: ModelCapabilities {
                max_context_tokens: 256_000,
                tool_calling: true,
                streaming: true,
                multimodal: true,
                min_vram_gb: Some(16.0),
                weights_size_gb: Some(7.5),
                active_params_b: Some(12),
                total_params_b: Some(12),
            },
            backend: BackendType::Candle,
            license: ModelLicense::Apache2,
            download_url: Some("https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-4-12b-it".into()),
            compatibility_score: 88,
        });
    }

    fn register_leanstral(&mut self) {
        self.register(ModelEntry {
            id: ModelId::new("mistral", "leanstral").with_variant("q4_k_m"),
            display_name: "Mistral Leanstral (Q4_K_M)".into(),
            capabilities: ModelCapabilities {
                max_context_tokens: 128_000,
                tool_calling: true,
                streaming: true,
                multimodal: false,
                min_vram_gb: Some(24.0),
                weights_size_gb: Some(35.0),
                active_params_b: Some(6),
                total_params_b: Some(119),
            },
            backend: BackendType::Candle,
            license: ModelLicense::Apache2,
            download_url: Some("https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Leanstral".into()),
            compatibility_score: 90,
        });
    }

    pub fn get(&self, canonical_id: &str) -> Option<&ModelEntry> {
        self.entries.get(canonical_id)
    }
    pub fn list(&self) -> Vec<&ModelEntry> {
        let mut entries: Vec<_> = self.entries.values().collect();
        entries.sort_by(|a, b| b.compatibility_score.cmp(&a.compatibility_score));
        entries
    }
}

```rust
use crate::{
    InferenceEngine, InferenceRequest, InferenceResponse, InferenceError,
    ModelId, ModelCapabilities, ChatMessage, ChatRole, TokenUsage, FinishReason,
};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use chrono::Utc;
use std::collections::HashMap;

pub struct NullEngine {
    model_id: ModelId,
    prefix: String,
}

impl NullEngine {
    pub fn new(model_id: ModelId) -> Self {
        Self { model_id, prefix: "[null-engine] ".into() }
    }
    pub fn with_prefix(mut self, prefix: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        self.prefix = prefix.into();
        self
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl InferenceEngine for NullEngine {
    fn model_id(&self) -> &ModelId { &self.model_id }

    async fn complete(&self, request: InferenceRequest) -> Result<InferenceResponse, InferenceError> {
        let last_msg = request.messages.last().map(|m| m.content.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
        Ok(InferenceResponse {
            content: format!("{}{}", self.prefix, last_msg),
            tool_calls: Vec::new(),
            usage: TokenUsage::new(10, 5),
            finish_reason: FinishReason::Stop,
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
            metadata: HashMap::new(),
        })
    }

    async fn stream(
        &self,
        request: InferenceRequest,
        callback: Box<dyn Fn(InferenceResponse) + Send>,
    ) -> Result<(), InferenceError> {
        callback(self.complete(request).await?);
        Ok(())
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> ModelCapabilities {
        ModelCapabilities {
            max_context_tokens: 4096,
            tool_calling: false,
            streaming: false,
            multimodal: false,
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }

    async fn is_ready(&self) -> bool { true }
}

use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};

### 2.4 `src/evaluator.rs`

```rust
use crate::*;
use crate::causal_consistency::CausalConsistencyScorer;
use crate::contradiction::ContradictionDetector;
use crate::validation_detector::ValidationDetector;
use crate::artifact_analyzer::ArtifactAnalyzer;
use tracing::info;

pub struct SessionEvaluator {
    causal_scorer: CausalConsistencyScorer,
    contradiction_detector: ContradictionDetector,
    validation_detector: ValidationDetector,
    artifact_analyzer: ArtifactAnalyzer,
}

impl SessionEvaluator {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            causal_scorer: CausalConsistencyScorer::new(),
            contradiction_detector: ContradictionDetector::new(),
            validation_detector: ValidationDetector::new(),
            artifact_analyzer: ArtifactAnalyzer::new(),
        }
    }

    pub async fn evaluate(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> EvaluationResult {
        info!("📊 Avaliando sessão: {}", trajectory.id);
        let mut dimensions = Vec::new();

        let causal_score = self.causal_scorer.score(trajectory).await;
        dimensions.push(EvaluationDimension {
            name: "Causal Consistency".into(),
            score: causal_score.score,
            details: causal_score.details,
            evidence: causal_score.evidence,
        });

        let contradiction_score = self.contradiction_detector.score(trajectory).await;
        dimensions.push(EvaluationDimension {
            name: "Contradiction Detection".into(),
            score: contradiction_score.score,
            details: contradiction_score.details,
            evidence: contradiction_score.evidence,
        });

        let validation_score = self.validation_detector.score(trajectory).await;
        dimensions.push(EvaluationDimension {
            name: "Explicit Validation".into(),
            score: validation_score.score,
            details: validation_score.details,
            evidence: validation_score.evidence,
        });

        let artifact_score = self.artifact_analyzer.score(trajectory).await;
        dimensions.push(EvaluationDimension {
            name: "Artifact Quality".into(),
            score: artifact_score.score,
            details: artifact_score.details,
            evidence: artifact_score.evidence,
        });

        let weights = [0.25, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30];
        let overall_score = dimensions.iter().zip(weights.iter()).map(|(d, w)| d.score * w).sum();

        let (summary, highlights, concerns, suggestions) = self.generate_insights(&dimensions);

        EvaluationResult {
            session_id: trajectory.id.clone(),
            overall_score,
            dimensions,
            summary,
            highlights,
            concerns,
            suggestions,
        }
    }

    fn generate_insights(&self, dims: &[EvaluationDimension]) -> (String, Vec<String>, Vec<String>, Vec<String>) {
        let mut highlights = Vec::new();
        let mut concerns = Vec::new();
        let mut suggestions = Vec::new();

        for dim in dims {
            if dim.score >= 0.85 {
                highlights.push(format!("✅ {}: {:.0}%", dim.name, dim.score * 100.0));
            } else if dim.score < 0.60 {
                concerns.push(format!("⚠️ {}: {:.0}%", dim.name, dim.score * 100.0));
                suggestions.push(self.generate_suggestion(dim));
            }
        }

        let summary = format!(
            "Sessão com {} dimensões. Score geral: {:.0}%. {} destaques, {} preocupações.",
            dims.len(),
            dims.iter().map(|d| d.score).sum::<f32>() / dims.len() as f32 * 100.0,
            highlights.len(),
            concerns.len()
        );
        (summary, highlights, concerns, suggestions)
    }

    fn generate_suggestion(&self, dim: &EvaluationDimension) -> String {
        match dim.name.as_str() {
            "Causal Consistency" => "Reforce a cadeia causal: explique como cada conclusão deriva da anterior.".into(),
            "Contradiction Detection" => "Revise afirmações conflitantes: mantenha consistência entre turns.".into(),
            "Explicit Validation" => "Inclua validações explícitas: 'verifiquei que X é verdade porque Y'.".into(),
            "Artifact Quality" => "Valide artefatos com testes: execute `cargo check` e `cargo test`.".into(),
            _ => "Revise a dimensão para melhorar a qualidade da sessão.".into(),
        }
    }
}

impl Default for SessionEvaluator {
    fn default() -> Self { Self::new() }
}
```

### 2.5 `src/causal_consistency.rs`

```rust
use crate::*;
use std::collections::HashMap;

pub struct CausalConsistencyScorer;

impl CausalConsistencyScorer {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Self }

    pub async fn score(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> DimensionScore {
        let mut evidence = Vec::new();
        let mut links = Vec::new();

        for turn in &trajectory.turns {
            let extracted = self.extract_causal_links(turn, &trajectory.turns);
            links.extend(extracted);
        }

        let score = if links.is_empty() { 0.5 } else { 0.95 };
        let details = if links.is_empty() {
            "Nenhum link causal explícito encontrado.".into()
        } else {
            format!("{} links causais identificados.", links.len())
        };

        DimensionScore { score, details, evidence }
    }

    fn extract_causal_links(&self, turn: &Turn, all_turns: &[Turn]) -> Vec<CausalLink> {
        let mut links = Vec::new();
        let text = turn.content.to_lowercase();

        let patterns = [
            ("porque", CausalRelation::Premise),
            ("já que", CausalRelation::Premise),
            ("portanto", CausalRelation::Refinement),
            ("consequentemente", CausalRelation::Refinement),
            ("logo", CausalRelation::Refinement),
            ("corrigindo", CausalRelation::Correction),
            ("na verdade", CausalRelation::Correction),
            ("verifiquei", CausalRelation::Validation),
        ];

        for (pattern, relation) in &patterns {
            if text.contains(pattern) {
                if let Some(prev) = all_turns.iter().find(|t| t.id != turn.id) {
                    links.push(CausalLink {
                        from_turn: prev.id.clone(),
                        to_turn: turn.id.clone(),
                        relation: relation.clone(),
                        strength: 0.7,
                    });
                }
                break;
            }
        }
        links
    }
}

pub struct DimensionScore {
    pub score: f32,
    pub details: String,
    pub evidence: Vec<String>,
}
```

### 2.6 `src/contradiction.rs`

```rust
use crate::*;

pub struct ContradictionDetector;

impl ContradictionDetector {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Self }

    pub async fn score(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> DimensionScore {
        let mut contradictions = Vec::new();
        let mut evidence = Vec::new();

        for i in 0..trajectory.turns.len() {
            for j in (i + 1)..trajectory.turns.len() {
                let a = &trajectory.turns[i];
                let b = &trajectory.turns[j];
                if let Some(c) = self.detect_contradiction(a, b) {
                    contradictions.push(c);
                    evidence.push(format!("Contradição entre {} e {}", a.id, b.id));
                }
            }
        }

        let score = if contradictions.is_empty() { 1.0 } else {
            (1.0 - (contradictions.len() as f32 / trajectory.turns.len() as f32 * 0.3)).max(0.0)
        };

        let details = if contradictions.is_empty() {
            "✅ Nenhuma contradição detectada.".into()
        } else {
            format!("⚠️ {} contradições detectadas.", contradictions.len())
        };

        DimensionScore { score, details, evidence }
    }

    fn detect_contradiction(&self, a: &Turn, b: &Turn) -> Option<String> {
        let ta = a.content.to_lowercase();
        let tb = b.content.to_lowercase();

        let negation_pairs = [("não", "sim"), ("falso", "verdadeiro"), ("errado", "certo")];
        for (neg, pos) in &negation_pairs {
            if (ta.contains(neg) && tb.contains(pos)) || (ta.contains(pos) && tb.contains(neg)) {
                return Some(format!("'{}' vs '{}'", neg, pos));
            }
        }

        if ta.contains("não") ^ tb.contains("não") {
            let similar = strsim::normalized_levenshtein(&ta, &tb);
            if similar > 0.8 {
                return Some("Afirmações semanticamente similares com negação oposta".into());
            }
        }
        None
    }
}
```

### 2.7 `src/validation_detector.rs`

```rust
use crate::*;
use regex::Regex;

pub struct ValidationDetector {
    patterns: Vec<Regex>,
}

impl ValidationDetector {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            patterns: vec![
                Regex::new(r"verifiquei que .*").unwrap(),
                Regex::new(r"confirmei que .*").unwrap(),
                Regex::new(r"validei que .*").unwrap(),
                Regex::new(r"testei que .*").unwrap(),
            ],
        }
    }

    pub async fn score(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> DimensionScore {
        let mut validations = Vec::new();
        let mut evidence = Vec::new();

        for turn in &trajectory.turns {
            if turn.role == TurnRole::Assistant {
                for re in &self.patterns {
                    if re.is_match(&turn.content) {
                        validations.push(turn.id.clone());
                        evidence.push(format!("Turno {} contém validação", turn.id));
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        let total = trajectory.turns.iter().filter(|t| t.role == TurnRole::Assistant).count();
        let score = if total == 0 { 0.0 } else { validations.len() as f32 / total as f32 };

        let details = if score >= 0.8 {
            format!("✅ {} de {} turns contêm validação explícita.", validations.len(), total)
        } else {
            format!("🟡 {} de {} turns contêm validação explícita.", validations.len(), total)
        };

        DimensionScore { score, details, evidence }
    }
}

### 2.8 `src/artifact_analyzer.rs`

```rust
use crate::*;

pub struct ArtifactAnalyzer;

impl ArtifactAnalyzer {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Self }

    pub async fn score(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> DimensionScore {
        let mut evidence = Vec::new();
        let mut compilable_count = 0;
        let mut testable_count = 0;

        for artifact in &trajectory.artifacts {
            if artifact.artifact_type == ArtifactType::Code {
                let compilable = self.check_compilable(artifact);
                let testable = self.check_testable(artifact);

                evidence.push(format!(
                    "Artifact {}: {}",
                    artifact.id,
                    if compilable && testable { "✅ Compilável e testável" }
                    else if compilable { "🟡 Compilável" }
                    else { "❌ Não compilável" }
                ));

                if compilable { compilable_count += 1; }
                if testable { testable_count += 1; }
            }
        }

        let total = trajectory.artifacts.iter().filter(|a| a.artifact_type == ArtifactType::Code).count();
        let score = if total == 0 { 0.0 } else {
            (compilable_count as f32 / total as f32 * 0.7) + (testable_count as f32 / total as f32 * 0.3)
        };

        let details = if total == 0 {
            "Nenhum artefato de código gerado.".into()
        } else {
            format!("{} de {} artefatos compilam, {} testáveis.", compilable_count, total, testable_count)
        };

        DimensionScore { score, details, evidence }
    }

    fn check_compilable(&self, artifact: &Artifact) -> bool {
        let content = &artifact.content;
        content.contains("fn main()") || content.contains("use ") || content.contains("impl ")
    }

    fn check_testable(&self, artifact: &Artifact) -> bool {
        artifact.content.contains("#[cfg(test)]") ||
        artifact.content.contains("#[test]") ||
        artifact.content.contains("assert_eq")
    }
}
```

### 3.3 `src/reflector.rs`

```rust
use arkhe_session_evaluator::{SessionEvaluator, SessionTrajectory, EvaluationResult};
use arkhe_memory_v2::EvolutionaryMemoryV2;
use arkhe_llm::InferenceEngine;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tracing::{info, debug};
use uuid::Uuid;

pub struct ReflectorAgent {
    evaluator: SessionEvaluator,
    memory: Arc<EvolutionaryMemoryV2>,
    llm: Arc<dyn InferenceEngine>,
}

impl ReflectorAgent {
    pub fn new(memory: Arc<EvolutionaryMemoryV2>, llm: Arc<dyn InferenceEngine>) -> Self {
        Self { evaluator: SessionEvaluator::new(), memory, llm }
    }

    pub async fn reflect(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> Result<ReflectionReport, String> {
        info!("🪞 Refletindo sobre sessão: {}", trajectory.id);
        let evaluation = self.evaluator.evaluate(trajectory).await;

        let causal_patterns = self.extract_causal_patterns(trajectory, &evaluation).await?;
        let procedural_patterns = self.extract_procedural_patterns(trajectory, &evaluation).await?;

        self.consolidate_patterns(&causal_patterns, &procedural_patterns, &evaluation).await?;

        Ok(ReflectionReport {
            session_id: trajectory.id.clone(),
            evaluation,
            causal_patterns,
            procedural_patterns,
            recommendations: self.generate_recommendations(&evaluation).await?,
        })
    }

    async fn extract_causal_patterns(
        &self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory, evaluation: &EvaluationResult
    ) -> Result<Vec<CausalPattern>, String> {
        Ok(vec![CausalPattern {
            id: format!("cp_{}", Uuid::new_v4()),
            antecedent: "O agente valida suposições".into(),
            consequent: "O código compila na primeira tentativa".into(),
            confidence: 0.85,
            source_session: trajectory.id.clone(),
        }])
    }

    async fn extract_procedural_patterns(
        &self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory, evaluation: &EvaluationResult
    ) -> Result<Vec<ProceduralPattern>, String> {
        let mut patterns = Vec::new();
        if evaluation.overall_score > 0.8 {
            patterns.push(ProceduralPattern {
                id: format!("pp_{}", Uuid::new_v4()),
                name: "Validação e Iteração".into(),
                description: "O agente validou suposições e iterou sobre o código até compilar.".into(),
                success_rate: evaluation.overall_score,
                source_session: trajectory.id.clone(),
            });
        }
        Ok(patterns)
    }

    async fn consolidate_patterns(
        &self, causal: &[CausalPattern], procedural: &[ProceduralPattern], evaluation: &EvaluationResult
    ) -> Result<(), String> {
        for p in causal { self.memory.store_causal_pattern(p).await?; }
        for p in procedural { self.memory.store_procedural_pattern(p).await?; }
        self.memory.store_episode(&evaluation.session_id, evaluation.overall_score, &evaluation.summary).await?;
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn generate_recommendations(&self, evaluation: &EvaluationResult) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
        Ok(evaluation.dimensions.iter()
            .filter(|d| d.score < 0.6)
            .map(|d| format!("Melhorar '{}': {}", d.name, d.details))
            .collect())
    }
}

    pub session_id: String,

    pub procedural_patterns: Vec<ProceduralPattern>,

}

### 4.4 `src/working.rs`

```rust
use crate::types::WorkingMemoryEntry;
use dashmap::DashMap;
use chrono::{Utc, Duration};
use tracing::debug;

pub struct WorkingMemory {
    entries: DashMap<String, WorkingMemoryEntry>,
    max_entries: usize,
    default_ttl: u64,
}

impl WorkingMemory {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self { entries: DashMap::new(), max_entries: 100, default_ttl: 300 }
    }

    pub fn insert(&self, id: &str, content: &str, relevance: f32) {
        if self.entries.len() >= self.max_entries { self.evict_oldest(); }
        self.entries.insert(id.to_string(), WorkingMemoryEntry {
            id: id.to_string(), content: content.to_string(),
            timestamp: Utc::now(), relevance, ttl: Some(self.default_ttl),
        });
        debug!("🧠 Working memory: inserted '{}'", id);
    }

    pub fn get(&self, id: &str) -> Option<WorkingMemoryEntry> {
        self.entries.get(id).map(|e| e.clone())
    }

    pub fn get_relevant(&self, threshold: f32) -> Vec<WorkingMemoryEntry> {
        let now = Utc::now();
        self.entries.iter()
            .filter(|e| e.value().relevance >= threshold && !self.is_expired(e.value()))
            .map(|e| e.clone())
            .collect()
    }

    pub fn remove(&self, id: &str) { self.entries.remove(id); }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize { self.entries.len() }

    fn is_expired(&self, entry: &WorkingMemoryEntry) -> bool {
        entry.ttl.map_or(false, |ttl| Utc::now() - entry.timestamp >= Duration::seconds(ttl as i64))
    }

    fn evict_oldest(&self) {
        if let Some(oldest) = self.entries.iter().min_by_key(|e| e.value().timestamp) {
            self.entries.remove(oldest.key());
        }
    }
}

impl Default for WorkingMemory {
    fn default() -> Self { Self::new() }
}

### 4.5 `src/episodic.rs`

```rust
use crate::types::{EpisodicEntry, MemoryError};
use chrono::Utc;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;
use tracing::debug;

#[cfg(feature = "persistent")]
use sled::Db;

pub struct EpisodicMemory {
    #[cfg(feature = "persistent")]
    store: Arc<Db>,
    cache: Arc<RwLock<Vec<EpisodicEntry>>>,
}

impl EpisodicMemory {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        #[cfg(feature = "persistent")]
        let store = Arc::new(sled::open("./episodic_memory").expect("Failed to open episodic memory DB"));

        let mut cache = Vec::new();
        #[cfg(feature = "persistent")]
        {
            for item in store.iter() {
                if let Ok((_, value)) = item {
                    if let Ok(entry) = rmp_serde::from_slice::<EpisodicEntry>(&value) {
                        cache.push(entry);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Self {
            #[cfg(feature = "persistent")]
            store,
            cache: Arc::new(RwLock::new(cache)),
        }
    }

    pub async fn store(&self, id: &str, score: f32, summary: &str) -> Result<(), MemoryError> {
        let entry = EpisodicEntry {
            id: id.to_string(), session_id: id.to_string(), score,
            summary: summary.to_string(), timestamp: Utc::now(),
            duration_secs: 0, tags: Vec::new(),
        };

        let mut cache = self.cache.write().await;
        cache.push(entry.clone());
        drop(cache);

        #[cfg(feature = "persistent")]
        {
            let serialized = rmp_serde::to_vec(&entry)
                .map_err(|e| MemoryError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;
            self.store.insert(id.as_bytes(), serialized)
                .map_err(|e| MemoryError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;
        }

        debug!("🧠 Episodic memory: stored session '{}' (score: {})", id, score);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn get_recent(&self, limit: usize) -> Vec<EpisodicEntry> {
        let mut cache = self.cache.write().await;
        cache.sort_by(|a, b| b.timestamp.cmp(&a.timestamp));
        cache.iter().take(limit).cloned().collect()
    }

    pub async fn get_all(&self) -> Vec<EpisodicEntry> {
        self.cache.read().await.clone()
    }

    pub async fn search(&self, query: &str) -> Vec<EpisodicEntry> {
        self.cache.read().await.iter()
            .filter(|e| e.summary.contains(query))
            .cloned()
            .collect()
    }

    pub async fn compact(&self, max_entries: usize) {
        let mut cache = self.cache.write().await;
        if cache.len() > max_entries {
            cache.sort_by(|a, b| b.timestamp.cmp(&a.timestamp));
            cache.truncate(max_entries);
            #[cfg(feature = "persistent")]
            {
                let _ = self.store.clear();
                for entry in cache.iter() {
                    if let Ok(serialized) = rmp_serde::to_vec(entry) {
                        let _ = self.store.insert(entry.id.as_bytes(), serialized);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

impl Default for EpisodicMemory {
    fn default() -> Self { Self::new() }
}
```

### 4.6 `src/semantic.rs`

```rust
use crate::types::CausalPattern;
use dashmap::DashMap;
use chrono::Utc;
use tracing::debug;

pub struct SemanticMemory {
    patterns: DashMap<String, CausalPattern>,
}

impl SemanticMemory {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Self { patterns: DashMap::new() } }

    pub async fn store_pattern(&self, pattern: &CausalPattern) -> Result<(), MemoryError> {
        let mut p = pattern.clone();
        p.updated_at = Utc::now();

        if let Some(existing) = self.patterns.get(&pattern.id) {
            let merged = self.merge_patterns(&existing, &p);
            self.patterns.insert(pattern.id.clone(), merged);
        } else {
            self.patterns.insert(pattern.id.clone(), p);
        }
        debug!("🧠 Semantic memory: stored causal pattern '{}'", pattern.id);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn get_patterns(&self) -> Vec<CausalPattern> {
        self.patterns.iter().map(|e| e.clone()).collect()
    }

    pub async fn get_by_confidence(&self, min_confidence: f32) -> Vec<CausalPattern> {
        self.patterns.iter()
            .filter(|e| e.confidence >= min_confidence)
            .map(|e| e.clone())
            .collect()
    }

    fn merge_patterns(&self, a: &CausalPattern, b: &CausalPattern) -> CausalPattern {
        let mut merged = a.clone();
        merged.confidence = (a.confidence + b.confidence) / 2.0;
        merged.updated_at = Utc::now();

        let mut sources = a.source_sessions.clone();
        for src in &b.source_sessions {
            if !sources.contains(src) { sources.push(src.clone()); }
        }
        merged.source_sessions = sources;
        merged
    }

    pub async fn compact(&self, min_confidence: f32) {
        let to_remove: Vec<String> = self.patterns.iter()
            .filter(|e| e.confidence < min_confidence)
            .map(|e| e.key().clone())
            .collect();
        for key in to_remove { self.patterns.remove(&key); }
        debug!("🧠 Semantic memory: removed {} patterns", to_remove.len());
    }
}

impl Default for SemanticMemory {
    fn default() -> Self { Self::new() }
}
```

### 4.7 `src/procedural.rs`

```rust
use crate::types::ProceduralPattern;
use dashmap::DashMap;
use chrono::Utc;
use tracing::debug;

pub struct ProceduralMemory {
    patterns: DashMap<String, ProceduralPattern>,
}

impl ProceduralMemory {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Self { patterns: DashMap::new() } }

    pub async fn store_pattern(&self, pattern: &ProceduralPattern) -> Result<(), MemoryError> {
        let mut p = pattern.clone();
        p.updated_at = Utc::now();

        if let Some(existing) = self.patterns.get(&pattern.id) {
            p.success_rate = (existing.success_rate + p.success_rate) / 2.0;
            let mut sources = existing.source_sessions.clone();
            for src in &p.source_sessions {
                if !sources.contains(src) { sources.push(src.clone()); }
            }
            p.source_sessions = sources;
        }

        self.patterns.insert(pattern.id.clone(), p);
        debug!("🧠 Procedural memory: stored pattern '{}'", pattern.id);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn get_patterns(&self) -> Vec<ProceduralPattern> {
        self.patterns.iter().map(|e| e.clone()).collect()
    }

    pub async fn get_best(&self, limit: usize) -> Vec<ProceduralPattern> {
        let mut all: Vec<ProceduralPattern> = self.patterns.iter().map(|e| e.clone()).collect();
        all.sort_by(|a, b| b.success_rate.partial_cmp(&a.success_rate).unwrap());
        all.truncate(limit);
        all
    }

    pub async fn compact(&self, min_success_rate: f32) {
        let to_remove: Vec<String> = self.patterns.iter()
            .filter(|e| e.success_rate < min_success_rate)
            .map(|e| e.key().clone())
            .collect();
        for key in to_remove { self.patterns.remove(&key); }
        debug!("🧠 Procedural memory: removed {} patterns", to_remove.len());
    }
}

impl Default for ProceduralMemory {
    fn default() -> Self { Self::new() }
}

use arkhe_llm::NullEngine;
use arkhe_memory_v2::EvolutionaryMemoryV2;
use arkhe_reflector_agent::ReflectorAgent;
use arkhe_session_evaluator::{SessionEvaluator, SessionTrajectory};
use clap::{Parser, Subcommand};
use std::sync::Arc;

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(name = "arkhe-skills", about = "Gerencie skills do Arkhe OS")]
struct Cli {
    #[command(subcommand)]
    command: Commands,
}

#[derive(Subcommand)]
enum Commands {
    /// Avalia uma sessão
    Evaluate { session_id: String },
    /// Reflete sobre uma sessão
    Reflect { session_id: String },
    /// Lista sessões
    List,
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    tracing_subscriber::fmt::init();
    let cli = Cli::parse();

    let memory = Arc::new(EvolutionaryMemoryV2::new());
    let llm = Arc::new(NullEngine::new(arkhe_llm::ModelId::new("arkhe", "null")));
    let reflector = ReflectorAgent::new(memory.clone(), llm);

    match cli.command {
        Commands::Evaluate { session_id } => {
            let evaluator = SessionEvaluator::new();
            let trajectory = load_trajectory(&session_id).await?;
            let result = evaluator.evaluate(&trajectory).await;
            println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&result)?);
        }
        Commands::Reflect { session_id } => {
            let trajectory = load_trajectory(&session_id).await?;
            let report = reflector.reflect(&trajectory).await?;
            println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&report)?);
        }
        Commands::List => {
            println!("Sessões disponíveis: (implementar com store)");
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}

async fn load_trajectory(_id: &str) -> Result<SessionTrajectory, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    Ok(SessionTrajectory {
        id: "demo".into(),
        agent_did: "did:arkhe:agent".into(),
        turns: vec![],
        artifacts: vec![],
        start_time: chrono::Utc::now(),
        end_time: None,
        metadata: std::collections::HashMap::new(),
    })
}

rust
//! # Arkhe LLM Adapter
//!
//! Adaptador unificado para inferência de LLMs no Arkhe OS, com suporte a:
//!
//! - **DeepSeek-V3/V4** via mistralrs (auto-detect) ou candle-transformers
//! - **Gemma 4 12B** otimizado para dispositivos de borda (16GB VRAM)
//! - **Leanstral** (Mistral AI) para verificação formal em Lean 4
//! - **Ponte Kani/TLA+ ↔ Lean 4** para verificação cross-layer
//! - **Procedural macro `#[derive(LeanSpec)]`** para geração automática de specs
//!
//! ## Arquitetura
//!
//! ```text
//! ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
//! │                    Arkhe LLM Adapter                         │
//! ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
//! │  Adapters          │  Verification        │  Macros          │
//! │  ├── DeepSeek      │  ├── KaniBridge      │  └── LeanSpec    │
//! │  ├── Gemma4        │  ├── TlaBridge       │                  │
//! │  └── Leanstral     │  └── CrossLayer      │                  │
//! └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
//! ```
//!
//! ## Uso Rápido
//!
//! ```rust,no_run
//! use arkhe_llm_adapter::{LlmAdapter, AdapterConfig, ModelFamily};
//!
//! #[tokio::main]
//! async fn main() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
//!     let config = AdapterConfig::new(ModelFamily::DeepSeekV4)
//!         .with_quantization(Quantization::Q4_K_M)
//!         .with_vram_limit_gb(16);
//!
//!     let adapter = LlmAdapter::load(config).await?;
//!     let response = adapter.chat("Explique a arquitetura Arkhe").await?;
//!     println!("{}", response);
//!     Ok(())
//! }
//! ```

#![warn(missing_docs)]
#![deny(unsafe_code)]

pub mod adapters;
pub mod verification;
pub mod types;
pub mod ci;

#[cfg(feature = "lean")]
pub mod lean;

//! Tipos fundamentais para o adaptador LLM.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::fmt;

/// Erros do adaptador LLM.
#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum LlmError {
    #[error("Modelo não suportado: {0}")]
    UnsupportedModel(String),

    #[error("Backend não disponível: {0}")]
    BackendUnavailable(String),

    #[error("VRAM insuficiente: requer {required}GB, disponível {available}GB")]
    InsufficientVram { required: f32, available: f32 },

    #[error("Erro de inference: {0}")]
    InferenceError(String),

    #[error("Erro de verificação formal: {0}")]
    VerificationError(String),

    #[error("Lean 4 não encontrado: {0}")]
    LeanNotFound(String),

    #[error("Erro de comunicação: {0}")]
    CommunicationError(String),

    #[error("Timeout após {0}s")]
    Timeout(u64),

    #[error("Erro interno: {0}")]
    Internal(String),
}

pub type LlmResult<T> = Result<T, LlmError>;

/// Família de modelos suportados.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum ModelFamily {
    /// DeepSeek-V3 (37B ativados, 671B total)
    DeepSeekV3,
    /// DeepSeek-V4 (próxima geração)
    DeepSeekV4,
    /// Gemma 4 12B (Google, Apache 2.0)
    Gemma4_12B,
    /// Gemma 4 26B A4B
    Gemma4_26B,
    /// Gemma 4 31B
    Gemma4_31B,
    /// Leanstral (Mistral AI para Lean 4)
    Leanstral,
    /// Qwen 3 (Alibaba)
    Qwen3,
    /// Llama 4 (Meta)
    Llama4,
}

impl fmt::Display for ModelFamily {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::DeepSeekV3 => write!(f, "deepseek-v3"),
            Self::DeepSeekV4 => write!(f, "deepseek-v4"),
            Self::Gemma4_12B => write!(f, "gemma-4-12b"),
            Self::Gemma4_26B => write!(f, "gemma-4-26b"),
            Self::Gemma4_31B => write!(f, "gemma-4-31b"),
            Self::Leanstral => write!(f, "leanstral"),
            Self::Qwen3 => write!(f, "qwen3"),
            Self::Llama4 => write!(f, "llama4"),
        }
    }
}

/// Nível de quantização.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum Quantization {
    /// Sem quantização (FP16/BF16)
    None,
    /// Q4_0 — 4.5 bits, menor tamanho
    Q4_0,
    /// Q4_K_M — ~4.7 bits, qualidade próxima de FP16
    Q4_K_M,
    /// Q5_K_M — ~5.7 bits, melhor qualidade
    Q5_K_M,
    /// Q8_0 — 8 bits, quase sem perda
    Q8_0,
    /// QAT Q4_0 — Quantization-Aware Training, melhor qualidade por GB
    QatQ4_0,
}

impl Quantization {
    /// Retorna o fator de compressão relativo a FP16.
    pub fn compression_factor(&self) -> f32 {
        match self {
            Self::None => 1.0,
            Self::Q4_0 => 3.5,
            Self::Q4_K_M => 3.8,
            Self::Q5_K_M => 3.0,
            Self::Q8_0 => 2.0,
            Self::QatQ4_0 => 3.8,
        }
    }

    /// VRAM estimado em GB para um modelo dado (parâmetros em bilhões).
    pub fn estimated_vram_gb(&self, params_b: f32) -> f32 {
        let base_size = params_b * 2.0; // FP16 = 2 bytes por parâmetro
        base_size / self.compression_factor()
    }
}

/// Backend de inferência.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum InferenceBackend {
    /// Mistral.rs (recomendado, suporte mais amplo)
    MistralRs,
    /// Candle (HuggingFace, pure Rust)
    Candle,
    /// llama.cpp (via bindings)
    LlamaCpp,
    /// Ollama (API local)
    Ollama,
}

/// Parâmetros de geração.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct GenerationParams {
    /// Temperatura (0.0 = determinístico, 1.0 = criativo)
    pub temperature: f32,
    /// Máximo de tokens a gerar
    pub max_tokens: usize,
    /// Top-p sampling
    pub top_p: f32,
    /// Penalidade de repetição
    pub repeat_penalty: f32,
    /// Seed para reprodutibilidade
    pub seed: Option<u64>,
}

impl Default for GenerationParams {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            temperature: 0.7,
            max_tokens: 2048,
            top_p: 0.9,
            repeat_penalty: 1.1,
            seed: None,
        }
    }
}

/// Papel em uma mensagem de chat.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum ChatRole {
    /// Mensagem do sistema
    System,
    /// Mensagem do usuário
    User,
    /// Resposta do assistente
    Assistant,
    /// Chamada de ferramenta
    Tool,
}

/// Mensagem de chat.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ChatMessage {
    /// Papel do remetente
    pub role: ChatRole,
    /// Conteúdo da mensagem
    pub content: String,
    /// Metadados opcionais
    pub metadata: Option<serde_json::Value>,
}

impl ChatMessage {
    /// Cria uma mensagem do sistema.
    pub fn system(content: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            role: ChatRole::System,
            content: content.into(),
            metadata: None,
        }
    }

    /// Cria uma mensagem do usuário.
    pub fn user(content: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            role: ChatRole::User,
            content: content.into(),
            metadata: None,
        }
    }

    /// Cria uma mensagem do assistente.
    pub fn assistant(content: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            role: ChatRole::Assistant,
            content: content.into(),
            metadata: None,
        }
    }
}

//! Adaptadores de LLM — DeepSeek, Gemma, Leanstral.

pub mod deepseek;
pub mod gemma;
pub mod leanstral;

use crate::types::*;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use std::sync::Arc;

/// Trait unificado para adaptadores LLM.
#[async_trait]
pub trait LlmAdapter: Send + Sync {
    /// Retorna a família do modelo.
    fn family(&self) -> ModelFamily;

    /// Retorna o backend utilizado.
    fn backend(&self) -> InferenceBackend;

    /// Gera texto a partir de um prompt.
    async fn generate(&self, prompt: &str, params: &GenerationParams) -> LlmResult<String>;

    /// Chat completion com histórico.
    async fn chat(&self, messages: &[ChatMessage], params: &GenerationParams) -> LlmResult<String>;

    /// Verifica se o modelo está carregado e pronto.
    fn is_ready(&self) -> bool;

    /// Retorna estatísticas de uso (VRAM, tokens/s, etc.).
    fn stats(&self) -> AdapterStats;
}

/// Estatísticas do adaptador.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct AdapterStats {
    /// VRAM utilizada em GB
    pub vram_used_gb: f32,
    /// VRAM total disponível em GB
    pub vram_total_gb: f32,
    /// Tokens por segundo (geração)
    pub tokens_per_second: f32,
    /// Tokens no contexto atual
    pub context_tokens: usize,
    /// Máximo de tokens de contexto
    pub max_context_tokens: usize,
    /// Temperatura atual
    pub temperature: f32,
}

/// Configuração do adaptador.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct AdapterConfig {
    /// Família do modelo
    pub family: ModelFamily,
    /// Backend preferido
    pub backend: InferenceBackend,
    /// Quantização
    pub quantization: Quantization,
    /// Limite de VRAM em GB (0 = auto-detect)
    pub vram_limit_gb: f32,
    /// Caminho do modelo local (None = download do HuggingFace)
    pub model_path: Option<String>,
    /// ID do modelo no HuggingFace
    pub hf_model_id: Option<String>,
    /// Device preferido (cpu, cuda, metal)
    pub device: String,
    /// Parâmetros de geração padrão
    pub default_params: GenerationParams,
}

impl AdapterConfig {
    /// Cria configuração para uma família de modelo.
    pub fn new(family: ModelFamily) -> Self {
        Self {
            family,
            backend: InferenceBackend::MistralRs,
            quantization: Quantization::Q4_K_M,
            vram_limit_gb: 0.0,
            model_path: None,
            hf_model_id: None,
            device: "cuda".to_string(),
            default_params: GenerationParams::default(),
        }
    }

    /// Define o backend.
    pub fn with_backend(mut self, backend: InferenceBackend) -> Self {
        self.backend = backend;
        self
    }

    /// Define a quantização.
    pub fn with_quantization(mut self, q: Quantization) -> Self {
        self.quantization = q;
        self
    }

    /// Define o limite de VRAM.
    pub fn with_vram_limit_gb(mut self, gb: f32) -> Self {
        self.vram_limit_gb = gb;
        self
    }

    /// Define o ID do modelo no HuggingFace.
    pub fn with_hf_model_id(mut self, id: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        self.hf_model_id = Some(id.into());
        self
    }

    /// Define o device.
    pub fn with_device(mut self, device: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        self.device = device.into();
        self
    }
}

/// Factory para criar adaptadores.
pub struct AdapterFactory;

impl AdapterFactory {
    /// Cria um adaptador baseado na configuração.
    pub async fn create(config: AdapterConfig) -> LlmResult<Arc<dyn LlmAdapter>> {
        match config.family {
            ModelFamily::DeepSeekV3 | ModelFamily::DeepSeekV4 => {
                deepseek::DeepSeekAdapter::load(config).await
            }
            ModelFamily::Gemma4_12B | ModelFamily::Gemma4_26B | ModelFamily::Gemma4_31B => {
                gemma::Gemma4Adapter::load(config).await
            }
            ModelFamily::Leanstral => {
                leanstral::LeanstralAdapter::load(config).await
            }
            _ => Err(LlmError::UnsupportedModel(config.family.to_string())),
        }
    }
}

//! Adaptador DeepSeek-V3/V4 via mistralrs ou candle.

use super::{AdapterConfig, AdapterStats, LlmAdapter};
use crate::types::*;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tracing::{debug, info, warn};

/// IDs padrão no HuggingFace para DeepSeek.
const HF_DEEPSEEK_V3: &str = "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3";
const HF_DEEPSEEK_V4: &str = "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4"; // Placeholder para futuro

/// Adaptador DeepSeek.
pub struct DeepSeekAdapter {
    config: AdapterConfig,
    #[cfg(feature = "mistralrs")]
    mistralrs_model: Option<mistralrs::Model>,
    #[cfg(feature = "candle")]
    candle_model: Option<candle_backend::CandleDeepSeek>,
    stats: parking_lot::Mutex<AdapterStats>,
}

#[cfg(feature = "candle")]
mod candle_backend {
    use candle_core::{Device, Tensor};
    use candle_transformers::models::deepseek::Model as DeepSeekModel;
    
    pub struct CandleDeepSeek {
        model: DeepSeekModel,
        device: Device,
    }
}

impl DeepSeekAdapter {
    /// Carrega o modelo DeepSeek.
    pub async fn load(config: AdapterConfig) -> LlmResult<Arc<dyn LlmAdapter>> {
        info!("🚀 Carregando DeepSeek: {:?}", config.family);

        // Verifica VRAM disponível
        let vram_required = config.quantization.estimated_vram_gb(671.0); // 671B params total
        info!("💾 VRAM estimado necessário: {:.1}GB", vram_required);

        match config.backend {
            #[cfg(feature = "mistralrs")]
            InferenceBackend::MistralRs => {
                Self::load_mistralrs(&config).await
            }
            #[cfg(feature = "candle")]
            InferenceBackend::Candle => {
                Self::load_candle(&config).await
            }
            _ => Err(LlmError::BackendUnavailable(format!(
                "Backend {:?} não disponível para DeepSeek",
                config.backend
            ))),
        }
    }

    #[cfg(feature = "mistralrs")]
    async fn load_mistralrs(config: &AdapterConfig) -> LlmResult<Arc<dyn LlmAdapter>> {
        use mistralrs::{IsqBits, ModelBuilder, TextMessages};

        let model_id = config.hf_model_id.as_deref()
            .unwrap_or(match config.family {
                ModelFamily::DeepSeekV3 => HF_DEEPSEEK_V3,
                ModelFamily::DeepSeekV4 => HF_DEEPSEEK_V4,
                _ => unreachable!(),
            });

        debug!("📥 Download/carregamento do modelo: {}", model_id);

        let builder = ModelBuilder::new(model_id);
        
        // Aplica quantização ISQ (In-Situ Quantization) do mistralrs
        let builder = match config.quantization {
            Quantization::Q4_0 | Quantization::Q4_K_M | Quantization::QatQ4_0 => {
                builder.with_auto_isq(IsqBits::Four)
            }
            Quantization::Q5_K_M => builder.with_auto_isq(IsqBits::Five),
            Quantization::Q8_0 => builder.with_auto_isq(IsqBits::Eight),
            Quantization::None => builder,
        };

        let model = builder.build().await.map_err(|e| {
            LlmError::InferenceError(format!("Falha ao carregar modelo mistralrs: {}", e))
        })?;

        info!("✅ DeepSeek carregado via mistralrs");

        Ok(Arc::new(Self {
            config: config.clone(),
            mistralrs_model: Some(model),
            #[cfg(feature = "candle")]
            candle_model: None,
            stats: parking_lot::Mutex::new(AdapterStats {
                vram_used_gb: 0.0,
                vram_total_gb: 0.0,
                tokens_per_second: 0.0,
                context_tokens: 0,
                max_context_tokens: 128_000, // DeepSeek-V3 suporta 128K
                temperature: config.default_params.temperature,
            }),
        }))
    }

    #[cfg(feature = "candle")]
    async fn load_candle(_config: &AdapterConfig) -> LlmResult<Arc<dyn LlmAdapter>> {
        // Implementação Candle para DeepSeek
        // Nota: candle-transformers pode não ter suporte nativo a DeepSeek-V3
        // mistralrs é o backend recomendado
        warn!("⚠️ Backend Candle para DeepSeek é experimental. Use mistralrs.");
        Err(LlmError::BackendUnavailable(
            "Candle backend para DeepSeek não implementado. Use mistralrs.".into()
        ))
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl LlmAdapter for DeepSeekAdapter {
    fn family(&self) -> ModelFamily {
        self.config.family
    }

    fn backend(&self) -> InferenceBackend {
        self.config.backend
    }

    async fn generate(&self, prompt: &str, params: &GenerationParams) -> LlmResult<String> {
        #[cfg(feature = "mistralrs")]
        if let Some(ref model) = self.mistralrs_model {
            let response = model.chat(prompt).await.map_err(|e| {
                LlmError::InferenceError(e.to_string())
            })?;
            return Ok(response);
        }

        Err(LlmError::InferenceError("Modelo não inicializado".into()))
    }

    async fn chat(&self, messages: &[ChatMessage], params: &GenerationParams) -> LlmResult<String> {
        // Converte ChatMessages para formato do backend
        let prompt = self.format_chat_prompt(messages);
        self.generate(&prompt, params).await
    }

    fn is_ready(&self) -> bool {
        #[cfg(feature = "mistralrs")]
        return self.mistralrs_model.is_some();
        #[cfg(not(feature = "mistralrs"))]
        false
    }

    fn stats(&self) -> AdapterStats {
        self.stats.lock().clone()
    }
}

impl DeepSeekAdapter {
    /// Formata mensagens de chat para prompt DeepSeek.
    fn format_chat_prompt(&self, messages: &[ChatMessage]) -> String {
        let mut prompt = String::new();
        for msg in messages {
            match msg.role {
                ChatRole::System => prompt.push_str(&format!("<|system|>\n{}\n", msg.content)),
                ChatRole::User => prompt.push_str(&format!("<|user|>\n{}\n", msg.content)),
                ChatRole::Assistant => prompt.push_str(&format!("<|assistant|>\n{}\n", msg.content)),
                ChatRole::Tool => prompt.push_str(&format!("<|tool|>\n{}\n", msg.content)),
            }
        }
        prompt.push_str("<|assistant|>\n");
        prompt
    }
}

//! Adaptador Gemma 4 12B otimizado para dispositivos de borda (16GB VRAM).

use super::{AdapterConfig, AdapterStats, LlmAdapter};
use crate::types::*;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tracing::{debug, info, warn};

/// IDs padrão no HuggingFace para Gemma 4.
const HF_GEMMA4_12B: &str = "google/gemma-4-12B-it";
const HF_GEMMA4_26B: &str = "google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it";
const HF_GEMMA4_31B: &str = "google/gemma-4-31B-it";

/// VRAM estimado para cada variação (Q4_K_M).
const VRAM_GEMMA4_12B_Q4: f32 = 6.6;  // GB
const VRAM_GEMMA4_26B_Q4: f32 = 14.4; // GB
const VRAM_GEMMA4_31B_Q4: f32 = 17.5; // GB

/// Adaptador Gemma 4.
pub struct Gemma4Adapter {
    config: AdapterConfig,
    #[cfg(feature = "mistralrs")]
    mistralrs_model: Option<mistralrs::Model>,
    stats: parking_lot::Mutex<AdapterStats>,
}

impl Gemma4Adapter {
    /// Carrega o modelo Gemma 4.
    pub async fn load(config: AdapterConfig) -> LlmResult<Arc<dyn LlmAdapter>> {
        info!("💎 Carregando Gemma 4: {:?}", config.family);

        // Verifica compatibilidade de VRAM
        let (vram_required, hf_id) = match config.family {
            ModelFamily::Gemma4_12B => (VRAM_GEMMA4_12B_Q4, HF_GEMMA4_12B),
            ModelFamily::Gemma4_26B => (VRAM_GEMMA4_26B_Q4, HF_GEMMA4_26B),
            ModelFamily::Gemma4_31B => (VRAM_GEMMA4_31B_Q4, HF_GEMMA4_31B),
            _ => unreachable!(),
        };

        // Se limite de VRAM definido, verifica
        if config.vram_limit_gb > 0.0 && vram_required > config.vram_limit_gb {
            return Err(LlmError::InsufficientVram {
                required: vram_required,
                available: config.vram_limit_gb,
            });
        }

        info!("💾 VRAM necessário: {:.1}GB (limite: {:.1}GB)", 
            vram_required, 
            if config.vram_limit_gb > 0.0 { config.vram_limit_gb } else { f32::INFINITY }
        );

        match config.backend {
            #[cfg(feature = "mistralrs")]
            InferenceBackend::MistralRs => {
                Self::load_mistralrs(&config, hf_id).await
            }
            _ => Err(LlmError::BackendUnavailable(
                "Gemma 4 requer backend mistralrs".into()
            )),
        }
    }

    #[cfg(feature = "mistralrs")]
    async fn load_mistralrs(config: &AdapterConfig, hf_id: &str) -> LlmResult<Arc<dyn LlmAdapter>> {
        use mistralrs::{IsqBits, ModelBuilder};

        let model_id = config.hf_model_id.as_deref().unwrap_or(hf_id);

        debug!("📥 Carregando Gemma 4 de: {}", model_id);

        let builder = ModelBuilder::new(model_id)
            .with_auto_isq(match config.quantization {
                Quantization::Q4_0 | Quantization::Q4_K_M | Quantization::QatQ4_0 => IsqBits::Four,
                Quantization::Q5_K_M => IsqBits::Five,
                Quantization::Q8_0 => IsqBits::Eight,
                Quantization::None => return Err(LlmError::InferenceError(
                    "Gemma 4 em edge requer quantização".into()
                )),
            });

        let model = builder.build().await.map_err(|e| {
            LlmError::InferenceError(format!("Falha ao carregar Gemma 4: {}", e))
        })?;

        info!("✅ Gemma 4 carregado: {} @ {:?}", model_id, config.quantization);

        Ok(Arc::new(Self {
            config: config.clone(),
            mistralrs_model: Some(model),
            stats: parking_lot::Mutex::new(AdapterStats {
                vram_used_gb: match config.family {
                    ModelFamily::Gemma4_12B => VRAM_GEMMA4_12B_Q4,
                    ModelFamily::Gemma4_26B => VRAM_GEMMA4_26B_Q4,
                    ModelFamily::Gemma4_31B => VRAM_GEMMA4_31B_Q4,
                    _ => 0.0,
                },
                vram_total_gb: config.vram_limit_gb,
                tokens_per_second: 0.0,
                context_tokens: 0,
                max_context_tokens: 256_000, // Gemma 4 suporta 256K context
                temperature: config.default_params.temperature,
            }),
        }))
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl LlmAdapter for Gemma4Adapter {
    fn family(&self) -> ModelFamily {
        self.config.family
    }

    fn backend(&self) -> InferenceBackend {
        self.config.backend
    }

    async fn generate(&self, prompt: &str, params: &GenerationParams) -> LlmResult<String> {
        #[cfg(feature = "mistralrs")]
        if let Some(ref model) = self.mistralrs_model {
            let response = model.chat(prompt).await.map_err(|e| {
                LlmError::InferenceError(e.to_string())
            })?;
            return Ok(response);
        }

        Err(LlmError::InferenceError("Modelo Gemma 4 não inicializado".into()))
    }

    async fn chat(&self, messages: &[ChatMessage], params: &GenerationParams) -> LlmResult<String> {
        let prompt = self.format_chat_prompt(messages);
        self.generate(&prompt, params).await
    }

    fn is_ready(&self) -> bool {
        #[cfg(feature = "mistralrs")]
        return self.mistralrs_model.is_some();
        #[cfg(not(feature = "mistralrs"))]
        false
    }

    fn stats(&self) -> AdapterStats {
        self.stats.lock().clone()
    }
}

impl Gemma4Adapter {
    /// Formata mensagens no formato Gemma 4.
    fn format_chat_prompt(&self, messages: &[ChatMessage]) -> String {
        let mut prompt = String::new();
        for msg in messages {
            match msg.role {
                ChatRole::System => prompt.push_str(&format!("<start_of_turn>user\n{}\n<end_of_turn>\n", msg.content)),
                ChatRole::User => prompt.push_str(&format!("<start_of_turn>user\n{}\n<end_of_turn>\n", msg.content)),
                ChatRole::Assistant => prompt.push_str(&format!("<start_of_turn>model\n{}\n<end_of_turn>\n", msg.content)),
                ChatRole::Tool => prompt.push_str(&format!("<start_of_turn>tool\n{}\n<end_of_turn>\n", msg.content)),
            }
        }
        prompt.push_str("<start_of_turn>model\n");
        prompt
    }
}

/// Verifica se o hardware suporta Gemma 4 12B.
pub fn check_edge_compatibility(vram_gb: f32) -> EdgeCompatibility {
    if vram_gb >= 16.0 {
        EdgeCompatibility::Optimal {
            recommended_quantization: Quantization::Q8_0,
            max_context: 256_000,
        }
    } else if vram_gb >= 8.0 {
        EdgeCompatibility::Compatible {
            recommended_quantization: Quantization::Q4_K_M,
            max_context: 128_000,
        }
    } else if vram_gb >= 6.0 {
        EdgeCompatibility::Limited {
            recommended_quantization: Quantization::Q4_0,
            max_context: 64_000,
        }
    } else {
        EdgeCompatibility::Incompatible {
            required_vram: 6.0,
            available_vram: vram_gb,
        }
    }
}

/// Resultado da verificação de compatibilidade edge.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum EdgeCompatibility {
    /// VRAM ótima — pode usar Q8 e contexto máximo
    Optimal { recommended_quantization: Quantization, max_context: usize },
    /// VRAM compatível — Q4_K_M recomendado
    Compatible { recommended_quantization: Quantization, max_context: usize },
    /// VRAM limitada — Q4_0 apenas
    Limited { recommended_quantization: Quantization, max_context: usize },
    /// Incompatível
    Incompatible { required_vram: f32, available_vram: f32 },
}

//! Adaptador Mistral Leanstral para verificação formal em Lean 4.

use super::{AdapterConfig, AdapterStats, LlmAdapter};
use crate::types::*;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use std::process::Stdio;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::process::Command;
use tracing::{debug, info, warn};

/// ID padrão Leanstral no HuggingFace.
const HF_LEANSTRAL: &str = "mistralai/Leanstral-7B";

/// Adaptador Leanstral — LLM especializado em Lean 4.
///
/// Leanstral é um agente de código que:
/// 1. Gera código Lean 4 a partir de especificações
/// 2. Prova propriedades de correção usando Lean 4
/// 3. Verifica formalmente a segurança de agentes
pub struct LeanstralAdapter {
    config: AdapterConfig,
    #[cfg(feature = "mistralrs")]
    mistralrs_model: Option<mistralrs::Model>,
    /// Caminho do executável lean (Lean 4)
    lean_path: Option<String>,
    stats: parking_lot::Mutex<AdapterStats>,
}

/// Resultado de verificação Lean 4.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct LeanVerificationResult {
    /// Status da verificação
    pub status: VerificationStatus,
    /// Provas geradas (código Lean 4)
    pub proofs: Vec<String>,
    /// Erros encontrados
    pub errors: Vec<String>,
    /// Tempo de verificação em ms
    pub verification_time_ms: u64,
    /// Métricas de cobertura
    pub coverage: f32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum VerificationStatus {
    /// Todas as propriedades provadas
    Verified,
    /// Algumas propriedades falharam
    Partial,
    /// Verificação falhou
    Failed,
    /// Timeout
    Timeout,
    /// Lean 4 não disponível
    LeanUnavailable,
}

impl LeanstralAdapter {
    /// Carrega o modelo Leanstral.
    pub async fn load(config: AdapterConfig) -> LlmResult<Arc<dyn LlmAdapter>> {
        info!("🔍 Carregando Leanstral para verificação formal");

        // Detecta instalação do Lean 4
        let lean_path = Self::detect_lean().await;

        match lean_path {
            Some(ref path) => info!("✅ Lean 4 detectado: {}", path),
            None => warn!("⚠️ Lean 4 não encontrado — verificação offline"),
        }

        #[cfg(feature = "mistralrs")]
        {
            use mistralrs::ModelBuilder;
            let model_id = config.hf_model_id.as_deref().unwrap_or(HF_LEANSTRAL);
            let model = ModelBuilder::new(model_id)
                .build()
                .await
                .map_err(|e| LlmError::InferenceError(e.to_string()))?;

            info!("✅ Leanstral carregado");

            Ok(Arc::new(Self {
                config: config.clone(),
                mistralrs_model: Some(model),
                lean_path,
                stats: parking_lot::Mutex::new(AdapterStats {
                    vram_used_gb: 7.0, // Leanstral ~7B params
                    vram_total_gb: config.vram_limit_gb,
                    tokens_per_second: 0.0,
                    context_tokens: 0,
                    max_context_tokens: 32_768,
                    temperature: 0.1, // Baixa temperatura para precisão formal
                }),
            }))
        }

        #[cfg(not(feature = "mistralrs"))]
        Err(LlmError::BackendUnavailable("mistralrs necessário para Leanstral".into()))
    }

    /// Detecta instalação do Lean 4.
    async fn detect_lean() -> Option<String> {
        // Tenta encontrar lean no PATH
        if let Ok(output) = Command::new("which").arg("lean").output().await {
            if output.status.success() {
                let path = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
                if !path.is_empty() {
                    return Some(path);
                }
            }
        }

        // Tenta caminhos comuns
        let common_paths = [
            "/usr/local/bin/lean",
            "/usr/bin/lean",
            "/opt/lean/bin/lean",
            "$HOME/.elan/bin/lean",
        ];

        for path in &common_paths {
            let expanded = shellexpand::full(path).unwrap_or_default().to_string();
            if tokio::fs::metadata(&expanded).await.is_ok() {
                return Some(expanded);
            }
        }

        None
    }

    /// Verifica formalmente uma propriedade usando Lean 4.
    pub async fn verify_property(
        &self,
        property_name: &str,
        lean_code: &str,
        timeout_secs: u64,
    ) -> LlmResult<LeanVerificationResult> {
        let start = std::time::Instant::now();

        let lean_path = match &self.lean_path {
            Some(p) => p.clone(),
            None => return Ok(LeanVerificationResult {
                status: VerificationStatus::LeanUnavailable,
                proofs: vec![],
                errors: vec!["Lean 4 não instalado".into()],
                verification_time_ms: 0,
                coverage: 0.0,
            }),
        };

        // Gera arquivo Lean 4 temporário
        let temp_dir = tempfile::tempdir()
            .map_err(|e| LlmError::Internal(e.to_string()))?;
        let proof_file = temp_dir.path().join(format!("{}.lean", property_name));

        let lean_script = format!(
            r#"
-- Propriedade: {property_name}
-- Gerado automaticamente por Arkhe Leanstral Adapter

{lean_code}

#check {property_name}
"#
        );

        tokio::fs::write(&proof_file, lean_script)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| LlmError::Internal(e.to_string()))?;

        // Executa Lean 4
        let output = Command::new(&lean_path)
            .arg(&proof_file)
            .stdout(Stdio::piped())
            .stderr(Stdio::piped())
            .kill_on_drop(true)
            .timeout(tokio::time::Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs))
            .output()
            .await;

        let duration = start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;

        match output {
            Ok(output) => {
                let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).to_string();
                let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).to_string();

                let status = if output.status.success() {
                    VerificationStatus::Verified
                } else if stderr.contains("error") {
                    VerificationStatus::Failed
                } else {
                    VerificationStatus::Partial
                };

                Ok(LeanVerificationResult {
                    status,
                    proofs: vec![lean_code.to_string()],
                    errors: if stderr.is_empty() { vec![] } else { vec![stderr] },
                    verification_time_ms: duration,
                    coverage: if output.status.success() { 1.0 } else { 0.0 },
                })
            }
            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::TimedOut => {
                Ok(LeanVerificationResult {
                    status: VerificationStatus::Timeout,
                    proofs: vec![],
                    errors: vec![format!("Timeout após {}s", timeout_secs)],
                    verification_time_ms: duration,
                    coverage: 0.0,
                })
            }
            Err(e) => Err(LlmError::VerificationError(e.to_string())),
        }
    }

    /// Gera prova Lean 4 a partir de especificação em linguagem natural.
    pub async fn generate_proof(
        &self,
        specification: &str,
    ) -> LlmResult<String> {
        let prompt = format!(
            r#"Você é um especialista em Lean 4. Gere uma prova formal para a seguinte especificação:

{specification}

Regras:
- Use apenas sintaxe Lean 4 válida
- Inclua todas as importações necessárias
- Forneça prova completa, não esboço
- Use tactics apropriadas (intro, apply, exact, etc.)

Código Lean 4:
"#
        );

        self.generate(&prompt, &GenerationParams {
            temperature: 0.1, // Precisão máxima
            max_tokens: 4096,
            top_p: 0.95,
            repeat_penalty: 1.0,
            seed: Some(42),
        }).await
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl LlmAdapter for LeanstralAdapter {
    fn family(&self) -> ModelFamily {
        ModelFamily::Leanstral
    }

    fn backend(&self) -> InferenceBackend {
        self.config.backend
    }

    async fn generate(&self, prompt: &str, params: &GenerationParams) -> LlmResult<String> {
        #[cfg(feature = "mistralrs")]
        if let Some(ref model) = self.mistralrs_model {
            let response = model.chat(prompt).await.map_err(|e| {
                LlmError::InferenceError(e.to_string())
            })?;
            return Ok(response);
        }

        Err(LlmError::InferenceError("Leanstral não inicializado".into()))
    }

    async fn chat(&self, messages: &[ChatMessage], params: &GenerationParams) -> LlmResult<String> {
        let prompt = messages.iter()
            .map(|m| format!("{:?}: {}", m.role, m.content))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join("\n");
        self.generate(&prompt, params).await
    }

    fn is_ready(&self) -> bool {
        #[cfg(feature = "mistralrs")]
        return self.mistralrs_model.is_some();
        #[cfg(not(feature = "mistralrs"))]
        false
    }

    fn stats(&self) -> AdapterStats {
        self.stats.lock().clone()
    }
}

## 2. `crates/arkhe-inference/src/lib.rs`

```rust
//! Arkhe Inference — Camada de inferência local-first para Arkhe OS.
//!
//! ## Filosofia
//!
//! Este crate implementa a estratégia de **soberania operacional** do Arkhe OS:
//! - Modelos rodam localmente sempre que possível
//! - APIs centrais são fallback, não padrão
//! - Cada backend é feature-gated (não force dependências pesadas)
//!
//! ## Modelos Prioritários (Análise de Compatibilidade 2026-06-26)
//!
//! | Prioridade | Modelo | Backend | Justificativa |
//! |------------|--------|---------|---------------|
//! | 1 | DeepSeek-V3/V4 | GGUF | MIT, execução local, 37B ativos |
//! | 2 | Gemma 4 12B | GGUF/Candle | 16GB VRAM, edge, Apache 2.0 |
//! | 3 | Llama 4 | GGUF | Potência bruta, mas licença restritiva |
//! | 4 | Mistral Leanstral | GGUF | Verificação formal (Lean 4) |
//!
//! ## Arquitetura
//!
//! ```text
//! InferenceEngine (trait)
//! ├── NullEngine        — para testes (sem dependências externas)
//! ├── GGUFEngine       — llama-cpp-2 (feature "gguf")
//! └── CandleEngine     — candle-core (feature "candle")
//!
//! ModelRegistry — catálogo de modelos compatíveis com Arkhe OS
//! InferenceRequest / InferenceResponse — tipos padronizados
//! ```
//!
//! ## Aviso sobre llama-cpp-2
//!
//! > *"As llama.cpp is a very fast moving target, this crate does not attempt
//! > to create a stable API with all the rust idioms."*
//!
//! O backend GGUF é feature-gated. A API do llama-cpp-2 muda frequentemente.
//! Se a compilação falhar com `features = ["gguf"]`, atualize a versão
//! em workspace.dependencies.

#![warn(missing_docs)]
#![deny(unsafe_code)]

pub mod error;
pub mod types;
pub mod registry;
pub mod null;

#[cfg(feature = "gguf")]
pub mod gguf;

#[cfg(feature = "candle")]
pub mod candle;

pub use error::InferenceError;
pub use types::{InferenceRequest, InferenceResponse, TokenUsage, ToolCall};
pub use registry::{ModelId, ModelRegistry, ModelCapabilities};
pub use null::NullEngine;

/// Trait unificado de inference — todo backend implementa isto.
///
/// ## Design Decisions
///
/// 1. **async**: Mesmo backends síncronos (llama-cpp-2) são wrapped em
///    `spawn_blocking` para não bloquear o runtime tokio.
/// 2. **`Send + Sync`**: Permite uso em contexto concorrente.
/// 3. **Sem generics no trait**: Simplifica composição e boxing.
pub trait InferenceEngine: Send + Sync {
    /// Identifica o modelo carregado.
    fn model_id(&self) -> &ModelId;

    /// Gera completamento de texto.
    async fn complete(&self, request: InferenceRequest) -> Result<InferenceResponse, InferenceError>;

    /// Gera completamento com streaming (se suportado).
    ///
    /// Implementações que não suportam streaming devem retornar
    /// o resultado completo em uma única chunk.
    async fn stream(
        &self,
        request: InferenceRequest,
        callback: Box<dyn Fn(InferenceResponse) + Send>,
    ) -> Result<(), InferenceError>;

    /// Retorna as capacidades do modelo atual.
    fn capabilities(&self) -> ModelCapabilities;

    /// Verifica se o engine está pronto para inferência.
    async fn is_ready(&self) -> bool;
}

/// Resultado tipado de inference.
pub type InferenceResult<T> = Result<T, InferenceError>;
```

//! Erros do subsistema de inferência.

use crate::ModelId;
use arkhe_core::ArkheError;
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum InferenceError {
    #[error("Model not found: {0}")]
    ModelNotFound(String),

    #[error("Model load failed: {0}")]
    LoadFailed(String),

    #[error("Inference failed: {0}")]
    InferenceFailed(String),

    #[error("Context length exceeded: requested {requested}, max {max}")]
    ContextOverflow { requested: usize, max: usize },

    #[error("Unsupported capability: {0:?}")]
    UnsupportedCapability(String),

    #[error("Backend not available: {0}. Enable feature '{1}' in Cargo.toml")]
    BackendNotAvailable(String, String),

    #[error("Timeout after {0:?}")]
    Timeout(std::time::Duration),

    #[error("Engine not ready: {model_id}")]
    NotReady { model_id: ModelId },

    #[error("Invalid request: {0}")]
    InvalidRequest(String),

    #[error("Internal inference error: {0}")]
    Internal(String),

    #[error(transparent)]
    Core(#[from] ArkheError),
}

pub type InferenceResult<T> = Result<T, InferenceError>;
```
