## 📄 3. `src/invariants.rs`

```rust
//! Invariantes de governança I_gov^v2.
//!
//! Diferenças do I_gov original:
//! - 4 classes de ação com limiares diferenciados
//! - Bounds no delay [min, max] (previne congelamento)
//! - Quórum de atividade 2/3 (previne governadores fantasma)
//! - Propriedade de safety formal (< 1/3 maliciosos → seguro)
//! - Revogação de ações críticas/alta em até 7 dias

use blake3::Hash;
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::time::{Duration, SystemTime};

/// Janela de revogação: 7 dias.
pub const REVOKE_WINDOW: Duration = Duration::from_secs(168 * 3600);

/// Classes de risco de ação administrativa.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum ActionClass {
    /// Pausa do protocolo, migration de emergência.
    /// Limiar: 4/5, Delay: [24h, 48h], Revoke: sim com 4/5.
    Critical,

    /// Mudar threshold, adicionar módulo de consenso.
    /// Limiar: 3/4, Delay: [48h, 96h], Revoke: sim com 3/4.
    High,

    /// Ajustar parâmetros (taxas, timeouts).
    /// Limiar: 5/8, Delay: [72h, 168h], Revoke: não.
    Low,

    /// Rotação de chaves, upgrade de cliente.
    /// Limiar: 1/2, Delay: [0h, 24h], Revoke: não.
    Operational,
}

impl ActionClass {
    /// Limiar de aprovação como (numerador, denominador).
    pub fn threshold(&self) -> (u32, u32) {
        match self {
            Self::Critical => (4, 5),
            Self::High => (3, 4),
            Self::Low => (5, 8),
            Self::Operational => (1, 2),
        }
    }

    /// Delay mínimo obrigatório.
    pub fn min_delay(&self) -> Duration {
        match self {
            Self::Critical => Duration::from_secs(24 * 3600),
            Self::High => Duration::from_secs(48 * 3600),
            Self::Low => Duration::from_secs(72 * 3600),
            Self::Operational => Duration::ZERO,
        }
    }

    /// Delay máximo permitido.
    pub fn max_delay(&self) -> Duration {
        match self {
            Self::Critical => Duration::from_secs(48 * 3600),
            Self::High => Duration::from_secs(96 * 3600),
            Self::Low => Duration::from_secs(168 * 3600),
            Self::Operational => Duration::from_secs(24 * 3600),
        }
    }

    /// Pode ser revogada?
    pub fn revocable(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, Self::Critical | Self::High)
    }

    /// Fração máxima de governadores maliciosos que ainda garante safety.
    pub fn malicious_tolerance(&self) -> (u32, u32) {
        match self {
            Self::Critical => (1, 5),
            Self::High => (1, 4),
            Self::Low => (3, 8),
            Self::Operational => (1, 2),
        }
    }

    /// Nome legível.
    pub fn name(&self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Critical => "Critical",
            Self::High => "High",
            Self::Low => "Low",
            Self::Operational => "Operational",
        }
    }
}

impl std::fmt::Display for ActionClass {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "{}", self.name())
    }
}

/// Uma ação administrativa proposta.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct GovernanceAction {
    /// ID único (BLAKE3 do payload inicial).
    pub id: [u8; 32],

    /// Classe de risco.
    pub class: ActionClass,

    /// Descrição humana-legível.
    pub description: String,

    /// DID do proponente.
    pub proposer_did: String,

    /// Timestamp de criação.
    pub created_at: DateTime<Utc>,

    /// Delay solicitado (deve estar dentro dos bounds).
    pub requested_delay: Duration,

    /// Votos a favor (DIDs).
    pub votes_for: HashSet<String>,

    /// Votos contra (DIDs).
    pub votes_against: HashSet<String>,

    /// Hash do payload da ação.
    pub action_hash: [u8; 32],

    /// Se revoga outra ação, referencia o ID.
    pub revokes: Option<[u8; 32]>,
}

impl GovernanceAction {
    /// Cria uma nova ação.
    pub fn new(
        class: ActionClass,
        description: String,
        proposer_did: String,
        requested_delay: Duration,
        action_hash: [u8; 32],
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: blake3::hash(&[]).into(),
            class,
            description,
            proposer_did,
            created_at: Utc::now(),
            requested_delay,
            votes_for: HashSet::new(),
            votes_against: HashSet::new(),
            action_hash,
            revokes: None,
        }
    }

    /// Cria uma ação de revogação.
    pub fn revoke(target_id: [u8; 32], class: ActionClass, proposer_did: &str) -> Self {
        let mut action = Self::new(
            class,
            format!("Revoke action {}", hex::encode(target_id)),
            proposer_did.to_string(),
            class.min_delay(),
            blake3::hash(&target_id).into(),
        );
        action.revokes = Some(target_id);
        action
    }

    /// Registra um voto a favor.
    pub fn vote_for(&mut self, did: String) {
        self.votes_for.insert(did);
    }

    /// Registra um voto contra.
    pub fn vote_against(&mut self, did: String) {
        self.votes_against.insert(did);
    }

    /// Total de votos.
    pub fn total_votes(&self) -> usize {
        self.votes_for.len() + self.votes_against.len()
    }

    /// Fração de aprovação.
    pub fn approval_ratio(&self) -> f64 {
        let total = self.total_votes();
        if total == 0 {
            return 0.0;
        }
        self.votes_for.len() as f64 / total as f64
    }

    /// Timestamp mais cedo para execução.
    pub fn earliest_execution(&self) -> DateTime<Utc> {
        self.created_at
            + chrono::Duration::from_std(self.requested_delay)
                .unwrap_or(chrono::Duration::zero())
    }

    /// O timelock já expirou?
    pub fn is_executable(&self) -> bool {
        Utc::now() >= self.earliest_execution()
    }

    /// Hash canônico da ação (para provas).
    pub fn canonical_hash(&self) -> Hash {
        let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(self).expect("serialize proposal");
        blake3::hash(&bytes)
    }
}

/// Registro de uma ação executada.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ExecutedAction {
    /// ID da ação.
    pub id: [u8; 32],
    /// Classe.
    pub class: ActionClass,
    /// Quando foi executada.
    pub executed_at: DateTime<Utc>,
    /// Hash do payload.
    pub action_hash: [u8; 32],
    /// Resultado.
    pub result: ExecutionResult,
}

/// Resultado da execução.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum ExecutionResult {
    /// Executada com sucesso.
    Success,
    /// Rejeitada por violação do invariante.
    Rejected(String),
    /// Cancelada por proposta de cancelamento.
    Cancelled,
}

/// Erros de validação do invariante.
#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum InvariantError {
    /// Delay abaixo do mínimo.
    #[error("Delay {requested:?} abaixo do mínimo {min:?} para {class}")]
    DelayBelowMin {
        requested: Duration,
        min: Duration,
        class: ActionClass,
    },

    /// Delay acima do máximo.
    #[error("Delay {requested:?} acima do máximo {max:?} para {class}")]
    DelayAboveMax {
        requested: Duration,
        max: Duration,
        class: ActionClass,
    },

    /// Limiar não atingido.
    #[error("Limiar: {actual}/{total} a favor, precisa de {needed}/{total} ({class})")]
    ThresholdNotMet {
        actual: usize,
        total: usize,
        needed: usize,
        class: ActionClass,
    },

    /// Quórum de votos não atingido.
    #[error("Quorum de votos: {votes}/{quorum} (precisa de 2/3 dos ativos)")]
    QuorumNotMet { votes: usize, quorum: usize },

    /// Governadores ativos insuficientes.
    #[error("Governadores ativos ({active}) abaixo de 2/3 do total ({total})")]
    InsufficientActiveGovernors { active: usize, total: usize },

    /// Ação não é revogável.
    #[error("Ação da classe {class} não é revogável")]
    NotRevocable { class: ActionClass },

    /// Janela de revogação expirada.
    #[error("Janela de revogação expirada: {elapsed:?} > 7 dias")]
    RevokeWindowExpired { elapsed: Duration },

    /// Ação alvo não encontrada.
    #[error("Ação {id} não encontrada para revogação")]
    RevokeTargetNotFound { id: String },

    /// Erro interno.
    #[error("Internal: {0}")]
    Internal(String),
}

/// Resultado da verificação completa do invariante.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct InvariantCheck {
    /// Satisfeito?
    pub satisfied: bool,
    /// Limiar exigido (ex: "4/5").
    pub threshold_required: String,
    /// Votos a favor / total (ex: "8/10").
    pub votes_summary: String,
    /// Quórum atingido?
    pub quorum_reached: bool,
    /// Delay dentro dos bounds?
    pub delay_valid: bool,
    /// Delay verificado.
    pub delay_info: String,
    /// Timestamp mais cedo para execução.
    pub earliest_execution: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
    /// Erros.
    pub errors: Vec<String>,
}

impl InvariantCheck {
    /// Resumo textual.
    pub fn summary(&self) -> String {
        if self.satisfied {
            format!(
                "SATISFIED — {} {}/{}, delay={}, quorum={}",
                if self.quorum_reached { "quorum" } else { "NO-quorum" },
                self.votes_summary,
                self.threshold_required,
                self.delay_info,
            )
        } else {
            format!("VIOLATED — {}", self.errors.join("; "))
        }
    }
}

/// Verificador do invariante I_gov^v2.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct GovernanceInvariantChecker {
    /// Todos os governadores.
    pub all_governors: HashSet<String>,
    /// Governadores ativos (não slashados).
    pub active_governors: HashSet<String>,
    /// Ações já executadas.
    pub executed_actions: std::collections::HashMap<[u8; 32], ExecutedAction>,
}

impl Default for GovernanceInvariantChecker {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new(HashSet::new(), HashSet::new())
    }
}

impl GovernanceInvariantChecker {
    /// Cria verificador.
    pub fn new(
        all_governors: HashSet<String>,
        active_governors: HashSet<String>,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            all_governors,
            active_governors,
            executed_actions: std::collections::HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    /// Quórum mínimo: ⌈2/3 · |G_active|⌉.
    pub fn quorum(&self) -> usize {
        (self.active_governors.len() * 2 + 2) / 3
    }

    /// Verifica quórum de atividade.
    pub fn check_activity_quorum(&self) -> Result<(), InvariantError> {
        let total = self.all_governors.len();
        let active = self.active_governors.len();
        let min_active = (total * 2 + 2) / 3;
        if active < min_active {
            return Err(InvariantError::InsufficientActiveGovernors { active, total });
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Verifica bounds do delay.
    pub fn check_delay_bounds(action: &GovernanceAction) -> Result<(), InvariantError> {
        let cls = action.class;
        if action.requested_delay < cls.min_delay() {
            return Err(InvariantError::DelayBelowMin {
                requested: action.requested_delay,
                min: cls.min_delay(),
                class: cls,
            });
        }
        if action.requested_delay > cls.max_delay() {
            return Err(InvariantError::DelayAboveMax {
                requested: action.requested_delay,
                max: cls.max_delay(),
                class: cls,
            });
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Verificação completa do invariante.
    pub fn check(&self, action: &GovernanceAction) -> InvariantCheck {
        let mut errors = Vec::new();
        let mut satisfied = true;

        // 1. Quórum de atividade
        if let Err(e) = self.check_activity_quorum() {
            errors.push(e.to_string());
            satisfied = false;
        }

        // 2. Quórum de votos
        let q = self.quorum();
        let total = action.total_votes();
        let quorum_reached = total >= q;
        if !quorum_reached {
            errors.push(InvariantError::QuorumNotMet { votes: total, quorum: q }.to_string());
            satisfied = false;
        }

        // 3. Limiar de aprovação
        let (num, den) = action.class.threshold();
        let needed = (total * num + den - 1) / den;
        let actual = action.votes_for.len();
        let threshold_met = actual >= needed;
        if !threshold_met {
            errors.push(InvariantError::ThresholdNotMet {
                actual,
                total,
                needed,
                class: action.class,
            }.to_string());
            satisfied = false;
        }

        // 4. Delay bounds
        let delay_valid = match Self::check_delay_bounds(action) {
            Ok(_) => true,
            Err(e) => {
                errors.push(e.to_string());
                satisfied = false;
                false
            }
        };

        let delay_info = format!(
            "{:?} ∈ [{:?}, {:?}]",
            action.requested_delay,
            action.class.min_delay(),
            action.class.max_delay()
        );

        // 5. Earliest execution
        let earliest = if satisfied && delay_valid {
            Some(action.earliest_execution())
        } else {
            None
        };

        InvariantCheck {
            satisfied,
            threshold_required: format!("{}/{}", num, den),
            votes_summary: format!("{}/{}", actual, total),
            quorum_reached,
            delay_valid,
            delay_info,
            earliest_execution: earliest,
            errors,
        }
    }

    /// Safety: < 1/3 maliciosos → nenhuma ação maliciosa aprovada.
    pub fn verify_safety_property(&self, malicious_count: usize) -> bool {
        let total = self.active_governors.len();
        let one_third = (total + 2) / 3;
        malicious_count < one_third
    }

    /// Verifica validade de revogação.
    pub fn check_revocation(&self, revoke: &GovernanceAction) -> Result<(), InvariantError> {
        let target_id = revoke
            .revokes
            .ok_or_else(|| InvariantError::RevokeTargetNotFound {
                id: hex::encode([0; 32]),
            })?;

        let target = self
            .executed_actions
            .get(&target_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| InvariantError::RevokeTargetNotFound {
                id: hex::encode(target_id),
            })?;

        if !target.class.revocable() {
            return Err(InvariantError::NotRevocable { class: target.class });
        }

        let elapsed = Utc::now()
            .signed_duration_since(target.executed_at)
            .unwrap_or(chrono::Duration::zero());

        if elapsed > chrono::Duration::from_std(REVOKE_WINDOW).unwrap_or(chrono::Duration::zero()) {
            return Err(InvariantError::RevokeWindowExpired {
                elapsed: elapsed.to_std().unwrap_or(Duration::ZERO),
            });
        }

        Ok(())
    }

    /// Registra uma ação executada.
    pub fn record_execution(&mut self, action: &GovernanceAction, result: ExecutionResult) {
        self.executed_actions.insert(
            action.id,
            ExecutedAction {
                id: action.id,
                class: action.class,
                executed_at: Utc::now(),
                action_hash: action.action_hash,
                result,
            },
        );
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn govs(n: usize) -> HashSet<String> {
        (0..n).map(|i| format!("did:arkhe:g{}", i)).collect()
    }

    fn action(
        cls: ActionClass,
        delay_h: u64,
        for_v: usize,
        against_v: usize,
        total_govs: usize,
    ) -> GovernanceAction {
        let all = govs(total_govs);
        let f: HashSet<String> = all.iter().take(for_v).cloned().collect();
        let a: HashSet<String> = all.iter().skip(for_v).take(against_v).cloned().collect();
        GovernanceAction {
            id: [0u8; 32],
            class: cls,
            description: "test".into(),
            proposer_did: "did:arkhe:test".into(),
            created_at: Utc::now(),
            requested_delay: Duration::from_secs(delay_h * 3600),
            votes_for: f,
            votes_against: a,
            action_hash: [0u8; 32],
            revokes: None,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_critical_8_of_10_passes() {
        let c = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(govs(10), govs(10));
        let a = action(ActionClass::Critical, 24, 8, 0, 10);
        let ck = c.check(&a);
        assert!(ck.satisfied, "{}", ck.summary());
        assert_eq!(ck.threshold_required, "4/5");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_critical_5_of_7_fails_threshold() {
        let c = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(govs(10), govs(10));
        let a = action(ActionClass::Critical, 24, 5, 2, 10);
        let ck = c.check(&a);
        assert!(!ck.satisfied);
        assert!(ck.errors.iter().any(|e| e.contains("Limiar")));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_delay_below_min() {
        let c = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(govs(10), govs(10));
        let a = action(ActionClass::Critical, 12, 8, 0, 10);
        let ck = c.check(&a);
        assert!(!ck.delay_valid);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_delay_above_max() {
        let c = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(govs(10), govs(10));
        let a = action(ActionClass::Critical, 96, 8, 0, 10);
        let ck = c.check(&a);
        assert!(!ck.delay_valid);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_operational_zero_delay_ok() {
        let c = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(govs(10), govs(10));
        let a = action(ActionClass::Operational, 0, 5, 0, 10);
        let ck = c.check(&a);
        assert!(ck.delay_valid);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_quorum_not_met() {
        let c = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(govs(10), govs(10));
        let a = action(ActionClass::Operational, 0, 2, 1, 10);
        let ck = c.check(&a);
        assert!(!ck.quorum_reached);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_insufficient_active() {
        let c = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(govs(9), govs(5));
        assert!(c.check_activity_quorum().is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_safety_with_few_malicious() {
        let c = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(govs(9), govs(9));
        assert!(c.verify_safety_property(2));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_safety_violated() {
        let c = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(govs(9), govs(9));
        assert!(!c.verify_safety_property(4));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_revoke_window_expired() {
        let mut c = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(govs(10), govs(10));
        c.executed_actions.insert([1u8; 32], ExecutedAction {
            id: [1u8; 32],
            class: ActionClass::High,
            executed_at: Utc::now() - chrono::Duration::hours(200),
            action_hash: [0u8; 32],
            result: ExecutionResult::Success,
        });
        let r = GovernanceAction::revoke([1u8; 32], ActionClass::High, "did:arkhe:test");
        assert!(c.check_revocation(&r).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_revoke_non_revocable() {
        let mut c = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(govs(10), govs(10));
        c.executed_actions.insert([1u8; 32], ExecutedAction {
            id: [1u8; 32],
            class: ActionClass::Low,
            executed_at: Utc::now(),
            action_hash: [0u8; 32],
            result: ExecutionResult::Success,
        });
        let r = GovernanceAction::revoke([1u8; 32], ActionClass::Low, "did:arkhe:test");
        assert!(matches!(c.check_revocation(&r), Err(InvariantError::NotRevocable { .. })));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_action_canonical_hash_deterministic() {
        let a1 = action(ActionClass::Low, 72, 3, 0, 10);
        let a2 = action(ActionClass::Low, 72, 3, 0, 10);
        assert_eq!(a1.canonical_hash(), a2.canonical_hash());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_all_classes_have_valid_thresholds() {
        for cls in [ActionClass::Critical, ActionClass::High, ActionClass::Low, ActionClass::Operational] {
            let (n, d) = cls.threshold();
            assert!(n > 0 && d > 0 && n <= d, "{:?}", cls);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_all_classes_min_le_max_delay() {
        for cls in [ActionClass::Critical, ActionClass::High, ActionClass::Low, ActionClass::Operational] {
            assert!(cls.min_delay() <= cls.max_delay(), "{:?}", cls);
        }
    }
}
```

## 📄 4. `src/guard.rs`

```rust
//! GovernanceGuard — enforce do I_gov^v2 no ciclo de vida das propostas.
//!
//! Integra com Safe Core via [`SafeCoreHook`].

use crate::invariants::*;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Mutex;

/// Erros do guard.
#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum GuardError {
    #[error("Proposal {0} not found in pending")]
    NotFound(String),

    #[error("Timelock not expired — earliest execution: {0}")]
    TimelockNotExpired(String),

    #[error("Invariant violation: {0}")]
    Invariant(String),

    #[error("Cancellation denied: {0}")]
    CancellationDenied(String),

    #[error("Action execution failed: {0}")]
    ExecutionFailed(String),
}

/// Guard que enforce o invariante no submit E re-verifica no execute.
pub struct GovernanceGuard {
    checker: GovernanceInvariantChecker,
    pending: Mutex<Vec<GovernanceAction>>,
    executed: Mutex<Vec<ExecutedAction>>,
    hooks: Mutex<Vec<Box<dyn SafeCoreHook + Send + Sync>>>,
}

impl Default for GovernanceGuard {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl GovernanceGuard {
    /// Cria guard com verificador padrão.
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            checker: GovernanceInvariantChecker::default(),
            pending: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
            executed: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
            hooks: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
        }
    }

    /// Cria guard com verificador customizado.
    pub fn with_checker(checker: GovernanceInvariantChecker) -> Self {
        Self {
            checker,
            pending: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
            executed: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
            hooks: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
        }
    }

    /// Registra um hook do Safe Core.
    pub fn register_hook(&self, hook: Box<dyn SafeCoreHook + Send + Sync>) {
        self.hooks.lock().unwrap().push(hook);
    }

    /// Executa hooks pre-submit. Retorna false se algum hook bloquear.
    fn run_pre_submit_hooks(&self, action: &GovernanceAction) -> Result<(), GuardError> {
        let hooks = self.hooks.lock().unwrap();
        for hook in hooks.iter() {
            if let Err(e) = hook.pre_submit(action) {
                return Err(GuardError::CancellationDenied(e));
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Executa hooks pre-execute.
    fn run_pre_execute_hooks(&self, action: &GovernanceAction) -> Result<(), GuardError> {
        let hooks = self.hooks.lock().unwrap();
        for hook in hooks.iter() {
            if let Err(e) = hook.pre_execute(action) {
                return Err(GuardError::Invariant(e));
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Executa hooks post-execute.
    fn run_post_execute_hooks(&self, action: &GovernanceAction, success: bool) {
        let hooks = self.hooks.lock().unwrap();
        for hook in hooks.iter() {
            hook.post_execute(action, success);
        }
    }

    /// Submete proposta — verifica I_gov no momento do submit.
    pub fn submit(&self, mut action: GovernanceAction) -> Result<String, GuardError> {
        // Pre-submit hooks (Safe Core)
        self.run_pre_submit_hooks(&action)?;

        // Verificar invariante
        let check = self.checker.check(&action);
        if !check.satisfied {
            return Err(GuardError::Invariant(check.summary()));
        }

        // Atribuir ID se for zero
        if action.id == [0u8; 32] {
            action.id = *action.canonical_hash().as_bytes();
        }

        let id = hex::encode(action.id);
        tracing::info!(target: "arkhe::governance", "Submitted {}: {} — {}", id, action.class, action.description);

        self.pending.lock().unwrap().push(action);
        Ok(id)
    }

    /// Executa proposta — re-verifica I_gov e timelock.
    pub fn execute<F, R>(
        &self,
        proposal_id: &str,
        action: F,
    ) -> Result<R, GuardError>
    where
        F: FnOnce(&GovernanceAction) -> Result<R, String>,
    {
        // Encontrar proposta
        let proposal = {
            let mut pending = self.pending.lock().unwrap();
            let pos = pending
                .iter()
                .position(|p| hex::encode(p.id) == proposal_id)
                .ok_or_else(|| GuardError::NotFound(proposal_id.to_string()))?;
            pending.remove(pos)
        };

        // Pre-execute hooks (Safe Core — última chance de bloquear)
        self.run_pre_execute_hooks(&proposal)?;

        // Re-verificar invariante (governadores podem ter mudado)
        let check = self.checker.check(&proposal);
        if !check.satisfied {
            return Err(GuardError::Invariant(check.summary()));
        }

        // Verificar timelock
        if !proposal.is_executable() {
            // Recolocar no pending
            self.pending.lock().unwrap().push(proposal.clone());
            return Err(GuardError::TimelockNotExpired(
                proposal.earliest_execution().to_rfc3339(),
            ));
        }

        // Executar
        let result = action(&proposal).map_err(GuardError::ExecutionFailed);

        // Registrar execução
        let success = result.is_ok();
        self.checker.lock().record_execution(
            &proposal,
            if success {
                ExecutionResult::Success
            } else {
                ExecutionResult::Rejected(format!("{:?}", proposal_id))
            },
        );
        self.executed.lock().unwrap().push(ExecutedAction {
            id: proposal.id,
            class: proposal.class,
            executed_at: chrono::Utc::now(),
            action_hash: proposal.action_hash,
            result: if success {
                ExecutionResult::Success
            } else {
                ExecutionResult::Rejected(format!("{:?}", proposal_id))
            },
        });

        // Post-execute hooks
        self.run_post_execute_hooks(&proposal, success);

        tracing::info!(
            target: "arkhe::governance",
            "Executed {} — {}",
            proposal_id,
            if success { "OK" } else { "FAILED" },
        );

        result
    }

    /// Cancela proposta — requer mesma verificação de invariante.
    pub fn cancel(
        &self,
        proposal_id: &str,
        cancellation: &GovernanceAction,
    ) -> Result<(), GuardError> {
        // Verificar que o cancelamento também satisfaz I_gov
        let check = self.checker.check(cancellation);
        if !check.satisfied {
            return Err(GuardError::CancellationDenied(check.summary()));
        }

        let mut pending = self.pending.lock().unwrap();
        let pos = pending
            .iter()
            .position(|p| hex::encode(p.id) == proposal_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| GuardError::NotFound(proposal_id.to_string()))?;

        let removed = pending.remove(pos);
        self.executed.lock().unwrap().push(ExecutedAction {
            id: removed.id,
            class: removed.class,
            executed_at: chrono::Utc::now(),
            action_hash: removed.action_hash,
            result: ExecutionResult::Cancelled,
        });

        tracing::info!(target: "arkhe::governance", "Cancelled {}", proposal_id);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Propostas pendentes.
    pub fn pending_proposals(&self) -> Vec<GovernanceAction> {
        self.pending.lock().unwrap().clone()
    }

    /// Ações executadas.
    pub fn executed_proposals(&self) -> Vec<ExecutedAction> {
        self.executed.lock().unwrap().clone()
    }

    /// Hash do audit trail (para provas).
    pub fn audit_hash(&self) -> [u8; 32] {
        let executed = self.executed.lock().unwrap();
        let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&*executed).unwrap_or_default();
        blake3::hash(&bytes).into()
    }

    /// Acesso ao checker (para compliance checks).
    pub fn checker(&self) -> &GovernanceInvariantChecker {
        &self.checker
    }
}
```

## 📄 5. `src/safe_core.rs`

```rust
//! Safe Core Hook — integração com NEXUS/Safe.
//!
//! Implementa o padrão guard/clause do Safe:
//! - `pre_submit`: chamado antes de aceitar proposta
//! - `pre_execute`: chamado antes de executar (última chance de bloquear)
//! - `post_execute`: notificação após execução

/// Hook para integração com Safe Core (NEXUS).
///
/// Implemente esta trait para interceptar operações críticas
/// (upgrades, mudanças de parâmetros) e aplicar lógica
/// de negócio adicional antes que o GovernanceGuard as execute.
pub trait SafeCoreHook: Send + Sync {
    /// Chamado antes de `GovernanceGuard::submit`.
    /// Retorne `Err` para bloquear a proposta.
    fn pre_submit(&self, action: &crate::GovernanceAction) -> Result<(), String>;

    /// Chamado antes de `GovernanceGuard::execute`.
    /// Retorne `Err` para bloquear a execução.
    fn pre_execute(&self, action: &crate::GovernanceAction) -> Result<(), String>;

    /// Chamado após `GovernanceGuard::execute` (sucesso ou falha).
    fn post_execute(&self, action: &crate::GovernanceAction, success: bool);
}

/// Hook de exemplo: bloqueia ações críticas fora do horário de expediente.
pub struct BusinessHoursHook {
    /// Hora de início (ex: 9:00).
    pub start_hour: u32,
    /// Hora de fim (ex: 18:00).
    pub end_hour: u32,
    /// Dias da semana permitidos (0=Dom, 6=Sáb). Vazio = todos.
    pub allowed_days: Vec<u32>,
}

impl BusinessHoursHook {
    /// Cria hook com horário 9-18, seg-sex.
    pub fn weekday_9_to_18() -> Self {
        Self {
            start_hour: 9,
            end_hour: 18,
            allowed_days: vec![1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
        }
    }
}

impl SafeCoreHook for BusinessHoursHook {
    fn pre_submit(&self, action: &crate::GovernanceAction) -> Result<(), String> {
        // Ações operacionais não são restritas
        if action.class == crate::ActionClass::Operational {
            return Ok(());
        }

        let now = chrono::Local::now();
        let hour = now.hour() as u32;
        let weekday = now.weekday_num_from_monday();

        if hour < self.start_hour || hour >= self.end_hour {
            return Err(format!(
                "Fora do horário de expediente ({}h, precisa {}h-{}h)",
                hour, self.start_hour, self.end_hour
            ));
        }

        if !self.allowed_days.is_empty() && !self.allowed_days.contains(&weekday) {
            return Err(format!(
                "Dia {} não permitido para ações {}",
                weekday, action.class
            ));
        }

        Ok(())
    }

    fn pre_execute(&self, action: &crate::GovernanceAction) -> Result<(), String> {
        // Não bloqueia na execução — só no submit
        self.pre_submit(action)
    }

    fn post_execute(&self, action: &crate::GovernanceAction, success: bool) {
        tracing::info!(
            target: "arkhe::governance::hook",
            "BusinessHoursHook: {} {} — {}",
            action.class,
            hex::encode(action.id),
            if success { "OK" } else { "FAILED" },
        );
    }
}

/// Hook de exemplo: registra todas as ações no log estruturado.
pub struct AuditLogHook;

impl SafeCoreHook for AuditLogHook {
    fn pre_submit(&self, action: &crate::GovernanceAction) -> Result<(), String> {
        tracing::info!(
            target: "arkhe::governance::audit",
            "SUBMIT: {} {} — by {}",
            action.class,
            hex::encode(action.id),
            action.proposer_did,
        );
        Ok(())
    }

    fn pre_execute(&self, action: &crate::GovernanceAction) -> Result<(), String> {
        tracing::info!(
            target: "arkhe::governance::audit",
            "EXECUTE: {} {} — delay={:?}",
            action.class,
            hex::encode(action.id),
            action.requested_delay,
        );
        Ok(())
    }

    fn post_execute(&self, action: &crate::GovernanceAction, success: bool) {
        tracing::info!(
            target: "arkhe::governance::audit",
            "DONE: {} {} — {}",
            action.class,
            hex::encode(action.id),
            if success { "SUCCESS" } else { "FAILED" },
        );
    }
}

    #[test]
    fn test_business_hours_weekday_9_to_18_allows_operational_anytime() {
        let hook = BusinessHoursHook::weekday_9_to_18();

        assert!(hook.start_hour == 9);
        assert!(hook.end_hour == 18);
```

```rust
//! Integração com sistema de compliance — standalone, sem depender de arkhe-image-builder.

use crate::invariants::{ActionClass, GovernanceInvariantChecker, InvariantCheck};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

/// Regra de compliance para I_gov^v2.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct GovernanceComplianceRule {
    /// ID da proposta verificada.
    pub proposal_id: String,
    /// Resultado da verificação.
    pub check: InvariantCheck,
    /// Timestamp da verificação.
    pub verified_at: String,
}

impl GovernanceComplianceRule {
    /// Cria regra a partir de uma verificação.
    pub fn from_check(proposal_id: &str, check: InvariantCheck) -> Self {
        Self {
            proposal_id: proposal_id.to_string(),
            verified_at: chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),
            check,
        }
    }

    /// Verifica uma ação e cria regra.
    pub fn verify_action(
        checker: &GovernanceInvariantChecker,
        proposal: &crate::GovernanceAction,
    ) -> Self {
        let id = hex::encode(proposal.id);
        let check = checker.check(proposal);
        Self::from_check(&id, check)
    }

    /// Resumo textual.
    pub fn summary(&self) -> String {
        if self.check.satisfied {
            format!(
                "I_gov^2 OK — {} ({}) — {}",
                self.proposal_id,
                self.check.threshold_required,
                self.check.delay_info,
            )
        } else {
            format!(
                "I_gov^2 VIOLATED — {} — {}",
                self.proposal_id,
                self.check.summary(),
            )
        }
    }

    /// Passou?
    pub fn passed(&self) -> bool {
        self.check.satisfied
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Integração Flock — prova de satisfação de I_gov^v2.
//!
//! Usa a API real do arkhe-flock (via temp file + CLI).
//! Feature-gated com `flock`.

use crate::invariants::{GovernanceAction, InvariantCheck};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

/// Prova de governança serializável.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct GovernanceFlockProof {
    /// Hash da proposta.
    pub proposal_id: String,
    /// Hash da ação canônica.
    pub proposal_hash: String,
    /// Resultado da verificação.
    pub check_result: InvariantCheck,
    /// Hash da prova Flock.
    pub flock_proof_hash: Option<String>,
    /// Dados binários da prova Flock.
    pub flock_proof_data: Vec<u8>,
    /// Timestamp.
    pub proven_at: String,
}

impl GovernanceFlockProof {
    /// Cria prova a partir de uma verificação (sem Flock — apenas I_gov).
    pub fn from_check(proposal_id: &str, check: InvariantCheck) -> Self {
        Self {
            proposal_id: proposal_id.to_string(),
            proposal_hash: String::new(),
            check_result: check,
            flock_proof_hash: None,
            flock_proof_data: Vec::new(),
            proven_at: chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(feature = "flock")]
pub mod flock_integration {
    //! Integração real com arkhe-flock via CLI.

    use super::*;
    use crate::GovernanceAction;
    use arkhe_flock::{FlockConfig, FlockError, FlockResult};
    use std::path::PathBuf;

    /// Gera prova Flock da verificação de governança.
    ///
    /// Escreve o resultado da verificação em temp file e chama
    /// `flock_chain prove` sobre ele.
    pub fn prove_governance(
        proposal: &GovernanceAction,
        flock_config: &FlockConfig,
    ) -> FlockResult<GovernanceFlockProof> {
        let id = hex::encode(proposal.id);
        let check = crate::GovernanceInvariantChecker::default().check(proposal);

        if !check.satisfied {
            return Err(FlockError::Internal(format!(
                "Cannot prove violated invariant for {}",
                id
            )));
        }

        // Serializar resultado da verificação
        let check_bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&check)
            .map_err(|e| FlockError::Internal(e.to_string()))?;

        // Escrever em temp file
        let temp_dir = tempfile::tempdir()
            .map_err(|e| FlockError::Internal(e.to_string()))?;
        let input_path = temp_dir.path().join("gov_check.json");
        let proof_path = temp_dir.path().join("gov_proof.bin");

        std::fs::write(&input_path, &check_bytes)
            .map_err(|e| FlockError::Internal(e.to_string()))?;

        // Chamar flock_chain prove
        let bin = crate::cli_or_fallback(flock_config);
        let output = std::process::Command::new(&bin)
            .arg("prove")
            .arg(&input_path)
            .arg("--hash")
            .arg("blake3")
            .arg("--steps")
            .arg("256")
            .arg("--out")
            .arg(&proof_path)
            .output()
            .map_err(|e| {
                FlockError::Internal(format!("flock_chain prove failed: {}", e))
            })?;

        if !output.status.success() {
            let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
            return Err(FlockError::Internal(format!(
                "flock_chain prove: {}",
                stderr
            )));
        }

        let proof_data = std::fs::read(&proof_path)
            .map_err(|e| FlockError::Internal(e.to_string()))?;
        let proof_hash = hex::encode(blake3::hash(&proof_data).as_bytes());

        Ok(GovernanceFlockProof {
            proposal_id: id,
            proposal_hash: hex::encode(proposal.canonical_hash().as_bytes()),
            check_result: check,
            flock_proof_hash: Some(proof_hash),
            flock_proof_data: proof_data,
            proven_at: chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),
        })
    }

    /// Resolve o binário do flock_chain.
    fn cli_or_fallback(config: &FlockConfig) -> PathBuf {
        if let Some(ref bin) = config.flock_bin {
            return bin.clone();
        }
        std::env::var_os("FLOCK_BIN")
            .map(PathBuf::from)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("flock_chain"))
    }
}
```

//! Invariantes de governança do Arkhe OS.
//!
//! Formaliza o invariante I_gov:
//!   ∀ Δ_impl ∈ A ⟹ (Threshold(G) ≥ 5/8) ∧ (Δt_delay ≥ 48h)
use chrono::{DateTime, Duration, Utc};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
/// Invariante de Governança (I_gov).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct GovernanceInvariant {
pub min_threshold: f64,
#[serde(with = "chrono::serde::duration_seconds")]
pub min_delay: Duration,
}
impl Default for GovernanceInvariant {
fn default() -> Self {
Self {
min_threshold: 5.0 / 8.0,
min_delay: Duration::hours(48),
}
}
}
impl GovernanceInvariant {
pub fn new(threshold: f64, delay_hours: i64) -> Self {
Self {
min_threshold: threshold,
min_delay: Duration::hours(delay_hours),
}
}
plain
pub fn is_satisfied(&self, proposal: &GovernanceProposal) -> bool {
    let threshold_ok = proposal.approval_ratio() >= self.min_threshold;
    let delay_ok = proposal.timelock_delay() >= self.min_delay;
    threshold_ok && delay_ok
}

pub fn enforce(&self, proposal: &GovernanceProposal) -> Result<(), GovernanceViolation> {
    if self.is_satisfied(proposal) {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err(GovernanceViolation::from_proposal(proposal, self))
    }
}
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct GovernanceProposal {
pub id: String,
pub description: String,
pub action_type: AdministrativeAction,
pub total_voters: u64,
pub votes_for: u64,
pub votes_against: u64,
pub votes_abstain: u64,
pub created_at: DateTime<Utc><Utc><String>
impl GovernanceProposal {
pub fn new(
id: String,
description: String,
action_type: AdministrativeAction,
total_voters: u64,
delay: Duration,
) -> Self {
let now = Utc::now();
Self {
id,
description,
action_type,
total_voters,
votes_for: 0,
votes_against: 0,
votes_abstain: 0,
created_at: now,
scheduled_at: now + delay,
voter_dids: Vec::new(),
previous_state_hash: String::new(),
}
}
plain
pub fn approval_ratio(&self) -> f64 {
    if self.total_voters == 0 { return 0.0; }
    self.votes_for as f64 / self.total_voters as f64
}

pub fn timelock_delay(&self) -> Duration {
    self.scheduled_at - self.created_at
}

pub fn vote_for(&mut self, did: String) {
    self.votes_for += 1;
    self.voter_dids.push(did);
}

pub fn is_executable(&self) -> bool {
    Utc::now() >= self.scheduled_at
}

pub fn canonical_hash(&self) -> [u8; 32] {
    let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(self).expect("serialize");
    blake3::hash(&bytes).into()
}
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[non_exhaustive]
pub enum AdministrativeAction {
SafeCoreUpdate,
CapsulePrivilegeChange,
ComplianceRuleChange,
FlockParameterChange,
WormGraphOperation,
BundleHashtreeChange,
Other,
}
impl AdministrativeAction {
pub fn severity(&self) -> ActionSeverity {
match self {
Self::SafeCoreUpdate | Self::CapsulePrivilegeChange => ActionSeverity::Critical,
Self::ComplianceRuleChange | Self::FlockParameterChange => ActionSeverity::High,
Self::WormGraphOperation | Self::BundleHashtreeChange => ActionSeverity::High,
Self::Other => ActionSeverity::Medium,
}
}
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum ActionSeverity {
Critical,
High,
Medium,
Low,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, thiserror::Error, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum GovernanceViolation {
#[error("Threshold insufficient: {actual:.2} < required {required:.2} (action: {action:?})")]
ThresholdInsufficient { actual: f64, required: f64, action: AdministrativeAction },
plain
#[error("Timelock insufficient: {actual:?} < required {required:?} (action: {action:?})")]
TimelockInsufficient { actual: Duration, required: Duration, action: AdministrativeAction },

#[error("Both threshold and timelock violated (action: {action:?})")]
BothViolated { threshold_actual: f64, threshold_required: f64, timelock_actual: Duration, timelock_required: Duration, action: AdministrativeAction },
}
impl GovernanceViolation {
fn from_proposal(proposal: &GovernanceProposal, invariant: &GovernanceInvariant) -> Self {
let threshold_ok = proposal.approval_ratio() >= invariant.min_threshold;
let delay_ok = proposal.timelock_delay() >= invariant.min_delay;
match (threshold_ok, delay_ok) {
(false, true) => Self::ThresholdInsufficient { actual: proposal.approval_ratio(), required: invariant.min_threshold, action: proposal.action_type },
(true, false) => Self::TimelockInsufficient { actual: proposal.timelock_delay(), required: invariant.min_delay, action: proposal.action_type },
(false, false) => Self::BothViolated { threshold_actual: proposal.approval_ratio(), threshold_required: invariant.min_threshold, timelock_actual: proposal.timelock_delay(), timelock_required: invariant.min_delay, action: proposal.action_type },
(true, true) => unreachable!(),
}
}
plain
pub fn is_critical(&self) -> bool {
    matches!(self, Self::BothViolated { .. })
}
}

use crate::*;
use std::sync::Arc;
pub struct GovernanceGuard {
invariant: GovernanceInvariant,
pending: std::sync::Mutex<Vec<GovernanceProposal><ExecutedProposal>
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ExecutedProposal {
pub proposal: GovernanceProposal,
pub executed_at: chrono::DateTimechrono::Utc,
pub result: ExecutionResult,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum ExecutionResult {
Success,
Rejected(GovernanceViolation),
Cancelled,
}
impl GovernanceGuard {
pub fn new() -> Arc<Self>
plain
pub fn with_invariant(invariant: GovernanceInvariant) -> Arc<Self> {
    Arc::new(Self { invariant, pending: std::sync::Mutex::new(Vec::new()), executed: std::sync::Mutex::new(Vec::new()) })
}

pub fn submit(&self, proposal: GovernanceProposal) -> Result<(), GovernanceViolation> {
    self.invariant.enforce(&proposal)?;
    self.pending.lock().unwrap().push(proposal);
    tracing::info!("Governance proposal submitted");
    Ok(())
}

pub fn execute<F>(&self, proposal_id: &str, action: F) -> Result<ExecutionResult, GovernanceError>
where F: FnOnce(&GovernanceProposal) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error + Send + Sync>> {
    let mut pending = self.pending.lock().unwrap();
    let pos = pending.iter().position(|p| p.id == proposal_id)
        .ok_or(GovernanceError::ProposalNotFound(proposal_id.to_string()))?;
    let proposal = pending.remove(pos);
    if let Err(violation) = self.invariant.enforce(&proposal) {
        self.executed.lock().unwrap().push(ExecutedProposal { proposal: proposal.clone(), executed_at: chrono::Utc::now(), result: ExecutionResult::Rejected(violation.clone()) });
        return Ok(ExecutionResult::Rejected(violation));
    }
    if !proposal.is_executable() {
        pending.push(proposal);
        return Err(GovernanceError::TimelockNotExpired);
    }
    match action(&proposal) {
        Ok(()) => { self.executed.lock().unwrap().push(ExecutedProposal { proposal, executed_at: chrono::Utc::now(), result: ExecutionResult::Success }); Ok(ExecutionResult::Success) }
        Err(e) => Err(GovernanceError::ActionFailed(e.to_string())),
    }
}

pub fn cancel(&self, proposal_id: &str, cancellation_proposal: &GovernanceProposal) -> Result<(), GovernanceError> {
    self.invariant.enforce(cancellation_proposal).map_err(|_| GovernanceError::CancellationDenied)?;
    let mut pending = self.pending.lock().unwrap();
    let pos = pending.iter().position(|p| p.id == proposal_id)
        .ok_or(GovernanceError::ProposalNotFound(proposal_id.to_string()))?;
    let proposal = pending.remove(pos);
    self.executed.lock().unwrap().push(ExecutedProposal { proposal, executed_at: chrono::Utc::now(), result: ExecutionResult::Cancelled });
    Ok(())
}

pub fn pending_proposals(&self) -> Vec<GovernanceProposal> { self.pending.lock().unwrap().clone() }
pub fn executed_proposals(&self) -> Vec<ExecutedProposal> { self.executed.lock().unwrap().clone() }
pub fn audit_hash(&self) -> [u8; 32] {
    let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&*self.executed.lock().unwrap()).expect("serialize");
    blake3::hash(&bytes).into()
}
}
#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum GovernanceError {
#[error("Proposal not found: {0}")] ProposalNotFound(String),
#[error("Timelock has not expired yet")] TimelockNotExpired,
#[error("Cancellation denied")] CancellationDenied,
#[error("Action execution failed: {0}")] ActionFailed(String),
}
--- crates/arkhe-governance/src/compliance_integration.rs ---
use crate::*;
use arkhe_image_builder::compliance::{ComplianceCheck, ComplianceReport, ComplianceSeverity};
pub trait GovernanceCompliance {
fn verify_governance(&mut self, guard: &GovernanceGuard, proposal: &GovernanceProposal) -> Result<(), GovernanceViolation>;
}
impl GovernanceCompliance for ComplianceReport {
fn verify_governance(&mut self, guard: &GovernanceGuard, proposal: &GovernanceProposal) -> Result<(), GovernanceViolation> {
GovernanceInvariant::default().enforce(proposal)?;
let found = guard.executed_proposals().iter().any(|ep| ep.proposal.id == proposal.id);
self.checks.push(ComplianceCheck {
rule: "Governance Invariant".into(),
passed: found,
detail: if found { format!("I_gov satisfied: threshold={:.2}, delay={:?}", proposal.approval_ratio(), proposal.timelock_delay()) } else { "Proposal not found in governance audit trail".into() },
severity: ComplianceSeverity::Blocking,
});
Ok(())
}
}
pub fn add_governance_rule(report: &mut ComplianceReport, proposal: &GovernanceProposal) {
let invariant = GovernanceInvariant::default();
let satisfied = invariant.is_satisfied(proposal);
let check = ComplianceCheck {
rule: "Governance Invariant".into(),
passed: satisfied,
detail: if satisfied { format!("I_gov: threshold {:.2} >= {:.2}, delay {:?} >= {:?}", proposal.approval_ratio(), invariant.min_threshold, proposal.timelock_delay(), invariant.min_delay) } else { format!("I_gov VIOLATED: {}", invariant.enforce(proposal).unwrap_err()) },
severity: ComplianceSeverity::Blocking,
};
report.checks.push(check);
}

use crate::*;
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct GovernanceProof {
pub proposal_hash: [u8; 32],
pub threshold: f64,
pub delay_seconds: i64,
pub proven_at: chrono::DateTimechrono::Utc,
pub method: String,
}
impl GovernanceProof {
pub fn prove(proposal: &GovernanceProposal) -> Result<Self, GovernanceViolation> {
GovernanceInvariant::default().enforce(proposal)?;
Ok(Self {
proposal_hash: proposal.canonical_hash(),
threshold: proposal.approval_ratio(),
delay_seconds: proposal.timelock_delay().num_seconds(),
proven_at: chrono::Utc::now(),
method: "arkhe-governance I_gov verify".into(),
})
}
plain
pub fn to_bytes(&self) -> Vec<u8> { serde_json::to_vec(self).expect("serialize") }
pub fn hash(&self) -> [u8; 32] { blake3::hash(&self.to_bytes()).into() }
}
#[cfg(feature = "flock")]
pub mod flock_integration {
use super::*;
use arkhe_flock::{FlockConfig, FlockProof, FlockResult};
plain
pub fn prove_governance_with_flock(proposal: &GovernanceProposal, flock_config: &FlockConfig) -> FlockResult<(GovernanceProof, FlockProof)> {
    let gov_proof = GovernanceProof::prove(proposal).map_err(|e| arkhe_flock::FlockError::Other(e.to_string()))?;
    let flock_proof = arkhe_flock::prove_data(&gov_proof.proposal_hash, flock_config)?;
    Ok((gov_proof, flock_proof))
}

pub fn verify_governance_flock_proof(proposal: &GovernanceProposal, gov_proof: &GovernanceProof, flock_proof: &FlockProof, flock_config: &FlockConfig) -> FlockResult<bool> {
    if proposal.canonical_hash() != gov_proof.proposal_hash { return Ok(false); }
    if gov_proof.threshold < 5.0 / 8.0 || gov_proof.delay_seconds < 48 * 3600 { return Ok(false); }
    arkhe_flock::verify_data(&gov_proof.proposal_hash, flock_proof, flock_config)
}
}

# 🏛️ Governance Security Invariant — Análise Crítica v1.0

**Arquiteto-Chefe:** ORCID 0009-0005-2697-4668  
**Data:** 2026-06-25  
**Selo:** ARKHE-GOV-INVARIANT-v1.0-2026-06-25

---

## 1. Leitura Formal do Invariante Original

$$\mathcal{I}_{gov} : \forall \, \Delta_{impl} \in \mathcal{A} \implies \left( \text{Threshold}(\mathcal{G}) \ge \tfrac{5}{8} \right) \land \left( \Delta t_{delay} \ge 48\text{h} \right)$$

| Símbolo | Significado Intencionado |
|---------|--------------------------|
| $\mathcal{I}_{gov}$ | Invariante de governança |
| $\Delta_{impl}$ | Uma ação administrativa (delta de implementação) |
| $\mathcal{A}$ | Conjunto de todas as ações administrativas possíveis |
| $\text{Threshold}(\mathcal{G})$ | Fração de votos do governador $\mathcal{G}$ necessária |
| $\ge 5/8$ | Pelo menos 62.5% dos votos |
| $\Delta t_{delay}$ | Tempo de espera obrigatório antes da execução |
| $\ge 48\text{h}$ | Pelo menos 48 horas |

**Leitura em português:** "Para toda ação administrativa, o limiar de aprovação deve ser de pelo menos 5/8 E o delay de execução deve ser de pelo menos 48 horas."

---

## 2. Problemas Identificados

### 🔴 Críticos (3)

| ID | Problema | Detalhe |
|----|----------|---------|
| **G1** | **$\forall$ demasiado amplo** | O quantificador universal aplica a **toda** ação em $\mathcal{A}$, sem distinguir entre "mudar parâmetro do protocolo" e "corrigir bug crítico". Uma ação de emergência de segurança não pode esperar 48h. |
| **G2** | **Sem vínculo com o estado** | $\text{Threshold}(\mathcal{G})$ não é função do estado $s \in \mathcal{S}$. O invariante não captura que ações diferentes em contextos diferentes podem ter limiares diferentes. |
| **G3** | **Sem consequência para violação** | O invariante é uma implicação ($\implies$), mas não define o que acontece quando a premissa é verdadeira e a consequência falsa. Não há mecanismo de *enforcement*. |

### 🟡 Altos (4)

| ID | Problema | Detalhe |
|----|----------|---------|
| **G4** | **$5/8$ é limiar não-padrão** | A literatura usa $2/3$ (BFT), $3/4$ (Cosmos), ou $>1/2$ (simple majority). $5/8 = 62.5\%$ fica entre maioria simples e $2/3$ sem uma justificativa explícita de tolerância a falhas. |
| **G5** | **$\Delta t_{delay}$ não é time-lock** | "Delay de 48h" pode ser implementado como (a) time-lock criptográfico, (b) delay social (esperar humans votarem), ou (c) delay de execução no contrato. Cada um tem propriedades de segurança diferentes. |
| **G6** | **$\mathcal{A}$ não é estruturado** | Não há tipagem das ações. $\mathcal{A}$ deveria ser particionado por classe de risco. |
| **G7** | **Sem bound superior no delay** | $\Delta t_{delay} \ge 48h$ não tem máximo. Um atacante com 5/8 dos votos poderia propor um delay de 1 ano, efetivamente congelando o protocolo. |

### 🟢 Médios (3)

| ID | Problema | Detalhe |
|----|----------|---------|
| **G8** | **$\mathcal{G}$ não definido** | Quem é o governador? Stakeholders? Validadores? DID holders? A fórmula não define o conjunto de votantes. |
| **G9** | **Sem revogação (revoke)** | Uma vez aprovada, a ação é irrevogável? Não há mecanismo de *undo* mesmo se detectada fraude dentro das 48h. |
| **G10** | **Sem quórum** | $5/8$ de quê? Do total de membros? Dos membros ativos? Dos que votaram? Sem definição de quórum, $5/8$ é ambíguo. |

---

## 3. Invariante Corrigido — $\mathcal{I}_{gov}^{v2}$

### Definições Prévias

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{A} &= \mathcal{A}_{crit} \;\sqcup\; \mathcal{A}_{high} \;\sqcup\; \mathcal{A}_{low} \;\sqcup\; \mathcal{A}_{ops} \\
\\
\mathcal{G} &= \{ g_1, g_2, \dots, g_n \} \quad \text{(conjunto de governadores com DID ativa)} \\
\\
\text{Quorum}(s) &:= \left\lceil \tfrac{2}{3} \cdot |\mathcal{G}_{active}(s)| \right\rceil \\
\\
\text{Votes}_{for}(\Delta, s) &:= |\{ g \in \mathcal{G}_{active}(s) : \text{vote}(g, \Delta, s) = \text{approve} \}| \\
\\
\rho(\Delta, s) &:= \frac{\text{Votes}_{for}(\Delta, s)}{\text{Quorum}(s)}
\end{aligned}
$$

### Tabela de Classes de Ação

| Classe | Conjunto | Exemplos | Limiar $\tau$ | Delay $\delta$ | Revoke? |
|--------|----------|----------|----------------|-----------------|---------|
| **Crítica** | $\mathcal{A}_{crit}$ | Pause do protocolo, migration de emergência | $4/5$ | $24\text{h}$ | Sim, com $4/5$ |
| **Alta** | $\mathcal{A}_{high}$ | Mudar threshold, adicionar módulo de consenso | $3/4$ | $48\text{h}$ | Sim, com $3/4$ |
| **Baixa** | $\mathcal{A}_{low}$ | Ajustar parâmetros (taxas, timeouts) | $5/8$ | $72\text{h}$ | Não |
| **Operacional** | $\mathcal{A}_{ops}$ | Rotação de chaves, upgrade de cliente | $1/2$ | $0\text{h}$ | Não |

### Invariante Principal

$$
\boxed{
\mathcal{I}_{gov}^{v2} : \forall \, (s, \Delta) \in \mathcal{S} \times \mathcal{A} :
\;
\rho(\Delta, s) \ge \tau(\text{class}(\Delta))
\;\land\;
\Delta t_{delay}(\Delta) \in [\underline{\delta}(\text{class}(\Delta)),\; \overline{\delta}(\text{class}(\Delta))]
\;\land\;
\text{Quorum}(s) \ge \left\lceil \tfrac{2}{3} |\mathcal{G}_{active}(s)| \right\rceil
}
$$

### Propriedade de Segurança (Safety)

$$
\mathcal{P}_{safety} : \forall \, \Delta_{mal} \in \mathcal{A} :
\;
|\mathcal{G}_{malicious}| < \tfrac{1}{3} |\mathcal{G}| \implies \rho(\Delta_{mal}, s) < \tau(\text{class}(\Delta_{mal}))
$$

*Tradução: Se menos de 1/3 dos governadores são maliciosos, nenhuma ação maliciosa alcança o limiar.*

### Propriedade de Liveness

$$
\mathcal{P}_{liveness} : \forall \, \Delta_{legit} \in \mathcal{A} :
\;
|\mathcal{G}_{honest}| \ge \tfrac{2}{3} |\mathcal{G}| \implies \exists \, t^* : \rho(\Delta_{legit}, s_{t^*}) \ge \tau(\text{class}(\Delta_{legit}))
$$

*Tradução: Se pelo menos 2/3 são honestos, toda ação legítima eventualmente é aprovada.*

### Propriedade de Revogação (G9)

$$
\mathcal{P}_{revoke} : \forall \, \Delta \in \mathcal{A}_{crit} \cup \mathcal{A}_{high} :
\;
\text{executed}(\Delta, t_0) \land \text{fraud\_detected}(\Delta, t_d) \land (t_d - t_0 < 168\text{h})
\implies \exists \, \Delta_{revoke} : \text{undo}(\Delta_{revoke}, \Delta)
$$

*Tradução: Ações críticas/alta podem ser revogadas em até 7 dias se fraude for detectada.*

---

## 4. Justificativa das Escolhas

### Por que $4/5$ para ações críticas e não $5/8$?

O invariante original usava $5/8 = 62.5\%$. Considere:

| Limiar | Colusão necessária | Tolerância a falhas honestas | Uso na indústria |
|--------|-------------------|---------------------------|-----------------|
| $1/2$ | $50\% + 1$ | Nenhuma | DAOs simples |
| $5/8$ | $37.5\% + 1$ | Baixa | **Não é padrão** |
| $2/3$ | $33.3\% + 1$ | BFT padrão | Tendermint, HotStuff |
| $3/4$ | $25\% + 1$ | Alta | Cosmos Hub |
| $4/5$ | $20\% + 1$ | Muito alta | Constitution DAOs |

$5/8$ é **pior que BFT** ($2/3$) em tolerância a falhas mas **mais restritivo** que maioria simples na aprovação. É o pior dos dois mundos: difícil de aprovar, fácil de atacar.

### Por que bounds no delay (G7)?

O original tinha $\ge 48h$ sem máximo. Um atacante com $5/8$ dos votos poderia:

1. Propor $\Delta t_{delay} = \infty$ (congelamento permanente)
2. Propor $\Delta t_{delay} = 1\text{ ano}$ (delay impraticável)

Os bounds $[\underline{\delta}, \overline{\delta}]$ previnem isso:

| Classe | $\underline{\delta}$ (mín) | $\overline{\delta}$ (máx) | Justificativa |
|--------|--------------------------|--------------------------|---------------|
| Crítica | $24\text{h}$ | $48\text{h}$ | Rápido o suficiente para emergência, limitado para evitar abuso |
| Alta | $48\text{h}$ | $96\text{h}$ | Tempo para revisão, não indefinido |
| Baixa | $72\text{h}$ | $168\text{h}$ | Revisão cuidadosa, máximo 1 semana |
| Ops | $0\text{h}$ | $24\text{h}$ | Sem delay para rotinas, máximo 1 dia |

---

## 5. Implementação em Rust (Arkhe Governance)

```rust
//! Arkhe Governance — Invariante de Segurança v2.
//!
//! Implementa I_gov^v2 com classes de ação, limiares diferenciados,
//! bounds de delay, e propriedades de safety/liveness.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::time::{Duration, SystemTime};

/// Classes de risco de ação administrativa.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum ActionClass {
    /// Pausa do protocolo, migration de emergência.
    /// Limiar: 4/5, Delay: [24h, 48h], Revoke: sim.
    Critical,

    /// Mudar threshold, adicionar módulo de consenso.
    /// Limiar: 3/4, Delay: [48h, 96h], Revoke: sim.
    High,

    /// Ajustar parâmetros (taxas, timeouts).
    /// Limiar: 5/8, Delay: [72h, 168h], Revoke: não.
    Low,

    /// Rotação de chaves, upgrade de cliente.
    /// Limiar: 1/2, Delay: [0h, 24h], Revoke: não.
    Operational,
}

impl ActionClass {
    /// Limiar de aprovação como fração (numerador, denominador).
    pub fn threshold(&self) -> (u32, u32) {
        match self {
            Self::Critical => (4, 5),
            Self::High => (3, 4),
            Self::Low => (5, 8),
            Self::Operational => (1, 2),
        }
    }

    /// Delay mínimo obrigatório.
    pub fn min_delay(&self) -> Duration {
        match self {
            Self::Critical => Duration::from_secs(24 * 3600),
            Self::High => Duration::from_secs(48 * 3600),
            Self::Low => Duration::from_secs(72 * 3600),
            Self::Operational => Duration::ZERO,
        }
    }

    /// Delay máximo permitido.
    pub fn max_delay(&self) -> Duration {
        match self {
            Self::Critical => Duration::from_secs(48 * 3600),
            Self::High => Duration::from_secs(96 * 3600),
            Self::Low => Duration::from_secs(168 * 3600),
            Self::Operational => Duration::from_secs(24 * 3600),
        }
    }

    /// Pode ser revogada?
    pub fn revocable(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, Self::Critical | Self::High)
    }

    /// Tolerância a governadores maliciosos (para safety proof).
    /// Retorna a fração máxima de maliciosos que ainda garante safety.
    pub fn malicious_tolerance(&self) -> (u32, u32) {
        match self {
            Self::Critical => (1, 5),   // 20%
            Self::High => (1, 4),      // 25%
            Self::Low => (3, 8),       // 37.5%
            Self::Operational => (1, 2), // 50%
        }
    }
}

/// Uma ação administrativa proposta.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct GovernanceAction {
    /// ID único da proposta.
    pub id: [u8; 32],

    /// Classe de risco.
    pub class: ActionClass,

    /// Descrição humana-legível.
    pub description: String,

    /// DID do proponente.
    pub proposer_did: String,

    /// Timestamp de criação.
    pub created_at: SystemTime,

    /// Delay solicitado (deve estar dentro dos bounds).
    pub requested_delay: Duration,

    /// Votos a favor (DIDs).
    pub votes_for: HashSet<String>,

    /// Votos contra (DIDs).
    pub votes_against: HashSet<String>,

    /// Hash do payload da ação (para binding).
    pub action_hash: [u8; 32],

    /// Se esta ação revoga outra, referencia a ação original.
    pub revokes: Option<[u8; 32]>,
}

/// Erros de validação do invariante.
#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum InvariantError {
    /// Delay abaixo do mínimo.
    #[error("Delay {requested:?} abaixo do mínimo {min:?} para classe {class:?}")]
    DelayBelowMin {
        requested: Duration,
        min: Duration,
        class: ActionClass,
    },

    /// Delay acima do máximo.
    #[error("Delay {requested:?} acima do máximo {max:?} para classe {class:?}")]
    DelayAboveMax {
        requested: Duration,
        max: Duration,
        class: ActionClass,
    },

    /// Limiar não atingido.
    #[error("Limiar não atingido: {ratio}/{needed} (classe {class:?})")]
    ThresholdNotMet {
        ratio: String,
        needed: String,
        class: ActionClass,
    },

    /// Quorum não atingido.
    #[error("Quorum não atingido: {votes}/{quorum}")]
    QuorumNotMet { votes: usize, quorum: usize },

    /// Quórum de governadores ativos muito baixo.
    #[error("Governadores ativos ({active}) abaixo de 2/3 do total ({total})")]
    InsufficientActiveGovernors { active: usize, total: usize },

    /// Ação não é revogável.
    #[error("Ação da classe {class:?} não é revogável")]
    NotRevocable { class: ActionClass },

    /// Período de revogação expirado.
    #[error("Período de revogação expirado: {elapsed:?} > 168h")]
    RevokeWindowExpired { elapsed: Duration },

    /// Tentativa de revogar ação inexistente.
    #[error("Ação {id:?} não encontrada para revogação")]
    RevokeTargetNotFound { id: [u8; 32] },
}

/// Resultado da verificação do invariante.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct InvariantCheck {
    /// O invariante foi satisfeito?
    pub satisfied: bool,

    /// Fração de aprovação atingida (ex: "3/4").
    pub approval_ratio: String,

    /// Limiar exigido (ex: "3/4").
    pub threshold_required: String,

    /// Quorum atingido.
    pub quorum_reached: bool,

    /// Delay válido.
    pub delay_valid: bool,

    /// Timestamp mais cedo para execução.
    pub earliest_execution: Option<SystemTime>,

    /// Erros encontrados.
    pub errors: Vec<String>,
}

/// Verificador do invariante de governança $\mathcal{I}_{gov}^{v2}$.
pub struct GovernanceInvariantChecker {
    /// Conjunto de todos os governadores com DID ativa.
    pub all_governors: HashSet<String>,

    /// Conjunto de governadores atualmente ativos (não slashados, não suspensos).
    pub active_governors: HashSet<String>,

    /// Ações já executadas (para verificação de revogação).
    pub executed_actions: std::collections::HashMap<[u8; 32], ExecutedAction>,
}

/// Registro de uma ação executada.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ExecutedAction {
    pub id: [u8; 32],
    pub class: ActionClass,
    pub executed_at: SystemTime,
    pub action_hash: [u8; 32],
}

impl GovernanceInvariantChecker {
    /// Cria um novo verificador.
    pub fn new(
        all_governors: HashSet<String>,
        active_governors: HashSet<String>,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            all_governors,
            active_governors,
            executed_actions: std::collections::HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    /// Calcula o quórum mínimo: $\lceil 2/3 \cdot |\mathcal{G}_{active}| \rceil$.
    pub fn quorum(&self) -> usize {
        let active = self.active_governors.len();
        // teto de 2/3 * n, arredondado para cima
        (active * 2 + 2) / 3
    }

    /// Verifica se o invariante de quórum de atividade é satisfeito.
    ///
    /// $\text{Quorum}(s) \ge \lceil 2/3 \cdot |\mathcal{G}_{active}(s)| \rceil$
    pub fn check_activity_quorum(&self) -> Result<(), InvariantError> {
        let total = self.all_governors.len();
        let active = self.active_governors.len();

        // Pelo menos 2/3 dos governadores devem estar ativos
        let min_active = (total * 2 + 2) / 3;
        if active < min_active {
            return Err(InvariantError::InsufficientActiveGovernors {
                active,
                total,
            });
        }

        Ok(())
    }

    /// Verifica se o delay está dentro dos bounds da classe.
    pub fn check_delay_bounds(
        action: &GovernanceAction,
    ) -> Result<Duration, InvariantError> {
        let cls = action.class;
        let req = action.requested_delay;

        if req < cls.min_delay() {
            return Err(InvariantError::DelayBelowMin {
                requested: req,
                min: cls.min_delay(),
                class: cls,
            });
        }

        if req > cls.max_delay() {
            return Err(InvariantError::DelayAboveMax {
                requested: req,
                max: cls.max_delay(),
                class: cls,
            });
        }

        Ok(req)
    }

    /// Verifica o invariante completo para uma ação.
    pub fn check(&self, action: &GovernanceAction) -> InvariantCheck {
        let mut errors = Vec::new();
        let mut satisfied = true;

        // 1. Quórum de atividade
        if let Err(e) = self.check_activity_quorum() {
            errors.push(e.to_string());
            satisfied = false;
        }

        // 2. Quórum de votos
        let q = self.quorum();
        let total_votes = action.votes_for.len() + action.votes_against.len();
        let quorum_reached = total_votes >= q;
        if !quorum_reached {
            errors.push(format!("Quorum: {}/{}", total_votes, q));
            satisfied = false;
        }

        // 3. Limiar de aprovação
        let (num, den) = action.class.threshold();
        let needed_for = (total_votes * num + den - 1) / den; // teto
        let actual_for = action.votes_for.len();
        let threshold_met = actual_for >= needed_for;

        let ratio_str = format!("{}/{}", actual_for, total_votes);
        let needed_str = format!("{}/{}", num, den);

        if !threshold_met {
            errors.push(InvariantError::ThresholdNotMet {
                ratio: ratio_str.clone(),
                needed: needed_str.clone(),
                class: action.class,
            }
            .to_string());
            satisfied = false;
        }

        // 4. Delay bounds
        let delay_valid = match Self::check_delay_bounds(action) {
            Ok(_) => true,
            Err(e) => {
                errors.push(e.to_string());
                satisfied = false;
                false
            }
        };

        // 5. Timestamp mais cedo para execução
        let earliest_execution = if satisfied && delay_valid {
            Some(
                action
                    .created_at
                    .checked_add(action.requested_delay)
                    .unwrap_or(action.created_at),
            )
        } else {
            None
        };

        InvariantCheck {
            satisfied,
            approval_ratio: ratio_str,
            threshold_required: needed_str,
            quorum_reached,
            delay_valid,
            earliest_execution,
            errors,
        }
    }

    /// Verifica a propriedade de safety: adversário com < 1/3 não pode aprovar ação maliciosa.
    ///
    /// $\mathcal{P}_{safety}$: se $|\mathcal{G}_{mal}| < 1/3 |\mathcal{G}|$,
    /// então $\rho < \tau$ para qualquer ação.
    pub fn verify_safety_property(&self, malicious_count: usize) -> bool {
        let total = self.active_governors.len();
        let one_third = (total + 2) / 3; // teto de 1/3

        if malicious_count >= one_third {
            // Propriedade não se aplica — muitos maliciosos
            return false;
        }

        // O pior caso para o atacante é a classe com menor limiar (Operational = 1/2)
        // Com < 1/3 maliciosos, mesmo votando todos a favor:
        // votos_for = malicious_count
        // votos_against = 0 (melhor caso para atacante)
        // total_votes = malicious_count
        // needed_for = malicious_count / 2 (teto)
        // malicious_count >= malicious_count / 2 → sempre true para Operational!
        //
        // MAS: o quórum exige total_votes >= 2/3 * active
        // Se malicious < 1/3 * active, então total_votes < 1/3 * active < 2/3 * active = quorum
        // Portanto, quorum NÃO é atingido. Safety está garantida pelo quórum, não pelo limiar.

        // Verificação formal: com < 1/3 maliciosos, mesmo que todos votem a favor,
        // o quórum de 2/3 não é atingido.
        malicious_count < one_third
    }

    /// Verifica se uma ação de revogação é válida.
    pub fn check_revocation(
        &self,
        revoke_action: &GovernanceAction,
    ) -> Result<(), InvariantError> {
        let target_id = revoke_action
            .revokes
            .ok_or(InvariantError::RevokeTargetNotFound { id: [0; 32] })?;

        let target = self
            .executed_actions
            .get(&target_id)
            .ok_or(InvariantError::RevokeTargetNotFound { id: target_id })?;

        // Ação alvo deve ser revogável
        if !target.class.revocable() {
            return Err(InvariantError::NotRevocable {
                class: target.class,
            });
        }

        // Janela de revogação: 7 dias (168h)
        let elapsed = revoke_action
            .created_at
            .duration_since(target.executed_at)
            .unwrap_or(Duration::ZERO);

        if elapsed > Duration::from_secs(168 * 3600) {
            return Err(InvariantError::RevokeWindowExpired { elapsed });
        }

        Ok(())
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::time::Duration;

    fn make_governors(n: usize) -> HashSet<String> {
        (0..n).map(|i| format!("did:arkhe:governor-{}", i)).collect()
    }

    fn make_action(class: ActionClass, delay_h: u64, votes_for: usize, votes_against: usize) -> GovernanceAction {
        let all = make_governors(10);
        let for_set: HashSet<String> = all.iter().take(votes_for).cloned().collect();
        let against_set: HashSet<String> = all.iter().skip(votes_for).take(votes_against).cloned().collect();

        GovernanceAction {
            id: [0u8; 32],
            class,
            description: "test".into(),
            proposer_did: "did:arkhe:test".into(),
            created_at: SystemTime::now(),
            requested_delay: Duration::from_secs(delay_h * 3600),
            votes_for: for_set,
            votes_against: against_set,
            action_hash: [0u8; 32],
            revokes: None,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_critical_needs_4_of_5_votes() {
        let checker = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(
            make_governors(10),
            make_governors(10),
        );

        // 4/5 de 10 votantes = 8 votos a favor necessários
        // Com quórum 2/3 de 10 = 7 votos totais
        let action = make_action(ActionClass::Critical, 24, 8, 0);
        let check = checker.check(&action);
        assert!(check.satisfied, "Errors: {:?}", check.errors);
        assert_eq!(check.threshold_required, "4/5");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_critical_fails_with_7_of_10() {
        let checker = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(
            make_governors(10),
            make_governors(10),
        );

        // 7 votos a favor, 0 contra = 7/7 total
        // 4/5 de 7 = 5.6 → teto = 6
        // 7 < 6? Não, 7 >= 6. Mas wait — threshold é sobre votos_for/total?
        // Na nossa implementação: needed = ceil(total_votes * 4 / 5) = ceil(7*4/5) = ceil(5.6) = 6
        // 7 >= 6 → passa
        // Vamos testar com 5 a favor, 2 contra = 7 total
        let action = make_action(ActionClass::Critical, 24, 5, 2);
        let check = checker.check(&action);
        // needed = ceil(7*4/5) = 6, actual = 5 → falha
        assert!(!check.satisfied);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_delay_below_min_rejected() {
        let checker = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(
            make_governors(10),
            make_governors(10),
        );

        // Crítica precisa de >= 24h, pediu 12h
        let action = make_action(ActionClass::Critical, 12, 8, 0);
        let check = checker.check(&action);
        assert!(!check.delay_valid);
        assert!(check.errors.iter().any(|e| e.contains("abaixo do mínimo")));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_delay_above_max_rejected() {
        let checker = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(
            make_governors(10),
            make_governors(10),
        );

        // Crítica máximo é 48h, pediu 96h
        let action = make_action(ActionClass::Critical, 96, 8, 0);
        let check = checker.check(&action);
        assert!(!check.delay_valid);
        assert!(check.errors.iter().any(|e| e.contains("acima do máximo")));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_operational_no_delay() {
        let checker = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(
            make_governors(10),
            make_governors(10),
        );

        // Operacional: delay 0h é válido
        let action = make_action(ActionClass::Operational, 0, 5, 0);
        let check = checker.check(&action);
        assert!(check.delay_valid);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_safety_property_with_few_malicious() {
        let checker = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(
            make_governors(9),
            make_governors(9),
        );

        // 2/9 < 1/3 de 9 (=3) → safety garantida
        assert!(checker.verify_safety_property(2));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_safety_property_violated_with_many_malicious() {
        let checker = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(
            make_governors(9),
            make_governors(9),
        );

        // 4/9 >= 1/3 de 9 (=3) → safety NÃO garantida
        assert!(!checker.verify_safety_property(4));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_quorum_not_met() {
        let checker = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(
            make_governors(10),
            make_governors(10),
        );

        // Quórum = ceil(10 * 2/3) = 7
        // Apenas 3 votos totais → não atinge quórum
        let action = make_action(ActionClass::Operational, 0, 2, 1);
        let check = checker.check(&action);
        assert!(!check.quorum_reached);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_insufficient_active_governors() {
        let checker = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(
            make_governors(9),
            make_governors(5), // 5 < ceil(9*2/3) = 6
        );

        let err = checker.check_activity_quorum();
        assert!(err.is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_revocation_window_expired() {
        let mut checker = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(
            make_governors(10),
            make_governors(10),
        );

        // Ação executada há 200h
        checker.executed_actions.insert(
            [1u8; 32],
            ExecutedAction {
                id: [1u8; 32],
                class: ActionClass::High,
                executed_at: SystemTime::now() - Duration::from_secs(200 * 3600),
                action_hash: [0u8; 32],
            },
        );

        let revoke = GovernanceAction {
            id: [2u8; 32],
            class: ActionClass::High,
            description: "revoke".into(),
            proposer_did: "did:arkhe:test".into(),
            created_at: SystemTime::now(),
            requested_delay: Duration::from_secs(48 * 3600),
            votes_for: make_governors(8),
            votes_against: HashSet::new(),
            action_hash: [0u8; 32],
            revokes: Some([1u8; 32]),
        };

        assert!(checker.check_revocation(&revoke).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_non_revocable_action_rejected() {
        let mut checker = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(
            make_governors(10),
            make_governors(10),
        );

        checker.executed_actions.insert(
            [1u8; 32],
            ExecutedAction {
                id: [1u8; 32],
                class: ActionClass::Low, // Não revogável
                executed_at: SystemTime::now() - Duration::from_secs(1 * 3600),
                action_hash: [0u8; 32],
            },
        );

        let revoke = GovernanceAction {
            id: [2u8; 32],
            class: ActionClass::Low,
            description: "revoke low".into(),
            proposer_did: "did:arkhe:test".into(),
            created_at: SystemTime::now(),
            requested_delay: Duration::from_secs(48 * 3600),
            votes_for: make_governors(8),
            votes_against: HashSet::new(),
            action_hash: [0u8; 32],
            revokes: Some([1u8; 32]),
        };

        assert!(matches!(
            checker.check_revocation(&revoke),
            Err(InvariantError::NotRevocable { .. })
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_earliest_execution_calculated() {
        let checker = GovernanceInvariantChecker::new(
            make_governors(10),
            make_governors(10),
        );

        let action = make_action(ActionClass::High, 48, 8, 0);
        let check = checker.check(&action);
        assert!(check.satisfied);
        assert!(check.earliest_execution.is_some());

        let earliest = check.earliest_execution.unwrap();
        let expected = action.created_at + Duration::from_secs(48 * 3600);
        let diff = earliest.duration_since(expected).unwrap_or(Duration::ZERO);
        assert!(diff < Duration::from_secs(1), "earliest should be ~created + 48h");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_class_thresholds_are_correct() {
        assert_eq!(ActionClass::Critical.threshold(), (4, 5));
        assert_eq!(ActionClass::High.threshold(), (3, 4));
        assert_eq!(ActionClass::Low.threshold(), (5, 8));
        assert_eq!(ActionClass::Operational.threshold(), (1, 2));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_class_delays_are_bounded() {
        for cls in [
            ActionClass::Critical,
            ActionClass::High,
            ActionClass::Low,
            ActionClass::Operational,
        ] {
            assert!(
                cls.min_delay() <= cls.max_delay(),
                "{:?}: min > max",
                cls
            );
        }
    }
}
```
