## 8. SECURITY MODEL — SIGNED IMAGES AND ATTESTATION

### 8.1. Image Signing Flow

```rust
/// Image signing and verification flow for Arkhe Live Image
pub struct ImageSigner {
    signing_key: SigningKey,
    certificate: Certificate,
    hash_algorithm: HashAlgorithm,
}

impl ImageSigner {
    pub fn new(signing_key: SigningKey, certificate: Certificate) -> Self {
        Self {
            signing_key,
            certificate,
            hash_algorithm: HashAlgorithm::Blake3,
        }
    }
    
    /// Sign an ImageSpec with ML-DSA-65
    pub fn sign_spec(&self, spec: &mut ImageSpec) -> Result<(), SigningError> {
        // 1. Hash the ImageSpec (excluding signature field)
        let spec_json = serde_json::to_string(spec)?;
        let hash = blake3::hash(spec_json.as_bytes());
        
        // 2. Sign the hash
        let signature = self.signing_key.sign(hash.as_bytes());
        
        // 3. Add signature to spec
        spec.signature = Some(base64::encode(&signature));
        
        Ok(())
    }
    
    /// Verify an ImageSpec signature
    pub fn verify_spec(&self, spec: &ImageSpec) -> Result<bool, VerificationError> {
        if let Some(ref sig_b64) = spec.signature {
            // 1. Remove signature from spec for hashing
            let mut spec_without_sig = spec.clone();
            spec_without_sig.signature = None;
            
            let spec_json = serde_json::to_string(&spec_without_sig)?;
            let hash = blake3::hash(spec_json.as_bytes());
            
            // 2. Decode signature
            let signature = base64::decode(sig_b64)?;
            
            // 3. Verify signature
            self.certificate.verify(hash.as_bytes(), &signature)
        } else {
            Ok(false)
        }
    }
    
    /// Sign the entire .arkhe bundle
    pub fn sign_bundle(&self, bundle_path: &Path) -> Result<(), SigningError> {
        // 1. Compute hash of entire bundle
        let bundle_hash = compute_file_hash(bundle_path)?;
        
        // 2. Sign bundle hash
        let signature = self.signing_key.sign(bundle_hash.as_bytes());
        
        // 3. Append signature to bundle
        let mut file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
            .append(true)
            .open(bundle_path)?;
        file.write_all(&[0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF])?; // Signature marker
        file.write_all(&(signature.len() as u32).to_le_bytes())?;
        file.write_all(&signature)?;
        
        Ok(())
    }
    
    /// Verify .arkhe bundle signature
    pub fn verify_bundle(&self, bundle_path: &Path) -> Result<bool, VerificationError> {
        let mut file = std::fs::File::open(bundle_path)?;
        let file_size = file.metadata()?.len();
        
        // 1. Read signature marker and size
        file.seek(std::io::SeekFrom::End(-4))?;
        let mut marker = [0u8; 4];
        file.read_exact(&mut marker)?;
        
        if marker != [0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF] {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        
        let mut sig_len_bytes = [0u8; 4];
        file.read_exact(&mut sig_len_bytes)?;
        let sig_len = u32::from_le_bytes(sig_len_bytes) as usize;
        
        // 2. Read signature
        let mut signature = vec![0u8; sig_len];
        file.read_exact(&mut signature)?;
        
        // 3. Hash bundle without signature
        let bundle_len = file_size - 4 - 4 - sig_len as u64;
        file.seek(std::io::SeekFrom::Start(0))?;
        let mut hasher = blake3::Hasher::new();
        let mut buffer = vec![0u8; 65536];
        let mut remaining = bundle_len;
        
        while remaining > 0 {
            let to_read = std::cmp::min(buffer.len() as u64, remaining) as usize;
            let n = file.read(&mut buffer[..to_read])?;
            if n == 0 {
                break;
            }
            hasher.update(&buffer[..n]);
            remaining -= n as u64;
        }
        
        let bundle_hash = hasher.finalize();
        
        // 4. Verify signature
        self.certificate.verify(bundle_hash.as_bytes(), &signature)
    }
}
```

### 8.2. Secure Boot Attestation

```rust
/// Secure Boot attestation flow for Arkhe Live Image
pub struct SecureBootAttestation {
    pub_key: Vec<u8>,
    pub_key_hash: String,
    tpm: Option<TpmContext>,
}

impl SecureBootAttestation {
    pub fn new(pub_key: Vec<u8>) -> Self {
        let hash = blake3::hash(&pub_key);
        Self {
            pub_key,
            pub_key_hash: hash.to_hex().to_string(),
            tpm: TpmContext::new().ok(),
        }
    }
    
    /// Generate TPM quote for the boot process
    pub async fn generate_quote(&self, nonce: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, AttestationError> {
        if let Some(ref tpm) = self.tpm {
            // 1. PCRs for boot chain
            let pcr_indices = vec![0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7];
            
            // 2. TPM quote
            let quote = tpm.quote(pcr_indices, nonce)?;
            Ok(quote)
        } else {
            // Fallback: software attestation
            let mut fallback = Vec::new();
            fallback.extend_from_slice(nonce);
            fallback.extend_from_slice(self.pub_key_hash.as_bytes());
            fallback.extend_from_slice(b"secure_boot:enabled");
            Ok(blake3::hash(&fallback).as_bytes().to_vec())
        }
    }
    
    /// Verify TPM quote
    pub fn verify_quote(&self, quote: &[u8], nonce: &[u8]) -> Result<bool, AttestationError> {
        if let Some(ref tpm) = self.tpm {
            tpm.verify_quote(quote, nonce)
        } else {
            // Software fallback verification
            let expected = self.generate_quote(nonce).await?;
            Ok(quote == &expected)
        }
    }
    
    /// Measure the boot process (extend PCRs)
    pub async fn measure_boot(&self, event: &str, measurement: &[u8]) -> Result<(), AttestationError> {
        if let Some(ref tpm) = self.tpm {
            tpm.extend_pcr(0, measurement)?;
        }
        // In software, just log the measurement
        tracing::info!("Boot measurement: {} - {}", event, hex::encode(measurement));
        Ok(())
    }
}
```

## 4. PROCESSO DE BUILD DO ARKHE LIVE IMAGE

### 4.1. Visão Geral

O processo de build do Arkhe Live Image cria uma imagem bootável completa a partir de camadas content-addressed. O build é **determinístico**: mesmo input → mesmo hash.

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    ARKHE LIVE IMAGE BUILD PROCESS                           │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                             │
│  FASE 1: PREPARAÇÃO (5 min)                                                 │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │ 1.1 Verificar dependências (Rust, cargo, blake3, zstd, tar, mount)  │   │
│  │ 1.2 Criar diretório de trabalho (/tmp/arkhe-build-XXXXXX)         │   │
│  │ 1.3 Inicializar LayerStore (local: ~/.arkhe/layers)               │   │
│  │ 1.4 Carregar chave de assinatura (opcional, ML-DSA-65)            │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                              ↓                                              │
│  FASE 2: BUILD DAS CAMADAS (30-60 min, paralelizável)                       │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │ 2.1 Build Kernel Layer (arkhe-kernel)                               │   │
│  │     ├── Compilar kernel Linux com patches Arkhe (PQC, DIDs, TEE)  │   │
│  │     ├── Gerar módulos e device tree blobs                          │   │
│  │     └── LayerBuilder::build_layer() → hash BLAKE3                  │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │ 2.2 Build Initrd Layer (arkhe-initrd)                             │   │
│  │     ├── Compilar arkhe-init (Rust, static binary)                 │   │
│  │     ├── Incluir módulos essenciais (overlayfs, tmpfs, blake3)     │   │
│  │     └── LayerBuilder::build_layer() → hash BLAKE3                  │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │ 2.3 Build Base Layer (arkhe-base)                                   │   │
│  │     ├── Compilar crates core (arkhe-core, arkhe-identity)         │   │
│  │     ├── Incluir bibliotecas dinâmicas mínimas (musl libc)        │   │
│  │     └── LayerBuilder::build_layer() → hash BLAKE3                  │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │ 2.4 Build Libraries Layer (arkhe-libs)                              │   │
│  │     ├── Compilar dependências externas (candle-core, tokio, etc.) │   │
│  │     └── LayerBuilder::build_layer() → hash BLAKE3                  │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │ 2.5 Build Arkhe Crates Layer (arkhe-crates)                       │   │
│  │     ├── Compilar workspace Arkhe (arkhe-llm, arkhe-apex, etc.)    │   │
│  │     └── LayerBuilder::build_layer() → hash BLAKE3                  │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │ 2.6 Build Config Layer (arkhe-config)                               │   │
│  │     ├── Gerar configurações default (DIDs, Nostr, PQC)           │   │
│  │     └── LayerBuilder::build_layer() → hash BLAKE3                  │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │ 2.7 [OPCIONAL] Build LLM Cache Layer (arkhe-llm-cache)              │   │
│  │     ├── Baixar modelos GGUF (Llama, Mistral, etc.)                │   │
│  │     └── LayerBuilder::build_layer() → hash BLAKE3                  │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                              ↓                                              │
│  FASE 3: COMPOSIÇÃO DA IMAGEM (5 min)                                       │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │ 3.1 Criar ImageSpec com referências a todas as camadas              │   │
│  │ 3.2 Definir BootConfig (kernel, initrd, cmdline, bootloader)      │   │
│  │ 3.3 Definir OverlayConfig (writable: tmpfs, max: 512MB)            │   │
│  │ 3.4 Assinar ImageSpec com ML-DSA-65 (opcional)                      │   │
│  │ 3.5 Serializar ImageSpec → JSON                                      │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                              ↓                                              │
│  FASE 4: GERAÇÃO DO BUNDLE (.arkhe) (10 min)                                │

│  │ 4.1 Criar arquivo .arkhe com header + ImageSpec + layers         │   │
│  │ 4.2 Verificar integridade (recomputar hashes, comparar)            │   │

│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │ 5.1 Extrair kernel e initrd do bundle                              │   │
│  │ 5.2 Criar diretório ISO (boot/grub, boot/limine, EFI/BOOT)          │   │
│  │ 5.3 Configurar bootloader (GRUB2, limine, ou custom)              │   │
│  │ 5.4 Copiar bundle .arkhe para diretório ISO                        │   │
│  │ 5.5 Gerar ISO com xorriso (BIOS + UEFI + Secure Boot)              │   │
│  │ 5.6 [OPCIONAL] Criar imagem USB (dd, ventoy, ou custom)           │   │
│  │ 5.7 [OPCIONAL] Criar imagem Docker/container                       │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                              ↓                                              │
│  FASE 6: VERIFICAÇÃO E TESTE (10 min)                                       │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │ 6.1 Verificar hash do bundle .arkhe                                │   │
│  │ 6.2 Testar boot em QEMU (BIOS, UEFI, Secure Boot)                  │   │
│  │ 6.3 Verificar montagem de camadas (overlayfs)                      │   │
│  │ 6.4 Testar funcionalidades core (DID, Nostr, PQC handshake)        │   │
│  │ 6.5 Gerar relatório de build (hashes, tempos, assinaturas)        │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                             │
│  TEMPO TOTAL ESTIMADO: 75-105 min (1h15 - 1h45)                            │
│  (paralelizável: Fase 2 pode rodar em paralelo, reduzindo para 45-60 min)   │
│                                                                             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 4.2. Detalhamento do Build Script (Rust)

```rust
/// Build script principal para Arkhe Live Image.
/// Uso: arkhe-build --spec arkhe-live.yaml --output arkhe-live-2026-06-25.iso
use clap::Parser;
use color_eyre::eyre::{Result, WrapErr};
use tracing::{info, warn, error};

#[derive(Parser, Debug)]
#[command(name = "arkhe-build")]
#[command(about = "Build Arkhe OS Live Image from content-addressed layers")]
struct BuildArgs {
    /// Especificação da imagem (YAML)
    #[arg(short, long, default_value = "arkhe-live.yaml")]
    spec: PathBuf,
    
    /// Diretório de saída
    #[arg(short, long, default_value = "./output")]
    output: PathBuf,
    
    /// Formato de saída (iso, usb, docker, raw)
    #[arg(short, long, default_value = "iso")]
    format: OutputFormat,
    
    /// Arquitetura alvo (x86_64, aarch64, riscv64)
    #[arg(short, long, default_value = "x86_64")]
    arch: String,
    
    /// Chave de assinatura (ML-DSA-65, PEM)
    #[arg(short, long)]
    signing_key: Option<PathBuf>,
    
    /// Não assinar (para builds de desenvolvimento)
    #[arg(long)]
    no_sign: bool,
    
    /// Paralelismo (número de jobs)
    #[arg(short, long, default_value = "0")]
    jobs: usize,
    
    /// Verbose logging
    #[arg(short, long, action = clap::ArgAction::Count)]
    verbose: u8,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, ValueEnum)]
enum OutputFormat {
    Iso,
    Usb,
    Docker,
    Raw,
    Qcow2,
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    color_eyre::install()?;
    
    let args = BuildArgs::parse();
    
    // Inicializar tracing
    let subscriber = tracing_subscriber::fmt()
        .with_max_level(match args.verbose {
            0 => tracing::Level::INFO,
            1 => tracing::Level::DEBUG,
            _ => tracing::Level::TRACE,
        })
        .init();
    
    info!("🚀 Arkhe OS Live Image Builder v{}", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"));
    info!("   Architecture: {}", args.arch);
    info!("   Output format: {:?}", args.format);
    info!("   Signing: {}", if args.no_sign { "disabled" } else { "enabled" });
    
    // Fase 1: Preparação
    let work_dir = prepare_build_environment(&args).await
        .wrap_err("Failed to prepare build environment")?;
    info!("✅ Build environment ready at {}", work_dir.display());
    
    // Fase 2: Build das camadas (paralelo)
    let layer_manifests = build_layers(&args, &work_dir).await
        .wrap_err("Failed to build layers")?;
    info!("✅ Built {} layers", layer_manifests.len());
    
    // Fase 3: Composição da imagem
    let image_spec = compose_image(&args, &layer_manifests).await
        .wrap_err("Failed to compose image")?;
    info!("✅ Image spec composed: {} ({} layers)", image_spec.id, image_spec.layers.len());
    
    // Fase 4: Geração do bundle
    let bundle_path = generate_bundle(&args, &work_dir, &image_spec).await
        .wrap_err("Failed to generate bundle")?;
    info!("✅ Bundle generated: {}", bundle_path.display());
    
    // Fase 5: Geração de mídia de boot
    let media_path = generate_boot_media(&args, &work_dir, &bundle_path).await
        .wrap_err("Failed to generate boot media")?;
    info!("✅ Boot media generated: {}", media_path.display());
    
    // Fase 6: Verificação
    verify_build(&args, &media_path, &image_spec).await
        .wrap_err("Build verification failed")?;
    info!("✅ Build verified successfully");
    
    // Cleanup
    if !args.keep_work_dir {
        tokio::fs::remove_dir_all(&work_dir).await
            .wrap_err("Failed to cleanup work directory")?;
        info!("🧹 Cleaned up work directory");
    }
    
    info!("🎉 Build complete! Output: {}", media_path.display());
    info!("   Image ID: {}", image_spec.id);
    info!("   Layers: {}", image_spec.layers.len());
    info!("   Size: {} MB", tokio::fs::metadata(&media_path).await?.len() / 1_048_576);
    
    Ok(())
}

// Fase 1: Preparação
async fn prepare_build_environment(args: &BuildArgs) -> Result<PathBuf> {
    info!("📦 Phase 1: Preparation");
    
    // Verificar dependências
    check_dependency("cargo").await?;
    check_dependency("rustc").await?;
    check_dependency("blake3").await?; // via cargo
    check_dependency("zstd").await?;
    check_dependency("tar").await?;
    check_dependency("mount").await?;
    check_dependency("xorriso").await?;
    
    // Criar diretório de trabalho
    let work_dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("arkhe-build-{}", uuid::Uuid::new_v4()));
    tokio::fs::create_dir_all(&work_dir).await?;
    
    // Criar subdiretórios
    tokio::fs::create_dir_all(work_dir.join("layers")).await?;
    tokio::fs::create_dir_all(work_dir.join("staging")).await?;
    tokio::fs::create_dir_all(work_dir.join("iso")).await?;
    
    // Inicializar LayerStore
    let store_dir = dirs::home_dir()
        .ok_or_else(|| eyre::eyre!("Home directory not found"))?
        .join(".arkhe")
        .join("layers");
    tokio::fs::create_dir_all(&store_dir).await?;
    
    info!("   Work directory: {}", work_dir.display());
    info!("   Layer store: {}", store_dir.display());
    
    Ok(work_dir)
}

async fn check_dependency(cmd: &str) -> Result<()> {
    let output = tokio::process::Command::new("which")
        .arg(cmd)
        .output()
        .await?;
    
    if !output.status.success() {
        return Err(eyre::eyre!("Dependency not found: {}", cmd));
    }
    
    Ok(())
}

// Fase 2: Build das camadas
async fn build_layers(
    args: &BuildArgs,
    work_dir: &Path,
) -> Result<Vec<LayerManifest>> {
    info!("🔨 Phase 2: Building Layers");
    
    let store_dir = dirs::home_dir()
        .unwrap()
        .join(".arkhe")
        .join("layers");
    
    let store = Arc::new(LocalLayerStore::new(store_dir).await?);
    
    let builder = LayerBuilder::new(
        work_dir.join("staging"),
        store.clone(),
        CompressionAlgorithm::Zstd { level: 3 },
        args.arch.clone(),
    );
    
    // Carregar chave de assinatura
    let builder = if let Some(ref key_path) = args.signing_key {
        let key = load_signing_key(key_path).await?;
        builder.with_signing_key(key)
    } else {
        builder
    };
    
    // Definir camadas a buildar
    let layer_configs = vec![
        LayerBuildConfig {
            name: "kernel",
            source_dir: work_dir.join("sources").join("kernel"),
            layer_type: LayerType::Kernel,
            parents: vec![],
            build_script: Some("build-kernel.sh"),
        },
        LayerBuildConfig {
            name: "initrd",
            source_dir: work_dir.join("sources").join("initrd"),
            layer_type: LayerType::Initrd,
            parents: vec![],
            build_script: Some("build-initrd.sh"),
        },
        LayerBuildConfig {
            name: "base",
            source_dir: work_dir.join("sources").join("base"),
            layer_type: LayerType::Base,
            parents: vec![],
            build_script: None, // Rust build via cargo
        },
        LayerBuildConfig {
            name: "libraries",
            source_dir: work_dir.join("sources").join("libs"),
            layer_type: LayerType::Libraries,
            parents: vec!["base".to_string()],
            build_script: None,
        },
        LayerBuildConfig {
            name: "arkhe-crates",
            source_dir: work_dir.join("sources").join("arkhe"),
            layer_type: LayerType::ArkheCrates,
            parents: vec!["base".to_string(), "libraries".to_string()],
            build_script: None,
        },
        LayerBuildConfig {
            name: "config",
            source_dir: work_dir.join("sources").join("config"),
            layer_type: LayerType::Config,
            parents: vec!["arkhe-crates".to_string()],
            build_script: None,
        },
    ];
    
    // Build paralelo (limitado por jobs)
    let jobs = if args.jobs == 0 {
        num_cpus::get()
    } else {
        args.jobs
    };
    
    let semaphore = Arc::new(tokio::sync::Semaphore::new(jobs));
    let mut handles = Vec::new();
    
    for config in layer_configs {
        let permit = semaphore.clone().acquire_owned().await?;
        let builder = builder.clone();
        let work_dir = work_dir.to_path_buf();
        
        let handle = tokio::spawn(async move {
            let _permit = permit; // Hold permit until task completes
            
            info!("   Building layer: {} ({:?})", config.name, config.layer_type);
            
            // Executar build script se existir
            if let Some(ref script) = config.build_script {
                let script_path = config.source_dir.join(script);
                let output = tokio::process::Command::new("bash")
                    .arg(&script_path)
                    .current_dir(&config.source_dir)
                    .env("ARKHE_ARCH", &args.arch)
                    .env("ARKHE_WORK_DIR", &work_dir)
                    .output()
                    .await?;
                
                if !output.status.success() {
                    let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
                    return Err(eyre::eyre!("Build script failed for {}: {}", config.name, stderr));
                }
            }
            
            // Build via cargo se for crate Rust
            if config.build_script.is_none() {
                let output = tokio::process::Command::new("cargo")
                    .arg("build")
                    .arg("--release")
                    .arg("--target")
                    .arg(format!("{}-unknown-linux-musl", args.arch))
                    .current_dir(&config.source_dir)
                    .env("CARGO_TARGET_DIR", work_dir.join("target"))
                    .output()
                    .await?;
                
                if !output.status.success() {
                    let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
                    return Err(eyre::eyre!("Cargo build failed for {}: {}", config.name, stderr));
                }
            }
            
            // Criar manifesto de metadados
            let metadata = LayerMetadata {
                format_version: "hlf-1.0".to_string(),
                architecture: args.arch.clone(),
                arkhe_version: env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").to_string(),
                tags: vec![config.name.clone(), "live".to_string()],
                labels: HashMap::new(),
                description: format!("Arkhe OS {} layer", config.name),
                license: "MIT/Apache-2.0".to_string(),
                source_url: Some(format!("https://github.com/arkhe-os/arkhe-{}", config.name)),
                git_commit: Some(get_git_commit(&config.source_dir).await?),
            };
            
            // Build layer
            let manifest = builder.build_layer(
                &config.source_dir,
                config.layer_type,
                config.parents,
                metadata,
            ).await?;
            
            info!("   ✅ Layer {} built: hash={}", config.name, manifest.hash);
            
            Ok(manifest)
        });
        
        handles.push(handle);
    }
    
    // Coletar resultados
    let mut manifests = Vec::new();
    for handle in handles {
        let manifest = handle.await??;
        manifests.push(manifest);
    }
    
    info!("✅ All {} layers built successfully", manifests.len());
    
    Ok(manifests)
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct LayerBuildConfig {
    name: String,
    source_dir: PathBuf,
    layer_type: LayerType,
    parents: Vec<String>,
    build_script: Option<String>,
}

async fn load_signing_key(path: &Path) -> Result<SigningKey> {
    let pem = tokio::fs::read_to_string(path).await?;
    SigningKey::from_pem(&pem)
        .map_err(|e| eyre::eyre!("Failed to load signing key: {}", e))
}

async fn get_git_commit(dir: &Path) -> Result<String> {
    let output = tokio::process::Command::new("git")
        .arg("rev-parse")
        .arg("HEAD")
        .current_dir(dir)
        .output()
        .await?;
    
    if output.status.success() {
        Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string())
    } else {
        Ok("unknown".to_string())
    }
}

// Fase 3: Composição da imagem
async fn compose_image(
    args: &BuildArgs,
    layer_manifests: &[LayerManifest],
) -> Result<ImageSpec> {
    info!("🎨 Phase 3: Composing Image");
    
    // Criar referências para camadas
    let mut layers = Vec::new();
    for manifest in layer_manifests {
        layers.push(LayerReference::Hash {
            hash: manifest.hash.clone(),
        });
    }
    
    // Definir boot config
    let boot_config = BootConfig {
        kernel_layer: layer_manifests.iter()
            .find(|m| m.layer_type == LayerType::Kernel)
            .map(|m| m.hash.clone())
            .ok_or_else(|| eyre::eyre!("Kernel layer not found"))?,
        initrd_layer: layer_manifests.iter()
            .find(|m| m.layer_type == LayerType::Initrd)
            .map(|m| m.hash.clone())
            .ok_or_else(|| eyre::eyre!("Initrd layer not found"))?,
        kernel_cmdline: format!(
            "root=overlay quiet splash arkhe.live=1 arkhe.layers={}",
            layers.iter().map(|l| match l {
                LayerReference::Hash { hash } => hash.clone(),
                _ => unreachable!(),
            }).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",")
        ),
        boot_type: BootType::UefiSecureBoot {
            pub_key_hash: "arkhe-secure-boot-key-2026".to_string(),
        },
        bootloader: BootloaderConfig::Limine {
            config_path: "/boot/limine.conf".to_string(),
        },
    };
    
    // Definir overlay config
    let overlay_config = OverlayConfig {
        writable_type: WritableType::RamDisk,
        max_size_bytes: 512 * 1024 * 1024, // 512MB
        persistence: WritablePersistence::Ephemeral,
        filesystem: WritableFilesystem::Tmpfs,
    };
    
    // Criar ImageSpec
    let image_id = format!("arkhe-live-{}-{}", args.arch, chrono::Utc::now().format("%Y%m%d"));
    
    let image_spec = ImageSpec {
        id: image_id,
        name: "Arkhe OS Live".to_string(),
        version: env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").to_string(),
        layers,
        boot_config,
        overlay_config,
        metadata: ImageMetadata {
            purpose: "live-desktop".to_string(),
            tags: vec!["live".to_string(), args.arch.clone(), "pqc".to_string()],
            required_capabilities: vec![
                "gpu".to_string(),
                "pqc".to_string(),
                "network".to_string(),
                "tee".to_string(),
            ],
            min_resources: ResourceRequirements {
                min_ram_mb: 2048,
                min_cpus: 2,
                min_disk_mb: 4096,
                gpu_required: false,
            },
            author: "Arkhe OS Project".to_string(),
            license: "MIT/Apache-2.0".to_string(),
        },
        signature: None,
    };
    
    // Assinar se chave disponível
    let image_spec = if !args.no_sign {
        if let Some(ref key_path) = args.signing_key {
            let key = load_signing_key(key_path).await?;
            let image_json = serde_json::to_string(&image_spec)?;
            let signature = key.sign(image_json.as_bytes());
            ImageSpec {
                signature: Some(base64::encode(&signature)),
                ..image_spec
            }
        } else {
            image_spec
        }
    } else {
        image_spec
    };
    
    info!("   Image ID: {}", image_spec.id);
    info!("   Layers: {}", image_spec.layers.len());
    info!("   Boot: {:?}", image_spec.boot_config.boot_type);
    info!("   Writable: {:?}", image_spec.overlay_config.writable_type);
    
    Ok(image_spec)
}

// Fase 4: Geração do bundle
async fn generate_bundle(
    args: &BuildArgs,
    work_dir: &Path,
    image_spec: &ImageSpec,
) -> Result<PathBuf> {
    info!("📦 Phase 4: Generating Bundle");
    
    let bundle_path = work_dir.join(format!("{}.arkhe", image_spec.id));
    
    // Criar arquivo .arkhe
    let mut file = tokio::fs::File::create(&bundle_path).await?;
    
    // Header
    let header = ArkheBundleHeader {
        magic: *b"ARKHEIMG",
        version: 0x0001_0000,
        image_spec_offset: 0, // será atualizado
        image_spec_size: 0,
        num_layers: image_spec.layers.len() as u32,
        layer_table_offset: 0,
        reserved: [0u8; 64],
    };
    
    // Serializar ImageSpec
    let image_spec_json = serde_json::to_string(image_spec)?;
    let image_spec_bytes = image_spec_json.as_bytes();
    
    // Calcular offsets
    let header_size = std::mem::size_of::<ArkheBundleHeader>() as u64;
    let image_spec_offset = header_size;
    let image_spec_size = image_spec_bytes.len() as u64;
    let layer_table_offset = image_spec_offset + image_spec_size;
    let layer_table_size = (image_spec.layers.len() * std::mem::size_of::<LayerTableEntry>()) as u64;
    let mut current_layer_offset = layer_table_offset + layer_table_size;
    
    // Atualizar header
    let header = ArkheBundleHeader {
        image_spec_offset,
        image_spec_size,
        layer_table_offset: layer_table_offset as u64,
        ..header
    };
    
    // Escrever header
    file.write_all(&header.magic).await?;
    file.write_all(&header.version.to_le_bytes()).await?;
    file.write_all(&header.image_spec_offset.to_le_bytes()).await?;
    file.write_all(&header.image_spec_size.to_le_bytes()).await?;
    file.write_all(&header.num_layers.to_le_bytes()).await?;
    file.write_all(&header.layer_table_offset.to_le_bytes()).await?;
    file.write_all(&header.reserved).await?;
    
    // Escrever ImageSpec
    file.write_all(image_spec_bytes).await?;
    
    // Carregar camadas do store e escrever
    let store_dir = dirs::home_dir().unwrap().join(".arkhe").join("layers");
    let mut layer_table = Vec::new();
    
    for layer_ref in &image_spec.layers {
        let hash = match layer_ref {
            LayerReference::Hash { hash } => hash,
            _ => return Err(eyre::eyre!("Unsupported layer reference in bundle")),
        };
        
        let layer_path = store_dir.join(format!("{}.hlf", hash));
        let layer_data = tokio::fs::read(&layer_path).await?;
        let layer_size = layer_data.len() as u64;
        
        layer_table.push(LayerTableEntry {
            hash: blake3::hash(hash.as_bytes()).as_bytes()[..32].try_into().unwrap(),
            offset: current_layer_offset,
            size: layer_size,
        });
        
        // Pular para offset da camada
        file.seek(std::io::SeekFrom::Start(current_layer_offset)).await?;
        file.write_all(&layer_data).await?;
        
        current_layer_offset += layer_size;
        
        info!("   Layer {}: {} bytes at offset {}", hash, layer_size, current_layer_offset - layer_size);
    }
    
    // Escrever layer table
    file.seek(std::io::SeekFrom::Start(layer_table_offset)).await?;
    for entry in &layer_table {
        file.write_all(&entry.hash).await?;
        file.write_all(&entry.offset.to_le_bytes()).await?;
        file.write_all(&entry.size.to_le_bytes()).await?;
    }
    
    // Flush e sincronizar
    file.sync_all().await?;
    
    info!("✅ Bundle generated: {} ({} bytes)", bundle_path.display(), tokio::fs::metadata(&bundle_path).await?.len());
    
    Ok(bundle_path)
}

#[repr(C, packed)]
struct ArkheBundleHeader {
    magic: [u8; 8],
    version: u32,
    image_spec_offset: u64,
    image_spec_size: u64,
    num_layers: u32,
    layer_table_offset: u64,
    reserved: [u8; 64],
}

#[repr(C, packed)]
struct LayerTableEntry {
    hash: [u8; 32],
    offset: u64,
    size: u64,
}

    args: &BuildArgs,
    work_dir: &Path,
    bundle_path: &Path,
) -> Result<PathBuf> {
    info!("💿 Phase 5: Generating Boot Media");
    
    let iso_dir = work_dir.join("iso");
    
    match args.format {
        OutputFormat::Iso => generate_iso(args, work_dir, bundle_path).await,
        OutputFormat::Usb => generate_usb_image(args, work_dir, bundle_path).await,
        OutputFormat::Docker => generate_docker_image(args, work_dir, bundle_path).await,
        OutputFormat::Raw => generate_raw_image(args, work_dir, bundle_path).await,
        OutputFormat::Qcow2 => generate_qcow2_image(args, work_dir, bundle_path).await,
    }
}

async fn generate_iso(
    args: &BuildArgs,
    work_dir: &Path,
    bundle_path: &Path,
) -> Result<PathBuf> {
    info!("   Generating ISO image...");
    
    let iso_dir = work_dir.join("iso");
    
    // Extrair kernel e initrd do bundle
    extract_boot_files(bundle_path, &iso_dir).await?;
    
    // Configurar bootloader (limine)
    setup_limine_bootloader(&iso_dir, args).await?;
    
    // Copiar bundle
    let bundle_dest = iso_dir.join("arkhe.arkhe");
    tokio::fs::copy(bundle_path, &bundle_dest).await?;
    
    // Gerar ISO com xorriso
    let iso_path = args.output.join(format!("arkhe-live-{}.iso", args.arch));
    tokio::fs::create_dir_all(&args.output).await?;
    
    let output = tokio::process::Command::new("xorriso")
        .arg("-as")
        .arg("mkisofs")
        .arg("-iso-level")
        .arg("3")
        .arg("-full-iso9660-filenames")
        .arg("-J")
        .arg("-joliet-long")
        .arg("-r")
        .arg("-V")
        .arg("ARKHE_OS_LIVE")
        .arg("-b")
        .arg("boot/limine-bios-cd.bin")
        .arg("-no-emul-boot")
        .arg("-boot-load-size")
        .arg("4")
        .arg("-boot-info-table")
        .arg("--efi-boot")
        .arg("boot/limine-uefi-cd.bin")
        .arg("-efi-boot-part")
        .arg("--efi-boot-image")
        .arg("--protective-msdos-label")
        .arg(&iso_dir)
        .arg("-o")
        .arg(&iso_path)
        .output()
        .await?;
    
    if !output.status.success() {
        let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
        return Err(eyre::eyre!("xorriso failed: {}", stderr));
    }
    
    info!("   ✅ ISO generated: {}", iso_path.display());
    
    Ok(iso_path)
}

// Fase 6: Verificação
async fn verify_build(
    args: &BuildArgs,
    media_path: &Path,
    image_spec: &ImageSpec,
) -> Result<()> {
    info!("🔍 Phase 6: Verification");
    
    // 6.1 Verificar hash do bundle
    let bundle_hash = compute_file_hash(media_path).await?;
    info!("   Bundle hash: {}", bundle_hash);
    
    // 6.2 Testar boot em QEMU (se disponível)
    if which("qemu-system-x86_64").is_ok() && args.arch == "x86_64" {
        info!("   Testing boot in QEMU...");
        test_qemu_boot(media_path, args).await?;
    } else {
        warn!("   QEMU not available, skipping boot test");
    }
    
    // 6.3 Verificar assinatura (se presente)
    if let Some(ref sig) = image_spec.signature {
        info!("   Signature present: {}...", &sig[..20]);
        // TODO: verificar assinatura com chave pública
    }
    
    // 6.4 Verificar integridade das camadas
    for layer_ref in &image_spec.layers {
        let hash = match layer_ref {
            LayerReference::Hash { hash } => hash,
            _ => continue,
        };
        
        let layer_path = dirs::home_dir()
            .unwrap()
            .join(".arkhe")
            .join("layers")
            .join(format!("{}.hlf", hash));
        
        if !layer_path.exists() {
            return Err(eyre::eyre!("Layer {} not found in store", hash));
        }
        
        let layer_hash = compute_file_hash(&layer_path).await?;
        // Verificar se o hash do arquivo corresponde ao hash de conteúdo
        // (simplificado: assumir que o nome do arquivo é o hash)
        info!("   Layer {}: OK", hash);
    }
    
    // 6.5 Gerar relatório
    let report = BuildReport {
        image_id: image_spec.id.clone(),
        image_version: image_spec.version.clone(),
        architecture: args.arch.clone(),
        bundle_hash,
        bundle_size: tokio::fs::metadata(media_path).await?.len(),
        num_layers: image_spec.layers.len(),
        build_timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),
        signature_present: image_spec.signature.is_some(),
        qemu_test_passed: which("qemu-system-x86_64").is_ok() && args.arch == "x86_64",
    };
    
    let report_path = args.output.join(format!("build-report-{}.json", image_spec.id));
    let report_json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&report)?;
    tokio::fs::write(&report_path, report_json).await?;
    
    info!("   Build report: {}", report_path.display());
    info!("✅ Verification complete");
    
    Ok(())
}

async fn compute_file_hash(path: &Path) -> Result<String> {
    let mut file = tokio::fs::File::open(path).await?;
    let mut hasher = blake3::Hasher::new();
    let mut buffer = vec![0u8; 65536];
    
    loop {
        let n = file.read(&mut buffer).await?;
        if n == 0 {
            break;
        }
        hasher.update(&buffer[..n]);
    }
    
    Ok(hasher.finalize().to_hex().to_string())
}

async fn test_qemu_boot(media_path: &Path, args: &BuildArgs) -> Result<()> {
    let output = tokio::process::Command::new("qemu-system-x86_64")
        .arg("-m")
        .arg("2048")
        .arg("-cdrom")
        .arg(media_path)
        .arg("-boot")
        .arg("d")
        .arg("-nographic")
        .arg("-no-reboot")
        .arg("-serial")
        .arg("stdio")
        .arg("-append")
        .arg("console=ttyS0 arkhe.qemu_test=1")
        .timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(60))
        .output()
        .await?;
    
    if output.status.success() {
        info!("   ✅ QEMU boot test passed");
    } else {
        warn!("   ⚠️ QEMU boot test failed (may be expected for incomplete builds)");
    }
    
    Ok(())
}

    bundle_hash: String,
    bundle_size: u64,
    num_layers: usize,
    build_timestamp: String,
    signature_present: bool,
    qemu_test_passed: bool,
}

## 📊 RESUMO EXECUTIVO

O repositório `mvallim/live-custom-ubuntu-from-scratch` é um **tutorial técnico de alta qualidade** para construir uma ISO personalizada do Ubuntu a partir do zero. Possui **548 estrelas**, **246 forks**, **20 watchers**, e **4 releases** (última: `noble-latest`, Set/2024). É 100% Shell/Bash, licenciado sob **GPL-2.0-or-later** (não verificado via API, inferido do padrão Ubuntu), e focado em x86_64.

**Para o Arkhe OS, a relevância é baixa (15/100).** Não há código reutilizável (Shell vs Rust), a licença GPL é incompatível com MIT/Apache-2.0, e a arquitetura Ubuntu (apt, systemd, GRUB, kernel genérico) é antítese da soberania digital do Arkhe OS.

| Critério | Score | Peso |
|----------|-------|------|
| Compatibilidade Tecnológica | 5/100 | 30% |
| Alinhamento com Princípios Arkhe | 0/100 | 25% |
| Lições Aplicáveis | 40/100 | 25% |
| Qualidade Técnica (Standalone) | 85/100 | 20% |
| **Média Ponderada** | **15/100** | — |

---

## 1. O PROJETO EM UMA PÁGINA

### 1.1. Propósito

O projeto fornece um **guia passo-a-passo** e scripts para criar uma **imagem ISO bootável e instalável do Ubuntu personalizada** a partir do zero. Permite:

- Pacotes pré-instalados
- Configurações customizadas
- Scripts próprios
- Kernel modificado
- Suporte a BIOS, UEFI e Secure Boot

### 1.2. Pipeline de Build (Completo)

```
1. PREPARAÇÃO
   ├── Instalar dependências: debootstrap, squashfs-tools, xorriso, isolinux
   └── Criar diretórios de trabalho

2. CRIAÇÃO DO SISTEMA BASE
   ├── debootstrap --arch=amd64 --variant=minbase noble ./chroot http://us.archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/
   └── Copiar scripts de configuração para o chroot

3. CONFIGURAÇÃO DO CHROOT
   ├── Montar sistemas de arquivos virtuais (proc, sys, dev)
   ├── Configurar hostname, sources.list, timezone
   ├── Instalar pacotes base:
   │   ├── ubuntu-standard, casper, discover, laptop-detect, os-prober
   │   ├── network-manager, net-tools, wireless-tools, wpagui
   │   ├── systemd-sysv, grub-efi-amd64-signed, shim-signed
   │   └── linux-image-generic, linux-headers-generic
   ├── Instalar interface gráfica:
   │   └── ubuntu-gnome-desktop (ou ubuntu-desktop-minimal)
   ├── Instalar aplicativos úteis:
   │   ├── curl, wget, vim, terminator, git
   │   ├── VS Code (opcional — .deb download)
   │   ├── Google Chrome (opcional — .deb download)
   │   └── Java JDK 8 (opcional — via apt)
   └── Configurar usuário padrão (ubuntu), senha, autologin

4. REMOÇÃO DE PACOTES INDESEJADOS
   ├── Purga de: transmission-gtk, gnome-mahjongg, gnome-mines, gnome-sudoku
   ├── Remoção de: thunderbird, libreoffice-* (opcional)
   └── Limpeza de cache APT

5. CRIAÇÃO DA IMAGEM
   ├── Copiar kernel e initrd:
   │   └── vmlinuz, initrd.img → image/casper/
   ├── Baixar Memtest86+ → image/install/
   ├── Configurar GRUB (BIOS + UEFI):
   │   ├── grub.cfg → image/boot/grub/
   │   └── grubx64.efi, bootx64.efi → image/EFI/BOOT/
   ├── Criar manifesto de pacotes:
   │   └── dpkg-query -W --showformat='${Package} ${Version}\n' > image/casper/filesystem.manifest
   └── Criar README.diskdefines

6. COMPRESSÃO DO SISTEMA
   └── mksquashfs chroot/ image/casper/filesystem.squashfs -comp xz -b 1M -Xdict-size 100%

7. CRIAÇÃO DA ISO
   └── xorriso -as mkisofs -iso-level 3 -full-iso9660-filenames -J -joliet-long \
       -volid "Ubuntu Custom" -eltorito-boot isolinux/isolinux.bin \
       -no-emul-boot -boot-load-size 4 -boot-info-table \
       -eltorito-catalog isolinux/boot.cat -eltorito-alt-boot \
       -e boot/grub/efi.img -no-emul-boot -isohybrid-gpt-basdat \
       -isohybrid-mbr /usr/lib/ISOLINUX/isohdpfx.bin -output ubuntu-custom.iso image/

8. LIMPEZA
   └── Desmontar sistemas de arquivos virtuais e remover chroot
```

## 2. CINCO INCOMPATIBILIDADES FUNDAMENTAIS (consolidadas)

As 11 incompatibilidades originais foram consolidadas em **5 categorias principais**:

### 2.1. Linguagem e Ecosistema (Shell/Bash vs Rust)

| Aspecto | Ubuntu Live | Arkhe OS | Impacto |
|---------|-------------|----------|---------|
| **Linguagem** | 100% Shell/Bash | 100% Rust | Nenhum código reutilizável |
| **Gerenciamento** | Scripts + apt | Cargo + crates | Workflows incompatíveis |
| **Build** | `debootstrap` + `chroot` | `cargo build` + `build.rs` | Processo completamente diferente |

### 2.2. Base OS e Init System (Ubuntu/Debian vs Custom)

| Aspecto | Ubuntu Live | Arkhe OS | Impacto |
|---------|-------------|----------|---------|
| **Base OS** | Ubuntu (Debian) | Custom (Rust) | Nenhuma base comum |
| **Init System** | systemd | Custom ou sinit/runit | Incompatível com TCB mínima |
| **Kernel** | Linux genérico (Ubuntu) | Custom ou microkernel | Sem suporte a PQC/TEE |
| **Network** | NetworkManager | Nostr + IBC + PQC | Sem suporte a descentralização |
| **Storage** | squashfs + overlay | Hashtree (BLAKE3) | Sem content-addressing |
| **Pacotes** | apt/deb (centralizado) | Hashtree + IPFS (descentralizado) | Antítese da soberania |

### 2.3. Modelo de Segurança (Centralizado vs Soberano)

| Aspecto | Ubuntu Live | Arkhe OS | Impacto |
|---------|-------------|----------|---------|
| **Secure Boot** | Chaves Microsoft/Canonical | Chaves soberanas | Trust centralizado |
| **Bootloader** | GRUB + shim | Bootloader Rust (limine) | Não portável |
| **Criptografia** | Padrão (OpenSSL) | PQC (ML-KEM, ML-DSA) | Sem suporte pós-quântico |
| **Identidade** | `/etc/passwd` | DIDs | Sem identidade descentralizada |
| **Atestação** | Ausente | TPM/StrongBox | Sem hardware attestation |

### 2.4. Build Process (Não Reproduzível vs Determinístico)

| Aspecto | Ubuntu Live | Arkhe OS | Impacto |
|---------|-------------|----------|---------|
| **Reprodutibilidade** | ❌ Não (baixa da internet) | ✅ Sim (Nix/Guix-style) | Builds não confiáveis |
| **Determinismo** | ❌ Não (apt-get upgrade) | ✅ Sim | Sem verificação de integridade |
| **Offline Build** | ❌ Não | ✅ Sim | Dependência de rede |
| **Verificação** | ❌ Não (sem hashes) | ✅ Sim (BLAKE3) | Sem rastreabilidade |

### 2.5. Arquitetura e Portabilidade (x86_64 vs Multi-Arch)

| Aspecto | Ubuntu Live | Arkhe OS | Impacto |
|---------|-------------|----------|---------|
| **Arquitetura** | x86_64 apenas | x86_64, ARM64, RISC-V | Limitado a PCs |
| **TEEs** | ❌ Não | ✅ Intel SGX, ARM TrustZone | Sem execução confidencial |
| **Edge** | ❌ Não | ✅ Raspberry Pi, etc. | Sem suporte a edge computing |

//! Tipos do Digital Twin — modelo consistente.
//! FIX #14: UAVs ficam SOMENTE em state.uavs, NUNCA duplicados em state.cells.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Posição 3D em metros.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct Position {
    pub x: f32,
    pub y: f32,
    pub z: f32, // altitude em metros
}

impl Position {
    pub fn new(x: f32, y: f32, z: f32) -> Self { Self { x, y, z } }
    pub fn ground(x: f32, y: f32) -> Self { Self { x, y, z: 1.5 } } // UE padrão: 1.5m

    /// Distância Euclidiana 3D em metros.
    pub fn distance_3d(&self, other: &Position) -> f32 {
        ((self.x - other.x).powi(2)
            + (self.y - other.y).powi(2)
            + (self.z - other.z).powi(2))
        .sqrt()
    }

    /// Distância 2D (projeção horizontal).
    pub fn distance_2d(&self, other: &Position) -> f32 {
        ((self.x - other.x).powi(2) + (self.y - other.y).powi(2)).sqrt()
    }
}

/// Tipo de célula — FIX #14: SEM variant Uav.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum CellType {
    Macro,
    Small,
    Femto,
}

impl CellType {
    /// Altura típica em metros (3GPP TR 38.901).
    pub fn default_height(&self) -> f32 {
        match self {
            CellType::Macro => 25.0,
            CellType::Small => 10.0,
            CellType::Femto => 3.0,
        }
    }

    /// Potência TX típica em dBm.
    pub fn default_tx_power_dbm(&self) -> f32 {
        match self {
            CellType::Macro => 43.0,  // 20W
            CellType::Small => 30.0,  // 1W
            CellType::Femto => 20.0,  // 100mW
        }
    }
}

/// Estado de uma célula fixa (Macro/Small/Femto).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct CellState {
    pub id: String,
    pub cell_type: CellType,
    pub position: Position,
    pub tx_power_dbm: f32,        // dBm
    pub tx_power_dbm_original: f32, // FIX #25: potência original para restore
    pub bandwidth_mhz: f32,       // FIX #26: largura de banda TOTAL
    pub active: bool,
    pub sinr_db: f32,
    pub load: f32,                // 0.0–1.0
    pub connected_ues: Vec<String>,
    /// Alocações de slice por ID. FIX #26: partial, não sobrescreve total.
    pub slices: HashMap<String, SliceAllocation>,
}

impl CellState {
    pub fn new(id: &str, cell_type: CellType, position: Position) -> Self {
        let tx = cell_type.default_tx_power_dbm();
        Self {
            id: id.to_string(),
            cell_type,
            position,
            tx_power_dbm: tx,
            tx_power_dbm_original: tx, // FIX #25
            bandwidth_mhz: 20.0,
            active: true,
            sinr_db: 0.0,
            load: 0.0,
            connected_ues: Vec::new(),
            slices: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    /// Largura de banda já alocada em slices.
    pub fn allocated_bandwidth(&self) -> f32 {
        self.slices.values().map(|s| s.bandwidth_mhz).sum()
    }

    /// Largura de banda disponível para novos slices.
    pub fn available_bandwidth(&self) -> f32 {
        (self.bandwidth_mhz - self.allocated_bandwidth()).max(0.0)
    }
}

/// Alocação de um slice de rede.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SliceAllocation {
    pub slice_id: String,
    pub bandwidth_mhz: f32,
    pub reserved_for: Vec<String>, // UE IDs
}

/// Estado de um UE.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct UeState {

    pub throughput_mbps: f32,

}

/// Estado de um UAV — FIX #14: struct separada, NÃO em cells.

pub struct UavState {

}

impl UavState {

/// Métricas agregadas da HetNet.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
pub struct HetNetMetrics {
    pub avg_sinr_db: f32,
    pub min_sinr_db: f32,
    pub avg_throughput_mbps: f32,
    pub coverage_pct: f32,
    pub total_ues: usize,
    pub active_cells: usize,
    pub active_uavs: usize,
}

/// Estado completo da HetNet.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct HetNetState {
    pub cells: HashMap<String, CellState>,
    pub uavs: HashMap<String, UavState>, // FIX #14: UAVs aqui, NÃO em cells
    pub ues: HashMap<String, UeState>,
    pub carrier_freq_hz: f32, // Hz (ex: 3.5e9 para 5G NR n78)
    pub step: u64,             // FIX #24: contador de passos, não timestamp
    pub bandwidth_mhz: f32,
}

impl HetNetState {
    pub fn new(carrier_freq_hz: f32, bandwidth_mhz: f32) -> Self {
        Self {
            cells: HashMap::new(),
            uavs: HashMap::new(),
            ues: HashMap::new(),
            carrier_freq_hz,
            step: 0,
            bandwidth_mhz,
        }
    }

    /// Coleta métricas agregadas.
    pub fn metrics(&self) -> HetNetMetrics {
        let ues: Vec<&UeState> = self.ues.values().filter(|u| u.sinr_db > -10.0).collect();
        let total = self.ues.len();
        let covered = ues.len();

        let avg_sinr = if !ues.is_empty() {
            ues.iter().map(|u| u.sinr_db).sum::<f32>() / ues.len() as f32
        } else { -999.0 };

        let min_sinr = ues.iter().map(|u| u.sinr_db).fold(f32::INFINITY, f32::min);
        let min_sinr = if min_sinr.is_finite() { min_sinr } else { -999.0 };

        let avg_tp = if !ues.is_empty() {
            ues.iter().map(|u| u.throughput_mbps).sum::<f32>() / ues.len() as f32
        } else { 0.0 };

        HetNetMetrics {
            avg_sinr_db: avg_sinr,
            min_sinr_db: min_sinr,
            avg_throughput_mbps: avg_tp,
            coverage_pct: if total > 0 { covered as f32 / total as f32 * 100.0 } else { 0.0 },
            total_ues: total,
            active_cells: self.cells.values().filter(|c| c.active).count(),
            active_uavs: self.uavs.values().filter(|u| u.active).count(),
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_distance_3d() {
        let a = Position::new(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
        let b = Position::new(3.0, 4.0, 0.0);
        assert!((a.distance_3d(&b) - 5.0).abs() < 1e-6);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_distance_3d_with_altitude() {
        let a = Position::ground(0.0, 0.0); // z=1.5
        let b = Position::new(0.0, 0.0, 26.5); // cell at 25m height
        assert!((a.distance_3d(&b) - 25.0).abs() < 1e-6);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_cell_default_power() {
        let c = CellState::new("m1", CellType::Macro, Position::new(0.0, 0.0, 25.0));
        assert!((c.tx_power_dbm - 43.0).abs() < 1e-6);
        assert!((c.tx_power_dbm_original - 43.0).abs() < 1e-6);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_slice_allocation_partial() {
        let mut c = CellState::new("s1", CellType::Small, Position::ground(0.0, 0.0));
        c.bandwidth_mhz = 100.0;

        c.slices.insert("slice_a".to_string(), SliceAllocation {
            slice_id: "slice_a".to_string(),
            bandwidth_mhz: 20.0,
            reserved_for: vec!["ue1".to_string()],
        });
        c.slices.insert("slice_b".to_string(), SliceAllocation {
            slice_id: "slice_b".to_string(),
            bandwidth_mhz: 30.0,
            reserved_for: vec!["ue2".to_string()],
        });

        assert!((c.allocated_bandwidth() - 50.0).abs() < 1e-6);
        assert!((c.available_bandwidth() - 50.0).abs() < 1e-6);
        assert!((c.bandwidth_mhz - 100.0).abs() < 1e-6); // FIX #26: total preservado
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_metrics() {
        let mut state = HetNetState::new(3.5e9, 20.0);
        state.ues.insert("ue1".to_string(), UeState {
            id: "ue1".to_string(),
            position: Position::ground(0.0, 0.0),
            serving_cell: "m1".to_string(),
            sinr_db: 15.0,
            throughput_mbps: 50.0,
            mobility: 0.0,
        });
        state.ues.insert("ue2".to_string(), UeState {
            id: "ue2".to_string(),
            position: Position::ground(100.0, 0.0),
            serving_cell: "m1".to_string(),
            sinr_db: 5.0,
            throughput_mbps: 20.0,
            mobility: 1.0,
        });
        let m = state.metrics();
        assert!((m.avg_sinr_db - 10.0).abs() < 1e-6);
        assert!((m.coverage_pct - 100.0).abs() < 1e-6);
    }
}

### `arkhe-digital-twin/src/channel.rs` — Modelo 3GPP TR 38.901 (fix #12)

```rust
//! Modelo de canal baseado em 3GPP TR 38.901.
//! FIX #12: path loss com distância, frequência, altura, shadowing.

use crate::types::{CellType, Position};
use rand::Rng;

/// Modelo de canal para cálculo de path loss.
pub struct ChannelModel {
    pub carrier_freq_hz: f32,
    pub shadowing_std_db: f32,
}

impl ChannelModel {
    pub fn new(carrier_freq_hz: f32) -> Self {
        Self {
            carrier_freq_hz,
            shadowing_std_db: 8.0, // típico NLOS urbano
        }
    }

    /// Frequência em GHz para as fórmulas 3GPP.
    fn fc_ghz(&self) -> f32 {
        self.carrier_freq_hz / 1e9
    }

    /// Path loss em dB — seleciona modelo por tipo de célula.
    pub fn path_loss_db(&self, cell_type: CellType, d_3d: f32, h_bs: f32, h_ue: f32) -> f32 {
        let d = d_3d.max(1.0); // mínimo 1m
        let fc = self.fc_ghz();

        match cell_type {
            CellType::Macro => self.path_loss_uma(d, h_bs, h_ue, fc),
            CellType::Small => self.path_loss_umi(d, h_bs, h_ue, fc),
            CellType::Femto => self.path_loss_inH(d, h_bs, h_ue, fc),
        }
    }

    /// Path loss para UAV (ARO — Aerial Rician channel).
    /// Usa UMa-LOS com perda adicional de altura quando UAV > 50m.
    pub fn path_loss_uav(&self, d_3d: f32, h_bs: f32, h_uav: f32) -> f32 {
        let fc = self.fc_ghz();
        let d = d_3d.max(1.0);
        let h_ue = h_uav.min(150.0); // clamp para o modelo

        // UMa-LOS base
        let pl = self.pl_uma_los(d, h_ue, fc);

        // Perda adicional por altura de UAV (3GPP TR 36.777 simplificado)
        let height_penalty = if h_uav > 50.0 {
            0.5 * (h_uav - 50.0) // 0.5 dB/m acima de 50m
        } else {
            0.0
        };

        pl + height_penalty
    }

    /// UMa (Urban Macro) — 3GPP TR 38.901 Table 7.4.1-1.
    fn path_loss_uma(&self, d: f32, h_bs: f32, h_ue: f32, fc: f32) -> f32 {
        // Probabilidade de LOS baseada em distância 2D
        let d_2d = d.hypot((h_bs - h_ue).max(0.0));
        let p_los = self.uma_los_probability(d_2d);

        let pl_los = self.pl_uma_los(d, h_ue, fc);
        let pl_nlos = self.pl_uma_nlos(d, h_ue, fc);

        // Combinação probabilística
        p_los * pl_los + (1.0 - p_los) * pl_nlos
    }

    fn uma_los_probability(&self, d_2d: f32) -> f32 {
        if d_2d <= 18.0 { return 1.0; }
        let p = (18.0 / d_2d + (1.0 - 18.0 / d_2d).exp() * (1.0 - 18.0 / d_2d)).exp();
        (1.0 + p).recip()
    }

    /// PL_UMa-LOS (dB)
    fn pl_uma_los(&self, d_3d: f32, h_ue: f32, fc: f32) -> f32 {
        // 22.4 + 21.1*log10(d3D) + 0.3*log10(hUT) - 3.2*(log10(11.75*hUT))^2 - 3.8*(log10(fc))^2
        let log_d = d_3d.log10();
        let log_h = h_ue.log10();
        let log_fc = fc.log10();
        22.4 + 21.1 * log_d + 0.3 * log_h - 3.2 * (11.75 * h_ue).log10().powi(2) - 3.8 * log_fc.powi(2)
    }

    /// PL_UMa-NLOS (dB)
    fn pl_uma_nlos(&self, d_3d: f32, h_ue: f32, fc: f32) -> f32 {
        // max(PL_UMa-LOS, 13.54 + 39.08*log10(d3D) + 20*log10(fc) - 0.6*(hUT-1.5))
        let pl_los = self.pl_uma_los(d_3d, h_ue, fc);
        let pl_nlos = 13.54 + 39.08 * d_3d.log10() + 20.0 * fc.log10() - 0.6 * (h_ue - 1.5);
        pl_los.max(pl_nlos)
    }

    /// UMi (Urban Micro) — 3GPP TR 38.901 Table 7.4.2-1.
    fn path_loss_umi(&self, d: f32, h_bs: f32, h_ue: f32, fc: f32) -> f32 {
        let d_2d = d.hypot((h_bs - h_ue).max(0.0));
        let p_los = self.umi_los_probability(d_2d);

        let pl_los = 32.4 + 21.0 * d.log10() + 20.0 * fc.log10();
        let pl_nlos = 35.3 * d.log10() + 22.4 + 21.3 * fc.log10() - 0.3 * (h_ue - 1.5);

        p_los * pl_los + (1.0 - p_los) * pl_nlos
    }

    fn umi_los_probability(&self, d_2d: f32) -> f32 {
        if d_2d <= 18.0 { return 1.0; }
        18.0 / d_2d + (1.0 - 18.0 / d_2d) * 0.5
    }

    /// InH (Indoor Hotspot) — Femtocells.
    fn path_loss_inH(&self, d: f32, _h_bs: f32, _h_ue: f32, fc: f32) -> f32 {
        // Simplificado: PL_InH-LOS = 32.4 + 21.0*log10(d3D) + 20*log10(fc)
        32.4 + 21.0 * d.max(1.0).log10() + 20.0 * fc.log10() + 5.0 // +5dB para paredes
    }

    /// Gera shadowing sample em dB (log-normal).
    pub fn shadowing_db(&self, rng: &mut impl Rng) -> f32 {
        // Box-Muller para gerar normal(0, sigma)
        let u1: f32 = rng.gen();
        let u2: f32 = rng.gen();
        let z = (-2.0 * u1.ln()).sqrt() * (2.0 * std::f32::consts::PI * u2).cos();
        z * self.shadowing_std_db
    }

    /// Thermal noise em dBm para uma dada largura de banda.
    /// N = -174 dBm/Hz + 10*log10(BW_Hz)
    pub fn thermal_noise_dbm(bandwidth_hz: f32) -> f32 {
        -174.0 + 10.0 * bandwidth_hz.log10()
    }

    /// Calcula SINR em dB para um UE servido por uma célula.
    pub fn sinr_db(
        &self,
        tx_power_dbm: f32,
        path_loss_db: f32,
        shadowing_db: f32,
        interference_power_dbm: f32,
        bandwidth_hz: f32,
        rng: &mut impl Rng,
    ) -> f32 {
        let rx_power_dbm = tx_power_dbm - path_loss_db + shadowing_db; // shadowing pode ser negativo
        let noise_dbm = Self::thermal_noise_dbm(bandwidth_hz);
        let noise_plus_interference_dbm = 10.0 * (10.0_f32.powf(noise_dbm / 10.0) + 10.0_f32.powf(interference_power_dbm / 10.0)).log10();
        rx_power_dbm - noise_plus_interference_dbm
    }

    /// Throughput estimado (Shannon capacity simplificado).
    pub fn shannon_mbps(sinr_db: f32, bandwidth_mhz: f32) -> f32 {
        let sinr_linear = 10.0_f32.powf(sinr_db / 10.0);
        let spectral_efficiency = (1.0 + sinr_linear).log2(); // bits/s/Hz
        spectral_efficiency * bandwidth_mhz // Mbps (approx)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_path_loss_increases_with_distance() {
        let model = ChannelModel::new(3.5e9);
        let pl_100 = model.path_loss_db(CellType::Macro, 100.0, 25.0, 1.5);
        let pl_500 = model.path_loss_db(CellType::Macro, 500.0, 25.0, 1.5);
        assert!(pl_500 > pl_100, "Path loss should increase with distance: {} vs {}", pl_500, pl_100);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_path_loss_macro_vs_femto() {
        let model = ChannelModel::new(3.5e9);
        let pl_macro = model.path_loss_db(CellType::Macro, 200.0, 25.0, 1.5);
        let pl_femto = model.path_loss_db(CellType::Femto, 50.0, 3.0, 1.5);
        // Femtocell a 50m deve ter menos loss que macro a 200m
        assert!(pl_femto < pl_macro);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_thermal_noise() {
        // -174 + 10*log10(20e6) = -174 + 73.01 = -100.99 dBm
        let noise = ChannelModel::thermal_noise_dbm(20e6);
        assert!((noise - (-101.0)).abs() < 0.1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_uav_height_penalty() {
        let model = ChannelModel::new(3.5e9);
        let pl_low = model.path_loss_uav(200.0, 25.0, 30.0);
        let pl_high = model.path_loss_uav(200.0, 25.0, 100.0);
        assert!(pl_high > pl_low, "UAV higher altitude should have more loss: {} vs {}", pl_high, pl_low);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_shannon_throughput() {
        let tp = ChannelModel::shannon_mbps(20.0, 20.0); // 20 dB SINR, 20 MHz
        assert!(tp > 100.0, "Shannon throughput should be > 100 Mbps at 20dB/20MHz, got {}", tp);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_shadowing_distribution() {
        let model = ChannelModel::new(3.5e9);
        let mut rng = rand::rngs::StdRng::seed_from_u64(42);
        let samples: Vec<f32> = (0..1000).map(|_| model.shadowing_db(&mut rng)).collect();
        let mean = samples.iter().sum::<f32>() / samples.len() as f32;
        // Média deve estar próxima de 0
        assert!(mean.abs() < 1.0, "Shadowing mean should be ~0, got {}", mean);
    }
}

### `arkhe-digital-twin/src/simulator.rs` — Simulador Corrigido

```rust
//! Simulador de HetNet — modelo corrigido.
//! FIX #12: SINR com path loss real. FIX #14: UAVs separados. FIX #25,#26: power/slicing.

use crate::channel::ChannelModel;
use crate::types::*;
use rand::Rng;
use tracing::debug;

pub struct HetNetSimulator {
    pub state: HetNetState,
    pub channel: ChannelModel,
    rng: rand::rngs::StdRng,
}

impl HetNetSimulator {
    pub fn new(state: HetNetState, seed: u64) -> Self {
        let channel = ChannelModel::new(state.carrier_freq_hz);
        Self {
            state,
            channel,
            rng: rand::rngs::StdRng::seed_from_u64(seed),
        }
    }

    /// Avança um passo de simulação. FIX #24: usa step counter.
    pub fn step(&mut self) -> HetNetMetrics {
        self.state.step += 1;
        self.update_sinr_all();
        self.state.metrics()
    }

    /// Atualiza SINR para todos os UEs usando modelo de canal 3GPP.
    fn update_sinr_all(&mut self) {
        let bandwidth_hz = self.state.bandwidth_mhz * 1e6;
        let cell_positions: Vec<(String, Position, f32, CellType)> = self.state.cells.iter()
            .filter(|(_, c)| c.active)
            .map(|(id, c)| (id.clone(), c.position, c.tx_power_dbm, c.cell_type))
            .collect();

        let uav_positions: Vec<(String, Position, f32)> = self.state.uavs.iter()
            .filter(|(_, u)| u.active)
            .map(|(id, u)| (id.clone(), u.position, u.tx_power_dbm))
            .collect();

        for (ue_id, ue) in self.state.ues.iter_mut() {
            // Encontrar célula servidora
            let serving = match self.state.cells.get(&ue.serving_cell) {
                Some(c) if c.active => c,
                _ => {
                    ue.sinr_db = -999.0;
                    ue.throughput_mbps = 0.0;
                    continue;
                }
            };

            let d_3d = ue.position.distance_3d(&serving.position);
            let h_bs = serving.position.z;
            let h_ue = ue.position.z;

            // Path loss do link servido
            let pl_db = self.channel.path_loss_db(serving.cell_type, d_3d, h_bs, h_ue);
            let shadow = self.channel.shadowing_db(&mut self.rng);

            // Interferência: soma de potências recebidas de TODAS as outras células
            let mut interference_linear = 0.0_f32;
            for (cell_id, cell_pos, tx_dbm, cell_type) in &cell_positions {
                if *cell_id == ue.serving_cell { continue; }
                let d = ue.position.distance_3d(cell_pos);
                let pl = self.channel.path_loss_db(*cell_type, d, cell_pos.z, h_ue);
                let rx_dbm = tx_dbm - pl;
                interference_linear += 10.0_f32.powf(rx_dbm / 10.0);
            }

            // Interferência de UAVs
            for (_uav_id, uav_pos, uav_tx) in &uav_positions {
                let d = ue.position.distance_3d(uav_pos);
                let pl = self.channel.path_loss_uav(d, uav_pos.z, ue.position.z);
                let rx_dbm = uav_tx - pl;
                interference_linear += 10.0_f32.powf(rx_dbm / 10.0);
            }

            let interference_dbm = if interference_linear > 0.0 {
                10.0 * interference_linear.log10()
            } else {
                -999.0
            };

            ue.sinr_db = self.channel.sinr_db(
                serving.tx_power_dbm, pl_db, shadow,
                interference_dbm, bandwidth_hz, &mut self.rng,
            );
            ue.throughput_mbps = ChannelModel::shannon_mbps(ue.sinr_db, self.state.bandwidth_mhz);
        }
    }

    /// Aplica intervenção de associação forçada.
    pub fn force_association(&mut self, ue_id: &str, cell_id: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
        if let Some(ue) = self.state.ues.get_mut(ue_id) {
            ue.serving_cell = cell_id.to_string();
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(format!("UE not found: {}", ue_id))
        }
    }

    /// Aplica intervenção de potência. FIX #25: preserva potência original.
    pub fn set_tx_power(&mut self, cell_id: &str, power_dbm: f32) -> Result<(), String> {
        let cell = self.state.cells.get_mut(cell_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("Cell not found: {}", cell_id))?;
        cell.tx_power_dbm = power_dbm;
        // NOTA: tx_power_dbm_original NÃO muda — é o baseline
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Ativa/desativa célula. FIX #25: usa potência original ao reativar.
    pub fn set_cell_active(&mut self, cell_id: &str, active: bool) -> Result<(), String> {
        let cell = self.state.cells.get_mut(cell_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("Cell not found: {}", cell_id))?;
        cell.active = active;
        if active {
            cell.tx_power_dbm = cell.tx_power_dbm_original; // FIX #25: restore
        } else {
            cell.tx_power_dbm = 0.0;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Move UAV para nova posição.
    pub fn move_uav(&mut self, uav_id: &str, target: Position) -> Result<(), String> {
        let uav = self.state.uavs.get_mut(uav_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("UAV not found: {}", uav_id))?;
        uav.position = target;
        uav.altitude_target = target.z;
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Aloca slice. FIX #26: parcial, não sobrescreve total.
    pub fn allocate_slice(
        &mut self, cell_id: &str, slice_id: &str, bandwidth_mhz: f32,
    ) -> Result<(), String> {
        let cell = self.state.cells.get_mut(cell_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("Cell not found: {}", cell_id))?;
        if bandwidth_mhz > cell.available_bandwidth() {
            return Err(format!(
                "Insufficient bandwidth: requested {} MHz, available {} MHz (total {} MHz, allocated {} MHz)",
                bandwidth_mhz, cell.available_bandwidth(), cell.bandwidth_mhz, cell.allocated_bandwidth(),
            ));
        }
        cell.slices.insert(slice_id.to_string(), SliceAllocation {
            slice_id: slice_id.to_string(),
            bandwidth_mhz,
            reserved_for: Vec::new(),
        });
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Remove slice.
    pub fn remove_slice(&mut self, cell_id: &str, slice_id: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
        let cell = self.state.cells.get_mut(cell_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("Cell not found: {}", cell_id))?;
        cell.slices.remove(slice_id);
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn setup_simulator() -> HetNetSimulator {
        let mut state = HetNetState::new(3.5e9, 20.0);
        state.cells.insert("macro_1".to_string(), CellState::new("macro_1", CellType::Macro, Position::new(0.0, 0.0, 25.0)));
        state.cells.insert("small_1".to_string(), CellState::new("small_1", CellType::Small, Position::new(200.0, 0.0, 10.0)));
        state.ues.insert("ue_1".to_string(), UeState {
            id: "ue_1".to_string(), position: Position::ground(50.0, 0.0),
            serving_cell: "macro_1".to_string(), sinr_db: 0.0, throughput_mbps: 0.0, mobility: 0.0,
        });
        state.uavs.insert("uav_1".to_string(), UavState::new("uav_1", Position::new(100.0, 0.0, 50.0)));
        HetNetSimulator::new(state, 42)
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_step_updates_sinr() {
        let mut sim = setup_simulator();
        let m = sim.step();
        assert!(m.avg_sinr_db > -100.0, "SINR should be reasonable, got {}", m.avg_sinr_db);
        assert_eq!(m.total_ues, 1);
        assert_eq!(m.active_cells, 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_force_association() {
        let mut sim = setup_simulator();
        sim.step();
        sim.force_association("ue_1", "small_1").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(sim.state.ues["ue_1"].serving_cell, "small_1");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_set_tx_power() {
        let mut sim = setup_simulator();
        sim.set_tx_power("macro_1", 40.0).unwrap();
        assert!((sim.state.cells["macro_1"].tx_power_dbm - 40.0).abs() < 1e-6);
        // Original preservado
        assert!((sim.state.cells["macro_1"].tx_power_dbm_original - 43.0).abs() < 1e-6);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_cell_active_restore_power() {
        let mut sim = setup_simulator();
        sim.set_cell_active("macro_1", false).unwrap();
        assert!((sim.state.cells["macro_1"].tx_power_dbm - 0.0).abs() < 1e-6);
        sim.set_cell_active("macro_1", true).unwrap();
        assert!((sim.state.cells["macro_1"].tx_power_dbm - 43.0).abs() < 1e-6); // FIX #25: restored
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_slice_allocation_partial() {
        let mut sim = setup_simulator();
        sim.allocate_slice("macro_1", "slice_embb", 10.0).unwrap();
        sim.allocate_slice("macro_1", "slice_mmtc", 5.0).unwrap();
        let cell = &sim.state.cells["macro_1"];
        assert!((cell.bandwidth_mhz - 20.0).abs() < 1e-6); // FIX #26: total preservado
        assert!((cell.allocated_bandwidth() - 15.0).abs() < 1e-6);
        assert!((cell.available_bandwidth() - 5.0).abs() < 1e-6);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_slice_overflow() {
        let mut sim = setup_simulator();
        assert!(sim.allocate_slice("macro_1", "big", 25.0).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_move_uav() {
        let mut sim = setup_simulator();
        sim.move_uav("uav_1", Position::new(300.0, 100.0, 80.0)).unwrap();
        assert!((sim.state.uavs["uav_1"].position.x - 300.0).abs() < 1e-6);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_uav_affects_sinr() {
        let mut sim = setup_simulator();
        let m_before = sim.step();
        // Move UAV perto do UE
        sim.move_uav("uav_1", Position::new(55.0, 5.0, 50.0)).unwrap();
        let m_after = sim.step();
        // UAV próximo pode aumentar ou diminuir SINR dependendo da interferência
        // O importante é que NÃO panic e retorna valores válidos
        assert!(m_after.avg_sinr_db.is_finite());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_step_counter_increments() {
        let mut sim = setup_simulator();
        assert_eq!(sim.state.step, 0);
        sim.step();
        assert_eq!(sim.state.step, 1);
        sim.step();
        assert_eq!(sim.state.step, 2);
    }
}

### `arkhe-hetnet-causal/src/types.rs`

```rust
use arkhe_digital_twin::HetNetState;
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum HetNetIntervention {
    ForceAssociation { ue_id: String, cell_id: String },
    SetTxPower { cell_id: String, power_dbm: f32 },
    MoveUav { uav_id: String, target_x: f32, target_y: f32, target_z: f32 },
    SetCellActive { cell_id: String, active: bool },
    AllocateSlice { cell_id: String, slice_id: String, bandwidth_mhz: f32 },
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct CausalEffect {
    pub id: String,
    pub intervention: HetNetIntervention,
    pub pre_metrics: arkhe_digital_twin::HetNetMetrics,
    pub post_metrics: arkhe_digital_twin::HetNetMetrics,
    /// FIX #21: confidence com calibração, não hardcoded.
    pub confidence: f32,
    pub uncertainty: f32,
    pub timestamp: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub step: u64,
}

impl std::fmt::Display for HetNetIntervention {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::ForceAssociation { ue_id, cell_id } => write!(f, "ForceAssociation({}, {})", ue_id, cell_id),
            Self::SetTxPower { cell_id, power_dbm } => write!(f, "SetTxPower({}, {}dBm)", cell_id, power_dbm),
            Self::MoveUav { uav_id, target_x, target_y, target_z } => {
                write!(f, "MoveUav({}, →{},{},{})", uav_id, target_x, target_y, target_z)
            }
            Self::SetCellActive { cell_id, active } => write!(f, "SetCellActive({}, {})", cell_id, if *active { "ON" } else { "OFF" }),
            Self::AllocateSlice { cell_id, slice_id, bandwidth_mhz } => {
                write!(f, "AllocateSlice({}, {}, {}MHz)", cell_id, slice_id, bandwidth_mhz)
            }
        }
    }
}

### `arkhe-hetnet-causal/src/confidence.rs` — FIX #21: Calibração Bayesiana

```rust
//! Calibração de confiança — FIX #21.
//! Usa atualização Bayesiana: prior → likelihood → posterior.

use crate::types::HetNetIntervention;
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Prior padrão por tipo de intervenção (baseada em conhecimento de domínio).
fn default_prior(intervention: &HetNetIntervention) -> f32 {
    match intervention {
        HetNetIntervention::ForceAssociation { .. } => 0.80,
        HetNetIntervention::SetTxPower { .. } => 0.70,
        HetNetIntervention::MoveUav { .. } => 0.65,
        HetNetIntervention::SetCellActive { .. } => 0.75,
        HetNetIntervention::AllocateSlice { .. } => 0.80,
    }
}

/// Likelihood baseada na magnitude da mudança observada.
/// Mudanças pequenas → alta incerteza. Mudanças grandes → menor incerteza relativa.
fn compute_likelihood(pre: f32, post: f32) -> f32 {
    let delta = (post - pre).abs();
    if delta < 0.5 { 0.5 }       // mudança tiny → baixa confiança no efeito
    else if delta < 2.0 { 0.7 }
    else if delta < 5.0 { 0.85 }
    else { 0.95 }                 // mudança grande → efeito claro
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct InterventionStats {
    count: u32,
    sum_confidence: f32,
    sum_squared_error: f32, // para calibração
}

/// Calibrador de confiança com atualização Bayesiana.
pub struct ConfidenceCalibrator {
    stats: HashMap<String, InterventionStats>,
}

impl ConfidenceCalibrator {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Self { stats: HashMap::new() } }

    /// Calcula confiança posterior para uma intervenção.
    pub fn calibrate(
        &mut self,
        intervention: &HetNetIntervention,
        pre_sinr: f32,
        post_sinr: f32,
    ) -> (f32, f32) {
        let type_key = self.intervention_type_key(intervention);
        let prior = default_prior(intervention);
        let likelihood = compute_likelihood(pre_sinr, post_sinr);

        // Bayes simplificado: posterior ∝ prior × likelihood
        let posterior = (prior * likelihood).clamp(0.1, 0.99);
        let uncertainty = 1.0 - posterior;

        // Atualiza estatísticas
        let entry = self.stats.entry(type_key).or_insert(InterventionStats {
            count: 0, sum_confidence: 0.0, sum_squared_error: 0.0,
        });
        entry.count += 1;
        entry.sum_confidence += posterior;

        (posterior, uncertainty)
    }

    /// Retorna a confiança média calibrada por tipo.
    pub fn mean_confidence(&self, intervention: &HetNetIntervention) -> f32 {
        let key = self.intervention_type_key(intervention);
        self.stats.get(&key)
            .map(|s| s.sum_confidence / s.count as f32)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| default_prior(intervention))
    }

    fn intervention_type_key(&self, i: &HetNetIntervention) -> String {
        match i {
            HetNetIntervention::ForceAssociation { .. } => "force_association",
            HetNetIntervention::SetTxPower { .. } => "set_tx_power",
            HetNetIntervention::MoveUav { .. } => "move_uav",
            HetNetIntervention::SetCellActive { .. } => "set_cell_active",
            HetNetIntervention::AllocateSlice { .. } => "allocate_slice",
        }.to_string()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::types::HetNetIntervention;

    #[test]
    fn test_prior_defaults() {
        let i = HetNetIntervention::ForceAssociation { ue_id: "u1".into(), cell_id: "c1".into() };
        assert!((default_prior(&i) - 0.80).abs() < 1e-6);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_likelihood_small_change() {
        let l = compute_likelihood(10.0, 10.3);
        assert!((l - 0.5).abs() < 1e-6);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_likelihood_large_change() {
        let l = compute_likelihood(5.0, 15.0);
        assert!((l - 0.95).abs() < 1e-6);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_calibration_updates() {
        let mut cal = ConfidenceCalibrator::new();
        let i = HetNetIntervention::SetTxPower { cell_id: "c1".into(), power_dbm: 40.0 };

        let (c1, u1) = cal.calibrate(&i, 10.0, 15.0);
        assert!(c1 > 0.5);
        assert!(u1 < 0.5);

        // Média deve refletir a atualização
        let mean = cal.mean_confidence(&i);
        assert!((mean - c1).abs() < 1e-6);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_uncertainty_inverse_confidence() {
        let mut cal = ConfidenceCalibrator::new();
        let i = HetNetIntervention::MoveUav { uav_id: "u1".into(), target_x: 0.0, target_y: 0.0, target_z: 50.0 };
        let (c, u) = cal.calibrate(&i, 5.0, 8.0);
        assert!((c + u - 1.0).abs() < 1e-6);
    }
}
