### `arkhe-hetnet-causal/src/engine.rs` — FIX #11: Ring Buffer + FIX #20: WormGraph

```rust
//! Motor causal — FIX #11: ring buffer com limite. FIX #20: persistência WormGraph.

use crate::confidence::ConfidenceCalibrator;
use crate::types::*;
use arkhe_digital_twin::{HetNetSimulator, HetNetMetrics, Position};
use std::collections::VecDeque;
use tracing::{info, warn};

/// Tamanho máximo do buffer em memória. FIX #11.
const MAX_HISTORY: usize = 10_000;

pub struct CausalHetNetEngine {
    pub calibrator: ConfidenceCalibrator,
    /// FIX #11: VecDeque com limite, não Vec infinito.
    history: VecDeque<CausalEffect>,
}

impl CausalHetNetEngine {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            calibrator: ConfidenceCalibrator::new(),
            history: VecDeque::with_capacity(MAX_HISTORY),
        }
    }

    /// Executa uma intervenção e mede o efeito causal.
    pub fn intervene(
        &mut self,
        simulator: &mut HetNetSimulator,
        intervention: &HetNetIntervention,
    ) -> Result<CausalEffect, String> {
        let pre_metrics = simulator.state.metrics();
        let pre_step = simulator.state.step;
        let pre_sinr = pre_metrics.avg_sinr_db;

        // Aplica a intervenção no simulador
        self.apply_intervention(simulator, intervention)?;

        // Executa um passo para ver o efeito
        let post_metrics = simulator.step();
        let post_sinr = post_metrics.avg_sinr_db;

        // FIX #21: confiança calibrada, não hardcoded
        let (confidence, uncertainty) = self.calibrator.calibrate(intervention, pre_sinr, post_sinr);

        let effect = CausalEffect {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            intervention: intervention.clone(),
            pre_metrics,
            post_metrics,
            confidence,
            uncertainty,
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now(),
            step: pre_step,
        };

        // FIX #11: insere com limite
        if self.history.len() >= MAX_HISTORY {
            self.history.pop_front();
        }
        self.history.push_back(effect.clone());

        info!(
            "[step {}] {} → sinr: {:.1}→{:.1} dB, conf: {:.2}",
            pre_step, intervention, pre_sinr, post_sinr, confidence,
        );

        Ok(effect)
    }

    fn apply_intervention(
        &self, sim: &mut HetNetSimulator, intervention: &HetNetIntervention,
    ) -> Result<(), String> {
        match intervention {
            HetNetIntervention::ForceAssociation { ue_id, cell_id } =>
                sim.force_association(ue_id, cell_id),
            HetNetIntervention::SetTxPower { cell_id, power_dbm } =>
                sim.set_tx_power(cell_id, *power_dbm),
            HetNetIntervention::MoveUav { uav_id, target_x, target_y, target_z } =>
                sim.move_uav(uav_id, Position::new(*target_x, *target_y, *target_z)),
            HetNetIntervention::SetCellActive { cell_id, active } =>
                sim.set_cell_active(cell_id, *active),
            HetNetIntervention::AllocateSlice { cell_id, slice_id, bandwidth_mhz } =>
                sim.allocate_slice(cell_id, slice_id, *bandwidth_mhz),
        }
    }

    /// FIX #20: Persiste histórico no WormGraph como RDF.
    pub fn persist_to_wormgraph(
        &self, graph: &mut arkhe_wormgraph::rdf::WormGraphDataset,
    ) -> Result<usize, String> {
        let mut count = 0;
        for effect in &self.history {
            let ttl = format!(
                r#"
                @prefix arkhe: <http://arkhe-os.org/> .
                @prefix dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/> .

                <arkhe:intervention/{id}> a arkhe:CausalIntervention ;
                    dc:description "{desc}" ;
                    arkhe:preSinr "{pre_sinr:.2}"^^xsd:float ;
                    arkhe:postSinr "{post_sinr:.2}"^^xsd:float ;
                    arkhe:confidence "{conf:.3}"^^xsd:float ;
                    arkhe:uncertainty "{unc:.3}"^^xsd:float ;
                    arkhe:step "{step}"^^xsd:integer ;
                    arkhe:timestamp "{ts}"^^xsd:string .
                "#,
                id = effect.id,
                desc = effect.intervention.to_string().replace('"', "\\\""),
                pre_sinr = effect.pre_metrics.avg_sinr_db,
                post_sinr = effect.post_metrics.avg_sinr_db,
                conf = effect.confidence,
                unc = effect.uncertainty,
                step = effect.step,
                ts = effect.timestamp.to_rfc3339(),
            );
            graph.load_turtle(&ttl)
                .map_err(|e| format!("Turtle parse error: {}", e))?;
            count += 1;
        }
        info!("Persisted {} interventions to WormGraph", count);
        Ok(count)
    }

    /// Gera candidatas de intervenção baseadas no estado atual.
    /// FIX #14: UAVs estão em state.uavs, NÃO em state.cells.
    pub fn generate_candidates(&self, state: &arkhe_digital_twin::HetNetState) -> Vec<HetNetIntervention> {
        let mut candidates = Vec::new();

        // 1. UEs com SINR baixo → tentar reassociar
        for (ue_id, ue) in &state.ues {
            if ue.sinr_db < 5.0 {
                // Encontrar célula com melhor SINR potencial (mais próxima, Macro preferida)
                if let Some(best) = state.cells.values()
                    .filter(|c| c.active && c.id != ue.serving_cell)
                    .min_by(|a, b| {
                        let da = ue.position.distance_3d(&a.position);
                        let db = ue.position.distance_3d(&b.position);
                        da.partial_cmp(&db).unwrap()
                    })
                {
                    candidates.push(HetNetIntervention::ForceAssociation {
                        ue_id: ue_id.clone(),
                        cell_id: best.id.clone(),
                    });
                }
            }
        }

        // 2. Células com load alto → aumentar potência
        for (cell_id, cell) in &state.cells {
            if cell.load > 0.8 && cell.tx_power_dbm < cell.cell_type.default_tx_power_dbm() + 3.0 {
                candidates.push(HetNetIntervention::SetTxPower {
                    cell_id: cell_id.clone(),
                    power_dbm: cell.tx_power_dbm + 3.0,
                });
            }
        }

        // 3. FIX #14: UAVs em state.uavs (NÃO em cells)
        for (uav_id, uav) in &state.uavs {
            if !uav.active { continue; }
            // Se há UEs com SINR baixo na área do UAV, mover UAV mais perto
            let nearby_bad_ues: Vec<_> = state.ues.values()
                .filter(|ue| {
                    ue.sinr_db < 0.0 &&
                    ue.position.distance_2d(&uav.position) < 500.0
                })
                .collect();

            if !nearby_bad_ues.is_empty() {
                // Mover UAV para centro de massa dos UEs com problema
                let cx = nearby_bad_ues.iter().map(|u| u.position.x).sum::<f32>() / nearby_bad_ues.len() as f32;
                let cy = nearby_bad_ues.iter().map(|u| u.position.y).sum::<f32>() / nearby_bad_ues.len() as f32;
                candidates.push(HetNetIntervention::MoveUav {
                    uav_id: uav_id.clone(),
                    target_x: cx,
                    target_y: cy,
                    target_z: uav.altitude_target,
                });
            }
        }

        // 4. Células ociosas → desligar para economia de energia
        for (cell_id, cell) in &state.cells {
            if cell.active && cell.connected_ues.is_empty() && cell.load < 0.05 {
                candidates.push(HetNetIntervention::SetCellActive {
                    cell_id: cell_id.clone(),
                    active: false,
                });
            }
        }

        candidates
    }

    pub fn history_len(&self) -> usize { self.history.len() }
    pub fn history(&self) -> &VecDeque<CausalEffect> { &self.history }
}

impl Default for CausalHetNetEngine {
    fn default() -> Self { Self::new() }
}

### `arkhe-llm/src/inference.rs` — A trait que tudo consome

```rust
//! Trait InferenceEngine — contrato real para qualquer backend LLM.
//!
//! Implementações: VllmBackend, OllamaBackend, OpenAIBackend, MockBackend.

use crate::error::LlmError;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Parâmetros de geração.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct GenerateParams {
    /// Temperatura (0.0–2.0). Default: 0.7
    pub temperature: f32,
    /// Número máximo de tokens na resposta. Default: 1024
    pub max_tokens: u32,
    /// Sequências de parada.
    pub stop_sequences: Vec<String>,
    /// Top-p (nucleus sampling). Default: 1.0
    pub top_p: f32,
    /// Frequência penalty. Default: 0.0
    pub frequency_penalty: f32,
    /// Presence penalty. Default: 0.0
    pub presence_penalty: f32,
}

impl Default for GenerateParams {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            temperature: 0.7,
            max_tokens: 1024,
            stop_sequences: Vec::new(),
            top_p: 1.0,
            frequency_penalty: 0.0,
            presence_penalty: 0.0,
        }
    }
}

impl GenerateParams {
    pub fn with_temperature(mut self, t: f32) -> Self { self.temperature = t.clamp(0.0, 2.0); self }
    pub fn with_max_tokens(mut self, m: u32) -> Self { self.max_tokens = m; self }
}

/// Resposta de geração.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct GenerateResponse {
    /// Texto gerado.
    pub text: String,
    /// Número de tokens gerados (se disponível).
    pub tokens_used: Option<u32>,
    /// Modelo usado.
    pub model: Option<String>,
    /// Tempo de resposta em milissegundos.
    pub duration_ms: u64,
    /// Metadados extras.
    pub metadata: HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>,
}

/// Trait principal — todo backend LLM do Arkhe OS implementa isto.
#[async_trait]
pub trait InferenceEngine: Send + Sync {
    /// Gera texto a partir de um prompt.
    async fn generate(
        &self,
        prompt: &str,
        params: GenerateParams,
    ) -> Result<GenerateResponse, LlmError>;

    /// Gera com apenas temperatura e max_tokens (conveniência).
    async fn generate_simple(
        &self,
        prompt: &str,
        temperature: f32,
        max_tokens: u32,
    ) -> Result<GenerateResponse, LlmError> {
        self.generate(prompt, GenerateParams::default()
            .with_temperature(temperature)
            .with_max_tokens(max_tokens)
        ).await
    }

    /// Retorna o nome do modelo subjacente.
    fn model_name(&self) -> &str;

    /// Verifica se o backend está disponível.
    async fn is_available(&self) -> bool;
}

/// Backend simples que ecoa um JSON fixo — para testes sem mockall.
pub struct EchoBackend {
    pub response_text: String,
    pub model: String,
}

impl EchoBackend {
    pub fn new(response_text: &str) -> Self {
        Self {
            response_text: response_text.to_string(),
            model: "echo".to_string(),
        }
    }

    /// Cria um EchoBackend que responde com JSON válido de skill.
    pub fn skill_echo(name: &str, description: &str, triggers: &[&str], template: &str) -> Self {
        let json = serde_json::json!({
            "name": name,
            "description": description,
            "triggers": triggers,
            "prompt_template": template,
            "examples": []
        });
        Self::new(&json.to_string())
    }

    /// Cria um EchoBackend que responde com JSON válido de avaliação.
    pub fn eval_echo(score: f32, feedback: &str) -> Self {
        let json = serde_json::json!({
            "score": score,
            "feedback": feedback,
            "improvements": []
        });
        Self::new(&json.to_string())
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl InferenceEngine for EchoBackend {
    async fn generate(
        &self,
        _prompt: &str,
        _params: GenerateParams,
    ) -> Result<GenerateResponse, LlmError> {
        Ok(GenerateResponse {
            text: self.response_text.clone(),
            tokens_used: Some(self.response_text.split_whitespace().count() as u32),
            model: Some(self.model.clone()),
            duration_ms: 1,
            metadata: HashMap::new(),
        })
    }
    fn model_name(&self) -> &str { &self.model }
    async fn is_available(&self) -> bool { true }
}

use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum MemorySource {
    UserInput,
    LlmOutput,
    Derived,
    System,
    External,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct MemoryEntry {
    pub id: String,
    pub content: String,
    pub content_hash: String,
    pub source: MemorySource,
    pub relevance: f32,
    pub confidence: f32,
    pub created_at: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub last_accessed: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub access_count: u32,
    pub tags: Vec<String>,
    pub metadata: HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>,
}

impl MemoryEntry {
    pub fn new(id: impl Into<String>, content: impl Into<String>, source: MemorySource) -> Self {
        let content_str = content.into();
        let hash = blake3::hash(content_str.as_bytes()).to_hex().to_string();
        Self {
            id: id.into(),
            content: content_str,
            content_hash: hash,
            source,
            relevance: 0.5,
            confidence: 0.5,
            created_at: Utc::now(),
            last_accessed: Utc::now(),
            access_count: 0,
            tags: Vec::new(),
            metadata: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn with_relevance(mut self, r: f32) -> Self { self.relevance = r.clamp(0.0, 1.0); self }
    pub fn with_confidence(mut self, c: f32) -> Self { self.confidence = c.clamp(0.0, 1.0); self }
    pub fn with_tags(mut self, tags: Vec<String>) -> Self { self.tags = tags; self }
    pub fn touch(&mut self) { self.last_accessed = Utc::now(); self.access_count += 1; }
}
```

### `arkhe-memory-v2/src/memory.rs`

```rust
use crate::types::MemoryEntry;
use dashmap::DashMap;
use std::path::Path;
use thiserror::Error;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;
use tracing::{debug, info};

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum MemoryError {
    #[error("IO error: {0}")]
    Io(#[from] std::io::Error),
    #[error("Serialization error: {0}")]
    Serialization(String),
    #[error("Entry not found: {0}")]
    NotFound(String),
    #[error("Storage path not configured")]
    NoStoragePath,
}

/// Memória de três camadas: Hot (RAM), Warm (disk), Cold (archive).
/// Implementação mínima funcional — Hot layer com persistência opcional.
pub struct ThreeLayerMemory {
    hot: DashMap<String, MemoryEntry>,
    storage_path: Option<String>,
}

impl ThreeLayerMemory {
    pub fn new(path: Option<&str>) -> Result<Self, MemoryError> {
        let storage_path = path.map(|p| p.to_string());
        if let Some(ref sp) = storage_path {
            let dir = std::path::Path::new(sp);
            if !dir.exists() {
                std::fs::create_dir_all(dir)?;
            }
        }
        Ok(Self { hot: DashMap::new(), storage_path })
    }

    pub fn store(&self, entry: MemoryEntry) -> Result<(), MemoryError> {
        let id = entry.id.clone();
        self.hot.insert(id, entry);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn get(&self, id: &str) -> Option<MemoryEntry> {
        self.hot.get(id).map(|e| {
            let mut entry = e.clone();
            entry.touch();
            entry
        })
    }

    pub fn query_by_tag(&self, tag: &str) -> Vec<MemoryEntry> {
        self.hot.iter()
            .filter(|e| e.value().tags.iter().any(|t| t == tag))
            .map(|e| e.value().clone())
            .collect()
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize { self.hot.len() }
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool { self.hot.is_empty() }

    /// Persiste todos os entries hot para disco (Warm layer).
    pub fn flush(&self) -> Result<usize, MemoryError> {
        let path = self.storage_path.as_ref().ok_or(MemoryError::NoStoragePath)?;
        let dir = Path::new(path);
        let mut count = 0;
        for entry in self.hot.iter() {
            let file_path = dir.join(format!("{}.json", entry.key()));
            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(entry.value())
                .map_err(|e| MemoryError::Serialization(e.to_string()))?;
            std::fs::write(&file_path, json)?;
            count += 1;
        }
        info!("Flushed {} entries to {:?}", count, path);
        Ok(count)
    }

    /// Carrega entries do disco.
    pub fn load_warm(&self) -> Result<usize, MemoryError> {
        let path = self.storage_path.as_ref().ok_or(MemoryError::NoStoragePath)?;
        let dir = Path::new(path);
        if !dir.exists() { return Ok(0); }

        let mut count = 0;
        for entry in std::fs::read_dir(dir)? {
            let entry = entry?;
            let path = entry.path();
            if path.extension().map(|e| e == "json").unwrap_or(false) {
                let json = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)?;
                let mem_entry: MemoryEntry = serde_json::from_str(&json)
                    .map_err(|e| MemoryError::Serialization(e.to_string()))?;
                self.hot.insert(mem_entry.id.clone(), mem_entry);
                count += 1;
            }
        }
        info!("Loaded {} entries from warm storage", count);
        Ok(count)
    }

    /// Remove um entry.
    pub fn remove(&self, id: &str) -> bool {
        self.hot.remove(id).is_some()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::types::MemorySource;

    #[test]
    fn test_store_and_get() {
        let mem = ThreeLayerMemory::new(None).unwrap();
        let entry = MemoryEntry::new("test-1", "hello world", MemorySource::UserInput);
        mem.store(entry).unwrap();
        let retrieved = mem.get("test-1").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(retrieved.content, "hello world");
        assert_eq!(retrieved.access_count, 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_query_by_tag() {
        let mem = ThreeLayerMemory::new(None).unwrap();
        mem.store(MemoryEntry::new("a", "content a", MemorySource::System)
            .with_tags(vec!["skill".to_string()])).unwrap();
        mem.store(MemoryEntry::new("b", "content b", MemorySource::Derived)
            .with_tags(vec!["fact".to_string()])).unwrap();
        mem.store(MemoryEntry::new("c", "content c", MemorySource::LlmOutput)
            .with_tags(vec!["skill".to_string()])).unwrap();

        let skills = mem.query_by_tag("skill");
        assert_eq!(skills.len(), 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_flush_and_load() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let path = dir.path().to_str().unwrap();

        let mem = ThreeLayerMemory::new(Some(path)).unwrap();
        mem.store(MemoryEntry::new("x", "persistent data", MemorySource::Derived)).unwrap();
        let flushed = mem.flush().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(flushed, 1);

        // Nova instância, carrega do disco
        let mem2 = ThreeLayerMemory::new(Some(path)).unwrap();
        let loaded = mem2.load_warm().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(loaded, 1);
        let entry = mem2.get("x").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(entry.content, "persistent data");
    }
}

### `arkhe-agi/src/skills/persistence.rs` — Usa API REAL do WormGraph

```rust
//! Persistência de skills via RDF no WormGraph (API real).
//!
//! Cada skill é armazenada como uma tripla RDF:
//!   arkhe:skill/<id> arkhe:hasSkillData <JSON serialization>
//! Carregamento usa SPARQL SELECT sobre o tipo de dado.

use crate::skills::types::{Skill, SkillStore};
use arkhe_wormgraph::rdf::{TermValue, WormGraphDataset};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use tracing::{debug, info, warn};

const SKILL_PREFIX: &str = "arkhe:skill/";

pub struct WormGraphSkillStore {
    graph: std::sync::Mutex<WormGraphDataset>,
}

impl WormGraphSkillStore {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            graph: std::sync::Mutex::new(WormGraphDataset::new()),
        }
    }

    pub fn from_graph(graph: WormGraphDataset) -> Self {
        Self { graph: std::sync::Mutex::new(graph) }
    }

    fn skill_uri(&self, id: &str) -> String {
        format!("{}{}", SKILL_PREFIX, id)
    }

    /// Armazena uma skill como tripla RDF + metadados em JSON-LD.
    fn store_internal(&self, skill: &Skill) -> Result<(), String> {
        let mut graph = self.graph.lock().map_err(|e| format!("Lock error: {}", e))?;

        let json_data = serde_json::to_string(skill)
            .map_err(|e| format!("Serialization error: {}", e))?;

        // Armazena os dados da skill como um Turtle com JSON-LD embed
        let ttl = format!(
            r#"
            @prefix arkhe: <http://arkhe-os.org/> .
            @prefix dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/> .
            @prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

            <{uri}> a arkhe:Skill ;
                dc:title "{name}" ;
                arkhe:skillData """{json}"""^^xsd:string ;
                arkhe:version "{version}" ;
                arkhe:created "{created}"^^xsd:dateTime .
            "#,
            uri = self.skill_uri(&skill.id),
            name = skill.name.replace('"', "\\\""),
            json = json_data.replace('\\', "\\\\").replace('"', "\\\"").replace('\n', "\\n"),
            version = skill.metadata.version,
            created = skill.created_at.to_rfc3339(),
        );

        // Carrega no grafo (acumula com dados existentes)
        graph.load_turtle(&ttl)
            .map_err(|e| format!("Turtle parse error: {}", e))?;

        debug!("Skill stored in WormGraph: {}", skill.id);
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl SkillStore for WormGraphSkillStore {
    async fn save(&self, skill: &Skill) -> Result<(), String> {
        self.store_internal(skill)?;
        info!("Skill persisted: {} ({})", skill.name, skill.id);
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn load_all(&self) -> Result<Vec<Skill>, String> {
        let graph = self.graph.lock().map_err(|e| format!("Lock error: {}", e))?;

        // Busca todos os fatos do tipo arkhe:Skill
        let results = graph.query_select(
            "SELECT ?skill ?data WHERE { ?skill a arkhe:Skill . ?skill arkhe:skillData ?data . }"
        ).map_err(|e| format!("SPARQL error: {}", e))?;

        let mut skills = Vec::new();
        if let arkhe_wormgraph::rdf::QueryResult::Select { bindings, .. } = results {
            for binding in &bindings {
                if let Some(TermValue::Literal(json_str)) = binding.get("data") {
                    if let Ok(skill) = serde_json::from_str::<Skill>(json_str) {
                        skills.push(skill);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Ok(skills)
    }

    async fn load(&self, id: &str) -> Result<Option<Skill>, String> {
        let uri = self.skill_uri(id);
        let graph = self.graph.lock().map_err(|e| format!("Lock error: {}", e))?;

        let query = format!(
            "SELECT ?data WHERE {{ <{}> arkhe:skillData ?data . }}", uri
        );
        let results = graph.query_select(&query)
            .map_err(|e| format!("SPARQL error: {}", e))?;

        if let arkhe_wormgraph::rdf::QueryResult::Select { bindings, .. } = results {
            for binding in &bindings {
                if let Some(TermValue::Literal(json_str)) = binding.get("data") {
                    if let Ok(skill) = serde_json::from_str::<Skill>(json_str) {
                        return Ok(Some(skill));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(None)
    }

    async fn delete(&self, id: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
        // Na implementação atual do WormGraphDataset, não há delete por URI.
        // Solução pragmática: recarregar o grafo sem a tripla.
        // Em produção, o WormGraph teria um método `retract()`.
        warn!("Skill delete for {} — WormGraphDataset does not support retract yet. Skill will be removed from local index only.", id);
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn update(&self, skill: &Skill) -> Result<(), String> {
        self.store_internal(skill)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn make_skill(id: &str, name: &str) -> Skill {
        Skill {
            id: id.to_string(),
            name: name.to_string(),
            description: format!("Test skill: {}", name),
            trigger: vec!["test".to_string()],
            prompt_template: "Process {{input}}".to_string(),
            examples: Vec::new(),
            metadata: crate::skills::types::SkillMetadata {
                author: "test".to_string(),
                version: "1.0.0".to_string(),
                tags: vec!["test".to_string()],
                requires_consent: false,
                estimated_cost: 50.0,
            },
            created_at: chrono::Utc::now(),
            last_used: chrono::Utc::now(),
            usage_count: 0,
            success_rate: 0.0,
            last_evaluation: None,
        }
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_save_and_load() {
        let store = WormGraphSkillStore::new();
        let skill = make_skill("skill-001", "TestSkill");

        store.save(&skill).await.unwrap();
        let loaded = store.load("skill-001").await.unwrap();
        assert!(loaded.is_some());
        assert_eq!(loaded.unwrap().name, "TestSkill");
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_load_all() {
        let store = WormGraphSkillStore::new();
        store.save(&make_skill("s1", "One")).await.unwrap();
        store.save(&make_skill("s2", "Two")).await.unwrap();
        store.save(&make_skill("s3", "Three")).await.unwrap();

        let all = store.load_all().await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(all.len(), 3);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_load_nonexistent() {
        let store = WormGraphSkillStore::new();
        let result = store.load("nonexistent").await.unwrap();
        assert!(result.is_none());
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_update() {
        let store = WormGraphSkillStore::new();
        let mut skill = make_skill("s-upd", "Original");
        store.save(&skill).await.unwrap();

        skill.name = "Updated".to_string();
        skill.usage_count = 10;
        store.update(&skill).await.unwrap();

        let loaded = store.load("s-upd").await.unwrap().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(loaded.name, "Updated");
        assert_eq!(loaded.usage_count, 10);
    }
}

### `arkhe-agi/src/skills/manager.rs` — Usa API REAL do InferenceEngine

```rust
use crate::skills::types::{Skill, SkillExecutionResult, SkillMetadata, SkillStore};
use arkhe_llm::inference::{GenerateParams, InferenceEngine};
use arkhe_memory_v2::{MemoryEntry, MemorySource, ThreeLayerMemory};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;
use thiserror::Error;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;
use tracing::{debug, error, info, warn};

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum SkillManagerError {
    #[error("LLM error: {0}")]
    Llm(String),
    #[error("Parse error: {0}")]
    Parse(String),
    #[error("Skill not found: {0}")]
    NotFound(String),
    #[error("Persistence error: {0}")]
    Persistence(String),
    #[error("Memory error: {0}")]
    Memory(String),
    #[error("Lock error: {0}")]
    Lock(String),
}

pub struct SkillManager {
    memory: Arc<ThreeLayerMemory>,
    llm: Arc<dyn InferenceEngine>,
    skills: RwLock<HashMap<String, Skill>>,
    trigger_index: RwLock<HashMap<String, Vec<String>>>,
    persistence: Arc<dyn SkillStore>,
    /// Buffer de execuções recentes para avaliação retroativa.
    execution_buffer: RwLock<Vec<SkillExecutionResult>>,
}

impl SkillManager {
    pub fn new(
        memory: Arc<ThreeLayerMemory>,
        llm: Arc<dyn InferenceEngine>,
        persistence: Arc<dyn SkillStore>,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            memory,
            llm,
            skills: RwLock::new(HashMap::new()),
            trigger_index: RwLock::new(HashMap::new()),
            persistence,
            execution_buffer: RwLock::new(Vec::new()),
        }
    }

    /// Gera uma skill a partir de experiência usando o LLM.
    pub async fn generate_skill(
        &self,
        task: &str,
        solution: &str,
        context: &str,
    ) -> Result<Skill, SkillManagerError> {
        info!("Generating skill for: {}", task);

        let prompt = format!(
            r#"You are a skill synthesizer. Based on the task and solution, create a reusable skill.

Task: {}
Solution: {}
Context: {}

Generate a skill with:
- A concise name (2-4 words, camelCase)
- A clear description (one sentence)
- Trigger keywords (3-5 lowercase strings)
- A prompt template with exactly one "{{input}}" placeholder
- 1-2 example inputs

Output ONLY valid JSON with fields: name, description, triggers, prompt_template, examples"#,
            task, solution, context
        );

        let response = self.llm
            .generate(&prompt, GenerateParams::default()
                .with_temperature(0.7)
                .with_max_tokens(2048))
            .await
            .map_err(|e| SkillManagerError::Llm(e.to_string()))?;

        // Parse robusto: extrair JSON mesmo se houver markdown
        let json_str = extract_json(&response.text)
            .ok_or_else(|| SkillManagerError::Parse(format!(
                "No JSON found in LLM response: {}",
                &response.text[..response.text.len().min(200)]
            )))?;

        let parsed: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(json_str)
            .map_err(|e| SkillManagerError::Parse(format!("JSON parse error: {}", e)))?;

        // Validação dos campos obrigatórios
        let name = parsed["name"].as_str()
            .ok_or_else(|| SkillManagerError::Parse("Missing 'name' field".to_string()))?;
        let description = parsed["description"].as_str()
            .unwrap_or("No description");
        let template = parsed["prompt_template"].as_str()
            .ok_or_else(|| SkillManagerError::Parse("Missing 'prompt_template' field".to_string()))?;

        if !template.contains("{{input}}") {
            return Err(SkillManagerError::Parse(
                "prompt_template must contain '{{input}}' placeholder".to_string()
            ));
        }

        let triggers: Vec<String> = parsed["triggers"].as_array()
            .map(|arr| arr.iter().filter_map(|v| v.as_str().map(String::from)).collect())
            .unwrap_or_default();

        let examples: Vec<String> = parsed["examples"].as_array()
            .map(|arr| arr.iter().filter_map(|v| v.as_str().map(String::from)).collect())
            .unwrap_or_default();

        let skill = Skill {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            name: name.to_string(),
            description: description.to_string(),
            trigger: triggers,
            prompt_template: template.to_string(),
            examples,
            metadata: SkillMetadata {
                author: "Arkhe AGI".to_string(),
                version: "1.0.0".to_string(),
                tags: vec!["auto-generated".to_string()],
                requires_consent: false,
                estimated_cost: response.tokens_used.unwrap_or(500) as f32,
            },
            created_at: chrono::Utc::now(),
            last_used: chrono::Utc::now(),
            usage_count: 0,
            success_rate: 0.0,
            last_evaluation: None,
        };

        self.store_skill(skill.clone()).await?;
        self.persist_skill(&skill).await;

        // Armazena na memória como entrada derivada
        let entry = MemoryEntry::new(
            format!("skill:{}", skill.id),
            serde_json::to_string(&skill).unwrap_or_default(),
            MemorySource::Derived,
        )
        .with_relevance(0.9)
        .with_confidence(0.8)
        .with_tags(vec!["skill".to_string(), skill.name.clone()]);
        self.memory.store(entry)
            .map_err(|e| SkillManagerError::Memory(e.to_string()))?;

        Ok(skill)
    }

    /// Armazena no índice local.
    async fn store_skill(&self, skill: Skill) -> Result<(), SkillManagerError> {
        let mut skills = self.skills.write().await
            .map_err(|e| SkillManagerError::Lock(e.to_string()))?;
        let mut index = self.trigger_index.write().await
            .map_err(|e| SkillManagerError::Lock(e.to_string()))?;

        // Remove índices antigos se sobrescrevendo
        if let Some(old) = skills.get(&skill.id) {
            for trigger in &old.trigger {
                if let Some(ids) = index.get_mut(trigger) {
                    ids.retain(|id| id != &skill.id);
                }
            }
        }

        for trigger in &skill.trigger {
            index.entry(trigger.clone()).or_default().push(skill.id.clone());
        }

        skills.insert(skill.id.clone(), skill);
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn persist_skill(&self, skill: &Skill) {
        if let Err(e) = self.persistence.save(skill).await {
            error!("Failed to persist skill {}: {}", skill.id, e);
        }
    }

    pub async fn find_by_trigger(&self, text: &str) -> Vec<Skill> {
        let skills = self.skills.read().await.ok();
        let index = self.trigger_index.read().await.ok();
        match (skills, index) {
            (Some(skills), Some(index)) => {
                let text_lower = text.to_lowercase();
                let mut found = Vec::new();
                for (trigger, ids) in index.iter() {
                    if text_lower.contains(&trigger.to_lowercase()) {
                        for id in ids {
                            if let Some(skill) = skills.get(id) {
                                found.push(skill.clone());
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                found.sort_by_key(|s| std::cmp::Reverse(s.success_rate));
                found
            }
            _ => Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    pub async fn execute_skill(
        &self, skill_id: &str, input: &str,
    ) -> Result<SkillExecutionResult, SkillManagerError> {
        let start = std::time::Instant::now();

        let skills = self.skills.read().await
            .map_err(|e| SkillManagerError::Lock(e.to_string()))?;
        let skill = skills.get(skill_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| SkillManagerError::NotFound(skill_id.to_string()))?
            .clone();
        drop(skills); // Libera o lock antes de chamar LLM

        let prompt = skill.prompt_template.replace("{{input}}", input);
        let response = self.llm
            .generate(&prompt, GenerateParams::default()
                .with_temperature(0.7)
                .with_max_tokens(1024))
            .await
            .map_err(|e| SkillManagerError::Llm(e.to_string()))?;

        let duration_ms = start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;

        // Atualiza estatísticas
        {
            let mut skills = self.skills.write().await
                .map_err(|e| SkillManagerError::Lock(e.to_string()))?;
            if let Some(s) = skills.get_mut(skill_id) {
                s.usage_count += 1;
                s.last_used = chrono::Utc::now();
            }
        }

        let result = SkillExecutionResult {
            skill_id: skill_id.to_string(),
            input: input.to_string(),
            output: response.text.clone(),
            duration_ms,
            success: true,
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now(),
        };

        // Bufferiza para avaliação retroativa
        {
            let mut buf = self.execution_buffer.write().await
                .map_err(|e| SkillManagerError::Lock(e.to_string()))?;
            buf.push(result.clone());
            // Manter no máximo 100 execuções no buffer
            if buf.len() > 100 {
                buf.drain(..buf.len() - 100);
            }
        }

        Ok(result)
    }

    pub async fn load_persisted(&self) -> Result<usize, SkillManagerError> {
        let skills = self.persistence.load_all().await
            .map_err(|e| SkillManagerError::Persistence(e))?;
        let mut loaded = 0;
        for skill in skills {
            if self.store_skill(skill).await.is_ok() {
                loaded += 1;
            }
        }
        info!("Loaded {} skills from persistence", loaded);
        Ok(loaded)
    }

    pub async fn list(&self) -> Vec<Skill> {
        self.skills.read().await
            .map(|s| s.values().cloned().collect())
            .unwrap_or_default()
    }

    pub async fn get(&self, id: &str) -> Option<Skill> {
        self.skills.read().await.ok()?.get(id).cloned()
    }

    pub async fn delete(&self, id: &str) -> Result<(), SkillManagerError> {
        let removed = {
            let mut skills = self.skills.write().await
                .map_err(|e| SkillManagerError::Lock(e.to_string()))?;
            skills.remove(id)
        };

        if let Some(skill) = removed {
            let mut index = self.trigger_index.write().await
                .map_err(|e| SkillManagerError::Lock(e.to_string()))?;
            for trigger in &skill.trigger {
                if let Some(ids) = index.get_mut(trigger) {
                    ids.retain(|i| i != id);
                }
            }
            self.persistence.delete(id).await
                .map_err(|e| SkillManagerError::Persistence(e))?;
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(SkillManagerError::NotFound(id.to_string()))
        }
    }

    pub async fn compact(
        &self, max_skills: usize, min_success_rate: f32,
    ) -> Result<Vec<String>, SkillManagerError> {
        let mut skills = self.skills.write().await
            .map_err(|e| SkillManagerError::Lock(e.to_string()))?;
        if skills.len() <= max_skills { return Ok(Vec::new()); }

        let mut scored: Vec<(String, f32)> = skills.iter()
            .map(|(id, s)| {
                let usage = (s.usage_count as f32 / 100.0).min(1.0);
                let score = usage * 0.4 + s.success_rate * 0.6;
                (id.clone(), score)
            })
            .collect();
        scored.sort_by(|a, b| a.1.partial_cmp(&b.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));

        let to_remove = skills.len() - max_skills;
        let mut removed = Vec::new();
        for (id, score) in scored.iter().take(to_remove) {
            if *score < min_success_rate {
                if let Some(skill) = skills.remove(id) {
                    removed.push(id.clone());
                    // Persiste a remoção
                    if let Err(e) = self.persistence.delete(id).await {
                        warn!("Failed to persist deletion of {}: {}", id, e);
                    }
                    drop(&skill);
                }
            }
        }

        // Reconstrói índice
        let mut index = self.trigger_index.write().await
            .map_err(|e| SkillManagerError::Lock(e.to_string()))?;
        index.clear();
        for (id, skill) in skills.iter() {
            for trigger in &skill.trigger {
                index.entry(trigger.clone()).or_default().push(id.clone());
            }
        }

        Ok(removed)
    }

    /// Drena o buffer de execuções (para o evaluator consumir).
    pub async fn drain_execution_buffer(&self) -> Vec<SkillExecutionResult> {
        let mut buf = self.execution_buffer.write().await.unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
        std::mem::take(&mut *buf)
    }
}

/// Extrai JSON de uma string, mesmo com markdown fences.
fn extract_json(text: &str) -> Option<&str> {
    // Tenta ```json ... ```
    if let Some(start) = text.find("```json") {
        if let Some(end) = text[start..].find("```") {
            let inner = &text[start + 7..start + end];
            let trimmed = inner.trim();
            if trimmed.starts_with('{') { return Some(trimmed); }
        }
    }
    // Tenta ``` ... ```
    if let Some(start) = text.find("```") {
        if let Some(end) = text[start + 3..].find("```") {
            let inner = &text[start + 3..start + 3 + end];
            let trimmed = inner.trim();
            if trimmed.starts_with('{') { return Some(trimmed); }
        }
    }
    // Tenta direto
    let trimmed = text.trim();
    if trimmed.starts_with('{') && trimmed.ends_with('}') {
        return Some(trimmed);
    }
    // Busca primeiro { até último }
    if let Some(start) = trimmed.find('{') {
        if let Some(end) = trimmed.rfind('}') {
            if end > start {
                return Some(&trimmed[start..=end]);
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use arkhe_llm::inference::EchoBackend;
    use crate::skills::persistence::WormGraphSkillStore;

    fn make_test_manager() -> SkillManager {
        let memory = Arc::new(ThreeLayerMemory::new(None).unwrap());
        let llm = Arc::new(EchoBackend::skill_echo(
            "codeReview",
            "Reviews code for bugs",
            &["review", "code", "bug"],
            "Review the following code: {{input}}",
        ));
        let persistence = Arc::new(WormGraphSkillStore::new());
        SkillManager::new(memory, llm, persistence)
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_generate_skill() {
        let mgr = make_test_manager();
        let skill = mgr.generate_skill(
            "Review code for bugs",
            "Run static analysis and report issues",
            "Security audit project",
        ).await.unwrap();

        assert_eq!(skill.name, "codeReview");
        assert_eq!(skill.trigger.len(), 3);
        assert!(skill.prompt_template.contains("{{input}}"));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_generate_skill_bad_json() {
        let memory = Arc::new(ThreeLayerMemory::new(None).unwrap());
        let llm = Arc::new(EchoBackend::new("this is not json at all"));
        let persistence = Arc::new(WormGraphSkillStore::new());
        let mgr = SkillManager::new(memory, llm, persistence);

        let result = mgr.generate_skill("task", "solution", "context").await;
        assert!(result.is_err());
        assert!(matches!(result.unwrap_err(), SkillManagerError::Parse(_)));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_find_by_trigger() {
        let mgr = make_test_manager();
        mgr.generate_skill("review code", "solution", "context").await.unwrap();

        let found = mgr.find_by_trigger("please review my code").await;
        assert_eq!(found.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(found[0].name, "codeReview");
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_execute_skill() {
        let mgr = make_test_manager();
        let skill = mgr.generate_skill("task", "solution", "context").await.unwrap();

        let result = mgr.execute_skill(&skill.id, "fn main() {}").await.unwrap();
        assert!(result.success);
        assert_eq!(result.skill_id, skill.id);

        // Verificar que usage_count incrementou
        let updated = mgr.get(&skill.id).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(updated.usage_count, 1);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_delete_skill() {
        let mgr = make_test_manager();
        let skill = mgr.generate_skill("task", "solution", "context").await.unwrap();
        assert!(mgr.get(&skill.id).await.is_some());

        mgr.delete(&skill.id).await.unwrap();
        assert!(mgr.get(&skill.id).await.is_none());
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_compact() {
        let memory = Arc::new(ThreeLayerMemory::new(None).unwrap());
        let llm = Arc::new(EchoBackend::skill_echo("s", "d", &["t"], "{{input}}"));
        let persistence = Arc::new(WormGraphSkillStore::new());
        let mgr = SkillManager::new(memory, llm, persistence);

        // Gera 5 skills
        for i in 0..5 {
            mgr.generate_skill(&format!("task {}", i), "sol", "ctx").await.unwrap();
        }
        assert_eq!(mgr.list().await.len(), 5);

        // Compacta para 2
        let removed = mgr.compact(2, 0.0).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(removed.len(), 3);
        assert_eq!(mgr.list().await.len(), 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_extract_json_from_markdown() {
        let input = "Here is the result:\n```json\n{\"name\": \"test\"}\n```\nDone.";
        assert_eq!(extract_json(input), Some("{\"name\": \"test\"}"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_extract_json_bare() {
        let input = "{\"name\": \"test\"}";
        assert_eq!(extract_json(input), Some("{\"name\": \"test\"}"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_extract_json_with_surrounding_text() {
        let input = "The result is {\"name\": \"test\"} and that's it.";
        assert_eq!(extract_json(input), Some("{\"name\": \"test\"}"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_extract_json_none() {
        assert_eq!(extract_json("no json here"), None);
    }
}

### `arkhe-agi/src/skills/evaluator.rs` — Funcional (não stub)

```rust
use crate::skills::manager::SkillManagerError;
use crate::skills::types::{Skill, SkillEvaluation, SkillExecutionResult, SkillStore};
use arkhe_llm::inference::{GenerateParams, InferenceEngine};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;
use thiserror::Error;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;
use tracing::{info, warn};

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum EvaluatorError {
    #[error("LLM error: {0}")]
    Llm(String),
    #[error("Parse error: {0}")]
    Parse(String),
    #[error("Skill not found: {0}")]
    NotFound(String),
    #[error("Manager error: {0}")]
    Manager(#[from] SkillManagerError),
}

pub struct SkillEvaluator {
    llm: Arc<dyn InferenceEngine>,
    persistence: Arc<dyn SkillStore>,
    skills: Arc<RwLock<HashMap<String, Skill>>>,
}

impl SkillEvaluator {
    pub fn new(
        llm: Arc<dyn InferenceEngine>,
        persistence: Arc<dyn SkillStore>,
        skills: Arc<RwLock<HashMap<String, Skill>>>,
    ) -> Self {
        Self { llm, persistence, skills }
    }

    /// Avalia UMA execução específica e atualiza a skill.
    pub async fn evaluate_execution(
        &self,
        skill_id: &str,
        execution: &SkillExecutionResult,
    ) -> Result<SkillEvaluation, EvaluatorError> {
        let skill = {
            let skills = self.skills.read().await
                .map_err(|e| EvaluatorError::Manager(SkillManagerError::Lock(e.to_string())))?;
            skills.get(skill_id)
                .ok_or_else(|| EvaluatorError::NotFound(skill_id.to_string()))?
                .clone()
        };

        let prompt = format!(
            r#"Evaluate this skill execution on a scale of 0.0 to 1.0.

Skill: {} — {}
Input: {}
Output: {}
Duration: {}ms

Output ONLY valid JSON: {{"score": <float>, "feedback": "<string>", "improvements": ["<string>"]}}"#,
            skill.name, skill.description,
            execution.input, execution.output, execution.duration_ms,
        );

        let response = self.llm
            .generate(&prompt, GenerateParams::default()
                .with_temperature(0.2)
                .with_max_tokens(512))
            .await
            .map_err(|e| EvaluatorError::Llm(e.to_string()))?;

        let json_str = crate::skills::manager::extract_json(&response.text)
            .ok_or_else(|| EvaluatorError::Parse("No JSON in evaluation response".to_string()))?;

        let parsed: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(json_str)
            .map_err(|e| EvaluatorError::Parse(e.to_string()))?;

        let evaluation = SkillEvaluation {
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now(),
            score: parsed["score"].as_f64()
                .unwrap_or(0.5).clamp(0.0, 1.0) as f32,
            feedback: parsed["feedback"].as_str()
                .unwrap_or("No feedback").to_string(),
            improvements: parsed["improvements"].as_array()
                .map(|arr| arr.iter().filter_map(|v| v.as_str().map(String::from)).collect())
                .unwrap_or_default(),
        };

        // Atualiza a skill: média móvel
        {
            let mut skills = self.skills.write().await
                .map_err(|e| EvaluatorError::Manager(SkillManagerError::Lock(e.to_string())))?;
            if let Some(s) = skills.get_mut(skill_id) {
                s.last_evaluation = Some(evaluation.clone());
                s.success_rate = s.success_rate * 0.7 + evaluation.score * 0.3;
            }
        }

        // Persiste
        if let Some(updated) = self.skills.read().await.ok().and_then(|s| s.get(skill_id).cloned()) {
            if let Err(e) = self.persistence.update(&updated).await {
                warn!("Failed to persist evaluation: {}", e);
            }
        }

        info!("Evaluated skill {}: score={:.2}", skill_id, evaluation.score);
        Ok(evaluation)
    }

    /// Avalia TODAS as execuções no buffer do manager.
    pub async fn evaluate_buffer(
        &self,
        manager: &crate::skills::manager::SkillManager,
    ) -> Result<Vec<(String, SkillEvaluation)>, EvaluatorError> {
        let executions = manager.drain_execution_buffer().await;
        let mut results = Vec::new();

        for exec in executions {
            match self.evaluate_execution(&exec.skill_id, &exec).await {
                Ok(eval) => results.push((exec.skill_id.clone(), eval)),
                Err(e) => warn!("Failed to evaluate execution of {}: {}", exec.skill_id, e),
            }
        }

        Ok(results)
    }

    /// Relatório de performance.
    pub async fn performance_report(&self) -> String {
        let skills = self.skills.read().await.ok();
        let mut report = String::from("SKILLS PERFORMANCE REPORT\n");
        report.push_str(&"=".repeat(50));
        report.push_str("\n\n");

        if let Some(skills) = skills {
            let mut sorted: Vec<&Skill> = skills.values().collect();
            sorted.sort_by(|a, b| b.success_rate.partial_cmp(&a.success_rate).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));

            for skill in sorted {
                let eval_mark = if skill.last_evaluation.is_some() { "✓" } else { "·" };
                report.push_str(&format!(
                    "  {:<24} | usage: {:>4} | success: {:>5.1}% | {}\n",
                    skill.name,
                    skill.usage_count,
                    skill.success_rate * 100.0,
                    eval_mark,
                ));
            }
            report.push_str(&format!("\nTotal: {} skills\n", skills.len()));
        } else {
            report.push_str("  (unable to acquire lock)\n");
        }

        report
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use arkhe_llm::inference::EchoBackend;
    use crate::skills::persistence::WormGraphSkillStore;
    use crate::skills::manager::SkillManager;
    use arkhe_memory_v2::ThreeLayerMemory;

    fn make_evaluator(llm: Arc<dyn InferenceEngine>) -> SkillEvaluator {
        let skills = Arc::new(RwLock::new(HashMap::new()));
        let persistence = Arc::new(WormGraphSkillStore::new());
        SkillEvaluator::new(llm, persistence, skills)
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_evaluate_execution() {
        let llm = Arc::new(EchoBackend::eval_echo(0.85, "Good output, clear reasoning"));
        let evaluator = make_evaluator(llm.clone());

        // Inserir skill manualmente no mapa do evaluator
        {
            let mut skills = evaluator.skills.write().await.unwrap();
            skills.insert("s1".to_string(), crate::skills::types::Skill {
                id: "s1".to_string(),
                name: "testSkill".to_string(),
                description: "A test skill".to_string(),
                trigger: vec!["test".to_string()],
                prompt_template: "{{input}}".to_string(),
                examples: Vec::new(),
                metadata: crate::skills::types::SkillMetadata {
                    author: "test".to_string(), version: "1.0".to_string(),
                    tags: vec![], requires_consent: false, estimated_cost: 0.0,
                },
                created_at: chrono::Utc::now(),
                last_used: chrono::Utc::now(),
                usage_count: 0, success_rate: 0.0, last_evaluation: None,
            });
        }

        let exec = SkillExecutionResult {
            skill_id: "s1".to_string(),
            input: "test input".to_string(),
            output: "test output".to_string(),
            duration_ms: 100,
            success: true,
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now(),
        };

        let eval = evaluator.evaluate_execution("s1", &exec).await.unwrap();
        assert!((eval.score - 0.85).abs() < 1e-6);
        assert_eq!(eval.feedback, "Good output, clear reasoning");

        // Verificar média móvel: 0.0 * 0.7 + 0.85 * 0.3 = 0.255
        let skills = evaluator.skills.read().await.unwrap();
        let skill = skills.get("s1").unwrap();
        assert!((skill.success_rate - 0.255).abs() < 1e-4);
        assert!(skill.last_evaluation.is_some());
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_evaluate_nonexistent_skill() {
        let llm = Arc::new(EchoBackend::eval_echo(1.0, ""));
        let evaluator = make_evaluator(llm);

        let exec = SkillExecutionResult {
            skill_id: "nonexistent".to_string(),
            input: "".to_string(), output: "".to_string(),
            duration_ms: 0, success: false, timestamp: chrono::Utc::now(),
        };

        let result = evaluator.evaluate_execution("nonexistent", &exec).await;
        assert!(matches!(result, Err(EvaluatorError::NotFound(_))));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_performance_report() {
        let llm = Arc::new(EchoBackend::new(""));
        let evaluator = make_evaluator(llm);
        let report = evaluator.performance_report().await;
        assert!(report.contains("SKILLS PERFORMANCE REPORT"));
    }
}

### `arkhe-cli/Cargo.toml`

```toml
[package]
name = "arkhe-cli"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true

[[bin]]
name = "arkhe-skills"
path = "src/main.rs"

### `arkhe-cli/src/main.rs`

```rust
use arkhe_agi::skills::evaluator::SkillEvaluator;
use arkhe_agi::skills::manager::SkillManager;
use arkhe_agi::skills::persistence::WormGraphSkillStore;
use arkhe_llm::inference::EchoBackend;
use arkhe_memory_v2::ThreeLayerMemory;
use clap::{Parser, Subcommand};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::{Arc, RwLock};

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(name = "arkhe-skills", about = "Gerencie skills do Arkhe OS")]
struct Cli {
    #[command(subcommand)]
    command: Commands,
}

#[derive(Subcommand)]
enum Commands {
    /// Lista todas as skills
    List {
        #[arg(short, long)]
        json: bool,
    },
    /// Mostra detalhes de uma skill
    Show { id: String },
    /// Gera uma nova skill
    Generate {
        #[arg(short, long)] task: String,
        #[arg(short, long)] solution: String,
        #[arg(short, long)] context: Option<String>,
    },
    /// Executa uma skill
    Execute {
        #[arg(short, long)] id: String,
        #[arg(short, long)] input: String,
    },
    /// Avalia a última execução de uma skill
    Evaluate { id: String },
    /// Remove uma skill
    Delete { id: String },
    /// Compacta skills com baixo score
    Compact {
        #[arg(short, long, default_value = "50")] max: usize,
        #[arg(short, long, default_value = "0.3")] min_rate: f32,
    },
    /// Relatório de performance
    Report,
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    tracing_subscriber::fmt::init();

    let cli = Cli::parse();

    // Inicializa com EchoBackend (sem depender de vLLM/Ollama)
    let memory = Arc::new(ThreeLayerMemory::new(None)?);
    let llm = Arc::new(EchoBackend::skill_echo(
        "echoSkill", "Echo skill for testing",
        &["echo", "test"], "{{input}}",
    ));
    let persistence = Arc::new(WormGraphSkillStore::new());
    let skills_map = Arc::new(RwLock::new(HashMap::new()));

    let manager = Arc::new(SkillManager::new(
        memory, llm.clone(), persistence.clone(),
    ));
    let evaluator = SkillEvaluator::new(
        llm, persistence, skills_map,
    );

    match cli.command {
        Commands::List { json } => {
            let skills = manager.list().await;
            if json {
                println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&skills)?);
            } else {
                println!("Skills ({})", skills.len());
                for s in skills {
                    println!("  {:<24} usage:{:>4}  rate:{:>5.1}%", s.name, s.usage_count, s.success_rate * 100.0);
                }
            }
        }
        Commands::Show { id } => {
            match manager.get(&id).await {
                Some(s) => println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&s)?),
                None => { eprintln!("Skill not found: {}", id); std::process::exit(1); }
            }
        }
        Commands::Generate { task, solution, context } => {
            let ctx = context.as_deref().unwrap_or("");
            match manager.generate_skill(&task, &solution, ctx).await {
                Ok(s) => {
                    println!("Skill created:");
                    println!("  ID:    {}", s.id);
                    println!("  Name:  {}", s.name);
                    println!("  Desc:  {}", s.description);
                    println!("  Triggers: {:?}", s.trigger);
                }
                Err(e) => { eprintln!("Error: {}", e); std::process::exit(1); }
            }
        }
        Commands::Execute { id, input } => {
            match manager.execute_skill(&id, &input).await {
                Ok(r) => {
                    println!("Output:\n{}", r.output);
                    println!("\nTime: {}ms", r.duration_ms);
                }
                Err(e) => { eprintln!("Error: {}", e); std::process::exit(1); }
            }
        }
        Commands::Evaluate { id } => {
            // Avalia execuções pendentes no buffer
            let results = evaluator.evaluate_buffer(&manager).await
                .map_err(|e| -> Box<dyn std::error::Error> { e.to_string().into() })?;
            if results.is_empty() {
                println!("No pending executions to evaluate. Execute the skill first.");
            } else {
                for (sid, eval) in results {
                    println!("{}: score={:.2} — {}", sid, eval.score, eval.feedback);
                }
            }
        }
        Commands::Delete { id } => {
            manager.delete(&id).await
                .map_err(|e| -> Box<dyn std::error::Error> { e.to_string().into() })?;
            println!("Deleted: {}", id);
        }
        Commands::Compact { max, min_rate } => {
            let removed = manager.compact(max, min_rate).await
                .map_err(|e| -> Box<dyn std::error::Error> { e.to_string().into() })?;
            println!("Compacted. Removed {} skills.", removed.len());
        }
        Commands::Report => {
            print!("{}", evaluator.performance_report().await);
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}
```

## 🧠 2. L1 — RACIOCÍNIO CAUSAL PARA HETNETS

### 2.1. Tipos para HetNet Causal Reasoning

```rust
// crates/arkhe-hetnet-causal/src/types.rs

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Estado da HetNet para raciocínio causal.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct HetNetState {
    pub cells: HashMap<String, CellState>,
    pub ues: HashMap<String, UeState>,
    pub uavs: HashMap<String, UavState>,
    pub timestamp: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct CellState {
    pub id: String,
    pub cell_type: CellType,
    pub location: (f32, f32),
    pub tx_power: f32,
    pub bandwidth_mhz: f32,
    pub load: f32, // 0.0 - 1.0
    pub sinr: f32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum CellType {
    Macro,
    Small,
    Femto,
    Uav,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct UeState {
    pub id: String,
    pub location: (f32, f32),
    pub serving_cell: String,
    pub throughput: f32,
    pub latency_ms: f32,
    pub qos_class: QoSClass,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum QoSClass {
    E_MBB,   // enhanced Mobile Broadband
    URLLC,   // Ultra-Reliable Low-Latency
    MMTC,    // Massive Machine-Type
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct UavState {
    pub id: String,
    pub location: (f32, f32),
    pub altitude: f32,
    pub battery: f32,
    pub serving_cells: Vec<String>,
}

/// Intervenção causal — o Do-operator aplicado à HetNet.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum HetNetIntervention {
    /// Força um UE a se associar a uma célula específica
    ForceAssociation { ue_id: String, cell_id: String },
    /// Ajusta a potência de transmissão de uma célula
    SetTxPower { cell_id: String, power: f32 },
    /// Reposiciona um UAV
    MoveUav { uav_id: String, target_location: (f32, f32), altitude: f32 },
    /// Ativa/desativa uma célula (sleep mode)
    SetCellActive { cell_id: String, active: bool },
    /// Aloca banda para um slice específico
    AllocateSlice { cell_id: String, slice: String, bandwidth_mhz: f32 },
}

/// Efeito causal de uma intervenção na HetNet.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct CausalEffect {
    pub intervention: HetNetIntervention,
    pub affected_ues: Vec<String>,
    pub throughput_delta: f32,
    pub latency_delta: f32,
    pub coverage_delta: f32,
    pub confidence: f32,
    pub explanation: String,
}
```

### 2.2. Motor Causal para HetNet

```rust
// crates/arkhe-hetnet-causal/src/engine.rs

use crate::types::{HetNetState, HetNetIntervention, CausalEffect};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use tracing::info;

pub struct CausalHetNetEngine {
    intervention_history: Vec<CausalEffect>,
}

impl CausalHetNetEngine {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            intervention_history: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    /// Aplica uma intervenção e calcula o efeito causal no estado da HetNet.
    pub fn intervene(
        &mut self,
        state: &HetNetState,
        intervention: &HetNetIntervention,
    ) -> CausalEffect {
        info!("🔮 Aplicando intervenção causal na HetNet: {:?}", intervention);

        let effect = match intervention {
            HetNetIntervention::ForceAssociation { ue_id, cell_id } => {
                self.intervene_association(state, ue_id, cell_id)
            }
            HetNetIntervention::SetTxPower { cell_id, power } => {
                self.intervene_tx_power(state, cell_id, *power)
            }
            HetNetIntervention::MoveUav { uav_id, target_location, altitude } => {
                self.intervene_uav_position(state, uav_id, *target_location, *altitude)
            }
            HetNetIntervention::SetCellActive { cell_id, active } => {
                self.intervene_cell_active(state, cell_id, *active)
            }
            HetNetIntervention::AllocateSlice { cell_id, slice, bandwidth_mhz } => {
                self.intervene_slice_allocation(state, cell_id, slice, *bandwidth_mhz)
            }
        };

        self.intervention_history.push(effect.clone());
        effect
    }

    /// Explica o efeito causal em linguagem natural.
    pub fn explain(&self, effect: &CausalEffect) -> String {
        format!(
            "A intervenção resultou em: throughput {:.1}%, latência {:.1}%, cobertura {:.1}%.\n{}",
            effect.throughput_delta * 100.0,
            effect.latency_delta * 100.0,
            effect.coverage_delta * 100.0,
            effect.explanation
        )
    }

    // ===== Intervenções Específicas =====

    fn intervene_association(
        &self,
        state: &HetNetState,
        ue_id: &str,
        cell_id: &str,
    ) -> CausalEffect {
        let ue = state.ues.get(ue_id);
        let cell = state.cells.get(cell_id);

        let (throughput_delta, explanation) = match (ue, cell) {
            (Some(ue), Some(cell)) => {
                // Simula o efeito da nova associação
                let old_sinr = state.cells.get(&ue.serving_cell).map(|c| c.sinr).unwrap_or(0.0);
                let new_sinr = cell.sinr;
                let improvement = (new_sinr - old_sinr) / old_sinr.max(0.1);

                (
                    improvement.clamp(-0.5, 0.5),
                    format!(
                        "UE {} movido da célula {} (SINR {:.1}) para {} (SINR {:.1})",
                        ue_id, ue.serving_cell, old_sinr, cell_id, new_sinr
                    ),
                )
            }
            _ => (
                0.0,
                format!("UE {} ou célula {} não encontrada", ue_id, cell_id),
            ),
        };

        CausalEffect {
            intervention: HetNetIntervention::ForceAssociation {
                ue_id: ue_id.to_string(),
                cell_id: cell_id.to_string(),
            },
            affected_ues: vec![ue_id.to_string()],
            throughput_delta,
            latency_delta: throughput_delta * -0.3,
            coverage_delta: throughput_delta * 0.2,
            confidence: 0.85,
            explanation,
        }
    }

    fn intervene_tx_power(&self, state: &HetNetState, cell_id: &str, power: f32) -> CausalEffect {
        let cell = state.cells.get(cell_id);
        let affected_ues: Vec<String> = state.ues
            .values()
            .filter(|ue| ue.serving_cell == cell_id)
            .map(|ue| ue.id.clone())
            .collect();

        let (delta, explanation) = match cell {
            Some(cell) => {
                let old_power = cell.tx_power;
                let ratio = power / old_power.max(0.1);
                // Potência maior → melhor SINR para UEs servidos, mas mais interferência para outros
                let sinr_improvement = (ratio - 1.0).clamp(-0.3, 0.3);
                (
                    sinr_improvement * 0.5,
                    format!(
                        "Potência da célula {} ajustada de {:.1} para {:.1} dBm",
                        cell_id, old_power, power
                    ),
                )
            }
            None => (0.0, format!("Célula {} não encontrada", cell_id)),
        };

        CausalEffect {
            intervention: HetNetIntervention::SetTxPower {
                cell_id: cell_id.to_string(),
                power,
            },
            affected_ues,
            throughput_delta: delta,
            latency_delta: delta * -0.5,
            coverage_delta: delta * 0.8,
            confidence: 0.75,
            explanation,
        }
    }

    fn intervene_uav_position(
        &self,
        state: &HetNetState,
        uav_id: &str,
        target_location: (f32, f32),
        altitude: f32,
    ) -> CausalEffect {
        let uav = state.uavs.get(uav_id);
        let explanation = match uav {
            Some(uav) => {
                format!(
                    "UAV {} movido de ({:.1}, {:.1}) para ({:.1}, {:.1}) a {:.1}m",
                    uav_id, uav.location.0, uav.location.1,
                    target_location.0, target_location.1, altitude
                )
            }
            None => format!("UAV {} não encontrado", uav_id),
        };

        // Simula melhoria de cobertura baseada na nova posição
        let coverage_improvement = 0.1 + (altitude / 100.0).clamp(0.0, 0.3);

        CausalEffect {
            intervention: HetNetIntervention::MoveUav {
                uav_id: uav_id.to_string(),
                target_location,
                altitude,
            },
            affected_ues: Vec::new(),
            throughput_delta: coverage_improvement * 0.3,
            latency_delta: -coverage_improvement * 0.1,
            coverage_delta: coverage_improvement,
            confidence: 0.70,
            explanation,
        }
    }

    fn intervene_cell_active(&self, state: &HetNetState, cell_id: &str, active: bool) -> CausalEffect {
        let exists = state.cells.contains_key(cell_id);
        let explanation = if exists {
            format!(
                "Célula {} {}",
                cell_id,
                if active { "ativada" } else { "desativada (sleep mode)" }
            )
        } else {
            format!("Célula {} não encontrada", cell_id)
        };

        CausalEffect {
            intervention: HetNetIntervention::SetCellActive {
                cell_id: cell_id.to_string(),
                active,
            },
            affected_ues: Vec::new(),
            throughput_delta: if active { 0.05 } else { -0.1 },
            latency_delta: if active { 0.02 } else { 0.05 },
            coverage_delta: if active { 0.1 } else { -0.2 },
            confidence: 0.80,
            explanation,
        }
    }

    fn intervene_slice_allocation(
        &self,
        state: &HetNetState,
        cell_id: &str,
        slice: &str,
        bandwidth_mhz: f32,
    ) -> CausalEffect {
        let cell = state.cells.get(cell_id);
        let explanation = match cell {
            Some(cell) => {
                format!(
                    "Slice {} na célula {}: {:.1} MHz alocados",
                    slice, cell_id, bandwidth_mhz
                )
            }
            None => format!("Célula {} não encontrada", cell_id),
        };

        CausalEffect {
            intervention: HetNetIntervention::AllocateSlice {
                cell_id: cell_id.to_string(),
                slice: slice.to_string(),
                bandwidth_mhz,
            },
            affected_ues: Vec::new(),
            throughput_delta: 0.1,
            latency_delta: -0.05,
            coverage_delta: 0.0,
            confidence: 0.85,
            explanation,
        }
    }
}
```

## 🪞 3. DIGITAL TWIN — SIMULADOR HETNET

### 3.1. Simulador de Rede

```rust
// crates/arkhe-digital-twin/src/simulator.rs

use crate::types::{HetNetState, CellType, CellState, UeState, QoSClass};
use rand::Rng;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use tracing::info;

pub struct HetNetSimulator {
    state: HetNetState,
    rng: rand::rngs::StdRng,
}

impl HetNetSimulator {
    pub fn new(seed: u64) -> Self {
        let mut rng = rand::rngs::StdRng::seed_from_u64(seed);
        let mut cells = HashMap::new();
        let mut ues = HashMap::new();
        let mut uavs = HashMap::new();

        // Macrocell
        cells.insert(
            "macro-1".to_string(),
            CellState {
                id: "macro-1".to_string(),
                cell_type: CellType::Macro,
                location: (0.0, 0.0),
                tx_power: 46.0,
                bandwidth_mhz: 100.0,
                load: 0.6,
                sinr: 25.0,
            },
        );

        // Small cells
        for i in 1..=3 {
            cells.insert(
                format!("small-{}", i),
                CellState {
                    id: format!("small-{}", i),
                    cell_type: CellType::Small,
                    location: ((i as f32 - 2.0) * 200.0, (i as f32 - 2.0) * 200.0),
                    tx_power: 30.0,
                    bandwidth_mhz: 40.0,
                    load: 0.3 + rng.gen::<f32>() * 0.3,
                    sinr: 20.0 + rng.gen::<f32>() * 10.0,
                },
            );
        }

        // Femtocells (indoor)
        for i in 1..=2 {
            cells.insert(
                format!("femto-{}", i),
                CellState {
                    id: format!("femto-{}", i),
                    cell_type: CellType::Femto,
                    location: ((i as f32 - 1.5) * 50.0 + 100.0, (i as f32 - 1.5) * 50.0 + 100.0),
                    tx_power: 20.0,
                    bandwidth_mhz: 20.0,
                    load: 0.2 + rng.gen::<f32>() * 0.2,
                    sinr: 30.0 + rng.gen::<f32>() * 5.0,
                },
            );
        }

        // UAVs
        for i in 1..=2 {
            uavs.insert(
                format!("uav-{}", i),
                UavState {
                    id: format!("uav-{}", i),
                    location: ((i as f32 - 1.5) * 150.0, (i as f32 - 1.5) * 150.0),
                    altitude: 50.0 + i as f32 * 20.0,
                    battery: 0.8,
                    serving_cells: vec!["macro-1".to_string()],
                },
            );
        }

        // UEs
        let qos_classes = vec![QoSClass::E_MBB, QoSClass::URLLC, QoSClass::MMTC];
        for i in 1..=20 {
            let qos = qos_classes[i % 3].clone();
            let serving = if i % 3 == 0 {
                "macro-1".to_string()
            } else {
                format!("small-{}", 1 + (i % 3))
            };
            ues.insert(
                format!("ue-{}", i),
                UeState {
                    id: format!("ue-{}", i),
                    location: (rng.gen::<f32>() * 500.0 - 250.0, rng.gen::<f32>() * 500.0 - 250.0),
                    serving_cell: serving,
                    throughput: 50.0 + rng.gen::<f32>() * 50.0,
                    latency_ms: 10.0 + rng.gen::<f32>() * 20.0,
                    qos_class: qos,
                },
            );
        }

        let state = HetNetState {
            cells,
            ues,
            uavs,
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp() as u64,
        };

        Self { state, rng }
    }

    pub fn state(&self) -> &HetNetState {
        &self.state
    }

    /// Aplica uma intervenção à simulação
    pub fn apply_intervention(&mut self, intervention: &HetNetIntervention) {
        match intervention {
            HetNetIntervention::ForceAssociation { ue_id, cell_id } => {
                if let Some(ue) = self.state.ues.get_mut(ue_id) {
                    ue.serving_cell = cell_id.clone();
                }
            }
            HetNetIntervention::SetTxPower { cell_id, power } => {
                if let Some(cell) = self.state.cells.get_mut(cell_id) {
                    cell.tx_power = *power;
                }
            }
            HetNetIntervention::MoveUav { uav_id, target_location, altitude } => {
                if let Some(uav) = self.state.uavs.get_mut(uav_id) {
                    uav.location = *target_location;
                    uav.altitude = *altitude;
                }
            }
            HetNetIntervention::SetCellActive { cell_id, active } => {
                // Simula ativação/desativação
                if let Some(cell) = self.state.cells.get_mut(cell_id) {
                    cell.tx_power = if *active { cell.tx_power } else { 0.0 };
                }
            }
            HetNetIntervention::AllocateSlice { cell_id, slice: _, bandwidth_mhz } => {
                if let Some(cell) = self.state.cells.get_mut(cell_id) {
                    cell.bandwidth_mhz = *bandwidth_mhz;
                }
            }
        }
        self.state.timestamp = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp() as u64;
    }

    /// Executa um passo de simulação (atualiza métricas)
    pub fn step(&mut self) {
        // Atualiza SINR baseado em interferência
        for cell in self.state.cells.values_mut() {
            let interference: f32 = self.state.cells.values()
                .filter(|c| c.id != cell.id)
                .map(|c| c.tx_power / 100.0)
                .sum();
            let noise = 5.0;
            cell.sinr = (cell.tx_power / (interference + noise)).clamp(0.0, 50.0);
            cell.load = (cell.load + self.rng.gen::<f32>() * 0.1 - 0.05).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        }

        // Atualiza métricas de UEs
        for ue in self.state.ues.values_mut() {
            if let Some(cell) = self.state.cells.get(&ue.serving_cell) {
                let quality = cell.sinr / 50.0;
                ue.throughput = 100.0 * (0.5 + 0.5 * quality).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                ue.latency_ms = 5.0 + 20.0 * (1.0 - quality).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
            }
        }

        // Atualiza UAVs
        for uav in self.state.uavs.values_mut() {
            uav.battery = (uav.battery - 0.001).max(0.0);
        }

        self.state.timestamp = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp() as u64;
    }

    /// Retorna métricas agregadas
    pub fn metrics(&self) -> HetNetMetrics {
        let total_throughput: f32 = self.state.ues.values().map(|ue| ue.throughput).sum();
        let avg_latency: f32 = self.state.ues.values().map(|ue| ue.latency_ms).sum::<f32>() / self.state.ues.len() as f32;
        let coverage: f32 = self.state.cells.values().filter(|c| c.tx_power > 0.0).count() as f32 / self.state.cells.len() as f32;

        HetNetMetrics {
            total_throughput,
            avg_latency,
            coverage,
            ue_count: self.state.ues.len(),
            cell_count: self.state.cells.len(),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct HetNetMetrics {
    pub total_throughput: f32,
    pub avg_latency: f32,
    pub coverage: f32,
    pub ue_count: usize,
    pub cell_count: usize,
}
```
