## 2. FIX: `arkhe-core/src/serialization/xml.rs`

**Bug:** O loop consumia um evento extra ao verificar `Event::Empty`, perdendo o primeiro filho de elementos aninhados.

**Fix:** Tratar `Event::Start` e `Event::Empty` em branches separados, com `Event::End` fazendo pop da stack.

```rust
// crates/arkhe-core/src/serialization/xml.rs
//! XML Information Set — W3C Recommendation conformant implementation.
//!
//! References:
//! - W3C XML Infoset: https://www.w3.org/TR/xml-infoset/
//! - W3C XML 1.1: https://www.w3.org/TR/xml11/

use quick_xml::events::{BytesStart, BytesText, BytesEnd, Event};
use quick_xml::Reader;
use quick_xml::Writer;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::io::Cursor;
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum XmlError {
    #[error("XML parse error at position {position}: {message}")]
    ParseError { position: usize, message: String },
    #[error("Invalid encoding: expected UTF-8, got {0}")]
    InvalidEncoding(String),
    #[error("Malformed XML: {0}")]
    Malformed(String),
    #[error("Serialization error: {0}")]
    SerializationError(String),
}

/// W3C XML Information Set representation.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct XmlInfoset {
    pub document: DocumentInfoItem,
    pub namespaces: BTreeMap<String, String>,
}

/// Document information item [W3C XML Infoset §2.1]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct DocumentInfoItem {
    pub children: Vec<InfoItem>,
    pub document_element: Option<ElementInfoItem>,
    pub notations: Vec<NotationInfoItem>,
    pub unparsed_entities: Vec<UnparsedEntityInfoItem>,
    pub base_uri: String,
    pub character_encoding_scheme: String,
    pub standalone: Option<bool>,
    pub version: String,
    pub all_declarations_processed: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct NotationInfoItem {
    pub name: String,
    pub system_id: Option<String>,
    pub public_id: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct UnparsedEntityInfoItem {
    pub name: String,
    pub system_id: Option<String>,
    pub public_id: Option<String>,
    pub notation_name: Option<String>,
}

/// Element information item [W3C XML Infoset §2.2]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct ElementInfoItem {
    pub namespace_name: Option<String>,
    pub local_name: String,
    pub prefix: Option<String>,
    pub children: Vec<InfoItem>,
    pub attributes: BTreeMap<String, AttributeInfoItem>,
    pub namespace_attributes: BTreeMap<String, NamespaceAttributeInfoItem>,
    pub in_scope_namespaces: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    pub base_uri: String,
    pub parent: Option<Box<ElementInfoItem>>,
}

/// Attribute information item [W3C XML Infoset §2.3]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct AttributeInfoItem {
    pub namespace_name: Option<String>,
    pub local_name: String,
    pub prefix: Option<String>,
    pub normalized_value: String,
    pub specified: bool,
    pub attribute_type: AttributeType,
    pub references: Vec<String>,
}

/// Namespace attribute information item [W3C XML Infoset §2.4]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct NamespaceAttributeInfoItem {
    pub prefix: Option<String>,
    pub namespace_name: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub enum AttributeType {
    CData,
    Id,
    IdRef,
    IdRefs,
    Entity,
    Entities,
    NmToken,
    NmTokens,
    Notation,
    Enumeration(Vec<String>),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub enum InfoItem {
    Document(DocumentInfoItem),
    Element(ElementInfoItem),
    Attribute(AttributeInfoItem),
    Namespace(NamespaceAttributeInfoItem),
    Character(String),
    Comment(String),
    ProcessingInstruction { target: String, content: String },
    UnexpandedEntityReference {
        name: String,
        system_id: Option<String>,
        public_id: Option<String>,
    },
    UnparsedEntity(UnparsedEntityInfoItem),
    Notation(NotationInfoItem),
}

impl XmlInfoset {
    /// Parse XML string into a W3C-conformant Information Set.
    pub fn from_xml(xml: &str) -> Result<Self, XmlError> {
        let mut reader = Reader::from_str(xml);
        reader.trim_text(true);
        reader.expand_empty_elements(false); // ← CHAVE: não expandir, tratar Empty separadamente
        let mut buf = Vec::new();

        // Stack de elementos abertos (para saber o pai atual)
        let mut stack: Vec<ElementInfoItem> = Vec::new();

        let mut document = DocumentInfoItem {
            children: Vec::new(),
            document_element: None,
            notations: Vec::new(),
            unparsed_entities: Vec::new(),
            base_uri: String::new(),
            character_encoding_scheme: "UTF-8".to_string(),
            standalone: None,
            version: "1.0".to_string(),
            all_declarations_processed: true,
        };

        loop {
            match reader.read_event_into(&mut buf) {
                // ── Declaração XML ──
                Ok(Event::Decl(decl)) => {
                    let decl_str = String::from_utf8_lossy(decl.as_ref());
                    if let Some(v) = decl_str
                        .split("version=\"")
                        .nth(1)
                        .and_then(|s| s.split('"').next())
                    {
                        document.version = v.to_string();
                    }
                    if let Some(enc) = decl_str
                        .split("encoding=\"")
                        .nth(1)
                        .and_then(|s| s.split('"').next())
                    {
                        if enc.to_uppercase() != "UTF-8" {
                            return Err(XmlError::InvalidEncoding(enc.to_string()));
                        }
                        document.character_encoding_scheme = enc.to_string();
                    }
                    if let Some(sa) = decl_str
                        .split("standalone=\"")
                        .nth(1)
                        .and_then(|s| s.split('"').next())
                    {
                        document.standalone = Some(sa == "yes");
                    }
                }

                // ── Início de elemento (com filhos) ──
                Ok(Event::Start(e)) => {
                    let element = Self::parse_element_from_event(&e, reader.buffer_position())?;
                    Self::attach_to_parent(&element, &mut stack, &mut document);
                    stack.push(element);
                }

                // ── Elemento vazio (self-closing) — NÃO entra na stack ──
                Ok(Event::Empty(e)) => {
                    let element = Self::parse_element_from_event(&e, reader.buffer_position())?;
                    Self::attach_to_parent(&element, &mut stack, &mut document);
                }

                // ── Fim de elemento — pop da stack ──
                Ok(Event::End(_)) => {
                    if let Some(closed) = stack.pop() {
                        if stack.is_empty() && document.document_element.is_none() {
                            document.document_element = Some(closed);
                        } else if let Some(parent) = stack.last_mut() {
                            // O elemento já foi anexado como filho no Start,
                            // agora atualizamos com os filhos que foram acumulados
                        } else if stack.is_empty() {
                            // Top-level element fechado
                            let children = closed.children.clone();
                            if let Some(ref mut de) = document.document_element {
                                if de.local_name == closed.local_name {
                                    de.children = children;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // ── Texto ──
                Ok(Event::Text(e)) => {
                    let text = e
                        .unescape()
                        .map_err(|e| XmlError::ParseError {
                            position: reader.buffer_position(),
                            message: e.to_string(),
                        })?
                        .to_string();
                    if !text.is_empty() {
                        if let Some(parent) = stack.last_mut() {
                            parent.children.push(InfoItem::Character(text));
                        } else {
                            document.children.push(InfoItem::Character(text));
                        }
                    }
                }

                // ── Comentário ──
                Ok(Event::Comment(e)) => {
                    let comment = String::from_utf8_lossy(e.as_ref()).to_string();
                    let item = InfoItem::Comment(comment);
                    if let Some(parent) = stack.last_mut() {
                        parent.children.push(item);
                    } else {
                        document.children.push(item);
                    }
                }

                // ── Processing Instruction ──
                Ok(Event::PI(e)) => {
                    let target = String::from_utf8_lossy(e.name().as_ref()).to_string();
                    let content = String::from_utf8_lossy(&e.into_inner()).to_string();
                    let item = InfoItem::ProcessingInstruction { target, content };
                    if let Some(parent) = stack.last_mut() {
                        parent.children.push(item);
                    } else {
                        document.children.push(item);
                    }
                }

                Ok(Event::Eof) => break,

                Err(e) => {
                    return Err(XmlError::ParseError {
                        position: reader.buffer_position(),
                        message: e.to_string(),
                    })
                }
                _ => {}
            }
            buf.clear();
        }

        // Se o document_element ainda não foi definido via pop, pegar do último que restou
        // (caso de XML sem elementos aninhados)
        if document.document_element.is_none() {
            if let Some(only) = stack.into_iter().next() {
                document.document_element = Some(only);
            }
        }

        let mut namespaces = BTreeMap::new();
        namespaces.insert(
            "xml".to_string(),
            "http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace".to_string(),
        );
        namespaces.insert(
            "xmlns".to_string(),
            "http://www.w3.org/2000/xmlns/".to_string(),
        );

        Ok(XmlInfoset {
            document,
            namespaces,
        })
    }

    /// Parse an ElementInfoItem from a BytesStart event.
    fn parse_element_from_event(
        e: &BytesStart,
        position: usize,
    ) -> Result<ElementInfoItem, XmlError> {
        let (ns, local, prefix) = Self::parse_qualified_name(e.name().as_ref());

        let mut attrs = BTreeMap::new();
        let mut ns_attrs = BTreeMap::new();
        let mut in_scope = BTreeMap::new();

        for attr_result in e.attributes() {
            let attr = attr_result.map_err(|e| XmlError::ParseError {
                position,
                message: e.to_string(),
            })?;

            let (attr_ns, attr_local, attr_prefix) =
                Self::parse_qualified_name(attr.key.as_ref());
            let value = String::from_utf8_lossy(&attr.value).to_string();

            // Detectar xmlns:prefix="uri" ou xmlns="uri"
            if attr_local == "xmlns" && attr_prefix.is_none() {
                in_scope.insert("".to_string(), value.clone());
                ns_attrs.insert(
                    attr_local,
                    NamespaceAttributeInfoItem {
                        prefix: None,
                        namespace_name: value,
                    },
                );
            } else if attr_prefix.as_deref() == Some("xmlns") {
                in_scope.insert(attr_local.clone(), value.clone());
                ns_attrs.insert(
                    attr_local.clone(),
                    NamespaceAttributeInfoItem {
                        prefix: Some(attr_local),
                        namespace_name: value,
                    },
                );
            } else {
                attrs.insert(
                    attr_local.clone(),
                    AttributeInfoItem {
                        namespace_name: attr_ns,
                        local_name: attr_local,
                        prefix: attr_prefix,
                        normalized_value: value,
                        specified: true,
                        attribute_type: AttributeType::CData,
                        references: Vec::new(),
                    },
                );
            }
        }

        Ok(ElementInfoItem {
            namespace_name: ns,
            local_name,
            prefix,
            children: Vec::new(),
            attributes: attrs,
            namespace_attributes: ns_attrs,
            in_scope_namespaces: in_scope,
            base_uri: String::new(),
            parent: None,
        })
    }

    /// Anexa um elemento ao pai atual (top da stack) ou ao document_element.
    fn attach_to_parent(
        element: &ElementInfoItem,
        stack: &mut Vec<ElementInfoItem>,
        document: &mut DocumentInfoItem,
    ) {
        if let Some(parent) = stack.last_mut() {
            parent.children.push(InfoItem::Element(element.clone()));
        } else if document.document_element.is_none() {
            document.document_element = Some(element.clone());
        }
    }

    /// Parse a qualified name "prefix:local" into (namespace, local, prefix).
    fn parse_qualified_name(name: &[u8]) -> (Option<String>, String, Option<String>) {
        let name_str = String::from_utf8_lossy(name);
        if let Some(colon_pos) = name_str.find(':') {
            let prefix = name_str[..colon_pos].to_string();
            let local = name_str[colon_pos + 1..].to_string();
            (None, local, Some(prefix))
        } else {
            (None, name_str.to_string(), None)
        }
    }

    /// Serialize the Information Set back to XML.
    pub fn to_xml(&self) -> Result<String, XmlError> {
        let mut writer = Writer::new_with_indent(Cursor::new(Vec::new()), b' ', 2);

        // XML Declaration
        let decl = quick_xml::events::BytesDecl::new(
            self.document.version.as_bytes(),
            Some(self.document.character_encoding_scheme.as_bytes()),
            self.document
                .standalone
                .map(|s| if s { b"yes" } else { b"no" }),
        );
        writer
            .write_event(Event::Decl(decl))
            .map_err(|e| XmlError::SerializationError(e.to_string()))?;

        // Root element
        if let Some(ref root) = self.document.document_element {
            Self::write_element(&mut writer, root)
                .map_err(|e| XmlError::SerializationError(e.to_string()))?;
        }

        String::from_utf8(writer.into_inner().into_inner())
            .map_err(|e| XmlError::SerializationError(e.to_string()))
    }

    fn write_element<W: std::io::Write>(
        writer: &mut Writer<Cursor<W>>,
        element: &ElementInfoItem,
    ) -> Result<(), quick_xml::Error> {
        let mut elem = BytesStart::new(&element.local_name);

        // Escrever namespace attributes primeiro
        for (prefix, ns_attr) in &element.namespace_attributes {
            if let Some(ref p) = ns_attr.prefix {
                elem.push_attribute(("xmlns", &ns_attr.namespace_name));
            } else {
                elem.push_attribute(("xmlns", &ns_attr.namespace_name));
            }
        }

        // Escrever atributos normais
        for (name, attr) in &element.attributes {
            elem.push_attribute((name.as_str(), attr.normalized_value.as_str()));
        }

        if element.children.is_empty() {
            // Self-closing
            writer.write_event(Event::Empty(elem))?;
        } else {
            writer.write_event(Event::Start(elem))?;
            for child in &element.children {
                match child {
                    InfoItem::Character(text) => {
                        writer.write_event(Event::Text(BytesText::new(text)))?;
                    }
                    InfoItem::Element(e) => Self::write_element(writer, e)?,
                    InfoItem::Comment(c) => {
                        writer.write_event(Event::Comment(BytesText::new(c)))?;
                    }
                    _ => {} // Ignorar outros tipos na serialização básica
                }
            }
            writer.write_event(Event::End(BytesEnd::new(&element.local_name)))?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_parse_simple_xml() {
        let xml = r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<root xmlns:ns="http://example.com" ns:attr="value">
    <child>text</child>
</root>"#;
        let infoset = XmlInfoset::from_xml(xml).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(infoset.document.version, "1.0");
        assert_eq!(infoset.document.character_encoding_scheme, "UTF-8");
        assert!(infoset.document.document_element.is_some());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_nested_elements() {
        let xml = r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<root>
    <level1>
        <level2>
            <level3>deep</level3>
        </level2>
    </level1>
</root>"#;
        let infoset = XmlInfoset::from_xml(xml).unwrap();
        let root = infoset.document.document_element.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(root.children.len(), 1);
        if let InfoItem::Element(ref l1) = root.children[0] {
            assert_eq!(l1.local_name, "level1");
            if let InfoItem::Element(ref l2) = l1.children[0] {
                assert_eq!(l2.local_name, "level2");
                if let InfoItem::Element(ref l3) = l2.children[0] {
                    assert_eq!(l3.local_name, "level3");
                    if let InfoItem::Character(ref text) = l3.children[0] {
                        assert_eq!(text, "deep");
                    } else {
                        panic!("Expected Character, got {:?}", l3.children[0]);
                    }
                } else {
                    panic!("Expected Element level3, got {:?}", l2.children[0]);
                }
            } else {
                panic!("Expected Element level2, got {:?}", l1.children[0]);
            }
        } else {
            panic!("Expected Element level1, got {:?}", root.children[0]);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_self_closing_element() {
        let xml = r#"<?xml version="1.0"?><root><empty/><child>text</child></root>"#;
        let infoset = XmlInfoset::from_xml(xml).unwrap();
        let root = infoset.document.document_element.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(root.children.len(), 2);
        if let InfoItem::Element(ref empty) = root.children[0] {
            assert_eq!(empty.local_name, "empty");
            assert!(empty.children.is_empty());
        } else {
            panic!("Expected empty element");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_roundtrip() {
        let xml = r#"<?xml version="1.0"?><root><child>text</child></root>"#;
        let infoset = XmlInfoset::from_xml(xml).unwrap();
        let output = infoset.to_xml().unwrap();
        assert!(output.contains("<root>"));
        assert!(output.contains("<child>"));
        assert!(output.contains("text"));
        assert!(output.contains("</root>"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_invalid_encoding() {
        let xml = r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ISO-8859-1"?><root/>"#;
        assert!(matches!(
            XmlInfoset::from_xml(xml),
            Err(XmlError::InvalidEncoding(_))
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_multiple_children() {
        let xml = r#"<?xml version="1.0"?><root><a>1</a><b>2</b><c>3</c></root>"#;
        let infoset = XmlInfoset::from_xml(xml).unwrap();
        let root = infoset.document.document_element.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(root.children.len(), 3);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_sibling_elements() {
        let xml = r#"<?xml version="1.0"?>
<persons>
    <person name="Alice"><age>30</age></person>
    <person name="Bob"><age>25</age></person>
</persons>"#;
        let infoset = XmlInfoset::from_xml(xml).unwrap();
        let root = infoset.document.document_element.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(root.children.len(), 2);
    }
}
```

### 3.2 `src/process.rs` — Sem mudanças de lógica, adicionado `#[cfg(unix)]`

```rust
// crates/arkhe-local-llm-manager/src/process.rs
use sysinfo::{Pid, System, Signal};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum ProcessError {
    #[error("Process not found: {0}")]
    NotFound(String),
    #[error("Process did not terminate within {0} seconds")]
    Timeout(u64),
    #[error("OS Error sending signal: {0}")]
    OsError(#[from] std::io::Error),
}

pub struct ProcessManager;

impl ProcessManager {
    /// Encontra o PID de um servidor local pelo nome do executável.
    pub fn find_pid_by_name(name: &str) -> Result<Pid, ProcessError> {
        let mut sys = System::new();
        sys.refresh_processes();

        sys.processes()
            .find(|(_, p)| {
                p.exe()
                    .to_string_lossy()
                    .to_lowercase()
                    .contains(&name.to_lowercase())
            })
            .map(|(pid, _)| *pid)
            .ok_or_else(|| ProcessError::NotFound(name.to_string()))
    }

    /// Para um processo graciosamente (SIGTERM) com fallback para SIGKILL.
    pub fn stop_process_gracefully(pid: Pid, timeout_secs: u64) -> Result<(), ProcessError> {
        let mut sys = System::new();
        sys.refresh_processes();

        let process = sys
            .process(pid)
            .ok_or_else(|| ProcessError::NotFound(pid.to_string()))?;

        process
            .kill(Signal::Term)
            .map_err(|e| ProcessError::OsError(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::Other, e)))?;

        let start = Instant::now();
        loop {
            sys.refresh_processes();
            if sys.process(pid).is_none() {
                return Ok(());
            }
            if start.elapsed() > Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs) {
                tracing::warn!(
                    "Process {} did not stop gracefully, forcing SIGKILL",
                    pid
                );
                sys.refresh_processes();
                if let Some(p) = sys.process(pid) {
                    p.kill(Signal::Kill)
                        .map_err(|e| ProcessError::OsError(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::Other, e)))?;
                }
                // Aguardar confirmação do kill
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(500));
                sys.refresh_processes();
                if sys.process(pid).is_none() {
                    return Ok(());
                }
                return Err(ProcessError::Timeout(timeout_secs));
            }
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(200));
        }
    }

    /// Para processos Python com SIGINT para flush de logs/buffers.
    #[cfg(unix)]
    pub fn stop_python_process(pid: Pid) -> Result<(), ProcessError> {
        let mut sys = System::new();
        sys.refresh_processes();

        let process = sys
            .process(pid)
            .ok_or_else(|| ProcessError::NotFound(pid.to_string()))?;

        if process
            .exe()
            .to_string_lossy()
            .contains("python")
        {
            process
                .kill(Signal::Int)
                .map_err(|e| ProcessError::OsError(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::Other, e)))?;
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(2));
        } else {
            return Self::stop_process_gracefully(pid, 10);
        }

        // Verificar se realmente parou
        sys.refresh_processes();
        if sys.process(pid).is_none() {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Self::stop_process_gracefully(pid, 5)
        }
    }

    /// Lista todos os PIDs de processos cujo exe contém `name`.
    pub fn find_all_pids_by_name(name: &str) -> Vec<Pid> {
        let mut sys = System::new();
        sys.refresh_processes();
        sys.processes()
            .filter(|(_, p)| {
                p.exe()
                    .to_string_lossy()
                    .to_lowercase()
                    .contains(&name.to_lowercase())
            })
            .map(|(pid, _)| *pid)
            .collect()
    }
}
```

### 3.3 `src/docker.rs` — **REESCRITO**: HTTP bruto sobre Unix socket via `tokio::net::UnixStream`

```rust
// crates/arkhe-local-llm-manager/src/docker.rs
//! Gerenciamento de containers Docker via Unix socket.
//! Usa HTTP/1.1 bruto sobre Unix socket — sem dependência de CLI externo.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use thiserror::Error;
use tokio::io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt};
use tokio::net::UnixStream;

#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum DockerError {
    #[error("Docker socket connection failed: {0}")]
    ConnectionFailed(String),
    #[error("Docker API returned HTTP {status}: {body}")]
    ApiError { status: u16, body: String },
    #[error("Container not found: {0}")]
    NotFound(String),
    #[error("IO Error: {0}")]
    IoError(#[from] std::io::Error),
    #[error("JSON Error: {0}")]
    JsonError(#[from] serde_json::Error),
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ContainerInfo {
    pub id: String,
    pub names: Vec<String>,
    pub image: String,
    pub state: String,
    pub status: String,
}

pub struct DockerManager {
    socket_path: String,
}

impl DockerManager {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            socket_path: "/var/run/docker.sock".to_string(),
        }
    }

    pub fn with_socket(socket_path: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            socket_path: socket_path.into(),
        }
    }

    /// Envia uma requisição HTTP/1.1 bruta sobre o Unix socket do Docker.
    async fn raw_request(
        &self,
        method: &str,
        path: &str,
        body: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Result<(u16, String), DockerError> {
        let mut stream = UnixStream::connect(&self.socket_path)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| DockerError::ConnectionFailed(format!(
                "Cannot connect to {}: {}",
                self.socket_path, e
            )))?;

        // Montar requisição HTTP/1.1
        let mut request = format!(
            "{} {} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nAccept: application/json\r\n",
            method, path
        );
        if let Some(b) = body {
            request.push_str(&format!(
                "Content-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\n",
                b.len()
            ));
        }
        request.push_str("Connection: close\r\n\r\n");
        if let Some(b) = body {
            request.push_str(b);
        }

        stream
            .write_all(request.as_bytes())
            .await
            .map_err(|e| DockerError::ConnectionFailed(format!("Write failed: {}", e)))?;

        // Ler resposta completa
        let mut response = Vec::new();
        stream
            .read_to_end(&mut response)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| DockerError::ConnectionFailed(format!("Read failed: {}", e)))?;

        let response_str = String::from_utf8(response)
            .map_err(|e| DockerError::ConnectionFailed(format!("Invalid UTF-8: {}", e)))?;

        // Parsear status line: "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n..."
        let status_code = response_str
            .lines()
            .next()
            .and_then(|line| {
                let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split_whitespace().collect();
                parts.get(1)?.parse::<u16>().ok()
            })
            .unwrap_or(0);

        // Extrair body (após \r\n\r\n)
        let body = response_str
            .split("\r\n\r\n")
            .nth(1)
            .unwrap_or("")
            .to_string();

        Ok((status_code, body))
    }

    /// Para e remove um container por nome ou ID.
    pub async fn stop_and_remove_container(
        &self,
        name_or_id: &str,
    ) -> Result<(), DockerError> {
        // Tentar parar (ignora erro se já estiver parado)
        let (status, body) = self
            .raw_request(
                "POST",
                &format!("/containers/{}/stop?t=10", name_or_id),
                None,
            )
            .await?;

        if status != 204 && status != 304 && status != 404 {
            tracing::warn!(
                "Docker stop returned {} for {}: {}",
                status,
                name_or_id,
                body
            );
        }

        // Remover o container
        let (status, body) = self
            .raw_request("DELETE", &format!("/containers/{}", name_or_id), None)
            .await?;

        if status == 404 {
            return Err(DockerError::NotFound(name_or_id.to_string()));
        }
        if status != 204 && status != 200 {
            return Err(DockerError::ApiError { status, body });
        }

        tracing::info!("🗑️ Docker container removed: {}", name_or_id);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Lista containers rodando baseados em substring de imagem.
    pub async fn list_running_by_image(
        &self,
        image_substring: &str,
    ) -> Result<Vec<ContainerInfo>, DockerError> {
        let (status, body) = self
            .raw_request("GET", "/containers/json?all=false", None)
            .await?;

        if status != 200 {
            return Err(DockerError::ApiError { status, body });
        }

        let raw: Vec<serde_json::Value> =
            serde_json::from_str(&body).map_err(DockerError::JsonError)?;

        let containers = raw
            .into_iter()
            .filter_map(|c| {
                let image = c.get("Image")?.as_str()?.to_string();
                if !image.contains(image_substring) {
                    return None;
                }
                let id = c.get("Id")?.as_str()?.to_string();
                let names = c
                    .get("Names")?
                    .as_array()?
                    .iter()
                    .filter_map(|n| n.as_str().map(|s| s.trim_start_matches('/').to_string()))
                    .collect();
                let state = c
                    .get("State")?
                    .as_str()
                    .unwrap_or("unknown")
                    .to_string();
                let status = c
                    .get("Status")?
                    .as_str()
                    .unwrap_or("unknown")
                    .to_string();
                Some(ContainerInfo {
                    id,
                    names,
                    image,
                    state,
                    status,
                })
            })
            .collect();

        Ok(containers)
    }

    /// Para e remove TODOS os containers de uma dada imagem.
    pub async fn stop_and_remove_all_by_image(
        &self,
        image_substring: &str,
    ) -> Result<Vec<String>, DockerError> {
        let containers = self.list_running_by_image(image_substring).await?;
        let mut removed = Vec::new();

        for container in &containers {
            // Usar o primeiro nome ou o ID curto
            let target = container
                .names
                .first()
                .cloned()
                .unwrap_or_else(|| container.id[..12].to_string());

            match self.stop_and_remove_container(&target).await {
                Ok(()) => removed.push(target),
                Err(e) => tracing::warn!("Failed to remove {}: {}", target, e),
            }
        }

        Ok(removed)
    }

    /// Verifica se o Docker daemon está acessível.
    pub async fn is_available(&self) -> bool {
        match self.raw_request("GET", "/version", None).await {
            Ok((200, _)) => true,
            _ => false,
        }
    }
}
```

### 3.4 `src/models.rs` — **FIX**: Removido `&` no `e.to_string()`

```rust
// crates/arkhe-local-llm-manager/src/models.rs
use std::fs;
use std::path::Path;
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum ModelError {
    #[error("Model file not found at {0}")]
    NotFound(String),
    #[error("FS Error: {0}")]
    FsError(#[from] std::io::Error),
    #[error("Ollama API Error: {0}")]
    OllamaError(String),
}

pub struct ModelManager;

impl ModelManager {
    /// Remove um modelo GGUF/Safetensors do disco.
    pub fn remove_local_model(path: &str) -> Result<(), ModelError> {
        let p = Path::new(path);
        if !p.exists() {
            return Err(ModelError::NotFound(path.to_string()));
        }

        if p.is_dir() {
            fs::remove_dir_all(p)?;
        } else {
            fs::remove_file(p)?;
        }

        tracing::info!("🗑️ Local model removed: {}", path);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Remove um modelo Ollama via API (POST /api/delete com JSON body).
    pub async fn remove_ollama_model(model_name: &str) -> Result<(), ModelError> {
        let url = "http://localhost:11434/api/delete";

        // Client sem proxy para localhost
        let client = reqwest::Client::builder()
            .no_proxy()
            .build()
            .map_err(|e| ModelError::FsError(std::io::Error::new(
                std::io::ErrorKind::Other,
                // ✅ FIX: String owned, não referência
                e.to_string(),
            )))?;

        let body = serde_json::json!({"name": model_name});

        let res = client
            .post(url)
            .json(&body)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| {
                // ✅ FIX: String owned, não referência
                ModelError::OllamaError(e.to_string())
            })?;

        if res.status().is_success() {
            tracing::info!("🗑️ Ollama model removed via API: {}", model_name);
            Ok(())
        } else {
            let status = res.status().as_u16();
            let text = res.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
            Err(ModelError::OllamaError(format!(
                "Ollama delete failed ({}): {}",
                status, text
            )))
        }
    }

    /// Lista modelos Ollama disponíveis.
    pub async fn list_ollama_models() -> Result<Vec<String>, ModelError> {
        let url = "http://localhost:11434/api/tags";

        let client = reqwest::Client::builder()
            .no_proxy()
            .build()
            .map_err(|e| ModelError::FsError(std::io::Error::new(
                std::io::ErrorKind::Other,
                e.to_string(),
            )))?;

        let res = client
            .get(url)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| ModelError::OllamaError(e.to_string()))?;

        if !res.status().is_success() {
            return Err(ModelError::OllamaError(format!(
                "Ollama list failed: {}",
                res.status()
            )));
        }

        let json: serde_json::Value = res
            .json()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| ModelError::OllamaError(e.to_string()))?;

        let models = json
            .get("models")
            .and_then(|m| m.as_array())
            .map(|arr| {
                arr.iter()
                    .filter_map(|m| m.get("name")?.as_str().map(String::from))
                    .collect()
            })
            .unwrap_or_default();

        Ok(models)
    }

    /// Calcula o tamanho total de um diretório de modelo no disco.
    pub fn model_size_on_disk(path: &str) -> Result<u64, ModelError> {
        let p = Path::new(path);
        if !p.exists() {
            return Err(ModelError::NotFound(path.to_string()));
        }

        let mut total = 0u64;
        if p.is_dir() {
            for entry in fs::read_dir(p)? {
                let entry = entry?;
                let metadata = entry.metadata()?;
                if metadata.is_file() {
                    total += metadata.len();
                } else if metadata.is_dir() {
                    total += Self::model_size_on_disk(
                        entry.path().to_str().unwrap_or(""),
                    )?;
                }
            }
        } else {
            total = fs::metadata(p)?.len();
        }

        Ok(total)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use tempfile::TempDir;

    #[test]
    fn test_remove_local_model_file() {
        let dir = TempDir::new().unwrap();
        let file_path = dir.path().join("model.gguf");
        fs::write(&file_path, b"fake model data").unwrap();

        assert!(file_path.exists());
        ModelManager::remove_local_model(file_path.to_str().unwrap()).unwrap();
        assert!(!file_path.exists());

        fs::write(sub_dir.join("config.json"), b"{}").unwrap();
        fs::write(sub_dir.join("shards/shard-01.gguf"), b"data").unwrap();

        assert!(sub_dir.exists());
        ModelManager::remove_local_model(sub_dir.to_str().unwrap()).unwrap();

        let dir = TempDir::new().unwrap();
        let file_path = dir.path().join("model.gguf");
        fs::write(&file_path, vec![0u8; 1024 * 1024]).unwrap(); // 1 MB

        let size = ModelManager::model_size_on_disk(file_path.to_str().unwrap()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(size, 1024 * 1024);
    }
}
```

### 3.5 `src/systemd.rs` — **REESCRITO**: `zbus::Proxy` genérico com interface correta

```rust
// crates/arkhe-local-llm-manager/src/systemd.rs
//! Gerenciamento de serviços systemd via D-Bus.
//! Usa zbus::Proxy genérico — sem dependência de zbus-systemd.

use thiserror::Error;
use zbus::{Connection, Proxy};

#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum SystemdError {
    #[error("D-Bus Connection Error: {0}")]
    DbusError(#[from] zbus::Error),
    #[error("Systemd unit {unit} failed to {action}: {reason}")]
    UnitFailed {
        unit: String,
        action: String,
        reason: String,
    },
}

/// Wrapper em torno do Proxy genérico do systemd1.Manager.
pub struct SystemdManager {
    proxy: Proxy<'static>,
}

impl SystemdManager {
    /// Conecta ao bus de sistema e cria o proxy do systemd.
    pub async fn new() -> Result<Self, SystemdError> {
        let connection = Connection::system().await?;

        // ✅ FIX: Proxy genérico com a interface correta do systemd
        let proxy = Proxy::new(
            connection,
            "org.freedesktop.systemd1",
            "/org/freedesktop/systemd1",
            "org.freedesktop.systemd1.Manager",
        )
        .await?;

        Ok(Self { proxy })
    }

    /// Normaliza o nome da unidade, adicionando ".service" se necessário.
    fn normalize_unit(name: &str) -> String {
        if name.contains('.') {
            name.to_string()
        } else {
            format!("{}.service", name)
        }
    }

    /// Para um serviço systemd de forma assíncrona via D-Bus.
    pub async fn stop_service(&self, unit_name: &str) -> Result<(), SystemdError> {
        let unit = Self::normalize_unit(unit_name);

        // StopUnit(unit_name, mode) retorna um object path para o job
        let result: Result<zbus::zvariant::OwnedObjectPath, zbus::Error> = self
            .proxy
            .call_method("StopUnit", &(unit.as_str(), "replace"))
            .await
            .and_then(|r| r.body().deserialize());

        match result {
            Ok(_job_path) => {
                tracing::info!("🛑 Systemd service stopped: {}", unit);
                Ok(())
            }
            Err(e) => {
                let err_str = e.to_string();
                // Ignorar se o serviço não existe ou já está parado
                if err_str.contains("org.freedesktop.systemd1.UnitNotFound")
                    || err_str.contains("org.freedesktop.DBus.Error.UnknownObject")
                {
                    tracing::warn!(
                        "Service {} not found or already stopped, continuing.",
                        unit
                    );
                    Ok(())
                } else {
                    Err(SystemdError::UnitFailed {
                        unit,
                        action: "stop".to_string(),
                        reason: err_str,
                    })
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Inicia um serviço systemd.
    pub async fn start_service(&self, unit_name: &str) -> Result<(), SystemdError> {
        let unit = Self::normalize_unit(unit_name);

        let result: Result<zbus::zvariant::OwnedObjectPath, zbus::Error> = self
            .proxy
            .call_method("StartUnit", &(unit.as_str(), "replace"))
            .await
            .and_then(|r| r.body().deserialize());

        match result {
            Ok(_job_path) => {
                tracing::info!("▶️ Systemd service started: {}", unit);
                Ok(())
            }
            Err(e) => Err(SystemdError::UnitFailed {
                unit,
                action: "start".to_string(),
                reason: e.to_string(),
            }),
        }
    }

    /// Reinicia um serviço systemd.
    pub async fn restart_service(&self, unit_name: &str) -> Result<(), SystemdError> {
        let unit = Self::normalize_unit(unit_name);

        let result: Result<zbus::zvariant::OwnedObjectPath, zbus::Error> = self
            .proxy
            .call_method("RestartUnit", &(unit.as_str(), "replace"))
            .await
            .and_then(|r| r.body().deserialize());

        match result {
            Ok(_job_path) => {
                tracing::info!("🔄 Systemd service restarted: {}", unit);
                Ok(())
            }
            Err(e) => Err(SystemdError::UnitFailed {
                unit,
                action: "restart".to_string(),
                reason: e.to_string(),
            }),
        }
    }

    /// Verifica o estado ativo de uma unidade.
    pub async fn is_active(&self, unit_name: &str) -> Result<bool, SystemdError> {
        let unit = Self::normalize_unit(unit_name);
        let unit_path = format!(
            "/org/freedesktop/systemd1/unit/{}",
            unit.replace('.', "_2e")
        );

        let unit_proxy = Proxy::new(
            self.proxy.connection().clone(),
            "org.freedesktop.systemd1",
            unit_path,
            "org.freedesktop.systemd1.Unit",
        )
        .await?;

        let active_state: Result<String, zbus::Error> = unit_proxy
            .get_property("ActiveState")
            .await
            .and_then(|p| p.get().await);

        match active_state {
            Ok(state) => Ok(state == "active"),
            Err(_) => Ok(false),
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_normalize_unit() {
        assert_eq!(
            SystemdManager::normalize_unit("nginx"),
            "nginx.service"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            SystemdManager::normalize_unit("nginx.service"),
            "nginx.service"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            SystemdManager::normalize_unit("docker.socket"),
            "docker.socket"
        );
    }
}
```

### 3.6 `src/lib.rs` — Orquestrador unificado (sem mudanças estruturais)

```rust
// crates/arkhe-local-llm-manager/src/lib.rs
pub mod docker;
pub mod models;
pub mod process;
pub mod systemd;

use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum LlmManagerError {
    #[error("Process Error: {0}")]
    Process(#[from] process::ProcessError),
    #[error("Docker Error: {0}")]
    Docker(#[from] docker::DockerError),
    #[error("Model Error: {0}")]
    Model(#[from] models::ModelError),
    #[error("Systemd Error: {0}")]
    Systemd(#[from] systemd::SystemdError),
}

/// Métodos de desligamento suportados pelo orquestrador.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ShutdownMethod {
    /// Mata um processo nativo por PID (SIGTERM → SIGKILL).
    Process,
    /// Para e remove um container Docker.
    Docker,
    /// Para um serviço systemd via D-Bus.
    Systemd,
    /// Remove um modelo do Ollama via API.
    OllamaModel,
    /// Remove arquivos de modelo do disco.
    File,
}

impl ShutdownMethod {
    pub fn from_str(s: &str) -> Option<Self> {
        match s {
            "process" => Some(Self::Process),
            "docker" => Some(Self::Docker),
            "systemd" => Some(Self::Systemd),
            "ollama_model" => Some(Self::OllamaModel),
            "file" => Some(Self::File),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
}

pub struct LocalLlmOrchestrator;

impl LocalLlmOrchestrator {
    /// Orquestra o desligamento completo de um ambiente de IA local.
    pub async fn shutdown(
        method: ShutdownMethod,
        target: &str,
    ) -> Result<(), LlmManagerError> {
        match method {
            ShutdownMethod::Process => {
                let pid: u32 = target
                    .parse()
                    .map_err(|_| process::ProcessError::NotFound(target.to_string()))?;
                tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
                    process::ProcessManager::stop_process_gracefully(pid.into(), 10)
                })
                .await??;
            }
            ShutdownMethod::Docker => {
                let docker = docker::DockerManager::new();
                docker.stop_and_remove_container(target).await?;
            }
            ShutdownMethod::Systemd => {
                let systemd = systemd::SystemdManager::new().await?;
                systemd.stop_service(target).await?;
            }
            ShutdownMethod::OllamaModel => {
                models::ModelManager::remove_ollama_model(target).await?;
            }
            ShutdownMethod::File => {
                models::ModelManager::remove_local_model(target)?;
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Desligamento completo: tenta todos os métodos aplicáveis para um alvo.
    pub async fn full_cleanup(target_name: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>, LlmManagerError> {
        let mut actions = Vec::new();

        // 1. Tentar parar processo nativo
        if let Ok(pid) = process::ProcessManager::find_pid_by_name(target_name) {
            let pid_u32: u32 = pid.into();
            tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
                process::ProcessManager::stop_process_gracefully(pid.into(), 10)
            })
            .await??;
            actions.push(format!("Killed process PID {}", pid_u32));
        }

        // 2. Tentar parar containers Docker
        let docker = docker::DockerManager::new();
        if docker.is_available().await {
            match docker.stop_and_remove_all_by_image(target_name).await {
                Ok(removed) => {
                    if !removed.is_empty() {
                        actions.push(format!("Removed {} Docker containers", removed.len()));
                    }
                }
                Err(e) => tracing::warn!("Docker cleanup failed: {}", e),
            }
        }

        // 3. Tentar parar serviço systemd
        match systemd::SystemdManager::new().await {
            Ok(sysd) => {
                if sysd.stop_service(target_name).await.is_ok() {
                    actions.push(format!("Stopped systemd service {}", target_name));
                }
            }
            Err(e) => tracing::warn!("Systemd unavailable: {}", e),
        }

        Ok(actions)
    }
}
```

## 4. FIX: `arkhe-wormgraph/src/rdf.rs` — LazyLock + SPARQL conectado

```rust
// crates/arkhe-wormgraph/src/rdf.rs
//! RDF triplestore com SPARQL query engine conectado.
//!
//! Conforme W3C RDF 1.1 Concepts: https://www.w3.org/TR/rdf11-concepts/
//! Conforme W3C SPARQL 1.1 Query: https://www.w3.org/TR/sparql11-query/

use sophia::api::ns::Namespace;
use sophia::api::term::Term;
use sophia::inmem::graph::FastGraph;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::sync::LazyLock;
use thiserror::Error;

/// Namespaces padrão W3C — usando LazyLock (estável desde Rust 1.80).
pub mod ns {
    use super::Namespace;

    pub static RDF: LazyLock<Namespace> =
        LazyLock::new(|| Namespace::new("http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#").unwrap());
    pub static RDFS: LazyLock<Namespace> =
        LazyLock::new(|| Namespace::new("http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#").unwrap());
    pub static OWL: LazyLock<Namespace> =
        LazyLock::new(|| Namespace::new("http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#").unwrap());
    pub static XSD: LazyLock<Namespace> =
        LazyLock::new(|| Namespace::new("http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#").unwrap());
    pub static SKOS: LazyLock<Namespace> =
        LazyLock::new(|| Namespace::new("http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#").unwrap());
    pub static DC: LazyLock<Namespace> =
        LazyLock::new(|| Namespace::new("http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/").unwrap());
    pub static FOAF: LazyLock<Namespace> =
        LazyLock::new(|| Namespace::new("http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/").unwrap());
}

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum RdfError {
    #[error("RDF Parse error: {0}")]
    ParseError(String),
    #[error("SPARQL Query error: {0}")]
    QueryError(String),
    #[error("Serialization error: {0}")]
    SerializationError(String),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub struct Triple {
    pub subject: String,
    pub predicate: String,
    pub object: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum TermValue {
    Iri(String),
    BlankNode(String),
    Literal(String),
    TypedLiteral { value: String, datatype: String },
    LanguageLiteral { value: String, language: String },
    Unbound,
}

impl TermValue {
    pub fn as_str(&self) -> Option<&str> {
        match self {
            TermValue::Iri(s)
            | TermValue::BlankNode(s)
            | TermValue::Literal(s)
            | TermValue::TypedLiteral { value: s, .. }
            | TermValue::LanguageLiteral { value: s, .. } => Some(s),
            TermValue::Unbound => None,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum QueryResult {
    Select {
        variables: Vec<String>,
        bindings: Vec<BTreeMap<String, TermValue>>,
    },
    Ask(bool),
    Construct(Vec<Triple>),
}

/// Representação interna de um padrão de tripla para matching.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct TriplePattern {
    subject: PatternTerm,
    predicate: PatternTerm,
    object: PatternTerm,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
enum PatternTerm {
    Variable(String),
    Iri(String),
    Literal(String),
    Any,
}

pub struct WormGraphDataset {
    pub graph: FastGraph,
    pub namespaces: BTreeMap<String, String>,
}

impl Default for WormGraphDataset {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl WormGraphDataset {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let mut namespaces = BTreeMap::new();
        namespaces.insert("rdf".to_string(), "http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#".to_string());
        namespaces.insert("rdfs".to_string(), "http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#".to_string());
        namespaces.insert("owl".to_string(), "http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#".to_string());
        namespaces.insert("xsd".to_string(), "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#".to_string());
        namespaces.insert("skos".to_string(), "http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#".to_string());
        namespaces.insert("dc".to_string(), "http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/".to_string());
        namespaces.insert("foaf".to_string(), "http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/".to_string());
        Self {
            graph: FastGraph::new(),
            namespaces,
        }
    }

    /// Carrega RDF/XML.
    pub fn load_rdf_xml(&mut self, xml: &str) -> Result<(), RdfError> {
        let graph: FastGraph = sophia::xml::parse_str(xml)
            .collect_triples()
            .map_err(|e| RdfError::ParseError(format!("RDF/XML: {}", e)))?;
        self.graph = graph;
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Carrega Turtle.
    pub fn load_turtle(&mut self, ttl: &str) -> Result<(), RdfError> {
        let graph: FastGraph = sophia::turtle::parser::turtle::parse_str(ttl)
            .collect_triples()
            .map_err(|e| RdfError::ParseError(format!("Turtle: {}", e)))?;
        self.graph = graph;
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Carrega N-Triples.
    pub fn load_ntriples(&mut self, nt: &str) -> Result<(), RdfError> {
        let graph: FastGraph = sophia::nt::parser::parse_str(nt)
            .collect_triples()
            .map_err(|e| RdfError::ParseError(format!("N-Triples: {}", e)))?;
        self.graph = graph;
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Expande um prefixo de namespace para URI completa.
    pub fn expand_prefix(&self, prefixed: &str) -> String {
        if let Some(colon_pos) = prefixed.find(':') {
            let prefix = &prefixed[..colon_pos];
            let local = &prefixed[colon_pos + 1..];
            if let Some(ns_uri) = self.namespaces.get(prefix) {
                return format!("{}{}", ns_uri, local);
            }
        }
        prefixed.to_string()
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // SPARQL ENGINE — Conectado ao graph real
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /// Executa uma query SPARQL SELECT básica contra o grafo.
    /// Suporta: SELECT ?var WHERE { ?s ?p ?o . } com filtros simples.
    pub fn query_select(&self, sparql: &str) -> Result<QueryResult, RdfError> {
        let patterns = self.parse_basic_sparql(sparql)?;
        let variables = self.extract_variables(&patterns);
        let bindings = self.evaluate_patterns(&patterns, &variables);
        Ok(QueryResult::Select { variables, bindings })
    }

    /// Executa uma query SPARQL ASK.
    pub fn query_ask(&self, sparql: &str) -> Result<QueryResult, RdfError> {
        let patterns = self.parse_basic_sparql(sparql)?;
        let variables = self.extract_variables(&patterns);
        let bindings = self.evaluate_patterns(&patterns, &variables);
        Ok(QueryResult::Ask(!bindings.is_empty()))
    }

    /// Faz match de uma tripla contra o grafo, retornando bindings para variáveis.
    fn match_triple(
        &self,
        pattern: &TriplePattern,
        existing_bindings: &[BTreeMap<String, TermValue>],
    ) -> Vec<BTreeMap<String, TermValue>> {
        let mut results = Vec::new();

        // Se não há bindings existentes, começar com um binding vazio
        let start_bindings = if existing_bindings.is_empty() {
            vec![BTreeMap::new()]
        } else {
            existing_bindings.to_vec()
        };

        for mut binding in start_bindings {
            for triple in self.graph.triples() {
                let t = triple.unwrap();
                let s_str = t.s().to_string();
                let p_str = t.p().to_string();
                let o_str = t.o().to_string();

                let mut new_binding = binding.clone();
                let mut matches = true;

                // Match subject
                if !Self::match_term(&pattern.subject, &s_str, &mut new_binding) {
                    matches = false;
                }
                // Match predicate
                if matches && !Self::match_term(&pattern.predicate, &p_str, &mut new_binding) {
                    matches = false;
                }
                // Match object
                if matches && !Self::match_term(&pattern.object, &o_str, &mut new_binding) {
                    matches = false;
                }

                if matches {
                    results.push(new_binding);
                }
            }
        }

        results
    }

    fn match_term(
        pattern: &PatternTerm,
        value: &str,
        binding: &mut BTreeMap<String, TermValue>,
    ) -> bool {
        match pattern {
            PatternTerm::Any => true,
            PatternTerm::Iri(iri) => {
                // Comparação de IRI: normalizar ambas as formas
                let normalized = value.trim_start_matches('<').trim_end_matches('>');
                iri == normalized || iri == value
            }
            PatternTerm::Literal(lit) => {
                let cleaned = value.trim_start_matches('"').trim_end_matches('"');
                lit == cleaned || lit == value
            }
            PatternTerm::Variable(var) => {
                if let Some(existing) = binding.get(var) {
                    // Verificar consistência com binding existente
                    existing.as_str().map(|s| s == value).unwrap_or(false)
                        || value == existing.as_str().unwrap_or("")
                } else {
                    // Novo binding
                    let term_val = if value.starts_with('<') && value.ends_with('>') {
                        TermValue::Iri(value[1..value.len() - 1].to_string())
                    } else if value.starts_with("_:") {
                        TermValue::BlankNode(value[2..].to_string())
                    } else {
                        TermValue::Literal(value.to_string())
                    };
                    binding.insert(var.clone(), term_val);
                    true
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Avalia uma lista de padrões de tripla, acumulando bindings.
    fn evaluate_patterns(
        &self,
        patterns: &[TriplePattern],
        _variables: &[String],
    ) -> Vec<BTreeMap<String, TermValue>> {
        let mut current_bindings: Vec<BTreeMap<String, TermValue>> = vec![BTreeMap::new()];

        for pattern in patterns {
            current_bindings = self.match_triple(pattern, &current_bindings);
            if current_bindings.is_empty() {
                break; // Early exit — sem resultados possíveis
            }
        }

        current_bindings
    }

    /// Parser SPARQL básico — extrai padrões de tripla de SELECT WHERE.
    fn parse_basic_sparql(&self, sparql: &str) -> Result<Vec<TriplePattern>, RdfError> {
        let mut patterns = Vec::new();

        // Extrair o bloco WHERE { ... }
        let where_body = if let Some(start) = sparql.find('{') {
            if let Some(end) = sparql[start..].find('}') {
                &sparql[start + 1..start + end]
            } else {
                return Err(RdfError::QueryError("Unclosed WHERE clause".to_string()));
            }
        } else {
            return Err(RdfError::QueryError("No WHERE clause found".to_string()));
        };

        // Dividir em triplas por ponto-e-vírgula ou ponto final
        for triple_str in where_body.split(';') {
            let triple_str = triple_str.trim();
            if triple_str.is_empty() || triple_str.starts_with('#') {
                continue;
            }
            // Remover ponto final
            let triple_str = triple_str.trim_end_matches('.');

            let tokens: Vec<&str> = triple_str.split_whitespace().collect();
            if tokens.len() < 3 {
                continue;
            }

            let subject = self.parse_pattern_term(tokens[0])?;
            let predicate = self.parse_pattern_term(tokens[1])?;
            let object = self.parse_pattern_term(tokens[2])?;

            patterns.push(TriplePattern {
                subject,
                predicate,
                object,
            });
        }

        if patterns.is_empty() {
            return Err(RdfError::QueryError(
                "No triple patterns found in WHERE clause".to_string(),
            ));
        }

        Ok(patterns)
    }

    fn parse_pattern_term(&self, token: &str) -> Result<PatternTerm, RdfError> {
        if token.starts_with('?') || token.starts_with('$') {
            Ok(PatternTerm::Variable(token[1..].to_string()))
        } else if token == "a" {
            // "a" é shorthand para rdf:type
            Ok(PatternTerm::Iri(
                "http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type".to_string(),
            ))
        } else if token.starts_with('<') && token.ends_with('>') {
            Ok(PatternTerm::Iri(
                token[1..token.len() - 1].to_string(),
            ))
        } else if token.starts_with('"') {
            Ok(PatternTerm::Literal(token.to_string()))
        } else if token.contains(':') {
            // Prefixo — expandir
            let expanded = self.expand_prefix(token);
            Ok(PatternTerm::Iri(expanded))
        } else {
            Ok(PatternTerm::Any)
        }
    }

    /// Extrai variáveis úteis dos padrões (na ordem de aparição).
    fn extract_variables(&self, patterns: &[TriplePattern]) -> Vec<String> {
        let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
        let mut vars = Vec::new();

        for pattern in patterns {
            for term in [&pattern.subject, &pattern.predicate, &pattern.object] {
                if let PatternTerm::Variable(v) = term {
                    if seen.insert(v.clone()) {
                        vars.push(v.clone());
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        vars
    }

    /// Conta o número de triplas no grafo.
    pub fn triple_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.graph.triples().count()
    }

    /// Serializa para RDF/XML.
    pub fn to_rdf_xml(&self) -> Result<String, RdfError> {
        let mut output = Vec::new();
        sophia::xml::serializer::write_graph(&mut output, &self.graph)
            .map_err(|e| RdfError::SerializationError(e.to_string()))?;
        String::from_utf8(output).map_err(|e| RdfError::SerializationError(e.to_string()))
    }

    /// Serializa para Turtle.
    pub fn to_turtle(&self) -> Result<String, RdfError> {
        let mut output = Vec::new();
        let mut ser = sophia::turtle::serializer::turtle::TurtleSerializer::new(&mut output);
        ser.serialize_graph(&self.graph)
            .map_err(|e| RdfError::SerializationError(e.to_string()))?;
        String::from_utf8(output).map_err(|e| RdfError::SerializationError(e.to_string()))
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn sample_graph() -> WormGraphDataset {
        let mut ds = WormGraphDataset::new();
        ds.load_turtle(
            r#"
            @prefix ex: <http://example.org/> .
            @prefix dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/> .
            @prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .

            ex:book1 a ex:Book ;
                dc:title "The Arkhe Protocol" ;
                dc:creator ex:author1 ;
                ex:pages "420" .

            ex:book2 a ex:Book ;
                dc:title "Decentralized Intelligence" ;
                dc:creator ex:author2 ;
                ex:pages "350" .

            ex:author1 a ex:Person ;
                rdfs:label "Dr. Arkhe" .

            ex:author2 a ex:Person ;
                rdfs:label "Prof. Genesis" .
        "#,
        )
        .unwrap();
        ds
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_load_turtle() {
        let ds = sample_graph();
        assert!(ds.triple_count() > 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_load_rdf_xml() {
        let rdf_xml = r#"<?xml version="1.0"?>
            <rdf:RDF xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
                     xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
                <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://example.org/book">
                    <dc:title>Test Book</dc:title>
                </rdf:Description>
            </rdf:RDF>"#;
        let mut ds = WormGraphDataset::new();
        assert!(ds.load_rdf_xml(rdf_xml).is_ok());
        assert!(ds.triple_count() > 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_sparql_select_all_books() {
        let ds = sample_graph();
        let result = ds
            .query_select(
                "SELECT ?book ?title WHERE { ?book a ex:Book . ?book dc:title ?title . }",
            )
            .unwrap();

        if let QueryResult::Select { bindings, .. } = result {
            assert_eq!(bindings.len(), 2);
        } else {
            panic!("Expected Select result");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_sparql_ask() {
        let ds = sample_graph();
        let result = ds
            .query_ask("ASK { ?x a ex:Book . ?x dc:title \"The Arkhe Protocol\" . }")
            .unwrap();

        if let QueryResult::Ask(answer) = result {
            assert!(answer);
        } else {
            panic!("Expected Ask result");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_sparql_ask_negative() {
        let ds = sample_graph();
        let result = ds
            .query_ask("ASK { ?x a ex:Spaceship . }")
            .unwrap();

        if let QueryResult::Ask(answer) = result {
            assert!(!answer);
        } else {
            panic!("Expected Ask result");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_expand_prefix() {
        let ds = WormGraphDataset::new();
        assert_eq!(
            ds.expand_prefix("rdf:type"),
            "http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            ds.expand_prefix("skos:prefLabel"),
            "http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#prefLabel"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_roundtrip_turtle() {
        let ds = sample_graph();
        let ttl = ds.to_turtle().unwrap();
        assert!(ttl.contains("http://example.org/"));
        assert!(ttl.len() > 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_load_ntriples() {
        let nt = "<http://example.org/a> <http://example.org/b> <http://example.org/c> .\n";
        let mut ds = WormGraphDataset::new();
        assert!(ds.load_ntriples(nt).is_ok());
        assert_eq!(ds.triple_count(), 1);
    }
}
```
