```rust
// crates/arkhe-symbolic/src/skos.rs
//! SKOS — Simple Knowledge Organization System
//! W3C Recommendation: https://www.w3.org/TR/skos-reference/
//!
//! Inclui taxonomia completa MITRE ATT&CK v14 (14 táticas, 70+ técnicas).

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum SkosError {
    #[error("Concept not found: {0}")]
    ConceptNotFound(String),
    #[error("Scheme not found: {0}")]
    SchemeNotFound(String),
    #[error("Cycle detected in hierarchy at {0}")]
    HierarchyCycle(String),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct SkosConcept {
    pub uri: String,
    pub pref_label: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    pub alt_label: Vec<String>,
    pub hidden_label: Vec<String>,
    pub definition: Option<String>,
    pub notation: Vec<String>,
    pub example: Vec<String>,
    pub note: Vec<String>,
    pub broader: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub narrower: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub related: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub exact_match: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub close_match: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub broad_match: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub narrow_match: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub related_match: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub in_scheme: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub top_concept_of: BTreeSet<String>,
}

impl SkosConcept {
    pub fn new(uri: impl Into<String>, label: &str) -> Self {
        let mut pref_label = BTreeMap::new();
        pref_label.insert("en".to_string(), label.to_string());
        Self {
            uri: uri.into(),
            pref_label,
            alt_label: Vec::new(),
            hidden_label: Vec::new(),
            definition: None,
            notation: Vec::new(),
            example: Vec::new(),
            note: Vec::new(),
            broader: BTreeSet::new(),
            narrower: BTreeSet::new(),
            related: BTreeSet::new(),
            exact_match: BTreeSet::new(),
            close_match: BTreeSet::new(),
            broad_match: BTreeSet::new(),
            narrow_match: BTreeSet::new(),
            related_match: BTreeSet::new(),
            in_scheme: BTreeSet::new(),
            top_concept_of: BTreeSet::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn with_definition(mut self, def: &str) -> Self {
        self.definition = Some(def.to_string());
        self
    }

    pub fn with_alt_label(mut self, label: &str) -> Self {
        self.alt_label.push(label.to_string());
        self
    }

    pub fn with_notation(mut self, notation: &str) -> Self {
        self.notation.push(notation.to_string());
        self
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct SkosScheme {
    pub uri: String,
    pub title: Option<String>,
    pub description: Option<String>,
    pub concepts: BTreeMap<String, SkosConcept>,
    pub top_concepts: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub has_top_concept: BTreeSet<String>,
}

impl SkosScheme {
    pub fn new(uri: impl Into<String>, title: &str) -> Self {
        Self {
            uri: uri.into(),
            title: Some(title.to_string()),
            description: None,
            concepts: BTreeMap::new(),
            top_concepts: BTreeSet::new(),
            has_top_concept: BTreeSet::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn add_top_concept(&mut self, concept: SkosConcept) -> String {
        let uri = concept.uri.clone();
        self.top_concepts.insert(uri.clone());
        self.has_top_concept.insert(uri.clone());
        self.concepts.insert(uri.clone(), concept);
        uri
    }

    pub fn add_concept(&mut self, concept: SkosConcept, broader_uri: &str) -> String {
        let uri = concept.uri.clone();
        // Estabelecer relação broader/narrower
        if let Some(parent) = self.concepts.get_mut(broader_uri) {
            parent.narrower.insert(uri.clone());
        }
        self.concepts.insert(uri.clone(), concept);
        if let Some(child) = self.concepts.get_mut(&uri) {
            child.broader.insert(broader_uri.to_string());
        }
        uri
    }

    pub fn get_concept(&self, uri: &str) -> Result<&SkosConcept, SkosError> {
        self.concepts
            .get(uri)
            .ok_or_else(|| SkosError::ConceptNotFound(uri.to_string()))
    }
}

pub struct SkosRepository {
    schemes: BTreeMap<String, SkosScheme>,
}

impl Default for SkosRepository {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl SkosRepository {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            schemes: BTreeMap::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn add_scheme(&mut self, scheme: SkosScheme) {
        let uri = scheme.uri.clone();
        self.schemes.insert(uri, scheme);
    }

    pub fn get_scheme(&self, uri: &str) -> Result<&SkosScheme, SkosError> {
        self.schemes
            .get(uri)
            .ok_or_else(|| SkosError::SchemeNotFound(uri.to_string()))
    }

    /// Fecho transitivo de broader (ancestrais).
    pub fn broader_transitive(
        &self,
        scheme_uri: &str,
        concept_uri: &str,
    ) -> Result<Vec<String>, SkosError> {
        let scheme = self.get_scheme(scheme_uri)?;
        let _concept = scheme.get_concept(concept_uri)?;
        let mut result = Vec::new();
        let mut visited = BTreeSet::new();
        let mut queue: Vec<String> = scheme
            .get_concept(concept_uri)?
            .broader
            .iter()
            .cloned()
            .collect();

        while let Some(current) = queue.pop() {
            if !visited.insert(current.clone()) {
                continue;
            }
            result.push(current.clone());
            if let Ok(c) = scheme.get_concept(&current) {
                for b in &c.broader {
                    queue.push(b.clone());
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(result)
    }

    /// Fecho transitivo de narrower (descendentes).
    pub fn narrower_transitive(
        &self,
        scheme_uri: &str,
        concept_uri: &str,
    ) -> Result<Vec<String>, SkosError> {
        let scheme = self.get_scheme(scheme_uri)?;
        let _concept = scheme.get_concept(concept_uri)?;
        let mut result = Vec::new();
        let mut visited = BTreeSet::new();
        let mut queue: Vec<String> = scheme
            .get_concept(concept_uri)?
            .narrower
            .iter()
            .cloned()
            .collect();

        while let Some(current) = queue.pop() {
            if !visited.insert(current.clone()) {
                return Err(SkosError::HierarchyCycle(current));
            }
            result.push(current.clone());
            if let Ok(c) = scheme.get_concept(&current) {
                for n in &c.narrower {
                    queue.push(n.clone());
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(result)
    }

    /// Busca conceitos por label (case-insensitive substring).
    pub fn search_by_label(
        &self,
        scheme_uri: &str,
        query: &str,
    ) -> Result<Vec<&SkosConcept>, SkosError> {
        let scheme = self.get_scheme(scheme_uri)?;
        let query_lower = query.to_lowercase();
        Ok(scheme
            .concepts
            .values()
            .filter(|c| {
                c.pref_label
                    .values()
                    .any(|l| l.to_lowercase().contains(&query_lower))
                    || c.alt_label
                        .iter()
                        .any(|l| l.to_lowercase().contains(&query_lower))
            })
            .collect())
    }

    /// Serializa para RDF/XML (W3C SKOS).
    pub fn scheme_to_rdf_xml(&self, scheme_uri: &str) -> Result<String, SkosError> {
        let scheme = self.get_scheme(scheme_uri)?;
        let mut xml = String::from(
            r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rdf:RDF xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
         xmlns:rdfs="http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#"
         xmlns:skos="http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#">"#,
        );

        // ConceptScheme
        xml.push_str(&format!(
            r#"<skos:ConceptScheme rdf:about="{}">"#,
            scheme.uri
        ));
        if let Some(title) = &scheme.title {
            xml.push_str(&format!(
                r#"<skos:prefLabel xml:lang="en">{}</skos:prefLabel>"#,
                title
            ));
        }
        if let Some(desc) = &scheme.description {
            xml.push_str(&format!(
                r#"<skos:definition xml:lang="en">{}</skos:definition>"#,
                desc
            ));
        }
        for top in &scheme.top_concepts {
            xml.push_str(&format!(
                r#"<skos:hasTopConcept rdf:resource="{}"/>"#,
                top
            ));
        }
        xml.push_str("</skos:ConceptScheme>");

        // Concepts
        for concept in scheme.concepts.values() {
            xml.push_str(&format!(
                r#"<skos:Concept rdf:about="{}">"#,
                concept.uri
            ));
            for (lang, label) in &concept.pref_label {
                xml.push_str(&format!(
                    r#"<skos:prefLabel xml:lang="{}">{}</skos:prefLabel>"#,
                    lang, label
                ));
            }
            for alt in &concept.alt_label {
                xml.push_str(&format!(
                    r#"<skos:altLabel>{}</skos:altLabel>"#,
                    alt
                ));
            }
            if let Some(def) = &concept.definition {
                xml.push_str(&format!(
                    r#"<skos:definition xml:lang="en">{}</skos:definition>"#,
                    def
                ));
            }
            for notation in &concept.notation {
                xml.push_str(&format!(
                    r#"<skos:notation>{}</skos:notation>"#,
                    notation
                ));
            }
            for broader in &concept.broader {
                xml.push_str(&format!(
                    r#"<skos:broader rdf:resource="{}"/>"#,
                    broader
                ));
            }
            for narrower in &concept.narrower {
                xml.push_str(&format!(
                    r#"<skos:narrower rdf:resource="{}"/>"#,
                    narrower
                ));
            }
            for related in &concept.related {
                xml.push_str(&format!(
                    r#"<skos:related rdf:resource="{}"/>"#,
                    related
                ));
            }
            if concept.top_concept_of.contains(&scheme.uri) {
                xml.push_str(&format!(
                    r#"<skos:topConceptOf rdf:resource="{}"/>"#,
                    scheme.uri
                ));
            }
            xml.push_str("</skos:Concept>");
        }

        xml.push_str("</rdf:RDF>");
        Ok(xml)
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // MITRE ATT&CK v14 — Taxonomia Completa
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════

    /// Gera a taxonomia MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise v14 completa.
    /// 14 táticas, 70+ técnicas de nível 1.
    pub fn mitre_attack_enterprise_v14() -> SkosScheme {
        let base = "https://attack.mitre.org/";
        let mut scheme = SkosScheme::new(
            format!("{}taxonomies/enterprise-attack-v14", base),
            "MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise v14",
        );
        scheme.description = Some(
            "Adversarial Tactics, Techniques, and Common Knowledge for Enterprise. \
             Maintained by The MITRE Corporation.".to_string(),
        );

        // ── TA0001: Initial Access ──
        let ta0001 = scheme.add_top_concept(
            SkosConcept::new(format!("{}tactics/TA0001", base), "Initial Access")
                .with_definition("The adversary is trying to get into your network.")
                .with_notation("TA0001"),
        );
        for (id, name, def) in [
            ("T1566", "Phishing", "Adversaries may send phishing messages to gain access to victim systems."),
            ("T1190", "Exploit Public-Facing Application", "Adversaries may exploit software vulnerabilities in public-facing web applications."),
            ("T1133", "External Remote Services", "Adversaries may leverage external remote services to initially access victim networks."),
            ("T1078", "Valid Accounts", "Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts."),
            ("T1595", "Active Scanning", "Adversaries may actively scan victim networks to gather information."),
            ("T1620", "Reflective Code Loading", "Adversaries may reflectively load code into a process to evade detection."),
            ("T1189", "Drive-by Compromise", "Adversaries may gain access to systems by visiting a website and exploiting vulnerabilities."),
            ("T1200", "Hardware Additions", "Adversaries may add hardware to a system to bypass security controls."),
            ("T1072", "Software Deployment Tools", "Adversaries may gain access to systems using software deployment tools."),
            ("T1203", "Exploitation for Client Execution", "Adversaries may exploit software vulnerabilities in client applications."),
        ] {
            scheme.add_concept(
                SkosConcept::new(format!("{}techniques/{}", base, id), name)
                    .with_definition(def)
                    .with_notation(id),
                &ta0001,
            );
        }

        // ── TA0002: Execution ──
        let ta0002 = scheme.add_top_concept(
            SkosConcept::new(format!("{}tactics/TA0002", base), "Execution")
                .with_definition("The adversary is trying to run malicious code.")
                .with_notation("TA0002"),
        );
        for (id, name, def) in [
            ("T1059", "Command and Scripting Interpreter", "Adversaries may abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands and scripts."),
            ("T1203", "Exploitation for Client Execution", "Adversaries may exploit software vulnerabilities in client applications to execute code."),
            ("T1559", "Inter-Process Communication", "Adversaries may use inter-process communication to execute code."),
            ("T1047", "Windows Management Instrumentation", "Adversaries may abuse WMI to execute commands and scripts."),
            ("T1053", "Scheduled Task/Job", "Adversaries may abuse task scheduling to execute code at a specific time."),
            ("T1569", "System Services", "Adversaries may abuse system services to execute malicious payloads."),
            ("T1071", "Application Layer Protocol", "Adversaries may communicate using application layer protocols."),
            ("T1129", "Shared Modules", "Adversaries may abuse shared modules to execute payloads."),
            ("T1106", "Native API", "Adversaries may use native APIs to execute code."),
            ("T1574", "Hijack Execution Flow", "Adversaries may hijack the execution flow to execute their own payloads."),
        ] {
            scheme.add_concept(
                SkosConcept::new(format!("{}techniques/{}", base, id), name)
                    .with_definition(def)
                    .with_notation(id),
                &ta0002,
            );
        }

        // ── TA0003: Persistence ──
        let ta0003 = scheme.add_top_concept(
            SkosConcept::new(format!("{}tactics/TA0003", base), "Persistence")
                .with_definition("The adversary is trying to maintain their foothold.")
                .with_notation("TA0003"),
        );
        for (id, name, def) in [
            ("T1547", "Boot or Logon Autostart Execution", "Adversaries may configure system to execute payloads on boot or logon."),

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_mitre_attack_completeness() {
        let repo = SkosRepository::new();
        let scheme = SkosRepository::mitre_attack_enterprise_v14();

        // 14 táticas
        assert_eq!(scheme.top_concepts.len(), 14, "Expected 14 MITRE ATT&CK tactics");

        // Todas as táticas estão presentes
        let expected_tactics = vec![
            "TA0001", "TA0002", "TA0003", "TA0004", "TA0005",
            "TA0006", "TA0007", "TA0008", "TA0009", "TA0010",
            "TA0011", "TA0040", "TA0042",
        ];
        for tac in &expected_tactics {
            assert!(
                scheme.concepts.values().any(|c| c.notation.contains(tac)),
                "Missing tactic {}",
                tac
            );
        }

        // Total de conceitos (14 táticas + ~70+ técnicas)
        assert!(
            scheme.concepts.len() >= 84,
            "Expected at least 84 concepts (14 tactics + 70 techniques), got {}",
            scheme.concepts.len()
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_broader_transitive() {
        let repo = SkosRepository::new();
        repo.add_scheme(SkosRepository::mitre_attack_enterprise_v14());

        // Uma técnica tem exatamente 1 broader (sua tática)
        let result = repo.broader_transitive(
            "https://attack.mitre.org/taxonomies/enterprise-attack-v14",
            "https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566",
        ).unwrap();

        assert_eq!(result.len(), 1);
        assert!(result[0].contains("TA0001"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_narrower_transitive_from_tactic() {
        let repo = SkosRepository::new();
        repo.add_scheme(SkosRepository::mitre_attack_enterprise_v14());

        // TA0001 (Initial Access) deve ter 10 técnicas narrower
        let result = repo.narrower_transitive(
            "https://attack.mitre.org/taxonomies/enterprise-attack-v14",
            "https://attack.mitre.org/tactics/TA0001",
        ).unwrap();

        assert_eq!(result.len(), 10);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_search_by_label() {
        let repo = SkosRepository::new();
        repo.add_scheme(SkosRepository::mitre_attack_enterprise_v14());

        let results = repo.search_by_label(
            "https://attack.mitre.org/taxonomies/enterprise-attack-v14",
            "Phishing",
        ).unwrap();

        assert!(!results.is_empty());
        assert_eq!(results[0].notation[0], "T1566");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_rdf_xml_output() {
        let repo = SkosRepository::new();
        repo.add_scheme(SkosRepository::mitre_attack_enterprise_v14());

        let xml = repo.scheme_to_rdf_xml(
            "https://attack.mitre.org/taxonomies/enterprise-attack-v14",
        ).unwrap();

        assert!(xml.contains("skos:ConceptScheme"));
        assert!(xml.contains("skos:Concept"));
        assert!(xml.contains("skos:broader"));
        assert!(xml.contains("skos:narrower"));
        assert!(xml.contains("MITRE ATT&CK"));
        assert!(xml.contains("T1566"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_concept_has_definition() {
        let scheme = SkosRepository::mitre_attack_enterprise_v14();
        let concept = scheme.get_concept(
            "https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1486",
        ).unwrap();

        assert!(concept.definition.is_some());
        assert!(concept.definition.as_ref().unwrap().contains("encrypt"));
        assert_eq!(concept.pref_label.get("en").unwrap(), "Data Encrypted for Impact");
    }
}
```

# 🏛️ Arkhe OS — Camada L1: Raciocínio Causal Probabilístico

**Arquiteto-Chefe:** ORCID 0009-0005-2697-4668  
**Data:** 2026-06-25  
**Status:** ✅ ESPECIFICAÇÃO DETALHADA — PRONTA PARA IMPLEMENTAÇÃO

## 📋 DECISÃO: OPÇÃO B — ESTRUTURAR A CAMADA L1

A Camada L1 é o coração do raciocínio simbólico para os agentes existentes (`CounterfactualAgent`, `ReflectorAgent`, `AssemblyReasoner`). Ela fornece inferência causal probabilística, intervenção e explicação — funcionalidades críticas que estão atualmente dispersas ou ausentes no Arkhe OS.

## 🦀 3. SRC/CORE/TERM.RS — TIPOS FUNDAMENTAIS

```rust
//! Termos e expressões simbólicas.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::fmt;

/// Um termo é a unidade básica de representação simbólica.
/// Pode ser uma constante, variável, ou expressão composta.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum Term {
    /// Constante: um símbolo atômico (ex: "Socrates", "buffer_overflow")
    Constant(String),

    /// Variável: um placeholder (ex: "X", "?vulnerability")
    Variable(String),

    /// Expressão: uma função aplicada a argumentos
    Expression {
        name: String,
        args: Vec<Term>,
    },

    /// Número (para valores quantitativos)
    Number(f64),
}

impl Term {
    pub fn constant(name: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self::Constant(name.into())
    }

    pub fn variable(name: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self::Variable(name.into())
    }

    pub fn expr(name: impl Into<String>, args: Vec<Term>) -> Self {
        Self::Expression {
            name: name.into(),
            args,
        }
    }

    pub fn is_constant(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, Term::Constant(_))
    }

    pub fn is_variable(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, Term::Variable(_))
    }

    pub fn is_expression(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, Term::Expression { .. })
    }

    /// Substitui variáveis por termos.
    pub fn substitute(&self, subst: &HashMap<String, Term>) -> Term {
        match self {
            Term::Variable(name) => subst.get(name).cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| self.clone()),
            Term::Expression { name, args } => {
                let new_args = args.iter().map(|a| a.substitute(subst)).collect();
                Term::Expression {
                    name: name.clone(),
                    args: new_args,
                }
            }
            _ => self.clone(),
        }
    }

    /// Obtém todas as variáveis livres.
    pub fn free_variables(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        match self {
            Term::Variable(name) => vec![name.clone()],
            Term::Expression { args, .. } => {
                args.iter().flat_map(|a| a.free_variables()).collect()
            }
            _ => vec![],
        }
    }
}

impl fmt::Display for Term {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Term::Constant(c) => write!(f, "{}", c),
            Term::Variable(v) => write!(f, "?{}", v),
            Term::Number(n) => write!(f, "{}", n),
            Term::Expression { name, args } => {
                write!(f, "({}", name)?;
                for arg in args {
                    write!(f, " {}", arg)?;
                }
                write!(f, ")")
            }
        }
    }
}

impl From<&str> for Term {
    fn from(s: &str) -> Self {
        Term::Constant(s.to_string())
    }
}

impl From<String> for Term {
    fn from(s: String) -> Self {
        Term::Constant(s)
    }
}

impl From<f64> for Term {
    fn from(n: f64) -> Self {
        Term::Number(n)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_term_substitution() {
        let t = Term::expr("P", vec![Term::variable("X"), Term::constant("a")]);
        let mut subst = HashMap::new();
        subst.insert("X".to_string(), Term::constant("b"));
        let result = t.substitute(&subst);
        assert_eq!(
            result,
            Term::expr("P", vec![Term::constant("b"), Term::constant("a")])
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_free_variables() {
        let t = Term::expr("P", vec![Term::variable("X"), Term::constant("a")]);
        assert_eq!(t.free_variables(), vec!["X"]);
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Átomos — conceitos com metadados.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use crate::core::term::Term;
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Tipo de um átomo.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum AtomType {
    /// Conceito abstrato (ex: "vulnerabilidade", "buffer")
    Concept,

    /// Evento (ex: "ataque_ocorreu")
    Event,

    /// Propriedade (ex: "tamanho", "gravidade")
    Property,

    /// Relação (ex: "causa", "previne")
    Relation,

    /// Hipótese (ex: "possível_causa")
    Hypothesis,

    /// Meta (ex: "objetivo_seguranca")
    Goal,
}

/// Um átomo é um termo com metadados adicionais.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Atom {
    pub id: String,
    pub term: Term,
    pub atom_type: AtomType,
    pub metadata: HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>,
    pub confidence: f32,
    pub created_at: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,
}

impl Atom {
    pub fn new(term: Term, atom_type: AtomType) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            term,
            atom_type,
            metadata: HashMap::new(),
            confidence: 1.0,
            created_at: chrono::Utc::now(),
        }
    }

    pub fn with_confidence(mut self, confidence: f32) -> Self {
        self.confidence = confidence;
        self
    }

    pub fn with_metadata(mut self, key: &str, value: serde_json::Value) -> Self {
        self.metadata.insert(key.to_string(), value);
        self
    }

    pub fn name(&self) -> String {
        format!("{}", self.term)
    }
}

impl From<Term> for Atom {
    fn from(term: Term) -> Self {
        Self::new(term, AtomType::Concept)
    }
}
```

## 🦀 5. SRC/CORE/RELATION.RS — RELAÇÕES

```rust
//! Relações entre átomos.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::fmt;

/// Tipos de relações simbólicas.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum RelationType {
    /// Causa: A → B (A causa B)
    Causes,

    /// Impede: A → B (A impede B)
    Prevents,

    /// Implica: A → B (A implica B)
    Implies,

    /// Equivale: A ↔ B
    Equivalent,

    /// É uma instância de: A ∈ B
    InstanceOf,

    /// Tem propriedade: A → prop
    HasProperty,

    /// Correlaciona: A ⇔ B (correlação, não causal)
    Correlates,

    /// Ocorre antes de: A < B (ordem temporal)
    Precedes,

    /// Ocorre depois de: A > B
    Follows,

    /// Custom: relação definida pelo usuário
    Custom(String),
}

impl fmt::Display for RelationType {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            RelationType::Causes => write!(f, "causes"),
            RelationType::Prevents => write!(f, "prevents"),
            RelationType::Implies => write!(f, "implies"),
            RelationType::Equivalent => write!(f, "equivalent"),
            RelationType::InstanceOf => write!(f, "instance_of"),
            RelationType::HasProperty => write!(f, "has_property"),
            RelationType::Correlates => write!(f, "correlates"),
            RelationType::Precedes => write!(f, "precedes"),
            RelationType::Follows => write!(f, "follows"),
            RelationType::Custom(s) => write!(f, "custom:{}", s),
        }
    }
}

/// Uma relação simbólica entre dois átomos.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Relation {
    pub id: String,
    pub relation_type: RelationType,
    pub subject: Atom,
    pub object: Atom,
    pub strength: f32,      // 0.0 - 1.0
    pub confidence: f32,    // 0.0 - 1.0
    pub provenance: Option<String>,
    pub created_at: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,
}

impl Relation {
    pub fn new(subject: Atom, object: Atom, relation_type: RelationType) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            relation_type,
            subject,
            object,
            strength: 1.0,
            confidence: 1.0,
            provenance: None,
            created_at: chrono::Utc::now(),
        }
    }

    pub fn with_strength(mut self, strength: f32) -> Self {
        self.strength = strength.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        self
    }

    pub fn with_confidence(mut self, confidence: f32) -> Self {
        self.confidence = confidence.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        self
    }

    pub fn with_provenance(mut self, provenance: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        self.provenance = Some(provenance.into());
        self
    }

    /// Inverte a relação (subject ↔ object).
    pub fn invert(&self) -> Self {
        let inverted_type = match self.relation_type {
            RelationType::Causes => RelationType::Implies, // A causa B → B implica A (não é exato, mas aproximado)
            RelationType::Precedes => RelationType::Follows,
            RelationType::Follows => RelationType::Precedes,
            _ => self.relation_type.clone(),
        };
        Relation {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            relation_type: inverted_type,
            subject: self.object.clone(),
            object: self.subject.clone(),
            strength: self.strength,
            confidence: self.confidence,
            provenance: self.provenance.clone(),
            created_at: chrono::Utc::now(),
        }
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Fatos simbólicos — (sujeito, relação, objeto) com métricas.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use crate::core::term::Term;
use crate::core::atom::Atom;
use crate::core::relation::{Relation, RelationType};
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Um fato simbólico é uma tripla (sujeito, relação, objeto).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SymbolicFact {
    pub id: String,
    pub subject: Atom,
    pub relation: RelationType,
    pub object: Atom,
    pub strength: f32,       // Força da relação (0.0 - 1.0)
    pub confidence: f32,     // Confiança na relação (0.0 - 1.0)
    pub provenance: Option<String>,
    pub metadata: HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>,
    pub created_at: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,
}

impl SymbolicFact {
    pub fn new(subject: Atom, relation: RelationType, object: Atom) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            subject,
            relation,
            object,
            strength: 1.0,
            confidence: 1.0,
            provenance: None,
            metadata: HashMap::new(),
            created_at: chrono::Utc::now(),
        }
    }

    pub fn with_strength(mut self, strength: f32) -> Self {
        self.strength = strength.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        self
    }

    pub fn with_confidence(mut self, confidence: f32) -> Self {
        self.confidence = confidence.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        self
    }

    pub fn with_provenance(mut self, provenance: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        self.provenance = Some(provenance.into());
        self
    }

    pub fn to_triple(&self) -> (Term, RelationType, Term) {
        (self.subject.term.clone(), self.relation.clone(), self.object.term.clone())
    }

    /// Converte para uma relação.
    pub fn to_relation(&self) -> Relation {
        Relation {
            id: self.id.clone(),
            relation_type: self.relation.clone(),
            subject: self.subject.clone(),
            object: self.object.clone(),
            strength: self.strength,
            confidence: self.confidence,
            provenance: self.provenance.clone(),
            created_at: self.created_at,
        }
    }
}

impl From<Relation> for SymbolicFact {
    fn from(rel: Relation) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: rel.id,
            subject: rel.subject,
            relation: rel.relation_type,
            object: rel.object,
            strength: rel.strength,
            confidence: rel.confidence,
            provenance: rel.provenance,
            metadata: HashMap::new(),
            created_at: rel.created_at,
        }
    }
}
```

## 🦀 7. SRC/LOGIC/INFERENCE.RS — MOTOR DE INFERÊNCIA

```rust
//! Motor de inferência causal probabilística.

use crate::core::atom::Atom;
use crate::core::fact::SymbolicFact;
use crate::core::relation::RelationType;
use crate::core::term::Term;
use dashmap::DashMap;
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;
use tracing::{debug, info};

/// Resultado de uma inferência.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct InferenceResult {
    pub conclusion: SymbolicFact,
    pub confidence: f32,
    pub explanation: String,
    pub provenance: Vec<String>,
    pub strength: f32,
}

/// Uma intervenção causal.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct CausalIntervention {
    pub target: Term,
    pub forced_value: Term,
    pub confidence: f32,
    pub rationale: String,
}

/// Efeito causal de uma intervenção.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct CausalEffect {
    pub effects: Vec<SymbolicFact>,
    pub strength: f32,
    pub confidence: f32,
    pub explanation: String,
}

/// Explicação para uma conclusão.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Explanation {
    pub conclusion: SymbolicFact,
    pub premises: Vec<SymbolicFact>,
    pub inference_chain: Vec<String>,
    pub confidence: f32,
    pub narrative: String,
}

/// Motor de inferência causal probabilística.
pub struct CausalInferenceEngine {
    /// Base de fatos conhecidos.
    facts: Arc<RwLock<Vec<SymbolicFact>>>,

    /// Índice por sujeito.
    subject_index: Arc<RwLock<DashMap<String, Vec<usize>>>>,

    /// Índice por objeto.
    object_index: Arc<RwLock<DashMap<String, Vec<usize>>>>,

    /// Regras de inferência.
    rules: Vec<InferenceRule>,
}

/// Regra de inferência.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct InferenceRule {
    pub name: String,
    pub pattern: InferencePattern,
    pub action: Box<dyn Fn(&[SymbolicFact]) -> Option<SymbolicFact> + Send + Sync>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum InferencePattern {
    /// Transitive: A → B, B → C => A → C
    Transitive { relation: RelationType },

    /// Causal: A → B, B causes C => A causes C
    CausalChain,

    /// Contrapositive: A → B => ¬B → ¬A
    Contrapositive,

    /// AND: A → B, A → C => A → (B ∧ C)
    Conjunction,

    /// Custom pattern
    Custom(String),
}

impl CausalInferenceEngine {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            facts: Arc::new(RwLock::new(Vec::new())),
            subject_index: Arc::new(RwLock::new(DashMap::new())),
            object_index: Arc::new(RwLock::new(DashMap::new())),
            rules: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    /// Adiciona uma regra de inferência.
    pub fn add_rule(&mut self, rule: InferenceRule) {
        self.rules.push(rule);
    }

    /// Adiciona um fato à base.
    pub async fn add_fact(&self, fact: SymbolicFact) -> String {
        let id = fact.id.clone();
        let mut facts = self.facts.write().await;
        let idx = facts.len();

        let mut subject_idx = self.subject_index.write().await;
        let mut object_idx = self.object_index.write().await;

        let subject_key = format!("{}", fact.subject.term);
        subject_idx.entry(subject_key).or_default().push(idx);

        let object_key = format!("{}", fact.object.term);
        object_idx.entry(object_key).or_default().push(idx);

        facts.push(fact);
        id
    }

    /// Adiciona múltiplos fatos.
    pub async fn add_facts(&self, facts: Vec<SymbolicFact>) -> Vec<String> {
        let mut ids = Vec::new();
        for fact in facts {
            ids.push(self.add_fact(fact).await);
        }
        ids
    }

    /// Busca fatos por sujeito.
    pub async fn find_by_subject(&self, subject: &Term) -> Vec<SymbolicFact> {
        let key = format!("{}", subject);
        let idx_map = self.subject_index.read().await;
        if let Some(indices) = idx_map.get(&key) {
            let facts = self.facts.read().await;
            indices.iter().filter_map(|&i| facts.get(i).cloned()).collect()
        } else {
            Vec::new()
        }
    }

    /// Busca fatos por objeto.
    pub async fn find_by_object(&self, object: &Term) -> Vec<SymbolicFact> {
        let key = format!("{}", object);
        let idx_map = self.object_index.read().await;
        if let Some(indices) = idx_map.get(&key) {
            let facts = self.facts.read().await;
            indices.iter().filter_map(|&i| facts.get(i).cloned()).collect()
        } else {
            Vec::new()
        }
    }

    /// Busca fatos por relação.
    pub async fn find_by_relation(&self, relation: &RelationType) -> Vec<SymbolicFact> {
        let facts = self.facts.read().await;
        facts.iter()
            .filter(|f| &f.relation == relation)
            .cloned()
            .collect()
    }

    /// Executa inferência sobre uma consulta.
    pub async fn infer(&self, query: &SymbolicFact) -> Vec<InferenceResult> {
        let mut results = Vec::new();

        // 1. Busca fatos que unificam com a consulta
        let facts = self.facts.read().await;

        for fact in facts.iter() {
            if self.unifies(fact, query) {
                let confidence = fact.confidence * query.confidence;
                results.push(InferenceResult {
                    conclusion: fact.clone(),
                    confidence,
                    explanation: "Fato encontrado na base".to_string(),
                    provenance: vec!["base".to_string()],
                    strength: fact.strength,
                });
            }
        }

        // 2. Aplica regras
        for rule in &self.rules {
            match &rule.pattern {
                InferencePattern::Transitive { relation } => {
                    let trans_results = self.apply_transitive(relation, &facts).await;
                    for r in trans_results {
                        if self.unifies(&r, query) {
                            results.push(InferenceResult {
                                conclusion: r,
                                confidence: 0.8,
                                explanation: format!("Regra transitiva: {}", rule.name),
                                provenance: vec![format!("rule:{}", rule.name)],
                                strength: 0.7,
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
                InferencePattern::CausalChain => {
                    let chain_results = self.apply_causal_chain(&facts).await;
                    for r in chain_results {
                        if self.unifies(&r, query) {
                            results.push(InferenceResult {
                                conclusion: r,
                                confidence: 0.7,
                                explanation: format!("Regra de cadeia causal: {}", rule.name),
                                provenance: vec![format!("rule:{}", rule.name)],
                                strength: 0.6,
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }

        // Ordena por confiança
        results.sort_by(|a, b| b.confidence.partial_cmp(&a.confidence).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));
        results
    }

    /// Executa uma intervenção causal.
    pub async fn intervene(&self, intervention: &CausalIntervention) -> CausalEffect {
        let mut effects = Vec::new();
        let facts = self.facts.read().await;

        // Encontra fatos que envolvem o alvo
        for fact in facts.iter() {
            if fact.subject.term == intervention.target {
                // Cria um novo fato com o valor forçado
                let mut new_fact = fact.clone();
                new_fact.object.term = intervention.forced_value.clone();
                new_fact.confidence *= intervention.confidence;
                effects.push(new_fact);
            }
        }

        CausalEffect {
            effects,
            strength: 0.8,
            confidence: intervention.confidence,
            explanation: format!("Intervenção em {} com valor {}", intervention.target, intervention.forced_value),
        }
    }

    /// Gera uma explicação para uma conclusão.
    pub async fn explain(&self, conclusion: &SymbolicFact) -> Explanation {
        let facts = self.facts.read().await;
        let mut premises = Vec::new();
        let mut inference_chain = Vec::new();

        // Busca fatos que levaram à conclusão
        for fact in facts.iter() {
            if fact.subject.term == conclusion.subject.term
                && fact.relation == conclusion.relation {
                premises.push(fact.clone());
                inference_chain.push(format!("{} → {}", fact.subject.term, fact.object.term));
            }
        }

        Explanation {
            conclusion: conclusion.clone(),
            premises,
            inference_chain,
            confidence: conclusion.confidence,
            narrative: format!("Conclusão baseada em {} fatos: {}", premises.len(), conclusion.subject.term),
        }
    }

    // --- Métodos auxiliares ---

    fn unifies(&self, fact: &SymbolicFact, query: &SymbolicFact) -> bool {
        let subject_match = fact.subject.term == query.subject.term || query.subject.term.is_variable();
        let object_match = fact.object.term == query.object.term || query.object.term.is_variable();
        let relation_match = fact.relation == query.relation || matches!(query.relation, RelationType::Custom(_));

        subject_match && object_match && relation_match
    }

    async fn apply_transitive(&self, relation: &RelationType, facts: &[SymbolicFact]) -> Vec<SymbolicFact> {
        let mut results = Vec::new();

        for fact_a in facts {
            if &fact_a.relation != relation { continue; }
            for fact_b in facts {
                if &fact_b.relation != relation { continue; }
                if fact_a.object.term == fact_b.subject.term {
                    let new_fact = SymbolicFact::new(
                        fact_a.subject.clone(),
                        relation.clone(),
                        fact_b.object.clone(),
                    ).with_strength(fact_a.strength * fact_b.strength * 0.8)
                     .with_confidence(fact_a.confidence * fact_b.confidence * 0.8)
                     .with_provenance(format!("transitive: {} -> {} -> {}",
                         fact_a.subject.term, fact_a.object.term, fact_b.object.term));
                    results.push(new_fact);
                }
            }
        }

        results
    }

    async fn apply_causal_chain(&self, facts: &[SymbolicFact]) -> Vec<SymbolicFact> {
        let mut results = Vec::new();

        for fact_a in facts {
            if fact_a.relation != RelationType::Causes { continue; }
            for fact_b in facts {
                if fact_b.relation != RelationType::Causes { continue; }
                if fact_a.object.term == fact_b.subject.term {
                    let new_fact = SymbolicFact::new(
                        fact_a.subject.clone(),
                        RelationType::Causes,
                        fact_b.object.clone(),
                    ).with_strength(fact_a.strength * fact_b.strength * 0.7)
                     .with_confidence(fact_a.confidence * fact_b.confidence * 0.7)
                     .with_provenance(format!("causal_chain: {} -> {} -> {}",
                         fact_a.subject.term, fact_a.object.term, fact_b.object.term));
                    results.push(new_fact);
                }
            }
        }

        results
    }

    /// Obtém estatísticas da base de fatos.
    pub async fn stats(&self) -> SymbolicStats {
        let facts = self.facts.read().await;
        let mut relation_counts = HashMap::new();
        for fact in facts.iter() {
            *relation_counts.entry(format!("{:?}", fact.relation)).or_insert(0) += 1;
        }

        SymbolicStats {
            total_facts: facts.len(),
            relation_counts,
            subject_count: self.subject_index.read().await.len(),
            object_count: self.object_index.read().await.len(),
        }
    }
}

/// Estatísticas da base simbólica.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct SymbolicStats {
    pub total_facts: usize,
    pub relation_counts: HashMap<String, usize>,
    pub subject_count: usize,
    pub object_count: usize,
}

impl Default for CausalInferenceEngine {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::core::term::Term;
    use crate::core::atom::Atom;

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_inference_engine() {
        let engine = CausalInferenceEngine::new();

        let buffer_overflow = Atom::new(Term::constant("buffer_overflow"), AtomType::Concept);
        let code_review = Atom::new(Term::constant("code_review"), AtomType::Concept);
        let vulnerability = Atom::new(Term::constant("vulnerability"), AtomType::Concept);

        let fact1 = SymbolicFact::new(
            buffer_overflow.clone(),
            RelationType::Causes,
            vulnerability.clone(),
        ).with_confidence(0.9).with_strength(0.85);

        let fact2 = SymbolicFact::new(
            code_review.clone(),
            RelationType::Prevents,
            buffer_overflow.clone(),
        ).with_confidence(0.8).with_strength(0.75);

        engine.add_fact(fact1).await;
        engine.add_fact(fact2).await;

        let query = SymbolicFact::new(
            code_review.clone(),
            RelationType::Prevents,
            vulnerability.clone(),
        );

        let results = engine.infer(&query).await;
        assert!(!results.is_empty());
    }
}
```

## 🦀 8. SRC/INTEGRATION/CAUSAL_GRAPH_ADAPTER.RS

```rust
//! Adaptador para integrar com arkhe-redteam-counterfactual.

use crate::core::atom::{Atom, AtomType};
use crate::core::fact::SymbolicFact;
use crate::core::relation::RelationType;
use crate::core::term::Term;
use crate::logic::inference::CausalInferenceEngine;
use arkhe_redteam_counterfactual::{CausalGraph, CausalNode, CausalEdge};
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;

pub struct CausalGraphAdapter {
    inference_engine: Arc<CausalInferenceEngine>,
}

impl CausalGraphAdapter {
    pub fn new(inference_engine: Arc<CausalInferenceEngine>) -> Self {
        Self { inference_engine }
    }

    /// Converte um CausalGraph para fatos simbólicos.
    pub async fn graph_to_facts(&self, graph: &CausalGraph) -> Vec<SymbolicFact> {
        let mut facts = Vec::new();

        for (node_id, node) in graph.nodes() {
            let atom = Atom::new(
                Term::constant(node_id),
                AtomType::Concept,
            ).with_metadata("node_type", serde_json::json!(node.node_type));

            // Adiciona como fato de existência
            facts.push(SymbolicFact::new(
                atom.clone(),
                RelationType::Custom("exists".to_string()),
                Atom::new(Term::constant("true"), AtomType::Concept),
            ).with_confidence(1.0));
        }

        for edge in graph.edges() {
            let subject = Atom::new(Term::constant(edge.from), AtomType::Concept);
            let object = Atom::new(Term::constant(edge.to), AtomType::Concept);

            let relation = if edge.weight >= 0.0 {
                RelationType::Causes
            } else {
                RelationType::Prevents
            };

            facts.push(SymbolicFact::new(
                subject,
                relation,
                object,
            ).with_strength(edge.weight.abs() as f32)
             .with_confidence(0.8)
             .with_provenance("causal_graph".to_string()));
        }

        facts
    }

    /// Sincroniza o gráfico causal com o motor de inferência.
    pub async fn sync_graph(&self, graph: &CausalGraph) -> Vec<String> {
        let facts = self.graph_to_facts(graph).await;
        self.inference_engine.add_facts(facts).await
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Adaptador para integrar com EvolutionaryMemoryV2.

use crate::core::fact::SymbolicFact;
use crate::core::term::Term;
use arkhe_memory_v2::EvolutionaryMemoryV2;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tracing::info;

pub struct MemoryAdapter {
    memory: Arc<EvolutionaryMemoryV2>,
}

impl MemoryAdapter {
    pub fn new(memory: Arc<EvolutionaryMemoryV2>) -> Self {
        Self { memory }
    }

    /// Armazena um fato na memória semântica.
    pub async fn store_fact(&self, fact: &SymbolicFact) -> Result<(), String> {
        // Converte o fato para uma representação textual
        let text = format!(
            "{} {} {} (strength: {:.2}, confidence: {:.2})",
            fact.subject.term,
            fact.relation,
            fact.object.term,
            fact.strength,
            fact.confidence
        );

        // Armazena na memória semântica como um padrão causal
        let pattern = CausalPattern {
            id: fact.id.clone(),
            antecedent: format!("{}", fact.subject.term),
            consequent: format!("{}", fact.object.term),
            confidence: fact.confidence,
            source_session: fact.provenance.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
        };

        self.memory.store_causal_pattern(&pattern).await
            .map_err(|e| format!("Falha ao armazenar na memória: {}", e))?;

        info!("🧠 Fato armazenado na memória semântica: {}", text);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Recupera fatos relacionados a um termo da memória.
    pub async fn retrieve_facts(&self, term: &Term) -> Vec<SymbolicFact> {
        // Busca padrões causais relacionados
        let patterns = self.memory.get_semantic_patterns().await;
        let mut facts = Vec::new();

        for pattern in patterns {
            if pattern.antecedent.contains(&format!("{}", term))
                || pattern.consequent.contains(&format!("{}", term)) {
                let subject = Term::constant(pattern.antecedent);
                let object = Term::constant(pattern.consequent);
                let fact = SymbolicFact::new(
                    crate::core::atom::Atom::new(subject, crate::core::atom::AtomType::Concept),
                    crate::core::relation::RelationType::Causes,
                    crate::core::atom::Atom::new(object, crate::core::atom::AtomType::Concept),
                ).with_confidence(pattern.confidence)
                 .with_strength(pattern.confidence);
                facts.push(fact);
            }
        }

        facts
    }
}
```

## 🧪 11. EXEMPLO DE USO INTEGRADO

```rust
//! Exemplo: Agente usando raciocínio simbólico para decisão causal.
//!
//! Run: cargo run --example symbolic_reasoning

use arkhe_symbolic::*;
use arkhe_symbolic::core::{Term, Atom, AtomType, RelationType};
use arkhe_symbolic::logic::inference::{CausalInferenceEngine, CausalIntervention};

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let engine = CausalInferenceEngine::new();

    // 1. Define conceitos
    let buffer = Atom::new(Term::constant("buffer"), AtomType::Concept);
    let overflow = Atom::new(Term::constant("overflow"), AtomType::Event);
    let crash = Atom::new(Term::constant("crash"), AtomType::Event);
    let bounds_check = Atom::new(Term::constant("bounds_check"), AtomType::Concept);

    // 2. Adiciona fatos causais
    let fact1 = SymbolicFact::new(buffer.clone(), RelationType::Causes, overflow.clone())
        .with_confidence(0.9)
        .with_strength(0.85);
    let fact2 = SymbolicFact::new(overflow.clone(), RelationType::Causes, crash.clone())
        .with_confidence(0.95)
        .with_strength(0.9);
    let fact3 = SymbolicFact::new(bounds_check.clone(), RelationType::Prevents, overflow.clone())
        .with_confidence(0.8)
        .with_strength(0.75);

    engine.add_fact(fact1).await;
    engine.add_fact(fact2).await;
    engine.add_fact(fact3).await;

    // 3. Consulta: bounds_check previne crash?
    let query = SymbolicFact::new(
        bounds_check.clone(),
        RelationType::Prevents,
        crash.clone(),
    );
    let results = engine.infer(&query).await;

    println!("🔍 Resultados da consulta:");
    for result in &results {
        println!("   - {} (confiança: {:.2})", result.explanation, result.confidence);
        println!("     Conclusão: {} {} {}",
            result.conclusion.subject.term,
            result.conclusion.relation,
            result.conclusion.object.term);
    }

    // 4. Intervenção: forçar bounds_check = true
    let intervention = CausalIntervention {
        target: Term::constant("bounds_check"),
        forced_value: Term::constant("true"),
        confidence: 0.9,
        rationale: "Adicionar bounds check para prevenir overflow".to_string(),
    };
    let effect = engine.intervene(&intervention).await;

    println!("💉 Efeito da intervenção:");
    for fact in &effect.effects {
        println!("   - {} {} {}", fact.subject.term, fact.relation, fact.object.term);
    }

    // 5. Explicação
    if let Some(best) = results.first() {
        let explanation = engine.explain(&best.conclusion).await;
        println!("📖 Explicação:");
        println!("   {}", explanation.narrative);
        for premise in &explanation.premises {
            println!("     - {} {} {}", premise.subject.term, premise.relation, premise.object.term);
        }
    }

    // 6. Estatísticas
    let stats = engine.stats().await;
    println!("📊 Estatísticas:");
    println!("   Total de fatos: {}", stats.total_facts);
    println!("   Relações: {:?}", stats.relation_counts);

    Ok(())
}
```

```rust
//! Tipos compartilhados para orquestração de agentes.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use uuid::Uuid;

/// Identificador único de um agente.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct AgentId(pub Uuid);

impl AgentId {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self(Uuid::new_v4())
    }
}

impl std::fmt::Display for AgentId {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "{}", self.0)
    }
}

impl Default for AgentId {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

/// Estado de um agente.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub enum AgentStatus {
    Idle,
    Running,
    Paused,
    Stopped,
    Error,
}

/// Intenção de um agente.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Intent {
    pub id: String,
    pub agent_id: AgentId,
    pub description: String,
    pub target: String,
    pub parameters: HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>,
    pub priority: u8,
    pub created_at: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,
    pub expires_at: Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>>,
    pub status: IntentStatus,
}

/// Status de uma intenção.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub enum IntentStatus {
    Pending,
    Approved,
    Rejected,
    Executing,
    Completed,
    Failed,
}

/// Grafo de estado — baseado em petgraph.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct StateGraph {
    pub id: String,
    pub nodes: Vec<GraphNode>,
    pub edges: Vec<GraphEdge>,
    pub start_node: String,
    pub end_nodes: Vec<String>,
}

/// Nó de um grafo.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct GraphNode {
    pub id: String,
    pub node_type: NodeType,
    pub config: serde_json::Value,
}

/// Tipo de nó.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum NodeType {
    Agent,
    Tool,
    Conditional,
    Human,
    Parallel,
    Loop,
    Terminate,
}

/// Aresta de um grafo.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct GraphEdge {
    pub from: String,
    pub to: String,
    pub condition: Option<String>,
}

/// Resultado da execução de um agente.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct AgentResult {
    pub agent_id: AgentId,
    pub intent_id: String,
    pub output: serde_json::Value,
    pub status: AgentStatus,
    pub execution_time_ms: u64,
    pub tokens_used: u64,
    pub governance_checks_passed: bool,
}

impl AgentResult {
    pub fn new(agent_id: AgentId, intent_id: &str) -> Self {
        Self {
            agent_id,
            intent_id: intent_id.to_string(),
            output: serde_json::json!({}),
            status: AgentStatus::Idle,
            execution_time_ms: 0,
            tokens_used: 0,
            governance_checks_passed: true,
        }
    }
}
```

## 🦀 4. SRC/AGENT_POOL.RS — POOL DE AGENTES

```rust
//! Pool de agentes — gerenciamento de ciclo de vida.

use crate::types::{AgentId, AgentStatus, AgentResult, Intent};
use arkhe_mcp_bridge::McpBridge;
use arkhe_memory_v2::EvolutionaryMemoryV2;
use dashmap::DashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;

/// Agente — uma entidade executora dentro do Arkhe OS.
pub struct Agent {
    pub id: AgentId,
    pub name: String,
    pub status: AgentStatus,
    pub capabilities: Vec<String>,
    memory: Arc<EvolutionaryMemoryV2>,
    mcp: Arc<McpBridge>,
}

impl Agent {
    pub fn new(id: AgentId, name: &str, memory: Arc<EvolutionaryMemoryV2>, mcp: Arc<McpBridge>) -> Self {
        Self {
            id,
            name: name.to_string(),
            status: AgentStatus::Idle,
            capabilities: vec!["execute".to_string(), "reason".to_string()],
            memory,
            mcp,
        }
    }

    /// Executa uma tarefa no agente.
    pub async fn execute(&mut self, task: &str, context: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<serde_json::Value, String> {
        self.status = AgentStatus::Running;

        let _ = self.memory.store_episode(
            &format!("task-{}", uuid::Uuid::new_v4()),
            0.5,
            &format!("Executando: {}", task),
        ).await;

        let result = serde_json::json!({
            "agent": self.name,
            "task": task,
            "context": context,
            "status": "completed",
            "timestamp": chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),
        });

        self.status = AgentStatus::Idle;
        Ok(result)
    }
}

/// Pool de agentes — gerenciamento concorrente.
pub struct AgentPool {
    agents: DashMap<AgentId, Arc<RwLock<Agent>>>,
    memory: Arc<EvolutionaryMemoryV2>,
    mcp: Arc<McpBridge>,
    next_id: u64,
}

impl AgentPool {
    pub fn new(memory: Arc<EvolutionaryMemoryV2>, mcp: Arc<McpBridge>) -> Self {
        Self {
            agents: DashMap::new(),
            memory,
            mcp,
            next_id: 0,
        }
    }

    /// Cria um novo agente ou retorna um existente.
    pub async fn get_or_create_agent(&self, agent_id: Option<AgentId>) -> Result<AgentId, String> {
        let id = agent_id.unwrap_or_else(|| AgentId::new());

        if self.agents.contains_key(&id) {
            return Ok(id);
        }

        let name = format!("agent-{}", self.next_id);
        self.next_id += 1;

        let agent = Agent::new(id, &name, self.memory.clone(), self.mcp.clone());
        self.agents.insert(id, Arc::new(RwLock::new(agent)));

        Ok(id)
    }

    /// Obtém um agente pelo ID.
    pub fn get_agent(&self, agent_id: AgentId) -> Option<Arc<RwLock<Agent>>> {
        self.agents.get(&agent_id).map(|entry| entry.clone())
    }

    /// Lista todos os agentes ativos.
    pub fn list_agents(&self) -> Vec<AgentId> {
        self.agents.iter().map(|entry| *entry.key()).collect()
    }

    /// Obtém o status de um agente.
    pub fn get_status(&self, agent_id: AgentId) -> Option<AgentStatus> {
        self.agents
            .get(&agent_id)
            .and_then(|entry| entry.try_read().ok())
            .map(|agent| agent.status.clone())
    }

    /// Executa uma tarefa em um agente.
    pub async fn execute_on_agent(
        &self,
        agent_id: AgentId,
        task: &str,
        context: &serde_json::Value,
    ) -> Result<AgentResult, String> {
        let agent_lock = self
            .agents
            .get(&agent_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("Agente não encontrado: {}", agent_id))?;

        let mut agent = agent_lock.write().await;
        let start = std::time::Instant::now();

        let output = agent.execute(task, context).await?;

        Ok(AgentResult {
            agent_id,
            intent_id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            output,
            status: AgentStatus::Idle,
            execution_time_ms: start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64,
            tokens_used: 0,
            governance_checks_passed: true,
        })
    }
}
```

## 🦀 5. SRC/GRAPH_ENGINE.RS — MOTOR DE GRAFOS

```rust
//! Motor de grafos de estado — substitui LangGraph.

use crate::types::{StateGraph, GraphNode, NodeType, GraphEdge, AgentResult, Intent};
use crate::agent_pool::AgentPool;
use crate::governance::GovernanceEngine;
use arkhe_mcp_bridge::McpBridge;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tracing::{info, warn, error};

pub struct GraphEngine {
    agent_pool: Arc<AgentPool>,
    governance: Arc<GovernanceEngine>,
    mcp: Arc<McpBridge>,
}

impl GraphEngine {
    pub fn new(
        agent_pool: Arc<AgentPool>,
        governance: Arc<GovernanceEngine>,
        mcp: Arc<McpBridge>,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            agent_pool,
            governance,
            mcp,
        }
    }

    /// Executa um grafo de estado a partir de uma intenção.
    pub async fn execute_graph(
        &self,
        graph: &StateGraph,
        intent: &Intent,
    ) -> Result<Vec<AgentResult>, String> {
        info!("▶️ Executando grafo: {}", graph.id);

        let mut current_node = graph.start_node.clone();
        let mut results = Vec::new();

        let nodes_map: HashMap<String, &GraphNode> = graph
            .nodes
            .iter()
            .map(|n| (n.id.clone(), n))
            .collect();

        let edges_map: HashMap<String, Vec<&GraphEdge>> = graph
            .edges
            .iter()
            .fold(HashMap::new(), |mut acc, e| {
                acc.entry(e.from.clone()).or_insert_with(Vec::new).push(e);
                acc
            });

        while !graph.end_nodes.contains(&current_node) {
            let node = nodes_map
                .get(&current_node)
                .ok_or_else(|| format!("Nó não encontrado: {}", current_node))?;

            info!("   Executando nó: {} ({:?})", node.id, node.node_type);

            let result = self.execute_node(node, intent, &results).await?;
            results.push(result);

            let edges = edges_map.get(&current_node).unwrap_or(&vec![]);
            if edges.is_empty() {
                return Err(format!("Sem arestas saindo de: {}", current_node));
            }

            let mut next_node = None;
            for edge in edges {
                if let Some(condition) = &edge.condition {
                    if self.evaluate_condition(condition, &results).await? {
                        next_node = Some(edge.to.clone());
                        break;
                    }
                } else {
                    next_node = Some(edge.to.clone());
                    break;
                }
            }

            if let Some(n) = next_node {
                current_node = n;
            } else {
                return Err(format!("Nenhuma aresta condicional satisfeita em: {}", current_node));
            }
        }

        Ok(results)
    }

    async fn execute_node(
        &self,
        node: &GraphNode,
        intent: &Intent,
        previous_results: &[AgentResult],
    ) -> Result<AgentResult, String> {
        match node.node_type {
            NodeType::Agent => {
                let agent_name = node
                    .config
                    .get("agent")
                    .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                    .unwrap_or("general");

                let agent_id = self.agent_pool
                    .get_or_create_agent(Some(intent.agent_id))
                    .await?;

                let context = serde_json::json!({
                    "intent": intent,
                    "previous_results": previous_results,
                    "node_config": node.config,
                });

                self.agent_pool
                    .execute_on_agent(agent_id, agent_name, &context)
                    .await
            }
            NodeType::Tool => {
                let tool_name = node
                    .config
                    .get("tool")
                    .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                    .unwrap_or("unknown");

                let params = node.config.get("params").cloned().unwrap_or(serde_json::json!({}));

                let result = self.mcp.call_tool(tool_name, params).await
                    .map_err(|e| format!("Tool '{}' failed: {}", tool_name, e))?;

                Ok(AgentResult {
                    agent_id: intent.agent_id,
                    intent_id: intent.id.clone(),
                    output: result,
                    status: AgentStatus::Idle,
                    execution_time_ms: 0,
                    tokens_used: 0,
                    governance_checks_passed: true,
                })
            }
            NodeType::Conditional => {
                let check = node
                    .config
                    .get("check")
                    .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                    .unwrap_or("true");

                let passed = self.evaluate_condition(check, previous_results).await?;

                if !passed {
                    return Err("Condição não satisfeita".to_string());
                }

                Ok(AgentResult {
                    agent_id: intent.agent_id,
                    intent_id: intent.id.clone(),
                    output: serde_json::json!({ "condition_passed": true }),
                    status: AgentStatus::Idle,
                    execution_time_ms: 0,
                    tokens_used: 0,
                    governance_checks_passed: true,
                })
            }
            NodeType::Human => {
                info!("⏳ Aguardando intervenção humana para nó: {}", node.id);
                Ok(AgentResult {
                    agent_id: intent.agent_id,
                    intent_id: intent.id.clone(),
                    output: serde_json::json!({ "status": "waiting_for_human" }),
                    status: AgentStatus::Paused,
                    execution_time_ms: 0,
                    tokens_used: 0,
                    governance_checks_passed: true,
                })
            }
            NodeType::Parallel => {
                let tasks = node
                    .config
                    .get("tasks")
                    .and_then(|v| v.as_array())
                    .unwrap_or(&vec![])
                    .iter()
                    .filter_map(|t| t.as_str().map(|s| s.to_string()))
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>();

                let mut handles = Vec::new();
                let self_clone = Arc::new(self.clone());

                for task in tasks {
                    let intent_clone = intent.clone();
                    let self_clone_inner = self_clone.clone();

                    handles.push(tokio::spawn(async move {
                        let agent_id = self_clone_inner.agent_pool
                            .get_or_create_agent(None)
                            .await
                            .unwrap();

                        let context = serde_json::json!({
                            "task": task,
                            "intent": intent_clone,
                        });

                        self_clone_inner.agent_pool
                            .execute_on_agent(agent_id, &task, &context)
                            .await
                            .unwrap_or_else(|e| AgentResult {
                                agent_id,
                                intent_id: intent_clone.id.clone(),
                                output: serde_json::json!({ "error": e }),
                                status: AgentStatus::Error,
                                execution_time_ms: 0,
                                tokens_used: 0,
                                governance_checks_passed: false,
                            })
                    }));
                }

                let results = futures::future::join_all(handles).await;
                let combined: Vec<AgentResult> = results
                    .into_iter()
                    .filter_map(|r| r.ok())
                    .collect();

                Ok(AgentResult {
                    agent_id: intent.agent_id,
                    intent_id: intent.id.clone(),
                    output: serde_json::json!({ "parallel_results": combined }),
                    status: AgentStatus::Idle,
                    execution_time_ms: 0,
                    tokens_used: 0,
                    governance_checks_passed: true,
                })
            }
            NodeType::Loop => {
                let max_iterations = node
                    .config
                    .get("max_iterations")
                    .and_then(|v| v.as_u64())
                    .unwrap_or(5);

                let mut loop_results = Vec::new();
                for i in 0..max_iterations {
                    info!("   Loop iteração {}", i + 1);
                    loop_results.push(serde_json::json!({
                        "iteration": i + 1,
                        "status": "completed",
                    }));
                }

                Ok(AgentResult {
                    agent_id: intent.agent_id,
                    intent_id: intent.id.clone(),
                    output: serde_json::json!({ "loop_results": loop_results }),
                    status: AgentStatus::Idle,
                    execution_time_ms: 0,
                    tokens_used: 0,
                    governance_checks_passed: true,
                })
            }
            NodeType::Terminate => {
                Ok(AgentResult {
                    agent_id: intent.agent_id,
                    intent_id: intent.id.clone(),
                    output: serde_json::json!({ "status": "terminated" }),
                    status: AgentStatus::Idle,
                    execution_time_ms: 0,
                    tokens_used: 0,
                    governance_checks_passed: true,
                })
            }
        }
    }

    async fn evaluate_condition(
        &self,
        condition: &str,
        results: &[AgentResult],
    ) -> Result<bool, String> {
        match condition {
            "success" => {
                Ok(results.last().map_or(false, |r| r.status != AgentStatus::Error))
            }
            "governance" => {
                Ok(true)
            }
            "has_output" => {
                Ok(results.last().map_or(false, |r| !r.output.is_null()))
            }
            _ => Ok(true),
        }
    }
}

impl Clone for GraphEngine {
    fn clone(&self) -> Self {
        Self {
            agent_pool: self.agent_pool.clone(),
            governance: self.governance.clone(),
            mcp: self.mcp.clone(),
        }
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Intent Boundary Layer — tradução de intenções para grafos executáveis.

use crate::types::{Intent, StateGraph, GraphNode, GraphEdge, NodeType};
use crate::governance::GovernanceEngine;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use tracing::{info, warn};

pub struct IntentBoundary {
    governance: GovernanceEngine,
    graph_cache: HashMap<String, StateGraph>,
}

impl IntentBoundary {
    pub fn new(governance: GovernanceEngine) -> Self {
        Self {
            governance,
            graph_cache: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    /// Traduz uma intenção em um grafo de estado executável.
    pub fn translate(&mut self, intent: &Intent) -> Result<StateGraph, String> {
        info!("🔄 Traduzindo intenção: {}", intent.description);

        if !self.governance.validate_intent(intent) {
            return Err("Intenção viola princípios de governança".to_string());
        }

        let cache_key = format!("{}_{}", intent.target, intent.priority);
        if let Some(graph) = self.graph_cache.get(&cache_key) {
            return Ok(graph.clone());
        }

        let graph = self.select_template(intent);
        self.graph_cache.insert(cache_key, graph.clone());

        Ok(graph)
    }

    fn select_template(&self, intent: &Intent) -> StateGraph {
        let description = intent.description.to_lowercase();

        if description.contains("analisar") || description.contains("auditar") {
            self.audit_template(intent)
        } else if description.contains("executar") || description.contains("fazer") {
            self.execute_template(intent)
        } else if description.contains("planejar") || description.contains("organizar") {
            self.plan_template(intent)
        } else if description.contains("aprender") || description.contains("treinar") {
            self.learn_template(intent)
        } else {
            self.general_template(intent)
        }
    }

    fn audit_template(&self, intent: &Intent) -> StateGraph {
        StateGraph {
            id: format!("audit-{}", intent.id),
            nodes: vec![
                GraphNode {
                    id: "recon".to_string(),
                    node_type: NodeType::Agent,
                    config: serde_json::json!({
                        "agent": "revelio",
                        "task": "Mapear superfície de ataque",
                        "target": intent.target,
                    }),
                },
                GraphNode {
                    id: "analyze".to_string(),
                    node_type: NodeType::Agent,
                    config: serde_json::json!({
                        "agent": "causal",
                        "task": "Analisar vulnerabilidades",
                    }),
                },
                GraphNode {
                    id: "report".to_string(),
                    node_type: NodeType::Tool,
                    config: serde_json::json!({
                        "tool": "reporter",
                        "format": "json",
                    }),
                },
                GraphNode {
                    id: "terminate".to_string(),
                    node_type: NodeType::Terminate,
                    config: serde_json::json!({}),
                },
            ],
            edges: vec![
                GraphEdge { from: "recon".to_string(), to: "analyze".to_string(), condition: None },
                GraphEdge { from: "analyze".to_string(), to: "report".to_string(), condition: Some("success") },
                GraphEdge { from: "report".to_string(), to: "terminate".to_string(), condition: None },
            ],
            start_node: "recon".to_string(),
            end_nodes: vec!["terminate".to_string()],
        }
    }

    fn execute_template(&self, intent: &Intent) -> StateGraph {
        StateGraph {
            id: format!("execute-{}", intent.id),
            nodes: vec![
                GraphNode {
                    id: "plan".to_string(),
                    node_type: NodeType::Agent,
                    config: serde_json::json!({
                        "agent": "planner",
                        "task": "Gerar plano de execução",
                    }),
                },
                GraphNode {
                    id: "execute".to_string(),
                    node_type: NodeType::Agent,
                    config: serde_json::json!({
                        "agent": "executor",
                        "task": "Executar plano",
                    }),
                },
                GraphNode {
                    id: "verify".to_string(),
                    node_type: NodeType::Agent,
                    config: serde_json::json!({
                        "agent": "validator",
                        "task": "Verificar resultado",
                    }),
                },
                GraphNode {
                    id: "terminate".to_string(),
                    node_type: NodeType::Terminate,
                    config: serde_json::json!({}),
                },
            ],
            edges: vec![
                GraphEdge { from: "plan".to_string(), to: "execute".to_string(), condition: None },
                GraphEdge { from: "execute".to_string(), to: "verify".to_string(), condition: Some("success") },
                GraphEdge { from: "verify".to_string(), to: "terminate".to_string(), condition: None },
            ],
            start_node: "plan".to_string(),
            end_nodes: vec!["terminate".to_string()],
        }
    }

    fn plan_template(&self, intent: &Intent) -> StateGraph {
        StateGraph {
            id: format!("plan-{}", intent.id),
            nodes: vec![
                GraphNode {
                    id: "decompose".to_string(),
                    node_type: NodeType::Agent,
                    config: serde_json::json!({
                        "agent": "goal_decomposer",
                        "task": "Decompor objetivo",
                    }),
                },
                GraphNode {
                    id: "prioritize".to_string(),
                    node_type: NodeType::Agent,
                    config: serde_json::json!({
                        "agent": "prioritizer",
                        "task": "Priorizar subtarefas",
                    }),
                },
                GraphNode {
                    id: "schedule".to_string(),
                    node_type: NodeType::Tool,
                    config: serde_json::json!({
                        "tool": "scheduler",
                        "params": { "mode": "parallel" },
                    }),
                },
                GraphNode {
                    id: "terminate".to_string(),
                    node_type: NodeType::Terminate,
                    config: serde_json::json!({}),
                },
            ],
            edges: vec![
                GraphEdge { from: "decompose".to_string(), to: "prioritize".to_string(), condition: None },
                GraphEdge { from: "prioritize".to_string(), to: "schedule".to_string(), condition: None },
                GraphEdge { from: "schedule".to_string(), to: "terminate".to_string(), condition: None },
            ],
            start_node: "decompose".to_string(),
            end_nodes: vec!["terminate".to_string()],
        }

    fn learn_template(&self, intent: &Intent) -> StateGraph {
        StateGraph {
            id: format!("learn-{}", intent.id),
            nodes: vec![
                GraphNode {
                    id: "retrieve".to_string(),

                GraphNode {

                    config: serde_json::json!({
                        "agent": "learner",
```
