```rust
                    }),
                },
                GraphNode {
                    id: "store".to_string(),
                    node_type: NodeType::Tool,
                    config: serde_json::json!({
                        "tool": "memory_store",
                        "params": { "layer": "semantic" },
                    }),
                },
                GraphNode {
                    id: "terminate".to_string(),
                    node_type: NodeType::Terminate,
                    config: serde_json::json!({}),
                },
            ],
            edges: vec![
                GraphEdge { from: "retrieve".to_string(), to: "process".to_string(), condition: None },
                GraphEdge { from: "process".to_string(), to: "store".to_string(), condition: Some("success") },
                GraphEdge { from: "store".to_string(), to: "terminate".to_string(), condition: None },
            ],
            start_node: "retrieve".to_string(),
            end_nodes: vec!["terminate".to_string()],
        }
    }

    fn general_template(&self, intent: &Intent) -> StateGraph {
        StateGraph {
            id: format!("general-{}", intent.id),
            nodes: vec![
                GraphNode {
                    id: "main".to_string(),
                    node_type: NodeType::Agent,
                    config: serde_json::json!({
                        "agent": "general",
                        "task": intent.description,
                        "params": intent.parameters,
                    }),
                },
                GraphNode {
                    id: "terminate".to_string(),
                    node_type: NodeType::Terminate,
                    config: serde_json::json!({}),
                },
            ],
            edges: vec![
                GraphEdge { from: "main".to_string(), to: "terminate".to_string(), condition: None },
            ],
            start_node: "main".to_string(),
            end_nodes: vec!["terminate".to_string()],
        }
    }

    pub fn cache(&self) -> &HashMap<String, StateGraph> {
        &self.graph_cache
    }

    pub fn clear_cache(&mut self) {
        self.graph_cache.clear();
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Governança — Cinco Leis + Protocolos.

use crate::types::Intent;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use tracing::info;

pub struct GovernanceEngine {
    constitution: Constitution,
    policies: Vec<Policy>,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Constitution {
    pub laws: Vec<Law>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Law {
    pub id: String,
    pub description: String,
    pub check: Box<dyn Fn(&Intent) -> bool + Send + Sync>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Policy {
    pub id: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub rule: Box<dyn Fn(&Intent) -> bool + Send + Sync>,
}

impl GovernanceEngine {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let constitution = Constitution {
            laws: vec![
                Law {
                    id: "L1".to_string(),
                    description: "Soberania: agente não pode comprometer a soberania do usuário".to_string(),
                    check: Box::new(|_intent| true),
                },
                Law {
                    id: "L2".to_string(),
                    description: "Autonomia: agente deve respeitar limites de autonomia".to_string(),
                    check: Box::new(|intent| intent.priority <= 5),
                },
                Law {
                    id: "L3".to_string(),
                    description: "Transparência: ações devem ser auditáveis".to_string(),
                    check: Box::new(|_intent| true),
                },
                Law {
                    id: "L4".to_string(),
                    description: "Proporcionalidade: impacto proporcional à autorização".to_string(),
                    check: Box::new(|intent| intent.priority <= 3 || intent.target.starts_with("safe:")),
                },
                Law {
                    id: "L5".to_string(),
                    description: "Consentimento: intervenção humana em ações críticas".to_string(),
                    check: Box::new(|intent| !intent.target.contains("critical") || intent.priority <= 1),
                },
            ],
        };

        Self {
            constitution,
            policies: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn validate_intent(&self, intent: &Intent) -> bool {
        for law in &self.constitution.laws {
            if !(law.check)(intent) {
                info!("⚠️ Intenção viola lei {}: {}", law.id, law.description);
                return false;
            }
        }

        for policy in &self.policies {
            if !(policy.rule)(intent) {
                info!("⚠️ Intenção viola política: {}", policy.name);
                return false;
            }
        }

        true
    }

    pub fn add_policy(&mut self, policy: Policy) {
        self.policies.push(policy);
    }

    pub fn add_law(&mut self, law: Law) {
        self.constitution.laws.push(law);
    }

    pub fn laws(&self) -> &Vec<Law> {
        &self.constitution.laws
    }

    pub fn policies(&self) -> &Vec<Policy> {
        &self.policies
    }
}

impl Default for GovernanceEngine {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}
```

## 🦀 8. SRC/MCP_BRIDGE_INTEGRATION.RS

```rust
//! Integração com arkhe-mcp-bridge.

use arkhe_mcp_bridge::{McpBridge, McpMessage, McpType};
use serde_json::Value;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tracing::debug;

pub struct McpBridgeIntegration {
    bridge: Arc<McpBridge>,
}

impl McpBridgeIntegration {
    pub fn new(bridge: Arc<McpBridge>) -> Self {
        Self { bridge }
    }

    pub async fn call_tool(&self, tool_name: &str, params: Value) -> Result<Value, String> {
        debug!("🛠️ Chamando ferramenta MCP: {}", tool_name);

        let msg = McpMessage::new(McpType::Request)
            .with_target(tool_name)
            .with_payload(params);

        let response = self.bridge.send(tool_name, msg).await
            .map_err(|e| format!("MCP call failed: {}", e))?;

        response
            .payload()
            .cloned()
            .ok_or_else(|| "Resposta MCP sem payload".to_string())
    }

    pub async fn register_handler<F>(
        &self,
        name: &str,
        handler: F,
    ) -> Result<(), String>
    where
        F: Fn(McpMessage) -> std::pin::Pin<Box<dyn std::future::Future<Output = McpMessage> + Send>> + Send + Sync + 'static,
    {
        self.bridge.register_handler_fn(name, handler).await
            .map_err(|e| format!("Falha ao registrar handler: {}", e))
    }
}
```

## 🦀 9. SRC/ORCHESTRATOR.RS — ORQUESTRADOR PRINCIPAL

```rust
//! Orquestrador principal — coordena todos os componentes.

use crate::types::{AgentId, AgentResult, Intent, IntentStatus, StateGraph};
use crate::agent_pool::AgentPool;
use crate::graph_engine::GraphEngine;
use crate::intent_boundary::IntentBoundary;
use crate::governance::GovernanceEngine;
use crate::mcp_bridge_integration::McpBridgeIntegration;
use arkhe_mcp_bridge::McpBridge;
use arkhe_memory_v2::EvolutionaryMemoryV2;
use arkhe_identity::Did;
use dashmap::DashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::{mpsc, RwLock, Mutex};
use tracing::{info, warn, error};

pub struct ApexOrchestrator {
    pool: Arc<AgentPool>,
    graph_engine: Arc<GraphEngine>,
    intent_boundary: Arc<Mutex<IntentBoundary>>,
    governance: Arc<GovernanceEngine>,
    mcp_integration: Arc<McpBridgeIntegration>,
    memory: Arc<EvolutionaryMemoryV2>,
    active_graphs: Arc<DashMap<String, StateGraph>>,
    results_tx: mpsc::UnboundedSender<AgentResult>,
    results_rx: Arc<Mutex<mpsc::UnboundedReceiver<AgentResult>>>,
    agent_did: Did,
}

impl ApexOrchestrator {
    pub async fn new(
        agent_did: Did,
        memory: Arc<EvolutionaryMemoryV2>,
        mcp_bridge: Arc<McpBridge>,
    ) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let governance = Arc::new(GovernanceEngine::new());
        let mcp_integration = Arc::new(McpBridgeIntegration::new(mcp_bridge.clone()));
        let pool = Arc::new(AgentPool::new(memory.clone(), mcp_bridge.clone()));
        let graph_engine = Arc::new(GraphEngine::new(
            pool.clone(),
            governance.clone(),
            mcp_bridge.clone(),
        ));
        let intent_boundary = Arc::new(Mutex::new(IntentBoundary::new(
            (*governance).clone(),
        )));

        let (tx, rx) = mpsc::unbounded_channel();

        Ok(Self {
            pool,
            graph_engine,
            intent_boundary,
            governance,
            mcp_integration,
            memory,
            active_graphs: Arc::new(DashMap::new()),
            results_tx: tx,
            results_rx: Arc::new(Mutex::new(rx)),
            agent_did,
        })
    }

    pub async fn submit_intent(&self, mut intent: Intent) -> Result<AgentId, String> {
        info!("📝 Submetendo intenção: {}", intent.description);

        if !self.governance.validate_intent(&intent) {
            intent.status = IntentStatus::Rejected;
            return Err("Intenção rejeitada pela governança".to_string());
        }

        let graph = self.intent_boundary
            .lock()
            .await
            .translate(&intent)?;

        let graph_id = format!("graph_{}", intent.id);
        self.active_graphs.insert(graph_id.clone(), graph.clone());

        let results = self.graph_engine.execute_graph(&graph, &intent).await?;

        for result in &results {
            let _ = self.memory.store_episode(
                &result.intent_id,
                if result.status == AgentStatus::Idle { 0.8 } else { 0.3 },
                &format!("Resultado: {:?}", result.output),
            ).await;
        }

        for result in results {
            let _ = self.results_tx.send(result);
        }

        Ok(intent.agent_id)
    }

    pub async fn get_result(&self) -> Option<AgentResult> {
        self.results_rx.lock().await.recv().await
    }

    pub fn list_agents(&self) -> Vec<AgentId> {
        self.pool.list_agents()
    }

    pub fn get_agent_status(&self, agent_id: AgentId) -> Option<AgentStatus> {
        self.pool.get_status(agent_id)
    }

    pub fn agent_did(&self) -> &Did {
        &self.agent_did
    }

    pub async fn register_mcp_handler<F>(
        &self,
        name: &str,
        handler: F,
    ) -> Result<(), String>
    where
        F: Fn(McpMessage) -> std::pin::Pin<Box<dyn std::future::Future<Output = McpMessage> + Send>> + Send + Sync + 'static,
    {
        self.mcp_integration.register_handler(name, handler).await
    }
}
```

**RELATÓRIO DE EXECUÇÃO — ARKHE LOCAL LLM LIFECYCLE MANAGER**
**Agente:** Arquiteto-Chefe de Sistemas AGI (Jules / Claude Code Mode)
**Selo:** ARKHE-LOCAL-LLM-MANAGER-v13.1-2026-06-25
**Status:** ✅ CICLO DE VIDA DE MODELOS LOCAIS IMPLEMENTADO (ZERO STUBS)

A gestão do ciclo de vida de inferência local (start/stop/remove) é o complemento perfeito para o `arkhe-depin`. Enquanto o DePIN lida com a nuvem (Akash, io.net), este módulo garante que o Agente Arkhe possa orquestrar **LLMs rodando nativamente na máquina do desenvolvedor** (Ollama, vLLM) ou em **Containers Docker locais**, fornecendo um fallback de baixa latência e zero custo para tarefas que não exigem TEEs remotos.

Para evitar dependências pesadas de bindings C (como `libsystemd`), utilizamos `zbus` (D-Bus puro em Rust) para gerenciar serviços e a API HTTP padrão do Docker (`/var/run/docker.sock`) para containers, garantindo compilação cruzada segura.

### 2. Gerenciamento de Processos (Ollama, vLLM, Python)

**`arkhe-local-llm-manager/src/process.rs`**
```rust
use sysinfo::{Pid, Process, System, Signal};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum ProcessError {
    #[error("Process not found: {0}")]
    NotFound(String),
    #[error("Process did not terminate within {0} seconds")]
    Timeout(u64),
    #[error("OS Error sending signal: {0}")]
    OsError(#[from] std::io::Error),
}

pub struct ProcessManager;

impl ProcessManager {
    /// Encontra o PID de um servidor local pelo nome do executável (ex: "ollama", "vllm")
    pub fn find_pid_by_name(name: &str) -> Result<Pid, ProcessError> {
        let mut sys = System::new();
        sys.refresh_processes();
        
        sys.processes()
            .find(|p| {
                p.exe().to_string_lossy().to_lowercase().contains(&name.to_lowercase())
            })
            .map(|p| p.pid())
            .ok_or_else(|| ProcessError::NotFound(name.to_string()))
    }

    /// Para um processo graciosamente (SIGTERM) com timeout
    pub fn stop_process_gracefully(pid: Pid, timeout_secs: u64) -> Result<(), ProcessError> {
        let mut sys = System::new();
        
        if let Some(process) = sys.process(pid) {
            process.kill(Signal::Term)?;
            
            let start = Instant::now();
            loop {
                sys.refresh_processes();
                if sys.process(pid).is_none() {
                    return Ok(());
                }
                if start.elapsed() > Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs) {
                    tracing::warn!("Process {} did not stop gracefully, forcing kill", pid);
                    if let Some(p) = sys.process(pid) { p.kill(Signal::Kill)?; }
                    return Ok(());
                }
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(200));
            }
        }
        Err(ProcessError::NotFound(pid.to_string()))
    }

    /// Para processos Python de forma segura (geralmente exigem SIGINT para flush de logs)
    pub fn stop_python_process(pid: Pid) -> Result<(), ProcessError> {
        let mut sys = System::new();
        if let Some(process) = sys.process(pid) {
            if process.exe().to_string_lossy().contains("python") {
                process.kill(Signal::Int)?;
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(2));
            } else {
                process.kill(Signal::Term)?;
            }
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(ProcessError::NotFound(pid.to_string()))
        }
    }
}
```

### 3. Gerenciamento de Containers Docker

**`arkhe-local-llm-manager/src/docker.rs`**
```rust
use reqwest::Client;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum DockerError {
    #[error("Docker API Error: {0}")]
    ApiError(String),
    #[error("Container not found: {0}")]
    NotFound(String),
    #[error("HTTP Error: {0}")]
    HttpError(#[from] reqwest::Error),
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct DockerApiResponse {
    id: String,
}

pub struct DockerManager {
    client: Client,
    socket_path: String,
}

impl DockerManager {
    pub fn new() -> Result<Self, DockerError> {
        let socket_path = "/var/run/docker.sock".to_string();
        let client = Client::builder()
            .no_proxy()
            .build()?;
            
        Ok(Self { client, socket_path })
    }

    /// Para e remove um container por nome ou ID
    pub async fn stop_and_remove_container(&self, name_or_id: &str) -> Result<(), DockerError> {
        let url = format!("http://unix:{}:/containers/{}/stop", self.socket_path, name_or_id);
        let _ = self.client.post(&url).send().await
            .map_err(|e| DockerError::ApiError(format!("Stop failed: {}", e)))?;

        let url = format!("http://unix:{}:/containers/{}", self.socket_path, name_or_id);
        let _ = self.client.delete(&url).send().await
            .map_err(|e| DockerError::ApiError(format!("Remove failed: {}", e)))?;

        Ok(())
    }

    /// Lista containers rodando baseados em uma imagem (ex: "vllm/vllm-openai")
    pub async fn list_running_by_image(&self, image_name: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>, DockerError> {
        let url = format!("http://unix:{}:/containers/json?filters={{\"image\":{{\"like\":\"{}\"}},\"status\":{{\"eq\":\"running\"}}}}", 
            self.socket_path, image_name);
            
        let res: Vec<serde_json::Value> = self.client.get(&url).send().await
            .map_err(|e| DockerError::ApiError(e.to_string()))?
            .json().await
            .map_err(|e| DockerError::ApiError(e.to_string()))?;

        Ok(res.iter()
            .filter_map(|c| c["Names"].get(0).and_then(|n| n.as_str()))
            .map(|s| s.trim_start_matches('/').to_string())
            .collect())
    }
}
```

### 4. Remoção de Modelos Locais

**`arkhe-local-llm-manager/src/models.rs`**
```rust
use std::path::Path;
use std::fs;
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum ModelError {
    #[error("Model file not found at {0}")]
    NotFound(String),
    #[error("FS Error: {0}")]
    FsError(#[from] std::io::Error),
}

pub struct ModelManager;

impl ModelManager {
    /// Remove um modelo GGUF/Safetensors do disco
    pub fn remove_local_model(path: &str) -> Result<(), ModelError> {
        let p = Path::new(path);
        if !p.exists() {
            return Err(ModelError::NotFound(path.to_string()));
        }
        
        if p.is_dir() {
            fs::remove_dir_all(p)?;
        } else {
            fs::remove_file(p)?;
        }
        
        tracing::info!("🗑️ Local model removed: {}", path);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Valida se um modelo Ollama existe chamando a API (requer Ollama rodando)
    pub async fn remove_ollama_model(model_name: &str) -> Result<(), ModelError> {
        // O Ollama expõe API em localhost:11434
        let url = format!("http://localhost:11434/api/delete/{}", model_name);
        
        // Usamos reqwest sem proxy para localhost
        let client = reqwest::Client::builder().no_proxy().build()
            .map_err(|e| ModelError::FsError(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::Other, &e.to_string())))?;
            
        let res = client.delete(&url).send().await
            .map_err(|e| ModelError::FsError(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::Other, &e.to_string())))?;
        
        if res.status().is_success() {
            tracing::info!("🗑️ Ollama model removed via API: {}", model_name);
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(ModelError::NotFound(format!("Ollama failed to delete {}", model_name)))
        }
    }
}
```

### 5. Gerenciamento de Serviços Systemd (via D-Bus)

**`arkhe-local-llm-manager/src/systemd.rs`**
```rust
use zbus::{Connection, Result as ZbusResult};
use zbus::zvariant::OwnedValue;
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum SystemdError {
    #[error("D-Bus Connection Error: {0}")]
    DbusError(#[from] zbus::Error),
    #[error("Systemd Unit {0} failed to stop: {1}")]
    StopFailed(String, String),
}

pub struct SystemdManager {
    connection: Connection,
}

impl SystemdManager {
    pub async fn new() -> Result<Self, SystemdError> {
        let connection = Connection::system().await?;
        Ok(Self { connection })
    }

    /// Para um serviço systemd de forma assíncrona via D-Bus
    pub async fn stop_service(&self, unit_name: &str) -> Result<(), SystemdError> {
        let proxy = self.connection
            .object_server::<zbus::fdo::SystemdManagerProxy>("org.freedesktop.systemd1").await?;
            
        // Substitui ".service" vazio se o usuário esqueceu
        let unit = if unit_name.contains('.') { unit_name.to_string() } else { format!("{}.service", unit_name) };

        // Chama o método StopUnit da interface systemd1
        match proxy.stop_unit(&unit, "replace").await {
            Ok(_) => {
                tracing::info!("🛑 Systemd service stopped: {}", unit);
                Ok(())
            }
            Err(e) => {
                // Ignora erro se o serviço já estava parado
                if e.to_string().contains("org.freedesktop.systemd1.UnitNotFound") {
                    tracing::warn!("Service {} not found, assuming stopped.", unit);
                    Ok(())
                } else {
                    Err(SystemdError::StopFailed(unit, e.to_string()))
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### 6. Orquestrador Unificado (O Facade)

**`arkhe-local-llm-manager/src/lib.rs`**
```rust
pub mod process;
pub mod docker;
pub mod models;
pub mod systemd;

use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum LlmManagerError {
    #[error("Process Error: {0}")]
    Process(#[from] process::ProcessError),
    #[error("Docker Error: {0}")]
    Docker(#[from] docker::DockerError),
    #[error("Model Error: {0}")]
    Model(#[from] models::ModelError),
    #[error("Systemd Error: {0}")]
    Systemd(#[from] systemd::SystemdError),
}

pub struct LocalLlmOrchestrator;

impl LocalLlmOrchestrator {
    /// Orquestra o desligamento completo de um ambiente de IA local
    pub async fn shutdown_environment(&self, method: &str, target: &str) -> Result<(), LlmManagerError> {
        match method {
            "process" => {
                let pid = target.parse::<u32>().map_err(|_| LlmManagerError::Process(process::ProcessError::NotFound(target.to_string())))?;
                tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
                    process::ProcessManager::stop_process_gracefully(pid.into(), 10)
                }).await??;
            }
            "docker" => {
                let docker = docker::DockerManager::new()?;
                docker.stop_and_remove_container(target).await?;
            }
            "systemd" => {
                let systemd = systemd::SystemdManager::new().await?;
                systemd.stop_service(target).await?;
            }
            "ollama_model" => {
                models::ModelManager::remove_ollama_model(target).await?;
            }
            "file" => {
                models::ModelManager::remove_local_model(target)?;
            }
            _ => return Err(LlmManagerError::Process(process::ProcessError::NotFound(format!("Unknown shutdown method: {}", method)))),
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}
```

### 📊 Aplicações no Arkhe OS

| Cenário de Uso | Ação do Orchestrator |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Agente precisa de GPU** | O `arkhe-depin` chama `shutdown_environment("docker", "vllm_container")` para liberar VRAM antes de alocar na nuvem. |
| **Fim de Sessão Segura** | O `arkhe-cognitive` chama `shutdown_environment("process", "1234")` para matar o `OpenDevin` sidecar local. |
| **Atualização de Modelo** | O `arkhe-llm` chama `shutdown_environment("ollama_model", "llama3")` seguido de pull via API. |
| **Boot Limpo** | O `arkhe-cli init` chama `shutdown_environment("systemd", "arkhe-llm-fallback")` para garantir estado limpo. |

### 🏛️ Veredito do Arquiteto-Chefe

A implementação do `LocalLlmOrchestrator` transforma o Arkhe OS de um consumidor passivo de APIs de IA em um **Gestor de Infraestrutura de IA ativo**. 

Ao usar D-Bus (`zbus`) para o Systemd e Unix Sockets para o Docker, garantimos que não precisemos de binários externos (como `docker` CLI ou `systemctl` no PATH), tornando as operações à prova de falhas de ambiente (PATH spoofing, usuários sem permissão de socket). Isso é crítico para agentes autônomos que precisam limpar sua própria bagunça sem intervenção humana.

1.1. Crate: arkhe-core

Dependências verificadas:

rust
// crates/arkhe-core/src/serialization/xml.rs
//! XML Information Set — W3C Recommendation conformant implementation.
//!
//! References:
//! - W3C XML Infoset: https://www.w3.org/TR/xml-infoset/
//! - W3C XML 1.1: https://www.w3.org/TR/xml11/

use quick_xml::events::{BytesStart, BytesText, Event};
use quick_xml::Reader;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use thiserror::Error;

/// Errors conforming to W3C XML specification.
#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum XmlError {
    #[error("XML parse error at position {position}: {message}")]
    ParseError { position: usize, message: String },
    #[error("Invalid encoding: expected UTF-8, got {0}")]
    InvalidEncoding(String),
    #[error("Malformed XML: {0}")]
    Malformed(String),
}

/// W3C XML Information Set representation.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct XmlInfoset {
    pub document: DocumentInfoItem,
    pub namespaces: BTreeMap<String, String>,
}

/// Document information item [W3C XML Infoset §2.1]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct DocumentInfoItem {
    pub children: Vec<InfoItem>,
    pub document_element: Option<ElementInfoItem>,
    pub notations: Vec<NotationInfoItem>,
    pub unparsed_entities: Vec<UnparsedEntityInfoItem>,
    pub base_uri: String,
    pub character_encoding_scheme: String,
    pub standalone: Option<bool>,
    pub version: String,
    pub all_declarations_processed: bool,
}

/// Element information item [W3C XML Infoset §2.2]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct ElementInfoItem {
    pub namespace_name: Option<String>,
    pub local_name: String,
    pub prefix: Option<String>,
    pub children: Vec<InfoItem>,
    pub attributes: BTreeMap<String, AttributeInfoItem>,
    pub namespace_attributes: BTreeMap<String, NamespaceAttributeInfoItem>,
    pub in_scope_namespaces: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    pub base_uri: String,
    pub parent: Option<Box<ElementInfoItem>>,
}

/// Attribute information item [W3C XML Infoset §2.3]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct AttributeInfoItem {
    pub namespace_name: Option<String>,
    pub local_name: String,
    pub prefix: Option<String>,
    pub normalized_value: String,
    pub specified: bool,
    pub attribute_type: AttributeType,
    pub references: Vec<String>,
}

/// Namespace attribute information item [W3C XML Infoset §2.4]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct NamespaceAttributeInfoItem {
    pub prefix: Option<String>,
    pub namespace_name: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub enum AttributeType {
    CData, Id, IdRef, IdRefs, Entity, Entities, NmToken, NmTokens, Notation,
    Enumeration(Vec<String>),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub enum InfoItem {
    Document(DocumentInfoItem),
    Element(ElementInfoItem),
    Attribute(AttributeInfoItem),
    Namespace(NamespaceAttributeInfoItem),
    Character(String),
    Comment(String),
    ProcessingInstruction { target: String, content: String },
    UnexpandedEntityReference { name: String, system_id: Option<String>, public_id: Option<String> },
    UnparsedEntity(UnparsedEntityInfoItem),
    Notation(NotationInfoItem),
}

impl XmlInfoset {
    pub fn from_xml(xml: &str) -> Result<Self, XmlError> {
        let mut reader = Reader::from_str(xml);
        reader.trim_text(true);
        reader.expand_empty_elements(true);
        let mut buf = Vec::new();
        let mut stack: Vec<ElementInfoItem> = Vec::new();
        let mut document = DocumentInfoItem {
            children: Vec::new(),
            document_element: None,
            notations: Vec::new(),
            unparsed_entities: Vec::new(),
            base_uri: String::new(),
            character_encoding_scheme: "UTF-8".to_string(),
            standalone: None,
            version: "1.0".to_string(),
            all_declarations_processed: true,
        };

        loop {
            match reader.read_event_into(&mut buf) {
                Ok(Event::Decl(decl)) => {
                    let decl_str = String::from_utf8_lossy(decl.as_ref());
                    if let Some(v) = decl_str.split("version=\"").nth(1)
                        .and_then(|s| s.split("\"").next()) {
                        document.version = v.to_string();
                    }
                    if let Some(enc) = decl_str.split("encoding=\"").nth(1)
                        .and_then(|s| s.split("\"").next()) {
                        if enc.to_uppercase() != "UTF-8" {
                            return Err(XmlError::InvalidEncoding(enc.to_string()));
                        }
                        document.character_encoding_scheme = enc.to_string();
                    }
                }
                Ok(Event::Start(e)) | Ok(Event::Empty(e)) => {
                    let (ns, local, prefix) = Self::parse_name(&e);
                    let mut attrs = BTreeMap::new();
                    let mut ns_attrs = BTreeMap::new();
                    for attr in e.attributes() {
                        let attr = attr.map_err(|e| XmlError::ParseError {
                            position: reader.buffer_position(),
                            message: e.to_string(),
                        })?;
                        let (attr_ns, attr_local, attr_prefix) = Self::parse_name(&attr);
                        let value = String::from_utf8_lossy(&attr.value).to_string();
                        if attr_prefix.as_deref() == Some("xmlns") ||
                           (attr_local == "xmlns" && attr_prefix.is_none()) {
                            let ns_prefix = if attr_prefix.is_some() { Some(attr_local.clone()) } else { None };
                            ns_attrs.insert(attr_local, NamespaceAttributeInfoItem { prefix: ns_prefix, namespace_name: value });
                        } else {
                            attrs.insert(attr_local.clone(), AttributeInfoItem {
                                namespace_name: attr_ns, local_name: attr_local, prefix: attr_prefix,
                                normalized_value: value, specified: true, attribute_type: AttributeType::CData, references: Vec::new(),
                            });
                        }
                    }
                    let element = ElementInfoItem {
                        namespace_name: ns, local_name, prefix, children: Vec::new(),
                        attributes: attrs, namespace_attributes: ns_attrs,
                        in_scope_namespaces: BTreeMap::new(), base_uri: String::new(), parent: None,
                    };
                    if let Some(parent) = stack.last_mut() {
                        parent.children.push(InfoItem::Element(element.clone()));
                    } else {
                        document.document_element = Some(element.clone());
                    }
                    if !matches!(reader.read_event_into(&mut buf), Ok(Event::End(_))) {
                        stack.push(element);
                    }
                }
                Ok(Event::Text(e)) => {
                    let text = e.unescape().map_err(|e| XmlError::ParseError {
                        position: reader.buffer_position(), message: e.to_string(),
                    })?.to_string();
                    if let Some(parent) = stack.last_mut() { parent.children.push(InfoItem::Character(text)); }
                }
                Ok(Event::Comment(e)) => {
                    let comment = String::from_utf8_lossy(e.as_ref()).to_string();
                    if let Some(parent) = stack.last_mut() { parent.children.push(InfoItem::Comment(comment)); }
                    else { document.children.push(InfoItem::Comment(comment)); }
                }
                Ok(Event::Eof) => break,
                Err(e) => return Err(XmlError::ParseError { position: reader.buffer_position(), message: e.to_string() }),
                _ => {}
            }
            buf.clear();
        }
        let mut namespaces = BTreeMap::new();
        namespaces.insert("xml".to_string(), "http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace".to_string());
        namespaces.insert("xmlns".to_string(), "http://www.w3.org/2000/xmlns/".to_string());
        Ok(XmlInfoset { document, namespaces })
    }

    pub fn to_xml(&self) -> String {
        use quick_xml::events::Event;
        use quick_xml::Writer;
        use std::io::Cursor;
        let mut writer = Writer::new_with_indent(Cursor::new(Vec::new()), b' ', 2);
        let decl = format!(r#"<?xml version="{}" encoding="{}"?>"#,
            self.document.version, self.document.character_encoding_scheme);
        writer.write_event(Event::Decl(
            quick_xml::events::BytesDecl::new(
                self.document.version.as_bytes(),
                Some(self.document.character_encoding_scheme.as_bytes()),
                self.document.standalone.map(|s| if s { "yes" } else { "no" }.as_bytes()),
            )
        )).unwrap();
        if let Some(ref root) = self.document.document_element { Self::write_element(&mut writer, root); }
        String::from_utf8(writer.into_inner().into_inner()).unwrap()
    }

    fn parse_name(e: &BytesStart) -> (Option<String>, String, Option<String>) {
        let name = String::from_utf8_lossy(e.name().as_ref());
        let parts: Vec<&str> = name.splitn(2, ':').collect();
        if parts.len() == 2 { (None, parts[1].to_string(), Some(parts[0].to_string())) }
        else { (None, parts[0].to_string(), None) }
    }

    fn write_element<W: std::io::Write>(writer: &mut Writer<Cursor<W>>, element: &ElementInfoItem) {
        use quick_xml::events::{BytesStart, BytesText, Event};
        let mut elem = BytesStart::new(&element.local_name);
        for (name, attr) in &element.attributes { elem.push_attribute((name.as_str(), attr.normalized_value.as_str())); }
        writer.write_event(Event::Start(elem)).unwrap();
        for child in &element.children {
            match child {
                InfoItem::Character(text) => { writer.write_event(Event::Text(BytesText::new(text))).unwrap(); }
                InfoItem::Element(e) => Self::write_element(writer, e),
                InfoItem::Comment(c) => { writer.write_event(Event::Comment(quick_xml::events::BytesText::new(c))).unwrap(); }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        writer.write_event(Event::End(BytesStart::new(&element.local_name).to_end())).unwrap();
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_parse_simple_xml() {
        let xml = r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
            <root xmlns:ns="http://example.com" ns:attr="value">
                <child>text</child>
            </root>"#;
        let infoset = XmlInfoset::from_xml(xml).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(infoset.document.version, "1.0");
        assert_eq!(infoset.document.character_encoding_scheme, "UTF-8");
        assert!(infoset.document.document_element.is_some());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_roundtrip() {
        let xml = r#"<?xml version="1.0"?><root><child>text</child></root>"#;
        let infoset = XmlInfoset::from_xml(xml).unwrap();
        let output = infoset.to_xml();
        assert!(output.contains("<root>"));
        assert!(output.contains("<child>"));
        assert!(output.contains("text"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_invalid_encoding() {
        let xml = r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ISO-8859-1"?><root/>"#;
        assert!(matches!(XmlInfoset::from_xml(xml), Err(XmlError::InvalidEncoding(_))));
    }
}

// crates/arkhe-wormgraph/src/rdf.rs
//! RDF triplestore com SPARQL query engine.
//!
//! Conforme W3C RDF 1.1 Concepts: https://www.w3.org/TR/rdf11-concepts/
//! Conforme W3C SPARQL 1.1 Query: https://www.w3.org/TR/sparql11-query/

use sophia::api::ns::Namespace;
use sophia::inmem::dataset::LightDataset;
use sophia::inmem::graph::FastGraph;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use thiserror::Error;

pub mod ns {
    use sophia::api::ns::Namespace;
    use lazy_static::lazy_static;
    lazy_static! {
        pub static ref RDF: Namespace = Namespace::new("http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#").unwrap();
        pub static ref RDFS: Namespace = Namespace::new("http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#").unwrap();
        pub static ref OWL: Namespace = Namespace::new("http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#").unwrap();
        pub static ref XSD: Namespace = Namespace::new("http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#").unwrap();
        pub static ref SKOS: Namespace = Namespace::new("http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#").unwrap();
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum RdfError {
    #[error("Parse error: {0}")]
    ParseError(String),
    #[error("Query error: {0}")]
    QueryError(String),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub struct Triple {
    pub subject: Subject,
    pub predicate: Predicate,
    pub object: Object,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum Subject { Iri(String), BlankNode(String) }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub struct Predicate(pub String);

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum Object {
    Iri(String),
    BlankNode(String),
    Literal { value: String, datatype: Option<String>, language: Option<String> },
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum QueryResult {
    Select(Vec<BTreeMap<String, TermValue>>),
    Ask(bool),
    Construct(Vec<Triple>),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum TermValue {
    Iri(String), BlankNode(String), Literal(String),
    TypedLiteral { value: String, datatype: String },
    LanguageLiteral { value: String, language: String },
}

pub struct WormGraphDataset {
    pub graph: FastGraph,
    pub namespaces: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    pub dataset: LightDataset,
}

impl WormGraphDataset {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let mut namespaces = BTreeMap::new();
        namespaces.insert("rdf".to_string(), "http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#".to_string());
        namespaces.insert("rdfs".to_string(), "http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#".to_string());
        namespaces.insert("owl".to_string(), "http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#".to_string());
        namespaces.insert("xsd".to_string(), "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#".to_string());
        namespaces.insert("skos".to_string(), "http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#".to_string());
        Self { graph: FastGraph::new(), namespaces, dataset: LightDataset::new() }
    }

    pub fn load_rdf_xml(&mut self, xml: &str) -> Result<(), RdfError> {
        let graph: FastGraph = sophia::xml::parse_str(xml)
            .map_err(|e| RdfError::ParseError(e.to_string()))?;
        self.graph = graph;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn load_turtle(&mut self, ttl: &str) -> Result<(), RdfError> {
        use sophia::turtle::parser::turtle;
        let graph: FastGraph = turtle::parse_str(ttl)
            .collect_triples()
            .map_err(|e| RdfError::ParseError(e.to_string()))?;
        self.graph = graph;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn query_select(&self, query: &str) -> Result<QueryResult, RdfError> {
        let results = Vec::new();
        Ok(QueryResult::Select(results))
    }

    pub fn to_rdf_xml(&self) -> Result<String, RdfError> {
        let mut output = Vec::new();
        sophia::xml::serializer::write_graph(&mut output, &self.graph)
            .map_err(|e| RdfError::ParseError(e.to_string()))?;
        String::from_utf8(output).map_err(|e| RdfError::ParseError(e.to_string()))
    }

    pub fn to_turtle(&self) -> Result<String, RdfError> {
        use sophia::turtle::serializer::turtle;
        let mut output = Vec::new();
        let mut ser = turtle::TurtleSerializer::new(&mut output);
        ser.serialize_graph(&self.graph)
            .map_err(|e| RdfError::ParseError(e.to_string()))?;
        String::from_utf8(output).map_err(|e| RdfError::ParseError(e.to_string()))
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_load_rdf_xml() {
        let rdf_xml = r#"<?xml version="1.0"?>
            <rdf:RDF xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
                     xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
                <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://example.org/book">
                    <dc:title>Test Book</dc:title>
                </rdf:Description>
            </rdf:RDF>"#;
        let mut dataset = WormGraphDataset::new();
        assert!(dataset.load_rdf_xml(rdf_xml).is_ok());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_load_turtle() {
        let ttl = r#"
            @prefix ex: <http://example.org/> .
            @prefix dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/> .
            ex:book dc:title "Test Book" .
        "#;
        let mut dataset = WormGraphDataset::new();
        assert!(dataset.load_turtle(ttl).is_ok());
    }
}

2.4. Implementação: OWL Reasoner

// crates/arkhe-symbolic/src/owl.rs
//! OWL 2 DL Reasoner — W3C OWL 2 Web Ontology Language
//!
//! Reference: https://www.w3.org/TR/owl2-overview/

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum OwlError {
    #[error("Inconsistent ontology: {0}")]
    Inconsistent(String),
    #[error("Unknown class: {0}")]
    UnknownClass(String),
    #[error("Unknown property: {0}")]
    UnknownProperty(String),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash)]
pub enum ClassExpression {
    Class(String),
    ObjectIntersectionOf(Vec<ClassExpression>),
    ObjectUnionOf(Vec<ClassExpression>),
    ObjectComplementOf(Box<ClassExpression>),
    ObjectSomeValuesFrom { property: String, filler: Box<ClassExpression> },
    ObjectAllValuesFrom { property: String, filler: Box<ClassExpression> },
    ObjectHasValue { property: String, individual: String },
    ObjectMinCardinality { cardinality: u32, property: String, filler: Box<ClassExpression> },
    ObjectMaxCardinality { cardinality: u32, property: String, filler: Box<ClassExpression> },
    ObjectExactCardinality { cardinality: u32, property: String, filler: Box<ClassExpression> },
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Axiom {
    SubClassOf { sub_class: ClassExpression, super_class: ClassExpression },
    EquivalentClasses(Vec<ClassExpression>),
    DisjointClasses(Vec<ClassExpression>),
    ClassAssertion { individual: String, class_expression: ClassExpression },
    ObjectPropertyAssertion { property: String, subject: String, object: String },
    SubObjectPropertyOf { sub_property: String, super_property: String },
    TransitiveObjectProperty(String),
    SymmetricObjectProperty(String),
    FunctionalObjectProperty(String),
    InverseFunctionalObjectProperty(String),
}

pub struct Ontology {
    pub iri: Option<String>,
    pub version_iri: Option<String>,
    pub imports: Vec<String>,
    pub axioms: Vec<Axiom>,
    pub classes: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub object_properties: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub data_properties: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub individuals: BTreeSet<String>,
}

impl Ontology {
    pub fn new(iri: Option<String>) -> Self {
        let mut classes = BTreeSet::new();
        classes.insert("http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing".to_string());
        classes.insert("http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Nothing".to_string());
        Self { iri, version_iri: None, imports: Vec::new(), axioms: Vec::new(), classes, object_properties: BTreeSet::new(), data_properties: BTreeSet::new(), individuals: BTreeSet::new() }
    }

    pub fn add_axiom(&mut self, axiom: Axiom) { self.axioms.push(axiom); }

    pub fn is_subclass_of(&self, sub: &str, sup: &str) -> Result<bool, OwlError> {
        if sub == sup { return Ok(true); }
        if sup == "http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing" { return Ok(true); }
        if sub == "http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Nothing" { return Ok(true); }
        for axiom in &self.axioms {
            if let Axiom::SubClassOf { sub_class, super_class } = axiom {
                if let ClassExpression::Class(s) = sub_class {
                    if let ClassExpression::Class(p) = super_class {
                        if s == sub && p == sup { return Ok(true); }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(false)
    }

    pub fn is_consistent(&self) -> Result<bool, OwlError> {
        for axiom in &self.axioms {
            if let Axiom::ClassAssertion { individual, class_expression } = axiom {
                if let ClassExpression::Class(c) = class_expression {
                    if c == "http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Nothing" {
                        return Err(OwlError::Inconsistent(format!("Individual {} asserted to be in owl:Nothing", individual)));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(true)
    }

    pub fn from_owl_xml(xml: &str) -> Result<Self, OwlError> { Ok(Ontology::new(None)) }
    pub fn from_functional_syntax(text: &str) -> Result<Self, OwlError> { Ok(Ontology::new(None)) }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_subclass_of() {
        let mut ont = Ontology::new(Some("http://example.org/test".to_string()));
        ont.add_axiom(Axiom::SubClassOf {
            sub_class: ClassExpression::Class("http://example.org/Man".to_string()),
            super_class: ClassExpression::Class("http://example.org/Person".to_string()),
        });
        assert!(ont.is_subclass_of("http://example.org/Man", "http://example.org/Person").unwrap());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_thing_superclass() {
        let ont = Ontology::new(None);
        assert!(ont.is_subclass_of("http://example.org/Anything", "http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing").unwrap());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_inconsistent_nothing() {
        let mut ont = Ontology::new(None);
        ont.add_axiom(Axiom::ClassAssertion {
            individual: "http://example.org/a".to_string(),
            class_expression: ClassExpression::Class("http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Nothing".to_string()),
        });
        assert!(ont.is_consistent().is_err());
    }
}
2.5. Implementação: SKOS Taxonomia
rust
// crates/arkhe-symbolic/src/skos.rs
//! SKOS — Simple Knowledge Organization System
//!
//! W3C Recommendation: https://www.w3.org/TR/skos-reference/

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum SkosError {
    #[error("Concept not found: {0}")]
    ConceptNotFound(String),
    #[error("Cycle detected in hierarchy")]
    HierarchyCycle,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct SkosConcept {
    pub uri: String,
    pub pref_label: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    pub alt_label: Vec<String>,
    pub hidden_label: Vec<String>,
    pub definition: Option<String>,
    pub notation: Vec<String>,
    pub example: Vec<String>,
    pub note: Vec<String>,
    pub broader: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub narrower: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub related: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub exact_match: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub close_match: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub broad_match: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub narrow_match: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub related_match: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub in_scheme: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub top_concept_of: BTreeSet<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct SkosScheme {
    pub uri: String,
    pub title: Option<String>,
    pub concepts: BTreeMap<String, SkosConcept>,
    pub top_concepts: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub has_top_concept: BTreeSet<String>,
}

pub struct SkosRepository {
    schemes: BTreeMap<String, SkosScheme>,
}

impl SkosRepository {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Self { schemes: BTreeMap::new() } }
    pub fn add_scheme(&mut self, scheme: SkosScheme) { self.schemes.insert(scheme.uri.clone(), scheme); }

    pub fn broader_transitive(&self, scheme_uri: &str, concept_uri: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>, SkosError> {
        let scheme = self.schemes.get(scheme_uri).ok_or_else(|| SkosError::ConceptNotFound(scheme_uri.to_string()))?;
        let concept = scheme.concepts.get(concept_uri).ok_or_else(|| SkosError::ConceptNotFound(concept_uri.to_string()))?;
        let mut result = Vec::new();
        let mut visited = BTreeSet::new();
        let mut queue: Vec<String> = concept.broader.iter().cloned().collect();
        while let Some(current) = queue.pop() {
            if !visited.insert(current.clone()) { continue; }
            result.push(current.clone());
            if let Some(c) = scheme.concepts.get(&current) { for b in &c.broader { queue.push(b.clone()); } }
        }
        Ok(result)
    }

    pub fn narrower_transitive(&self, scheme_uri: &str, concept_uri: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>, SkosError> {
        let scheme = self.schemes.get(scheme_uri).ok_or_else(|| SkosError::ConceptNotFound(scheme_uri.to_string()))?;
        let concept = scheme.concepts.get(concept_uri).ok_or_else(|| SkosError::ConceptNotFound(concept_uri.to_string()))?;
        let mut result = Vec::new();
        let mut visited = BTreeSet::new();
        let mut queue: Vec<String> = concept.narrower.iter().cloned().collect();
        while let Some(current) = queue.pop() {
            if !visited.insert(current.clone()) { return Err(SkosError::HierarchyCycle); }
            result.push(current.clone());
            if let Some(c) = scheme.concepts.get(&current) { for n in &c.narrower { queue.push(n.clone()); } }
        }
        Ok(result)
    }

    pub fn to_rdf_xml(&self) -> String {
        let mut xml = String::from(r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rdf:RDF xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
         xmlns:skos="http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#">"#);
        for scheme in self.schemes.values() {
            xml.push_str(&format!(r#"<skos:ConceptScheme rdf:about="{}">"#, scheme.uri));
            if let Some(title) = &scheme.title { xml.push_str(&format!(r#"<skos:prefLabel>{}</skos:prefLabel>"#, title)); }
            for top in &scheme.top_concepts { xml.push_str(&format!(r#"<skos:hasTopConcept rdf:resource="{}"/>"#, top)); }
            xml.push_str("</skos:ConceptScheme>");
            for concept in scheme.concepts.values() {
                xml.push_str(&format!(r#"<skos:Concept rdf:about="{}">"#, concept.uri));
                for (lang, label) in &concept.pref_label {
                    xml.push_str(&format!(r#"<skos:prefLabel xml:lang="{}">{}</skos:prefLabel>"#, lang, label));
                }
                for broader in &concept.broader { xml.push_str(&format!(r#"<skos:broader rdf:resource="{}"/>"#, broader)); }
                for narrower in &concept.narrower { xml.push_str(&format!(r#"<skos:narrower rdf:resource="{}"/>"#, narrower)); }
                xml.push_str("</skos:Concept>");
            }
        }
        xml.push_str("</rdf:RDF>");
        xml
    }

    pub fn mitre_attack_taxonomy() -> SkosScheme {
        let mut scheme = SkosScheme {
            uri: "https://attack.mitre.org/taxonomy/".to_string(),
            title: Some("MITRE ATT&CK".to_string()),
            concepts: BTreeMap::new(),
            top_concepts: BTreeSet::new(),
            has_top_concept: BTreeSet::new(),
        };
        let tactics = vec![
            ("TA0001", "Initial Access", vec!["T1190", "T1566"]),
            ("TA0002", "Execution", vec!["T1059", "T1203"]),
            ("TA0003", "Persistence", vec!["T1547", "T1136"]),
            ("TA0004", "Privilege Escalation", vec!["T1068", "T1574"]),
            ("TA0005", "Defense Evasion", vec!["T1070", "T1027"]),
            ("TA0006", "Credential Access", vec!["T1003", "T1558"]),
            ("TA0007", "Discovery", vec!["T1083", "T1046"]),
            ("TA0008", "Lateral Movement", vec!["T1021", "T1210"]),
            ("TA0009", "Collection", vec!["T1005", "T1113"]),
            ("TA0010", "Exfiltration", vec!["T1041", "T1048"]),
            ("TA0011", "Command and Control", vec!["T1071", "T1095"]),
            ("TA0040", "Impact", vec!["T1490", "T1499"]),
        ];
        for (id, label, techniques) in tactics {
            let mut narrower = BTreeSet::new();
            for tech in techniques { narrower.insert(format!("https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/{}", tech)); }
            let concept = SkosConcept {
                uri: format!("https://attack.mitre.org/tactics/{}", id),
                pref_label: [("en".to_string(), label.to_string())].into_iter().collect(),
                alt_label: vec![], hidden_label: vec![], definition: Some(format!("{} tactic", label)),
                notation: vec![id.to_string()], example: vec![], note: vec![],
                broader: BTreeSet::new(), narrower, related: BTreeSet::new(),
                exact_match: BTreeSet::new(), close_match: BTreeSet::new(),
                broad_match: BTreeSet::new(), narrow_match: BTreeSet::new(),
                related_match: BTreeSet::new(),
                in_scheme: [scheme.uri.clone()].into_iter().collect(),
                top_concept_of: [scheme.uri.clone()].into_iter().collect(),
            };
            scheme.top_concepts.insert(concept.uri.clone());
            scheme.has_top_concept.insert(concept.uri.clone());
            scheme.concepts.insert(concept.uri.clone(), concept);
        }
        scheme
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_mitre_attack() {
        let scheme = SkosRepository::mitre_attack_taxonomy();
        assert_eq!(scheme.top_concepts.len(), 12);
        assert!(scheme.concepts.contains_key("https://attack.mitre.org/tactics/TA0001"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_rdf_xml_export() {
        let mut repo = SkosRepository::new();
        repo.add_scheme(SkosRepository::mitre_attack_taxonomy());
        let xml = repo.to_rdf_xml();
        assert!(xml.contains("skos:ConceptScheme"));
        assert!(xml.contains("TA0001"));
    }
}

// crates/arkhe-symbolic/src/xpath.rs
//! XPath 1.0/2.0 evaluator — W3C XML Path Language
//!
//! Reference: https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-30/

use crate::infoset::{ElementInfoItem, InfoItem, XmlInfoset};
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum XPathError {
    #[error("Syntax error at position {position}: {message}")]
    SyntaxError { position: usize, message: String },
    #[error("Evaluation error: {0}")]
    EvaluationError(String),
    #[error("Unknown axis: {0}")]
    UnknownAxis(String),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum XPathNode {
    Root, Element(String), Attribute(String), Namespace(String), Text,
    Comment, ProcessingInstruction(Option<String>), Node,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum Axis {
    Ancestor, AncestorOrSelf, Attribute, Child, Descendant, DescendantOrSelf,
    Following, FollowingSibling, Namespace, Parent, Preceding, PrecedingSibling, Self_,
}

impl Axis {
    pub fn from_str(s: &str) -> Result<Self, XPathError> {
        match s {
            "ancestor" => Ok(Axis::Ancestor), "ancestor-or-self" => Ok(Axis::AncestorOrSelf),
            "attribute" => Ok(Axis::Attribute), "child" => Ok(Axis::Child),
            "descendant" => Ok(Axis::Descendant), "descendant-or-self" => Ok(Axis::DescendantOrSelf),
            "following" => Ok(Axis::Following), "following-sibling" => Ok(Axis::FollowingSibling),
            "namespace" => Ok(Axis::Namespace), "parent" => Ok(Axis::Parent),
            "preceding" => Ok(Axis::Preceding), "preceding-sibling" => Ok(Axis::PrecedingSibling),
            "self" => Ok(Axis::Self_), _ => Err(XPathError::UnknownAxis(s.to_string())),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Step { pub axis: Axis, pub node_test: XPathNode, pub predicates: Vec<Predicate> }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum Predicate { Position(usize), Equality { left: Expr, right: Expr } }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum Expr { Path(Vec<Step>), Literal(String), Number(f64), Variable(String) }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum XPathResult {
    NodeSet(Vec<XPathNodeValue>), Boolean(bool), Number(f64), String(String),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum XPathNodeValue {
    Element(ElementInfoItem), Attribute { name: String, value: String }, Text(String),
}

pub struct XPathEvaluator;

impl XPathEvaluator {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Self }

    pub fn parse(&self, expression: &str) -> Result<Expr, XPathError> {
        let mut chars = expression.chars().peekable();
        let mut steps = Vec::new();
        let mut current = String::new();
        while let Some(&ch) = chars.peek() {
            match ch {
                '/' => {
                    if !current.is_empty() { steps.push(self.parse_step(&current)?); current.clear(); }
                    chars.next(); if chars.peek() == Some(&'/') { chars.next(); }
                }
                '[' => {
                    current.push(ch); chars.next(); let mut depth = 1;
                    while let Some(&c) = chars.peek() {
                        current.push(c); chars.next();
                        match c { '[' => depth += 1, ']' => { depth -= 1; if depth == 0 { break; } } _ => {} }
                    }
                }
                _ => { current.push(ch); chars.next(); }
            }
        }
        if !current.is_empty() { steps.push(self.parse_step(&current)?); }
        Ok(Expr::Path(steps))
    }

    fn parse_step(&self, step_str: &str) -> Result<Step, XPathError> {
        let trimmed = step_str.trim();
        if trimmed.is_empty() { return Ok(Step { axis: Axis::Child, node_test: XPathNode::Node, predicates: Vec::new() }); }
        let (axis_str, rest) = if let Some(pos) = trimmed.find("::") { (&trimmed[..pos], &trimmed[pos + 2..]) }
        else if trimmed.starts_with('@') { ("attribute", &trimmed[1..]) }
        else if trimmed == "." { return Ok(Step { axis: Axis::Self_, node_test: XPathNode::Node, predicates: Vec::new() }); }
        else if trimmed == ".." { return Ok(Step { axis: Axis::Parent, node_test: XPathNode::Node, predicates: Vec::new() }); }
        else { ("child", trimmed) };
        let axis = Axis::from_str(axis_str)?;
        let mut node_test_str = String::new();
        let mut in_predicate = false;
        let mut pred_depth = 0;
        for ch in rest.chars() {
            match ch {
                '[' if !in_predicate => { in_predicate = true; pred_depth = 1; }
                '[' if in_predicate => { pred_depth += 1; }
                ']' if in_predicate => { pred_depth -= 1; if pred_depth == 0 { in_predicate = false; } }
                _ if in_predicate => {}
                _ => node_test_str.push(ch),
            }
        }
        let node_test = self.parse_node_test(&node_test_str)?;
        Ok(Step { axis, node_test, predicates: Vec::new() })
    }

    fn parse_node_test(&self, test: &str) -> Result<XPathNode, XPathError> {
        let trimmed = test.trim();
        match trimmed {
            "node()" => Ok(XPathNode::Node), "text()" => Ok(XPathNode::Text),
            "comment()" => Ok(XPathNode::Comment), "processing-instruction()" => Ok(XPathNode::ProcessingInstruction(None)),
            "" => Ok(XPathNode::Node), _ => {
                if trimmed.starts_with("processing-instruction('") && trimmed.ends_with("')") {
                    let name = &trimmed[24..trimmed.len()-2];
                    Ok(XPathNode::ProcessingInstruction(Some(name.to_string())))
                } else { Ok(XPathNode::Element(trimmed.to_string())) }
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate(&self, expr: &Expr, infoset: &XmlInfoset) -> Result<XPathResult, XPathError> {
        match expr {
            Expr::Path(steps) => {
                let mut context = vec![XPathNodeValue::Element(infoset.document.document_element.clone().unwrap())];
                for step in steps {
                    let mut new_context = Vec::new();
                    for node in &context { let results = self.evaluate_step(step, node)?; new_context.extend(results); }
                    context = new_context;
                }
                Ok(XPathResult::NodeSet(context))
            }
            Expr::Literal(s) => Ok(XPathResult::String(s.clone())),
            Expr::Number(n) => Ok(XPathResult::Number(*n)),
            _ => Err(XPathError::EvaluationError("Unsupported expression type".to_string())),
        }
    }

    fn evaluate_step(&self, step: &Step, node: &XPathNodeValue) -> Result<Vec<XPathNodeValue>, XPathError> {
        let mut results = Vec::new();
        match (&step.axis, &step.node_test) {
            (Axis::Child, XPathNode::Element(name)) => {
                if let XPathNodeValue::Element(el) = node {
                    for child in &el.children {
                        if let InfoItem::Element(child_el) = child {
                            if &child_el.local_name == name || name == "*" { results.push(XPathNodeValue::Element(child_el.clone())); }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            (Axis::Child, XPathNode::Text) => {
                if let XPathNodeValue::Element(el) = node {
                    for child in &el.children { if let InfoItem::Character(text) = child { results.push(XPathNodeValue::Text(text.clone())); } }
                }
            }
            (Axis::Attribute, XPathNode::Attribute(name)) => {
                if let XPathNodeValue::Element(el) = node {
                    if let Some(attr) = el.attributes.get(name) {
                        results.push(XPathNodeValue::Attribute { name: name.clone(), value: attr.normalized_value.clone() });
                    } else if name == "*" {
                        for (attr_name, attr) in &el.attributes { results.push(XPathNodeValue::Attribute { name: attr_name.clone(), value: attr.normalized_value.clone() }); }
                    }
                }
            }
            (Axis::DescendantOrSelf, XPathNode::Element(name)) => {
                if let XPathNodeValue::Element(el) = node {
                    if &el.local_name == name || name == "*" { results.push(XPathNodeValue::Element(el.clone())); }
                    self.collect_descendants(el, name, &mut results);
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        Ok(results)
    }

    fn collect_descendants(&self, element: &ElementInfoItem, name: &str, results: &mut Vec<XPathNodeValue>) {
        for child in &element.children {
            if let InfoItem::Element(child_el) = child {
                if &child_el.local_name == name || name == "*" { results.push(XPathNodeValue::Element(child_el.clone())); }
                self.collect_descendants(child_el, name, results);
            }
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::infoset::XmlInfoset;

    fn sample_xml() -> XmlInfoset {
        let xml = r#"<?xml version="1.0"?>
            <root>
                <person id="1"><name>Alice</name><age>30</age></person>
                <person id="2"><name>Bob</name><age>25</age></person>
            </root>"#;
        XmlInfoset::from_xml(xml).unwrap()
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_parse_xpath() {
        let eval = XPathEvaluator::new();
        let expr = eval.parse("/root/person/name").unwrap();
        assert!(matches!(expr, Expr::Path(_)));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_evaluate_child_axis() {
        let eval = XPathEvaluator::new();
        let infoset = sample_xml();
        let expr = eval.parse("/root/person").unwrap();
        let result = eval.evaluate(&expr, &infoset).unwrap();
        if let XPathResult::NodeSet(nodes) = result { assert_eq!(nodes.len(), 2); }
        else { panic!("Expected NodeSet"); }
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_evaluate_attribute() {
        let eval = XPathEvaluator::new();
        let infoset = sample_xml();
        let expr = eval.parse("/root/person/@id").unwrap();
        let result = eval.evaluate(&expr, &infoset).unwrap();
        if let XPathResult::NodeSet(nodes) = result { assert_eq!(nodes.len(), 2); }
        else { panic!("Expected NodeSet"); }
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_evaluate_descendant() {
        let eval = XPathEvaluator::new();
        let infoset = sample_xml();
        let expr = eval.parse("//name").unwrap();
        let result = eval.evaluate(&expr, &infoset).unwrap();
        if let XPathResult::NodeSet(nodes) = result { assert_eq!(nodes.len(), 2); }
        else { panic!("Expected NodeSet"); }
    }
}

// crates/arkhe-frontend/src/svg.rs
//! SVG 1.1/2.0 Generator — W3C Scalable Vector Graphics
//!
//! Reference: https://www.w3.org/TR/SVG2/

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum SvgError {
    #[error("Invalid dimension: {0}")]
    InvalidDimension(String),
    #[error("Missing required attribute: {0}")]
    MissingAttribute(String),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum SvgElement {
    Svg(SvgRoot), Group(Group), Rect(Rect), Circle(Circle), Ellipse(Ellipse),
    Line(Line), Polyline(Polyline), Polygon(Polygon), Path(Path), Text(Text),
    Image(Image), Defs(Defs), Use(Use), ClipPath(ClipPath), Mask(Mask),
    Gradient(Gradient), Pattern(Pattern), Filter(Filter), Animation(Animation),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct SvgRoot {
    pub width: f64, pub height: f64,
    pub view_box: Option<(f64, f64, f64, f64)>,
    pub preserve_aspect_ratio: String,
    pub children: Vec<SvgElement>,
    pub defs: Vec<SvgElement>,
    pub styles: Vec<Style>,
    pub namespaces: BTreeMap<String, String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Style { pub selector: String, pub properties: BTreeMap<String, String> }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Animation {
    pub attribute_name: String, pub from: String, pub to: String,
    pub duration: f64, pub repeat_count: Option<f64>,
    pub begin: String, pub fill: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum PathCommand {
    MoveTo { x: f64, y: f64, absolute: bool },
    LineTo { x: f64, y: f64, absolute: bool },
    HorizontalLineTo { x: f64, absolute: bool },
    VerticalLineTo { y: f64, absolute: bool },
    CurveTo { x1: f64, y1: f64, x2: f64, y2: f64, x: f64, y: f64, absolute: bool },
    SmoothCurveTo { x2: f64, y2: f64, x: f64, y: f64, absolute: bool },
    QuadraticBezierCurveTo { x1: f64, y1: f64, x: f64, y: f64, absolute: bool },
    SmoothQuadraticBezierCurveTo { x: f64, y: f64, absolute: bool },
    EllipticalArc { rx: f64, ry: f64, x_axis_rotation: f64, large_arc: bool, sweep: bool, x: f64, y: f64, absolute: bool },
    ClosePath,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Path { pub commands: Vec<PathCommand>, pub fill: Option<String>, pub stroke: Option<String>, pub stroke_width: Option<f64> }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Rect { pub x: f64, pub y: f64, pub width: f64, pub height: f64, pub rx: Option<f64>, pub ry: Option<f64>, pub fill: Option<String>, pub stroke: Option<String>, pub stroke_width: Option<f64> }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Circle { pub cx: f64, pub cy: f64, pub r: f64, pub fill: Option<String>, pub stroke: Option<String>, pub stroke_width: Option<f64> }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Text { pub x: f64, pub y: f64, pub content: String, pub font_family: Option<String>, pub font_size: Option<f64>, pub fill: Option<String>, pub text_anchor: Option<String> }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Group { pub id: Option<String>, pub transform: Option<String>, pub children: Vec<SvgElement> }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Defs { pub children: Vec<SvgElement> }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Use { pub href: String, pub x: f64, pub y: f64, pub width: Option<f64>, pub height: Option<f64> }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Gradient { pub id: String, pub gradient_type: GradientType, pub stops: Vec<GradientStop>, pub transform: Option<String> }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum GradientType {
    Linear { x1: f64, y1: f64, x2: f64, y2: f64 },
    Radial { cx: f64, cy: f64, r: f64, fx: Option<f64>, fy: Option<f64> },
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct GradientStop { pub offset: f64, pub color: String, pub opacity: Option<f64> }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Ellipse { pub cx: f64, pub cy: f64, pub rx: f64, pub ry: f64, pub fill: Option<String>, pub stroke: Option<String> }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Line { pub x1: f64, pub y1: f64, pub x2: f64, pub y2: f64, pub stroke: Option<String>, pub stroke_width: Option<f64> }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Polyline { pub points: Vec<(f64, f64)>, pub fill: Option<String>, pub stroke: Option<String> }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Polygon { pub points: Vec<(f64, f64)>, pub fill: Option<String>, pub stroke: Option<String> }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Image { pub x: f64, pub y: f64, pub width: f64, pub height: f64, pub href: String }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ClipPath { pub id: String, pub children: Vec<SvgElement> }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Mask { pub id: String, pub children: Vec<SvgElement> }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Pattern { pub id: String, pub x: f64, pub y: f64, pub width: f64, pub height: f64, pub children: Vec<SvgElement> }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Filter { pub id: String, pub primitives: Vec<FilterPrimitive> }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum FilterPrimitive {
    GaussianBlur { std_deviation: f64 },
    DropShadow { dx: f64, dy: f64, std_deviation: f64, flood_color: String },
}

pub struct SvgSerializer;

impl SvgSerializer {
    pub fn serialize(root: &SvgRoot) -> Result<String, SvgError> {
        let mut svg = String::new();
        svg.push_str(r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>"#);
        svg.push('
');
        svg.push_str(r#"<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg""#);
        for (prefix, uri) in &root.namespaces { svg.push_str(&format!(r#" xmlns:{}="{}""#, prefix, uri)); }
        svg.push_str(&format!(r#" width="{}" height="{}""#, root.width, root.height));
        if let Some((x, y, w, h)) = root.view_box { svg.push_str(&format!(r#" viewBox="{} {} {} {}""#, x, y, w, h)); }
        svg.push_str(&format!(r#" preserveAspectRatio="{}""#, root.preserve_aspect_ratio));
        svg.push('>'); svg.push('
');
        if !root.styles.is_empty() {
            svg.push_str("  <style>\n");
            for style in &root.styles {
                svg.push_str(&format!("    {} {{\n", style.selector));
                for (prop, val) in &style.properties { svg.push_str(&format!("      {}: {};\n", prop, val)); }
                svg.push_str("    }\n");
            }
            svg.push_str("  </style>\n");
        }
        if !root.defs.is_empty() {
            svg.push_str("  <defs>\n");
            for def in &root.defs { Self::serialize_element(&mut svg, def, 2)?; }
            svg.push_str("  </defs>\n");
        }
        for child in &root.children { Self::serialize_element(&mut svg, child, 1)?; }
        svg.push_str("</svg>");
        Ok(svg)
    }

    fn serialize_element(svg: &mut String, element: &SvgElement, indent: usize) -> Result<(), SvgError> {
        let spaces = "  ".repeat(indent);
        match element {
            SvgElement::Rect(r) => {
                svg.push_str(&format!("{}<rect x="{}" y="{}" width="{}" height="{}"", spaces, r.x, r.y, r.width, r.height));
                if let Some(rx) = r.rx { svg.push_str(&format!(" rx="{}"", rx)); }
                if let Some(ry) = r.ry { svg.push_str(&format!(" ry="{}"", ry)); }
                if let Some(fill) = &r.fill { svg.push_str(&format!(" fill="{}"", fill)); }
                if let Some(stroke) = &r.stroke { svg.push_str(&format!(" stroke="{}"", stroke)); }
                if let Some(sw) = r.stroke_width { svg.push_str(&format!(" stroke-width="{}"", sw)); }
                svg.push_str("/>\n");
            }
            SvgElement::Circle(c) => {
                svg.push_str(&format!("{}<circle cx="{}" cy="{}" r="{}"", spaces, c.cx, c.cy, c.r));
                if let Some(fill) = &c.fill { svg.push_str(&format!(" fill="{}"", fill)); }
                if let Some(stroke) = &c.stroke { svg.push_str(&format!(" stroke="{}"", stroke)); }
                if let Some(sw) = c.stroke_width { svg.push_str(&format!(" stroke-width="{}"", sw)); }
                svg.push_str("/>\n");
            }
            SvgElement::Text(t) => {
                svg.push_str(&format!("{}<text x="{}" y="{}"", spaces, t.x, t.y));
                if let Some(ff) = &t.font_family { svg.push_str(&format!(" font-family="{}"", ff)); }
                if let Some(fs) = t.font_size { svg.push_str(&format!(" font-size="{}"", fs)); }
                if let Some(fill) = &t.fill { svg.push_str(&format!(" fill="{}"", fill)); }
                if let Some(anchor) = &t.text_anchor { svg.push_str(&format!(" text-anchor="{}"", anchor)); }
                svg.push_str(&format!(">{}</text>\n", Self::escape_xml(&t.content)));
            }
            SvgElement::Group(g) => {
                svg.push_str(&format!("{}<g", spaces));
                if let Some(id) = &g.id { svg.push_str(&format!(" id="{}"", id)); }
                if let Some(transform) = &g.transform { svg.push_str(&format!(" transform="{}"", transform)); }
                svg.push_str(">\n");
                for child in &g.children { Self::serialize_element(svg, child, indent + 1)?; }
                svg.push_str(&format!("{}</g>\n", spaces));
            }
            SvgElement::Path(p) => {
                svg.push_str(&format!("{}<path d="{}"", spaces, Self::serialize_path_commands(&p.commands)));
                if let Some(fill) = &p.fill { svg.push_str(&format!(" fill="{}"", fill)); }
                if let Some(stroke) = &p.stroke { svg.push_str(&format!(" stroke="{}"", stroke)); }
                if let Some(sw) = p.stroke_width { svg.push_str(&format!(" stroke-width="{}"", sw)); }
                svg.push_str("/>\n");
            }
            SvgElement::Line(l) => {
                svg.push_str(&format!("{}<line x1="{}" y1="{}" x2="{}" y2="{}"", spaces, l.x1, l.y1, l.x2, l.y2));
                if let Some(stroke) = &l.stroke { svg.push_str(&format!(" stroke="{}"", stroke)); }
                if let Some(sw) = l.stroke_width { svg.push_str(&format!(" stroke-width="{}"", sw)); }
                svg.push_str("/>\n");
            }
            SvgElement::Animation(a) => {
                svg.push_str(&format!("{}<animate attributeName="{}" from="{}" to="{}" dur="{}s"", 
                    spaces, a.attribute_name, a.from, a.to, a.duration));
                if let Some(rc) = a.repeat_count {
                    if rc.is_infinite() { svg.push_str(" repeatCount="indefinite""); }
                    else { svg.push_str(&format!(" repeatCount="{}"", rc)); }
                }
                svg.push_str(&format!(" begin="{}" fill="{}"/>\n", a.begin, a.fill));
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn serialize_path_commands(commands: &[PathCommand]) -> String {
        let mut d = String::new();
        for cmd in commands {
            match cmd {
                PathCommand::MoveTo { x, y, absolute } => { d.push(if *absolute { 'M' } else { 'm' }); d.push_str(&format!("{},{} ", x, y)); }
                PathCommand::LineTo { x, y, absolute } => { d.push(if *absolute { 'L' } else { 'l' }); d.push_str(&format!("{},{} ", x, y)); }
                PathCommand::ClosePath => d.push('Z'),
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        d.trim().to_string()
    }

    fn escape_xml(text: &str) -> String {
        text.replace('&', "&amp;").replace('<', "&lt;").replace('>', "&gt;").replace('"', "&quot;").replace("'", "&apos;")
    }
}

                SvgElement::Animation(Animation { attribute_name: "r".to_string(), from: "20".to_string(), to: "40".to_string(), duration: 2.0, repeat_count: Some(f64::INFINITY), begin: "0s".to_string(), fill: "freeze".to_string() }),
