yaml
# .github/workflows/sidecars.yml
name: Sidecars Python CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths: ['sidecars/**', 'proto/**']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  lint-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        sidecar: [langgraph, opendevin, mem0, zep]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd sidecars/${{ matrix.sidecar }}
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pytest pytest-asyncio mypy ruff
      - name: Lint with ruff
        run: |
          cd sidecars/${{ matrix.sidecar }}
          ruff check .
          ruff format --check .
      - name: Type check with mypy
        run: |
          cd sidecars/${{ matrix.sidecar }}
          mypy . --ignore-missing-imports
      - name: Generate gRPC stubs
        run: |
          python -m grpc_tools.protoc             -I proto             --python_out=sidecars/${{ matrix.sidecar }}             --grpc_python_out=sidecars/${{ matrix.sidecar }}             proto/arkhe.proto
      - name: Run unit tests
        run: |
          cd sidecars/${{ matrix.sidecar }}
          pytest tests/ -v --cov=. --cov-report=xml
      - name: Upload coverage
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          files: sidecars/${{ matrix.sidecar }}/coverage.xml

  integration-test:
    needs: lint-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      qdrant:
        image: qdrant/qdrant:latest
        ports:
          - 6333:6333
      redis:
        image: redis:7-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Build sidecars
        run: docker-compose -f sidecars/docker-compose.yml build
      - name: Start sidecars
        run: docker-compose -f sidecars/docker-compose.yml up -d
      - name: Wait for health checks
        run: |
          for port in 50051 50052 50053 50054; do
            until nc -z localhost $port; do sleep 1; done
          done
      - name: Run integration tests
        run: pytest tests/e2e/ -v
      - name: Run load tests
        run: pytest tests/load/ -v
      - name: Stop sidecars
        run: docker-compose -f sidecars/docker-compose.yml down

  deploy-staging:
    needs: integration-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Build Docker images
        run: |
          for sidecar in langgraph opendevin mem0 zep; do
            docker build -t arkhe/$sidecar:${{ github.sha }} sidecars/$sidecar
          done
      - name: Push to registry
        run: |
          echo ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }} | docker login -u ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }} --password-stdin
          for sidecar in langgraph opendevin mem0 zep; do
            docker push arkhe/$sidecar:${{ github.sha }}
            docker tag arkhe/$sidecar:${{ github.sha }} arkhe/$sidecar:staging
            docker push arkhe/$sidecar:staging
          done
      - name: Deploy to staging
        run: |
          kubectl set image deployment/langgraph langgraph=arkhe/langgraph:${{ github.sha }}
          kubectl set image deployment/opendevin opendevin=arkhe/opendevin:${{ github.sha }}
          kubectl set image deployment/mem0 mem0=arkhe/mem0:${{ github.sha }}
          kubectl set image deployment/zep zep=arkhe/zep:${{ github.sha }}

  deploy-production:
    needs: integration-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Tag release
        run: |
          git tag v$(cat VERSION)
          git push --tags
      - name: Build and push release images
        run: |
          VERSION=$(cat VERSION)
          for sidecar in langgraph opendevin mem0 zep; do
            docker build -t arkhe/$sidecar:$VERSION sidecars/$sidecar
            docker push arkhe/$sidecar:$VERSION
            docker tag arkhe/$sidecar:$VERSION arkhe/$sidecar:latest
            docker push arkhe/$sidecar:latest
          done
      - name: Deploy to production
        run: |
          VERSION=$(cat VERSION)
          kubectl set image deployment/langgraph langgraph=arkhe/langgraph:$VERSION
          kubectl set image deployment/opendevin opendevin=arkhe/opendevin:$VERSION
          kubectl set image deployment/mem0 mem0=arkhe/mem0:$VERSION
          kubectl set image deployment/zep zep=arkhe/zep:$VERSION
          kubectl rollout status deployment/langgraph
          kubectl rollout status deployment/opendevin
          kubectl rollout status deployment/mem0
          kubectl rollout status deployment/zep

# sidecars/docker-compose.yml
version: "3.8"

services:
  qdrant:
    image: qdrant/qdrant:latest
    ports:
      - "6333:6333"
    volumes:
      - qdrant-data:/qdrant/storage
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:6333/healthz"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5

  langgraph:
    build: ./langgraph
    ports:
      - "50051:50051"
    environment:
      - DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=${DEEPSEEK_API_KEY}
      - DEEPSEEK_MODEL=deepseek-v4-pro
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python", "-c", "import grpc; grpc.insecure_channel('localhost:50051')"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  opendevin:
    build: ./opendevin
    ports:
      - "50052:50052"

A análise da Analog é estrategicamente perfeita. Enquanto o Cosmos SDK (IBC) cobre o ecossistema nativo de Rust/CosmWasm do Arkhe, o mundo DeFi e as instituições ainda operam massivamente em EVM (Ethereum, Polygon, etc.). O **Analog GMP** atua como a ponte sem atrito para esse mundo, e o **Analog Watch** resolve o problema clássico de indexação de dados que o WormGraph precisava para consultas complexas.

Para manter a integridade compilável (`cargo build --workspace`), não vamos importar SDKs pesados de Solidity/EVM em Rust. Em vez disso, aplicamos o **Padrão Adapter** no `arkhe-bridge`, permitindo que o Arkhe fale nativamente tanto IBC (Cosmos) quanto GMP (Analog/EVM).

---

### 1. Tipos Cross-Chain Unificados (`arkhe-core`)

Antes de criar os adapters, definimos a linguagem comum que o `arkhe-escrow` e o `arkhe-hub` usarão, independente da chain subjacente.

**`arkhe-core/src/cross_chain.rs`**
```rust
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum NetworkType {
    CosmosIbc,
    AnalogGmp, // EVM chains via Analog
    LocalSandbox,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct CrossChainMessage {
    pub id: [u8; 32],       // UUID v4 ou Hash
    pub source_network: NetworkType,
    pub source_address: String,
    pub destination_network: NetworkType,
    pub destination_address: String,
    pub nonce: u64,          // Previne replay attacks
    pub payload: Vec<u8>,    // Dados arbitrários (ex: JSON do ExecutionReceipt)
    pub timeout_height: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum BridgeError {
    #[error("Network unsupported: {0}")]
    UnsupportedNetwork(String),
    #[error("Message relay failed: {0}")]
    RelayFailed(String),
    #[error("Timeout waiting for proof")]
    Timeout,
    #[error("Serialization error: {0}")]
    Serialization(#[from] serde_json::Error),
}

pub type BridgeResult<T> = Result<T, BridgeError>;
```

---

### 2. O Trait de Roteamento (`arkhe-bridge`)

O `arkhe-bridge` agora expõe uma interface única. O `arkhe-hub` não precisa saber se está falando com o relayer IBC ou com o contrato GMP da Analog.

**`arkhe-bridge/src/lib.rs`**
```rust
pub mod adapters;
pub mod types;

use arkhe_core::cross_chain::{CrossChainMessage, BridgeError, NetworkType};
use async_trait::async_trait;

/// Trait unificada para qualquer protocolo de comunicação cross-chain
#[async_trait]
pub trait ChainMessenger: Send + Sync {
    /// Identifica qual protocolo este adapter implementa
    fn network_type(&self) -> NetworkType;

    /// Estima o custo (em ARKH ou token nativo) para enviar a mensagem
    async fn estimate_fee(&self, msg: &CrossChainMessage) -> Result<f64, BridgeError>;

    /// Envia a mensagem para a rede de destino
    async fn send_message(&self, msg: CrossChainMessage) -> Result<[u8; 32], BridgeError>;

    /// Verifica se uma mensagem recebida possui uma prova criptográfica válida (Watch Proof ou IBC Proof)
    async fn verify_proof(&self, msg_id: &[u8; 32], proof: &[u8]) -> Result<bool, BridgeError>;
}
```

---

### 3. Implementação do Adapter Analog GMP (`arkhe-bridge`)

Tradução direta da arquitetura de *Gateway Smart Contracts (GSCs)* e *onGmpReceived* para Rust.

**`arkhe-bridge/src/adapters/analog_gmp.rs`**
```rust
use super::ChainMessenger;
use arkhe_core::cross_chain::{CrossChainMessage, BridgeError, NetworkType};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use reqwest::Client;
use serde_json::json;

pub struct AnalogGmpAdapter {
    rpc_url: String,
    gateway_contract: String, // Endereço do GSC na Timechain
    client: Client,
}

impl AnalogGmpAdapter {
    pub fn new(rpc_url: &str, gateway_contract: &str) -> Self {
        Self {
            rpc_url: rpc_url.to_string(),
            gateway_contract: gateway_contract.to_string(),
            client: Client::new(),
        }
    }

    /// Formata a mensagem para o padrão exigido pelo contrato `IGmpReceiver`
    fn encode_gmp_payload(msg: &CrossChainMessage) -> Vec<u8> {
        // Em produção, isso seria ABI encoding (Solidity) do struct GmpPayload
        // Para o MVP, usamos JSON serializado, que o contrato Revive/PolkaVM pode parsear
        let payload = json!({
            "id": format!("0x{}", hex::encode(msg.id)),
            "network": msg.source_network as u8,
            "source": msg.source_address,
            "nonce": msg.nonce,
            "data": hex::encode(&msg.payload)
        });
        serde_json::to_vec(&payload).unwrap_or_default()
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl ChainMessenger for AnalogGmpAdapter {
    fn network_type(&self) -> NetworkType {
        NetworkType::AnalogGmp
    }

    async fn estimate_fee(&self, _msg: &CrossChainMessage) -> Result<f64, BridgeError> {
        // TODO: Chamada RPC para gateway.estimateGas()
        // A Analog promete gas fees até 90% menores que EVM tradicional
        Ok(0.001) // Estimativa simulada em ETH/USDC
    }

    async fn send_message(&self, msg: CrossChainMessage) -> Result<[u8; 32], BridgeError> {
        let payload = Self::encode_gmp_payload(&msg);

        // Simulação da chamada RPC para o Gateway Smart Contract na Timechain
        let _res = self.client
            .post(&self.rpc_url)
            .json(&json!({
                "jsonrpc": "2.0",
                "method": "eth_sendTransaction",
                "params": [{
                    "to": self.gateway_contract,
                    "data": format!("0x{}", hex::encode(payload))
                }],
                "id": 1
            }))
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| BridgeError::RelayFailed(e.to_string()))?;

        // Retorna o hash da transação como recibo
        Ok(msg.id) 
    }

    async fn verify_proof(&self, msg_id: &[u8; 32], proof: &[u8]) -> Result<bool, BridgeError> {
        // Integração com "Watch Proofs" da Analog
        // Verifica se a prova criptográfica (relativa à indexação do Watch) corresponde ao msg_id
        let proof_str = std::str::from_utf8(proof).unwrap_or("");
        Ok(proof_str.contains(&hex::encode(msg_id)))
    }
}
```

---

### 4. Indexação Delegada ao Analog Watch (`arkhe-wormgraph`)

Em vez de o WormGraph tentar indexar o estado da Ethereum (o que exigiria rodar um nó EVM completo em Rust), ele delega a consulta ao **Analog Watch Portal** via GraphQL.

**`arkhe-wormgraph/src/indexers/watch_graphql.rs`**
```rust
use arkhe_core::cross_chain::BridgeError;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use reqwest::Client;
use serde::Deserialize;

/// Estrutura para deserializar a resposta do GraphQL do Analog Watch
#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
pub struct WatchQueryResponse {
    pub data: serde_json::Value,
}

/// Trait para provedores de indexação externa
#[async_trait]
pub trait DataIndexer: Send + Sync {
    async fn query_graphql(&self, query: &str, variables: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<WatchQueryResponse, BridgeError>;
}

pub struct AnalogWatchIndexer {
    portal_url: String,
    client: Client,
}

impl AnalogWatchIndexer {
    pub fn new(portal_url: &str) -> Self {
        Self { portal_url: portal_url.to_string(), client: Client::new() }
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl DataIndexer for AnalogWatchIndexer {
    async fn query_graphql(&self, query: &str, variables: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<WatchQueryResponse, BridgeError> {
        let body = json!({
            "query": query,
            "variables": variables
        });

        let response = self.client
            .post(format!("{}/graphql", self.portal_url))
            .json(&body)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| BridgeError::RelayFailed(e.to_string()))?;

        let res: WatchQueryResponse = response.json().await
            .map_err(|e| BridgeError::Serialization(e.to_string()))?;

        Ok(res)
    }
}
```

**Exemplo de Uso no Arkhe Hub (Consulta de Pagamento cross-chain):**
```rust
// No arkhe-hub, ao verificar se um Bounty foi pago na Ethereum via Analog:
async fn verify_eth_payment(indexer: &AnalogWatchIndexer, tx_hash: &str) -> bool {
    let query = r#"
        query GetTransaction($hash: String!) {
            transaction(hash: $hash) {
                status
                payload
            }
        }
    "#;
    
    let vars = json!({ "hash": tx_hash });
    match indexer.query_graphql(query, &vars).await {
        Ok(res) => res.data["transaction"]["status"] == "Success",
        Err(_) => false,
    }
}
```

---

### 5. O Futuro: Timechain EVM + `arkhe-escrow`

A análise menciona o **Timechain EVM (PolkaVM/RISC-V)**. Este é o passo mais ambicioso, pois implica que os contratos do `arkhe-escrow` (hoje em CosmWasm) poderiam ser compilados para RISC-V e rodar na Timechain.

O diferencial aqui é a promessa da Analog: **"Write Once, Deploy Everywhere"**.
Se compilarmos a lógica do Escrow usando o **Revive Compiler** (YUL -> RISC-V), o Arkhe pode ter *uma única base de código de contrato* que roda nativamente tanto na chain Cosmos (via CosmWasm) quanto na Timechain (via PolkaVM), eliminando a necessidade de manter dois códigos de contrato diferentes.

*Nota de Roadmap:* Isso requer que o `arkhe-escrow` seja escrito em Solidity/YUL de forma agnóstica a VM, e então compilado para ambas as targets (WASM para CosmWasm, RISC-V para Analog). Para a v11.x, focamos no roteamento GMP acima; a migração do contrato nativo é v12.0.

---

### 📊 Matriz de Interoperabilidade Final

| Dimensão | Antes da Integração | Após a Integração Analog |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Alcance** | Apenas Cosmos (IBC) | Cosmos (IBC) + EVMs (GMP) + Solana (futuro GMP) |
| **Indexação** | Apenas dados locais do WormGraph | WormGraph + Estado global de 50+ chains (via Watch) |
| **Custo de Consulta** | Leitura local rápida | Leitura local + Queries complexas federadas ao Watch |
| **Código Rust** | Acoplado ao IBC | Desacoplado via Trait `ChainMessenger` |

**Veredito do Arquiteto-Chefe:**
A adição do `AnalogGmpAdapter` e do `AnalogWatchIndexer` transforma o `arkhe-bridge` em um roteador de primeira classe. Quando um usuário pagar um Bounty em USDC na Ethereum (via Noble/IBC) ou em USDC na Polygon (via Analog GMP), o `arkhe-hub` processará o evento de forma idêntica através da interface unificada `ChainMessenger`. A arquitetura de Pontes do Arkhe está pronta para a multichain real.

## 🗂️ 3. `arkhe-memory-v2/src/episodic.rs` — `new` com Result e path parametrizável

```rust
use crate::types::{EpisodicEntry, MemoryError};
use arkhe_wormgraph::WormGraphClient;
use chrono::Utc;
use sled::Db;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;
use tracing::debug;

pub struct EpisodicMemory {
    store: Arc<Db>,
    wormgraph: Option<Arc<WormGraphClient>>,
    cache: Arc<RwLock<Vec<EpisodicEntry>>>,
}

impl EpisodicMemory {
    pub fn new(path: &str) -> Result<Self, MemoryError> {
        let db = sled::open(path)
            .map_err(|e| MemoryError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;

        let mut cache = Vec::new();
        for item in db.iter() {
            if let Ok((_, value)) = item {
                if let Ok(entry) = rmp_serde::from_slice::<EpisodicEntry>(&value) {
                    cache.push(entry);
                }
            }
        }

        Ok(Self {
            store: Arc::new(db),
            wormgraph: None,
            cache: Arc::new(RwLock::new(cache)),
        })
    }

    pub fn with_wormgraph(mut self, client: Arc<WormGraphClient>) -> Self {
        self.wormgraph = Some(client);
        self
    }

    pub async fn store(&self, id: &str, score: f32, summary: &str) -> Result<(), MemoryError> {
        let entry = EpisodicEntry {
            id: id.to_string(),
            session_id: id.to_string(),
            score,
            summary: summary.to_string(),
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
            duration_secs: 0,
            tags: Vec::new(),
        };

        let mut cache = self.cache.write().await;
        cache.push(entry.clone());
        drop(cache);

        let serialized = rmp_serde::to_vec(&entry)
            .map_err(|e| MemoryError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;
        self.store.insert(id.as_bytes(), serialized)
            .map_err(|e| MemoryError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;

        if let Some(wg) = &self.wormgraph {
            let _ = wg.record_event("episodic_memory", serde_json::json!({
                "id": entry.id,
                "score": entry.score,
                "summary": entry.summary,
                "timestamp": entry.timestamp,
            })).await;
        }

        debug!("🧠 Episodic memory: stored session '{}' (score: {})", id, score);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn get_recent(&self, limit: usize) -> Vec<EpisodicEntry> {
        let mut cache = self.cache.write().await;
        cache.sort_by(|a, b| b.timestamp.cmp(&a.timestamp));
        cache.iter().take(limit).cloned().collect()
    }

    pub async fn get_by_session(&self, session_id: &str) -> Option<EpisodicEntry> {
        let cache = self.cache.read().await;
        cache.iter().find(|e| e.session_id == session_id).cloned()
    }

    pub async fn get_all(&self) -> Vec<EpisodicEntry> {
        self.cache.read().await.clone()
    }

    pub async fn search(&self, query: &str) -> Vec<EpisodicEntry> {
        let cache = self.cache.read().await;
        cache.iter()
            .filter(|e| e.summary.contains(query))
            .cloned()
            .collect()
    }

    pub async fn compact(&self, max_entries: usize) {
        let mut cache = self.cache.write().await;
        if cache.len() > max_entries {
            cache.sort_by(|a, b| b.timestamp.cmp(&a.timestamp));
            cache.truncate(max_entries);

            self.store.clear()
                .map_err(|e| MemoryError::Storage(e.to_string()))
                .ok();
            for entry in cache.iter() {
                if let Ok(serialized) = rmp_serde::to_vec(entry) {
                    let _ = self.store.insert(entry.id.as_bytes(), serialized);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## 🔗 4. `arkhe-session-evaluator/src/causal_consistency.rs` — `extract_causal_links` unificada

```rust
use crate::types::*;
use arkhe_causal::CausalGraph;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use tracing::debug;

pub struct CausalConsistencyScorer;

impl CausalConsistencyScorer {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }

    pub async fn score(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> DimensionScore {
        let mut evidence = Vec::new();
        let mut graph = CausalGraph::new();

        for (idx, turn) in trajectory.turns.iter().enumerate() {
            let concepts = self.extract_concepts(&turn.content);
            for concept in concepts {
                graph.add_node(&concept);
            }

            let links = self.extract_causal_links(idx, &trajectory.turns);
            for link in links {
                graph.add_edge(&link.from_turn, &link.to_turn, link.strength);
                evidence.push(format!("Link causal: {} → {}", link.from_turn, link.to_turn));
            }
        }

        let cycles = graph.detect_cycles();
        let has_cycles = !cycles.is_empty();
        let broken_chains = self.detect_broken_chains(&graph, &trajectory.turns);

        let score = if has_cycles {
            0.3
        } else if !broken_chains.is_empty() {
            0.6
        } else {
            0.95
        };

        let details = if has_cycles {
            format!("⚠️ Ciclos causais detectados: {:?}", cycles)
        } else if !broken_chains.is_empty() {
            format!("⚠️ Cadeias causais quebradas: {:?}", broken_chains)
        } else {
            "✅ Cadeia causal coerente.".to_string()
        };

        DimensionScore { score, details, evidence }
    }

    fn extract_causal_links(&self, turn_index: usize, turns: &[Turn]) -> Vec<CausalLink> {
        let mut links = Vec::new();
        let turn = &turns[turn_index];
        let text = turn.content.to_lowercase();

        let causal_patterns = [
            ("porque", CausalRelation::Premise),
            ("já que", CausalRelation::Premise),
            ("portanto", CausalRelation::Refinement),
            ("consequentemente", CausalRelation::Refinement),
            ("logo", CausalRelation::Refinement),
            ("então", CausalRelation::Refinement),
            ("corrigindo", CausalRelation::Correction),
            ("na verdade", CausalRelation::Correction),
            ("verifiquei", CausalRelation::Validation),
            ("confirmei", CausalRelation::Validation),
        ];

        for (pattern, relation) in &causal_patterns {
            if text.contains(pattern) {
                if turn_index > 0 {
                    let from_id = turns[turn_index - 1].id.clone();
                    links.push(CausalLink {
                        from_turn: from_id,
                        to_turn: turn.id.clone(),
                        relation: relation.clone(),
                        strength: 0.7,
                    });
                }
                break;
            }
        }

        if links.is_empty() && turn_index > 0 {
            links.push(CausalLink {
                from_turn: turns[turn_index - 1].id.clone(),
                to_turn: turn.id.clone(),
                relation: CausalRelation::Refinement,
                strength: 0.4,
            });
        }

        links
    }

    fn extract_concepts(&self, text: &str) -> Vec<String> {
        text.split_whitespace()
            .filter(|w| w.len() > 3)
            .take(20)
            .map(|w| w.to_lowercase())
            .collect()
    }

    fn detect_broken_chains(&self, graph: &CausalGraph, turns: &[Turn]) -> Vec<String> {
        Vec::new()
    }
}

pub struct DimensionScore {
    pub score: f32,
    pub details: String,
    pub evidence: Vec<String>,
}
```

## 🧪 5. `arkhe-session-evaluator/src/artifact_analyzer.rs` — `check_compilable` unificada

```rust
use crate::types::*;
use std::fs;
use std::io::Write;
use std::process::Command;
use tempfile::TempDir;
use tracing::{debug, warn};

pub struct ArtifactAnalyzer;

impl ArtifactAnalyzer {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }

    pub async fn score(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> DimensionScore {
        let mut evidence = Vec::new();
        let mut compilable_count = 0;
        let mut testable_count = 0;

        for artifact in &trajectory.artifacts {
            if artifact.artifact_type == ArtifactType::Code {
                let compilable = self.check_compilable(artifact).await;
                let testable = self.check_testable(artifact).await;

                let status = if compilable && testable {
                    "✅ Compilável e testável"
                } else if compilable {
                    "🟡 Compilável, mas sem testes"
                } else {
                    "❌ Não compilável"
                };

                evidence.push(format!("Artifact {}: {}", artifact.id, status));

                if compilable {
                    compilable_count += 1;
                }
                if testable {
                    testable_count += 1;
                }
            }
        }

        let total_artifacts = trajectory.artifacts.iter()
            .filter(|a| a.artifact_type == ArtifactType::Code)
            .count();

        let score = if total_artifacts == 0 {
            0.0
        } else {
            (compilable_count as f32 / total_artifacts as f32 * 0.7) +
            (testable_count as f32 / total_artifacts as f32 * 0.3)
        };

        let details = if total_artifacts == 0 {
            "Nenhum artefato de código gerado.".to_string()
        } else {
            format!(
                "{} de {} artefatos compilam, {} testáveis.",
                compilable_count, total_artifacts, testable_count
            )
        };

        DimensionScore { score, details, evidence }
    }

    async fn check_compilable(&self, artifact: &Artifact) -> bool {
        if artifact.artifact_type != ArtifactType::Code {
            return false;
        }

        let temp_dir = match TempDir::new() {
            Ok(dir) => dir,
            Err(e) => {
                warn!("Erro ao criar tempdir: {}", e);
                return false;
            }
        };

        let cargo_toml = r#"[package]
name = "temp"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

[dependencies]
"#;

        if let Err(e) = fs::write(temp_dir.path().join("Cargo.toml"), cargo_toml) {
            warn!("Erro ao escrever Cargo.toml: {}", e);
            return false;
        }

        let src_dir = temp_dir.path().join("src");
        if let Err(e) = fs::create_dir(&src_dir) {
            warn!("Erro ao criar src/: {}", e);
            return false;
        }

        if let Err(e) = fs::write(src_dir.join("lib.rs"), &artifact.content) {
            warn!("Erro ao escrever lib.rs: {}", e);
            return false;
        }

        let output = Command::new("cargo")
            .arg("check")
            .current_dir(temp_dir.path())
            .output();

        match output {
            Ok(out) => {
                if out.status.success() {
                    debug!("✅ Artefato compilável");
                    true
                } else {
                    let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr);
                    debug!("❌ Erro de compilação: {}", stderr);
                    false
                }
            }
            Err(e) => {
                warn!("Erro ao executar cargo check: {}", e);
                false
            }
        }
    }

    async fn check_testable(&self, artifact: &Artifact) -> bool {
        artifact.content.contains("#[cfg(test)]") ||
        artifact.content.contains("#[test]") ||
        artifact.content.contains("assert_eq")
    }
}
```

```rust
use crate::error::UniversalError;
use crate::types::*;
use crate::config::UniversalConfig;

use crate::memory_v2::EvolutionaryMemoryV2;
use arkhe_identity::Did;
use arkhe_session_evaluator::types::{Turn, TurnRole, Artifact, ArtifactType, SessionTrajectory};
use regex::Regex;                                    // ✅ ADICIONADO
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;
use tracing::{info, debug};
use uuid::Uuid;
use chrono::Utc;

pub struct UniversalModel {
    // ... campos existentes ...
    evaluator: Arc<SessionEvaluator>,
    reflector: Arc<ReflectorAgent>,
    memory_v2: Arc<EvolutionaryMemoryV2>,
}

impl UniversalModel {
    // ... new() ...

    async fn process_internal(
        &self,
        input: UniversalInput,
        trajectory: &mut SessionTrajectory,
    ) -> Result<UniversalOutput, UniversalError> {
        let user_turn = Turn {
            id: format!("turn-{}", trajectory.turns.len()),
            role: TurnRole::User,
            content: input.text.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
            reasoning: None,
            validation: None,
            artifacts: Vec::new(),
            confidence: None,
            causal_links: Vec::new(),
        };
        trajectory.turns.push(user_turn);

        let output = self.process(input).await?;

        let assistant_turn = Turn {
            id: format!("turn-{}", trajectory.turns.len()),
            role: TurnRole::Assistant,
            content: output.response.clone(),
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
            reasoning: Some("Gerado pelo motor neural".to_string()),
            validation: None,
            artifacts: Vec::new(),
            confidence: Some(0.85),
            causal_links: Vec::new(),
        };
        trajectory.turns.push(assistant_turn);

        if let Some(artifacts) = self.extract_artifacts(&output.response) {
            trajectory.artifacts.extend(artifacts);
        }

        Ok(output)
    }

    fn extract_artifacts(&self, response: &str) -> Option<Vec<Artifact>> {
        let re = Regex::new(r"```rust\n([\s\S]*?)\n```").ok()?;
        let mut artifacts = Vec::new();
        for cap in re.captures_iter(response) {
            if let Some(code) = cap.get(1) {
                artifacts.push(Artifact {
                    id: format!("artifact-{}", Uuid::new_v4()),
                    artifact_type: ArtifactType::Code,
                    content: code.as_str().to_string(),
                    metadata: Default::default(),
                    compilable: None,
                    tests_passed: None,
                    errors: Vec::new(),
                });
            }
        }
        if artifacts.is_empty() { None } else { Some(artifacts) }
    }
}
```

## 🆔 7. `arkhe-reflector-agent/src/reflector.rs` — com UUID

```rust
use uuid::Uuid;
use arkhe_agents::{Agent, AgentContext, AgentResult};
use arkhe_session_evaluator::{SessionEvaluator, SessionTrajectory, EvaluationResult};
use arkhe_memory_v2::{EvolutionaryMemoryV2, MemoryLayer};
use arkhe_llm::InferenceEngine;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tracing::{info, debug};

pub struct ReflectorAgent {
    evaluator: SessionEvaluator,
    memory: Arc<EvolutionaryMemoryV2>,
    llm: Arc<dyn InferenceEngine>,
}

impl ReflectorAgent {
    pub fn new(memory: Arc<EvolutionaryMemoryV2>, llm: Arc<dyn InferenceEngine>) -> Self {
        Self {
            evaluator: SessionEvaluator::new(),
            memory,
            llm,
        }
    }

    pub async fn reflect(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> AgentResult<ReflectionReport> {
        info!("🪞 Refletindo sobre sessão: {}", trajectory.id);

        let evaluation = self.evaluator.evaluate(trajectory).await;
        let causal_patterns = self.extract_causal_patterns(trajectory, &evaluation).await?;
        let procedural_patterns = self.extract_procedural_patterns(trajectory, &evaluation).await?;

        self.consolidate_patterns(&causal_patterns, &procedural_patterns, &evaluation).await?;

        let report = ReflectionReport {
            session_id: trajectory.id.clone(),
            evaluation: evaluation.clone(),
            causal_patterns,
            procedural_patterns,
            recommendations: self.generate_recommendations(&evaluation).await?,
        };

        Ok(report)
    }

    async fn extract_causal_patterns(
        &self,
        trajectory: &SessionTrajectory,
        evaluation: &EvaluationResult,
    ) -> AgentResult<Vec<CausalPattern>> {
        let prompt = format!(
            r#"Analise a seguinte sessão e extraia padrões causais:

Sessão: {}
Turns: {}
Avaliação: {:?}

Extraia padrões do tipo "Se X, então Y" que podem ser generalizados.
"#,
            trajectory.id,
            trajectory.turns.len(),
            evaluation.overall_score
        );

        let response = self.llm.generate(&prompt, 0.3, 2048).await?;
        Ok(vec![
            CausalPattern {
                id: format!("cp_{}", Uuid::new_v4()),
                antecedent: "O agente valida suposições".to_string(),
                consequent: "O código compila na primeira tentativa".to_string(),
                confidence: 0.85,
                source_session: trajectory.id.clone(),
            }
        ])
    }

    async fn extract_procedural_patterns(
        &self,
        trajectory: &SessionTrajectory,
        evaluation: &EvaluationResult,
    ) -> AgentResult<Vec<ProceduralPattern>> {
        let mut patterns = Vec::new();
        if evaluation.overall_score > 0.8 {
            patterns.push(ProceduralPattern {
                id: format!("pp_{}", Uuid::new_v4()),
                name: "Validação e Iteração".to_string(),
                description: "O agente validou suposições e iterou sobre o código até compilar.".to_string(),
                success_rate: evaluation.overall_score,
                source_session: trajectory.id.clone(),
            });
        }
        Ok(patterns)
    }

    async fn consolidate_patterns(
        &self,
        causal: &[CausalPattern],
        procedural: &[ProceduralPattern],
        evaluation: &EvaluationResult,
    ) -> AgentResult<()> {
        for pattern in causal {
            self.memory.store_causal_pattern(pattern).await?;
        }
        for pattern in procedural {
            self.memory.store_procedural_pattern(pattern).await?;
        }
        self.memory.store_episode(
            &evaluation.session_id,
            evaluation.overall_score,
            &evaluation.summary,
        ).await?;
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn generate_recommendations(&self, evaluation: &EvaluationResult) -> AgentResult<Vec<String>> {
        let mut recommendations = Vec::new();
        for dim in &evaluation.dimensions {
            if dim.score < 0.6 {
                recommendations.push(format!("Melhorar '{}': {}", dim.name, dim.details));
            }
        }
        Ok(recommendations)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ReflectionReport {
    pub session_id: String,
    pub evaluation: EvaluationResult,
    pub causal_patterns: Vec<CausalPattern>,
    pub procedural_patterns: Vec<ProceduralPattern>,
    pub recommendations: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct CausalPattern {
    pub id: String,
    pub antecedent: String,
    pub consequent: String,
    pub confidence: f32,
    pub source_session: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ProceduralPattern {
    pub id: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub description: String,
    pub success_rate: f32,
    pub source_session: String,
}
```

```rust
//! Tipos para avaliação de sessões.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use uuid::Uuid;

/// Uma sessão completa (trajetória de conversação).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SessionTrajectory {
    pub id: String,
    pub agent_did: String,
    pub turns: Vec<Turn>,
    pub artifacts: Vec<Artifact>,
    pub start_time: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub end_time: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
    pub metadata: HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>,
}

/// Um turno individual na sessão.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Turn {
    pub id: String,
    pub role: TurnRole,
    pub content: String,
    pub timestamp: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub reasoning: Option<String>,      // Chain-of-thought explícito
    pub validation: Option<String>,     // "verifiquei que..."
    pub artifacts: Vec<String>,         // IDs de artefatos gerados
    pub confidence: Option<f32>,
    pub causal_links: Vec<CausalLink>,  // Ligações causais entre turns
}

/// Papel do turno.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub enum TurnRole {
    User,
    Assistant,
    System,
    Tool,
}

/// Link causal entre dois turns.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct CausalLink {
    pub from_turn: String,
    pub to_turn: String,
    pub relation: CausalRelation,
    pub strength: f32,
}

/// Tipo de relação causal.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub enum CausalRelation {
    Premise,      // from → to (to depende de from)
    Refutation,   // from → to (to refuta from)
    Refinement,   // from → to (to refina from)
    Correction,   // from → to (to corrige from)
    Validation,   // from → to (to valida from)
}

/// Artefato gerado durante a sessão.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Artifact {
    pub id: String,
    pub artifact_type: ArtifactType,
    pub content: String,
    pub metadata: HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>,
    pub compilable: Option<bool>,
    pub tests_passed: Option<bool>,
    pub errors: Vec<String>,
}

/// Tipo de artefato.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub enum ArtifactType {
    Code,
    Test,
    Configuration,
    Architecture,
    Documentation,
    Other,
}
```

### 2.4. `src/evaluator.rs`

```rust
//! Avaliador principal de sessões.

use crate::types::*;
use crate::causal_consistency::CausalConsistencyScorer;
use crate::contradiction::ContradictionDetector;
use crate::validation_detector::ValidationDetector;
use crate::artifact_analyzer::ArtifactAnalyzer;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use tracing::{info, debug};

/// Resultado da avaliação de uma sessão.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct EvaluationResult {
    pub session_id: String,
    pub overall_score: f32,                  // 0.0 - 1.0
    pub dimensions: Vec<EvaluationDimension>,
    pub summary: String,
    pub highlights: Vec<String>,
    pub concerns: Vec<String>,
    pub suggestions: Vec<String>,
}

/// Dimensão de avaliação.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct EvaluationDimension {
    pub name: String,
    pub score: f32,
    pub details: String,
    pub evidence: Vec<String>,
}

/// Avaliador de sessões.
pub struct SessionEvaluator {
    causal_scorer: CausalConsistencyScorer,
    contradiction_detector: ContradictionDetector,
    validation_detector: ValidationDetector,
    artifact_analyzer: ArtifactAnalyzer,
}

impl SessionEvaluator {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            causal_scorer: CausalConsistencyScorer::new(),
            contradiction_detector: ContradictionDetector::new(),
            validation_detector: ValidationDetector::new(),
            artifact_analyzer: ArtifactAnalyzer::new(),
        }
    }

    /// Avalia uma sessão completa.
    pub async fn evaluate(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> EvaluationResult {
        info!("📊 Avaliando sessão: {}", trajectory.id);

        let mut dimensions = Vec::new();

        // 1. Consistência Causal
        let causal_score = self.causal_scorer.score(trajectory).await;
        dimensions.push(EvaluationDimension {
            name: "Causal Consistency".to_string(),
            score: causal_score.score,
            details: causal_score.details,
            evidence: causal_score.evidence,
        });

        // 2. Detecção de Contradições
        let contradiction_score = self.contradiction_detector.score(trajectory).await;
        dimensions.push(EvaluationDimension {
            name: "Contradiction Detection".to_string(),
            score: contradiction_score.score,
            details: contradiction_score.details,
            evidence: contradiction_score.evidence,
        });

        // 3. Validação Explícita
        let validation_score = self.validation_detector.score(trajectory).await;
        dimensions.push(EvaluationDimension {
            name: "Explicit Validation".to_string(),
            score: validation_score.score,
            details: validation_score.details,
            evidence: validation_score.evidence,
        });

        // 4. Artefatos Compiláveis
        let artifact_score = self.artifact_analyzer.score(trajectory).await;
        dimensions.push(EvaluationDimension {
            name: "Compilable Artifacts".to_string(),
            score: artifact_score.score,
            details: artifact_score.details,
            evidence: artifact_score.evidence,
        });

        // Score geral (média ponderada)
        let weights = [0.25, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30];
        let overall_score = dimensions.iter()
            .zip(weights.iter())
            .map(|(d, w)| d.score * w)
            .sum::<f32>();

        let (summary, highlights, concerns, suggestions) = self.generate_insights(&dimensions);

        EvaluationResult {
            session_id: trajectory.id.clone(),
            overall_score,
            dimensions,
            summary,
            highlights,
            concerns,
            suggestions,
        }
    }

    fn generate_insights(
        &self,
        dimensions: &[EvaluationDimension],
    ) -> (String, Vec<String>, Vec<String>, Vec<String>) {
        let mut highlights = Vec::new();
        let mut concerns = Vec::new();
        let mut suggestions = Vec::new();

        for dim in dimensions {
            if dim.score >= 0.85 {
                highlights.push(format!("✅ {}: {:.0}% — {}", dim.name, dim.score * 100.0, dim.details));
            } else if dim.score < 0.60 {
                concerns.push(format!("⚠️ {}: {:.0}% — {}", dim.name, dim.score * 100.0, dim.details));
                suggestions.push(self.generate_suggestion(dim));
            }
        }

        let summary = format!(
            "Sessão com {} dimensões avaliadas. Score geral: {:.0}%. {} destaques, {} preocupações.",
            dimensions.len(),
            dimensions.iter().map(|d| d.score).sum::<f32>() / dimensions.len() as f32 * 100.0,
            highlights.len(),
            concerns.len()
        );

        (summary, highlights, concerns, suggestions)
    }

    fn generate_suggestion(&self, dim: &EvaluationDimension) -> String {
        match dim.name.as_str() {
            "Causal Consistency" => {
                "Reforce a cadeia causal: explique como cada conclusão deriva da anterior.".to_string()
            }
            "Contradiction Detection" => {
                "Revise afirmações conflitantes: mantenha consistência entre turns.".to_string()
            }
            "Explicit Validation" => {
                "Inclua validações explícitas: 'verifiquei que X é verdade porque Y'.".to_string()
            }
            "Compilable Artifacts" => {
                "Valide artefatos com testes: execute `cargo check` e `cargo test`.".to_string()
            }
            _ => "Revise a dimensão para melhorar a qualidade da sessão.".to_string(),
        }
    }
}

impl Default for SessionEvaluator {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Avaliação de consistência causal usando CausalGraph.

use crate::types::*;
use arkhe_causal::CausalGraph;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use tracing::debug;

pub struct CausalConsistencyScorer;

impl CausalConsistencyScorer {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self

    pub async fn score(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> DimensionScore {
        let mut evidence = Vec::new();

        // 1. Constrói grafo causal a partir dos turns
        let mut graph = CausalGraph::new();
        let mut turn_nodes = HashMap::new();

        for turn in &trajectory.turns {
            let node_id = format!("turn_{}", turn.id);
            turn_nodes.insert(turn.id.clone(), node_id.clone());

            // Extrai conceitos do turno
            let concepts = self.extract_concepts(&turn.content);
            for concept in concepts {
                graph.add_node(&concept);
            }

            // Adiciona relações causais explícitas
            if let Some(links) = self.extract_causal_links(turn) {
                for link in links {
                    graph.add_edge(&link.from, &link.to, link.strength);
                    evidence.push(format!("Link causal: {} → {}", link.from, link.to));
                }
            }

            // Adiciona relações baseadas em ordem temporal
            if let Some(prev) = trajectory.turns.iter().find(|t| t.id == turn.id) {
                //... (simplificado)
            }
        }

        // 2. Verifica ciclos causais
        let cycles = graph.detect_cycles();
        let has_cycles = !cycles.is_empty();

        // 3. Verifica cadeias causais quebradas
        let broken_chains = self.detect_broken_chains(&graph, &trajectory.turns);

        let score = if has_cycles {
            0.3
        } else if !broken_chains.is_empty() {
            0.6
        } else {
            0.95
        };

        let details = if has_cycles {
            format!("⚠️ Ciclos causais detectados: {:?}", cycles)
        } else if !broken_chains.is_empty() {
            format!("⚠️ Cadeias causais quebradas: {:?}", broken_chains)
        } else {
            "✅ Cadeia causal coerente.".to_string()
        };

        DimensionScore {
            score,
            details,
            evidence,
        }
    }

    fn extract_concepts(&self, text: &str) -> Vec<String> {
        // Extrai conceitos simples (palavras-chave)
        let words: Vec<&str> = text.split_whitespace()
            .filter(|w| w.len() > 3)
            .take(20)
            .collect();
        words.iter().map(|w| w.to_lowercase()).collect()
    }

    fn extract_causal_links(&self, turn: &Turn) -> Option<Vec<CausalLink>> {
        // Extrai links causais explícitos do texto
        // Ex: "porque", "portanto", "como consequência"
        let mut links = Vec::new();
        let text = turn.content.to_lowercase();

        // Padrões simples
        if text.contains("porque") || text.contains("já que") {
            // Simplificado: cria um link do turno anterior para este
            if let Some(prev) = turn.causal_links.first() {
                links.push(CausalLink {
                    from_turn: prev.from_turn.clone(),
                    to_turn: turn.id.clone(),
                    relation: CausalRelation::Premise,
                    strength: 0.8,
                });
            }
        }

        if text.contains("portanto") || text.contains("consequentemente") {
            if let Some(prev) = turn.causal_links.first() {
                links.push(CausalLink {
                    from_turn: prev.from_turn.clone(),
                    to_turn: turn.id.clone(),
                    relation: CausalRelation::Refinement,
                    strength: 0.7,
                });
            }
        }

        if links.is_empty() { None } else { Some(links) }
    }
```

### 2.6. `src/contradiction.rs`

```rust
//! Detecção de contradições entre turns.

use crate::types::*;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use strsim::normalized_levenshtein;

pub struct ContradictionDetector;

impl ContradictionDetector {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }

    pub async fn score(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> DimensionScore {
        let mut contradictions = Vec::new();
        let mut evidence = Vec::new();

        // Compara todos os pares de turns
        for i in 0..trajectory.turns.len() {
            for j in (i + 1)..trajectory.turns.len() {
                let turn_a = &trajectory.turns[i];
                let turn_b = &trajectory.turns[j];

                if let Some(contradiction) = self.detect_contradiction(turn_a, turn_b) {
                    contradictions.push(contradiction);
                    evidence.push(format!(
                        "Contradição entre turnos {} e {}: {}",
                        turn_a.id, turn_b.id, contradiction
                    ));
                }
            }
        }

        let score = if contradictions.is_empty() {
            1.0
        } else {
            (1.0 - (contradictions.len() as f32 / trajectory.turns.len() as f32 * 0.3)).max(0.0)
        };

        let details = if contradictions.is_empty() {
            "✅ Nenhuma contradição detectada.".to_string()
        } else {
            format!("⚠️ {} contradições detectadas.", contradictions.len())
        };

        DimensionScore { score, details, evidence }
    }

    fn detect_contradiction(&self, a: &Turn, b: &Turn) -> Option<String> {
        // Simplificado: verifica negação direta
        let text_a = a.content.to_lowercase();
        let text_b = b.content.to_lowercase();

        // Padrões de contradição
        let negation_patterns = [
            ("não", "sim"),
            ("falso", "verdadeiro"),
            ("errado", "certo"),
            ("impossível", "possível"),
        ];

        for (neg, pos) in &negation_patterns {
            if text_a.contains(neg) && text_b.contains(pos) {
                return Some(format!("'{}' vs '{}'", neg, pos));
            }
            if text_a.contains(pos) && text_b.contains(neg) {
                return Some(format!("'{}' vs '{}'", pos, neg));
            }
        }

        // Verifica similaridade semântica com negação
        let similar = normalized_levenshtein(&text_a, &text_b);
        if similar > 0.8 && (text_a.contains("não") ^ text_b.contains("não")) {
            return Some("Afirmações semanticamente similares com negação oposta".to_string());
        }

        None
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Detecção de validação explícita nas respostas.

use crate::types::*;
use regex::Regex;

pub struct ValidationDetector {
    patterns: Vec<Regex>,
}

impl ValidationDetector {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let patterns = vec![
            Regex::new(r"verifiquei que .*").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"confirmei que .*").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"validei que .*").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"chequei que .*").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"testei que .*").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"vi que .* funciona").unwrap(),
            Regex::new(r"executei .* e .*").unwrap(),
        ];
        Self { patterns }
    }

    pub async fn score(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> DimensionScore {
        let mut validations = Vec::new();
        let mut evidence = Vec::new();

        for turn in &trajectory.turns {
            if turn.role == TurnRole::Assistant {
                let content = &turn.content;
                let found = self.patterns.iter()
                    .filter(|re| re.is_match(content))
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>();

                if !found.is_empty() {
                    validations.push(turn.id.clone());
                    evidence.push(format!(
                        "Turno {} contém validação: \"{}\"",
                        turn.id,
                        found[0].find(content).map(|m| m.as_str()).unwrap_or("...")
                    ));
                }
            }
        }

        let total_assistant_turns = trajectory.turns.iter()
            .filter(|t| t.role == TurnRole::Assistant)
            .count();

        let score = if total_assistant_turns == 0 {
            0.0
        } else {
            (validations.len() as f32 / total_assistant_turns as f32).min(1.0)
        };

        let details = if score >= 0.8 {
            format!("✅ {} de {} turns contêm validação explícita.", validations.len(), total_assistant_turns)
        } else if score >= 0.5 {
            format!("🟡 {} de {} turns contêm validação explícita.", validations.len(), total_assistant_turns)
        } else {
            format!("⚠️ Apenas {} de {} turns contêm validação explícita.", validations.len(), total_assistant_turns)
        };

        DimensionScore { score, details, evidence }
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Análise de artefatos gerados (compilabilidade, testabilidade).

use crate::types::*;
use std::process::Command;
use tempfile::TempDir;
use std::fs;
use tracing::{info, warn};

pub struct ArtifactAnalyzer;

impl ArtifactAnalyzer {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }

    pub async fn score(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> DimensionScore {
        let mut evidence = Vec::new();
        let mut compilable_count = 0;
        let mut testable_count = 0;

        for artifact in &trajectory.artifacts {
            if artifact.artifact_type == ArtifactType::Code {
                let compilable = self.check_compilable(artifact).await;
                let testable = self.check_testable(artifact).await;

                let status = if compilable && testable {
                    "✅ Compilável e testável"
                } else if compilable {
                    "🟡 Compilável, mas sem testes"
                } else {
                    "❌ Não compilável"
                };

                evidence.push(format!("Artifact {}: {}", artifact.id, status));

                if compilable {
                    compilable_count += 1;
                }
                if testable {
                    testable_count += 1;
                }
            }
        }

        let total_artifacts = trajectory.artifacts.iter()
            .filter(|a| a.artifact_type == ArtifactType::Code)
            .count();

        let score = if total_artifacts == 0 {
            0.0
        } else {
            (compilable_count as f32 / total_artifacts as f32 * 0.7) +
            (testable_count as f32 / total_artifacts as f32 * 0.3)
        };

        let details = if total_artifacts == 0 {
            "Nenhum artefato de código gerado.".to_string()
        } else {
            format!(
                "{} de {} artefatos compilam, {} testáveis.",
                compilable_count, total_artifacts, testable_count
            )
        };

        DimensionScore { score, details, evidence }
    }

    async fn check_compilable(&self, artifact: &Artifact) -> bool {
        // Simplificado: verifica se o código contém sintaxe básica de Rust
        let content = &artifact.content;

        // Verifica se parece com Rust
        if content.contains("fn main()") || content.contains("use ") || content.contains("impl ") {
            // Em produção: executaria cargo check em um tempfile
            return true;
        }

        false
    }

    async fn check_testable(&self, artifact: &Artifact) -> bool {
        let content = &artifact.content;
        content.contains("#[cfg(test)]") ||
        content.contains("#[test]") ||
        content.contains("assert_eq")
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Agente de reflexão — analisa trajetórias e consolida aprendizado.

use arkhe_agents::{Agent, AgentContext, AgentResult};
use arkhe_session_evaluator::{SessionEvaluator, SessionTrajectory, EvaluationResult};
use arkhe_memory_v2::{EvolutionaryMemoryV2, MemoryLayer};
use arkhe_llm::InferenceEngine;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tracing::{info, debug};

/// Agente de reflexão: analisa uma trajetória e extrai padrões de aprendizado.
pub struct ReflectorAgent {
    evaluator: SessionEvaluator,
    memory: Arc<EvolutionaryMemoryV2>,
    llm: Arc<dyn InferenceEngine>,
}

impl ReflectorAgent {
    pub fn new(memory: Arc<EvolutionaryMemoryV2>, llm: Arc<dyn InferenceEngine>) -> Self {
        Self {
            evaluator: SessionEvaluator::new(),
            memory,
            llm,
        }
    }

    /// Analisa uma trajetória completa e extrai padrões de aprendizado.
    pub async fn reflect(&self, trajectory: &SessionTrajectory) -> AgentResult<ReflectionReport> {
        info!("🪞 Refletindo sobre sessão: {}", trajectory.id);

        // 1. Avalia a sessão
        let evaluation = self.evaluator.evaluate(trajectory).await;

        // 2. Extrai padrões causais da sessão
        let causal_patterns = self.extract_causal_patterns(trajectory, &evaluation).await?;

        // 3. Extrai padrões procedurais (habilidades)
        let procedural_patterns = self.extract_procedural_patterns(trajectory, &evaluation).await?;

        // 4. Consolida na memória
        self.consolidate_patterns(&causal_patterns, &procedural_patterns, &evaluation).await?;

        // 5. Gera relatório
        let report = ReflectionReport {
            session_id: trajectory.id.clone(),
            evaluation: evaluation.clone(),
            causal_patterns,
            procedural_patterns,
            recommendations: self.generate_recommendations(&evaluation).await?,
        };

        Ok(report)
    }

    async fn extract_causal_patterns(
        &self,
        trajectory: &SessionTrajectory,
        evaluation: &EvaluationResult,
    ) -> AgentResult<Vec<CausalPattern>> {
        let prompt = format!(
            r#"Analise a seguinte sessão e extraia padrões causais:

Sessão: {}
Turns: {}
Avaliação: {:?}

Extraia padrões do tipo "Se X, então Y" que podem ser generalizados.
"#,
            trajectory.id,
            trajectory.turns.len(),
            evaluation.overall_score
        );

        let response = self.llm.generate(&prompt, 0.3, 2048).await?;
        // Parse da resposta para extrair padrões
        // (simplificado)

        Ok(vec![
            CausalPattern {
                id: format!("cp_{}", uuid::Uuid::new_v4()),
                antecedent: "O agente valida suposições".to_string(),
                consequent: "O código compila na primeira tentativa".to_string(),
                confidence: 0.85,
                source_session: trajectory.id.clone(),
            }
        ])
    }

    async fn extract_procedural_patterns(
        &self,
        trajectory: &SessionTrajectory,
        evaluation: &EvaluationResult,
    ) -> AgentResult<Vec<ProceduralPattern>> {
        // Extrai habilidades e estratégias demonstradas

        let mut patterns = Vec::new();

        // Exemplo: se a sessão tem alta validação e artefatos compiláveis
        if evaluation.overall_score > 0.8 {
            patterns.push(ProceduralPattern {
                id: format!("pp_{}", uuid::Uuid::new_v4()),
                name: "Validação e Iteração".to_string(),
                description: "O agente validou suposições e iterou sobre o código até compilar.".to_string(),
                success_rate: evaluation.overall_score,
                source_session: trajectory.id.clone(),
            });
        }

        Ok(patterns)
    }

    async fn consolidate_patterns(
        &self,
        causal: &[CausalPattern],
        procedural: &[ProceduralPattern],
        evaluation: &EvaluationResult,
    ) -> AgentResult<()> {
        // Consolida na memória semântica e procedural

        for pattern in causal {
            self.memory.store_causal_pattern(pattern).await?;
        }

        for pattern in procedural {
            self.memory.store_procedural_pattern(pattern).await?;
        }

        // Atualiza a memória episódica com a avaliação
        self.memory.store_episode(
            &evaluation.session_id,
            evaluation.overall_score,
            &evaluation.summary,
        ).await?;

        Ok(())
    }

    async fn generate_recommendations(&self, evaluation: &EvaluationResult) -> AgentResult<Vec<String>> {
        let mut recommendations = Vec::new();

        for dim in &evaluation.dimensions {
            if dim.score < 0.6 {
                recommendations.push(format!("Melhorar '{}': {}", dim.name, dim.details));
            }
        }

        Ok(recommendations)
    }
}

/// Relatório de reflexão.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ReflectionReport {
    pub session_id: String,
    pub evaluation: EvaluationResult,
    pub causal_patterns: Vec<CausalPattern>,
    pub procedural_patterns: Vec<ProceduralPattern>,
    pub recommendations: Vec<String>,
}

/// Padrão causal extraído.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct CausalPattern {
    pub id: String,
    pub antecedent: String,
    pub consequent: String,
    pub confidence: f32,
    pub source_session: String,
}

/// Padrão procedural extraído.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ProceduralPattern {
    pub id: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub description: String,
    pub success_rate: f32,
    pub source_session: String,
}
```

```rust
//! Memória de quatro camadas para o Arkhe OS.

pub mod working;
pub mod episodic;
pub mod semantic;
pub mod procedural;
pub mod types;

pub use working::WorkingMemory;
pub use episodic::EpisodicMemory;
pub use semantic::SemanticMemory;
pub use procedural::ProceduralMemory;
pub use types::*;

/// Memória evolutiva com quatro camadas.
pub struct EvolutionaryMemoryV2 {
    pub working: WorkingMemory,
    pub episodic: EpisodicMemory,
    pub semantic: SemanticMemory,
    pub procedural: ProceduralMemory,
}

impl EvolutionaryMemoryV2 {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            working: WorkingMemory::new(),
            episodic: EpisodicMemory::new(),
            semantic: SemanticMemory::new(),
            procedural: ProceduralMemory::new(),
        }
    }

    pub async fn store_causal_pattern(&self, pattern: &CausalPattern) -> Result<(), MemoryError> {
        self.semantic.store_pattern(pattern).await
    }

    pub async fn store_procedural_pattern(&self, pattern: &ProceduralPattern) -> Result<(), MemoryError> {
        self.procedural.store_pattern(pattern).await
    }

    pub async fn store_episode(&self, id: &str, score: f32, summary: &str) -> Result<(), MemoryError> {
        self.episodic.store(id, score, summary).await
    }

    pub async fn get_semantic_patterns(&self) -> Vec<CausalPattern> {
        self.semantic.get_patterns().await
    }

    pub async fn get_procedural_patterns(&self) -> Vec<ProceduralPattern> {
        self.procedural.get_patterns().await
    }

    pub fn working_memory(&self) -> &WorkingMemory {
        &self.working
    }
}

impl Default for EvolutionaryMemoryV2 {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Memória de trabalho (Working Memory) — contexto imediato.

use crate::types::WorkingMemoryEntry;
use dashmap::DashMap;
use chrono::{Utc, Duration};
use tracing::debug;

pub struct WorkingMemory {
    entries: DashMap<String, WorkingMemoryEntry>,
    max_entries: usize,
    default_ttl: u64, // segundos
}

impl WorkingMemory {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            entries: DashMap::new(),
            max_entries: 100,
            default_ttl: 300, // 5 minutos
        }
    }

    pub fn insert(&self, id: &str, content: &str, relevance: f32) {
        let entry = WorkingMemoryEntry {
            id: id.to_string(),
            content: content.to_string(),
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
            relevance,
            ttl: Some(self.default_ttl),
        };

        // Verifica limite
        if self.entries.len() >= self.max_entries {
            self.evict_oldest();
        }

        self.entries.insert(id.to_string(), entry);
        debug!("🧠 Working memory: inserted '{}'", id);
    }

    pub fn get(&self, id: &str) -> Option<WorkingMemoryEntry> {
        self.entries.get(id).map(|e| e.clone())
    }

    pub fn get_relevant(&self, threshold: f32) -> Vec<WorkingMemoryEntry> {
        let now = Utc::now();
        self.entries.iter()
            .filter(|e| {
                let entry = e.value();
                entry.relevance >= threshold && !self.is_expired(entry)
            })
            .map(|e| e.clone())
            .collect()
    }

    pub fn update(&self, id: &str, content: &str, relevance: f32) {
        if let Some(mut entry) = self.entries.get_mut(id) {
            entry.content = content.to_string();
            entry.relevance = relevance;
            entry.timestamp = Utc::now();
        }
    }

    pub fn remove(&self, id: &str) {
        self.entries.remove(id);
    }

    pub fn clear(&self) {
        self.entries.clear();
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.entries.len()
    }

    fn is_expired(&self, entry: &WorkingMemoryEntry) -> bool {
        if let Some(ttl) = entry.ttl {
            let elapsed = Utc::now() - entry.timestamp;
            elapsed >= Duration::seconds(ttl as i64)
        } else {
            false
        }
    }

    fn evict_oldest(&self) {
        if let Some(oldest) = self.entries.iter()
            .min_by_key(|e| e.value().timestamp)
            .map(|e| e.key().clone())
        {
            self.entries.remove(&oldest);
            debug!("🧠 Evicted oldest working memory entry");
        }
    }

    /// Compacta a memória de trabalho (remove entradas expiradas e de baixa relevância).
    pub fn compact(&self, min_relevance: f32) {
        let to_remove: Vec<String> = self.entries.iter()
            .filter(|e| {
                let entry = e.value();
                self.is_expired(entry) || entry.relevance < min_relevance
            })
            .map(|e| e.key().clone())
            .collect();

        for key in to_remove {
            self.entries.remove(&key);
        }

        debug!("🧠 Compacted working memory: removed {} entries", to_remove.len());
    }
}

impl Default for WorkingMemory {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Memória episódica (Episodic Memory) — histórico de sessões.

use crate::types::EpisodicEntry;
use arkhe_wormgraph::WormGraphClient;
use sled::Db;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;
use tracing::debug;

pub struct EpisodicMemory {
    store: Arc<Db>,
    wormgraph: Option<Arc<WormGraphClient>>,
    cache: Arc<RwLock<Vec<EpisodicEntry>>>,
}

impl EpisodicMemory {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let db = sled::open("./episodic_memory").expect("Failed to open episodic memory DB");
        let mut cache = Vec::new();

        // Carrega cache do sled
        for item in db.iter() {
            if let Ok((_, value)) = item {
                if let Ok(entry) = rmp_serde::from_slice::<EpisodicEntry>(&value) {
                    cache.push(entry);
                }
            }
        }

        Self {
            store: Arc::new(db),
            wormgraph: None,
            cache: Arc::new(RwLock::new(cache)),
        }
    }

    pub fn with_wormgraph(mut self, client: Arc<WormGraphClient>) -> Self {
        self.wormgraph = Some(client);
        self
    }

    pub async fn store(&self, id: &str, score: f32, summary: &str) -> Result<(), MemoryError> {
        let entry = EpisodicEntry {
            id: id.to_string(),
            session_id: id.to_string(),
            score,
            summary: summary.to_string(),
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
            duration_secs: 0,
            tags: Vec::new(),
        };

        // Armazena no cache
        let mut cache = self.cache.write().await;
        cache.push(entry.clone());
        drop(cache);

        // Persiste no sled
        let serialized = rmp_serde::to_vec(&entry)
            .map_err(|e| MemoryError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;
        self.store.insert(id.as_bytes(), serialized)
            .map_err(|e| MemoryError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;

        // Opcional: WormGraph
        if let Some(wg) = &self.wormgraph {
            let _ = wg.record_event("episodic_memory", serde_json::json!({
                "id": entry.id,
                "score": entry.score,
                "summary": entry.summary,
                "timestamp": entry.timestamp,
            })).await;
        }

        debug!("🧠 Episodic memory: stored session '{}' (score: {})", id, score);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn get_recent(&self, limit: usize) -> Vec<EpisodicEntry> {
        let mut cache = self.cache.write().await;
        cache.sort_by(|a, b| b.timestamp.cmp(&a.timestamp));
        cache.iter().take(limit).cloned().collect()
    }

    pub async fn get_by_session(&self, session_id: &str) -> Option<EpisodicEntry> {
        let cache = self.cache.read().await;
        cache.iter().find(|e| e.session_id == session_id).cloned()
    }

    pub async fn get_all(&self) -> Vec<EpisodicEntry> {
        self.cache.read().await.clone()
    }

    pub async fn search(&self, query: &str) -> Vec<EpisodicEntry> {
        let cache = self.cache.read().await;
        cache.iter()
            .filter(|e| e.summary.contains(query))
            .cloned()
            .collect()
    }

    pub async fn compact(&self, max_entries: usize) {
        let mut cache = self.cache.write().await;
        if cache.len() > max_entries {
            cache.sort_by(|a, b| b.timestamp.cmp(&a.timestamp));
            cache.truncate(max_entries);

            // Reconstroi o sled
            self.store.clear()
                .map_err(|e| MemoryError::Storage(e.to_string()))
                .ok();
            for entry in cache.iter() {
                if let Ok(serialized) = rmp_serde::to_vec(entry) {
                    let _ = self.store.insert(entry.id.as_bytes(), serialized);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

impl Default for EpisodicMemory {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Memória semântica (Semantic Memory) — padrões causais consolidados.

use crate::types::CausalPattern;
use dashmap::DashMap;
use chrono::Utc;
use tracing::debug;

pub struct SemanticMemory {
    patterns: DashMap<String, CausalPattern>,
}

impl SemanticMemory {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            patterns: DashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    pub async fn store_pattern(&self, pattern: &CausalPattern) -> Result<(), MemoryError> {
        let mut p = pattern.clone();
        p.updated_at = Utc::now();

        // Se já existe, funde
        if let Some(existing) = self.patterns.get(&pattern.id) {
            let merged = self.merge_patterns(&existing, &p);
            self.patterns.insert(pattern.id.clone(), merged);
        } else {
            self.patterns.insert(pattern.id.clone(), p);
        }

        debug!("🧠 Semantic memory: stored causal pattern '{}'", pattern.id);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn get_pattern(&self, id: &str) -> Option<CausalPattern> {
        self.patterns.get(id).map(|p| p.clone())
    }

    pub async fn get_patterns(&self) -> Vec<CausalPattern> {
        self.patterns.iter().map(|e| e.clone()).collect()
    }

    pub async fn get_by_antecedent(&self, antecedent: &str) -> Vec<CausalPattern> {
        self.patterns.iter()
            .filter(|e| e.antecedent.contains(antecedent))
            .map(|e| e.clone())
            .collect()
    }

    pub async fn get_by_consequent(&self, consequent: &str) -> Vec<CausalPattern> {
        self.patterns.iter()
            .filter(|e| e.consequent.contains(consequent))
            .map(|e| e.clone())
            .collect()
    }

    pub async fn get_by_confidence(&self, min_confidence: f32) -> Vec<CausalPattern> {
        self.patterns.iter()
            .filter(|e| e.confidence >= min_confidence)
            .map(|e| e.clone())
            .collect()
    }

    fn merge_patterns(&self, a: &CausalPattern, b: &CausalPattern) -> CausalPattern {
        // Mescla dois padrões causais
        let mut merged = a.clone();
        merged.confidence = (a.confidence + b.confidence) / 2.0;
        merged.updated_at = Utc::now();

        // Unifica as sessões fonte
        let mut sources = a.source_sessions.clone();
        for src in &b.source_sessions {
            if !sources.contains(src) {
                sources.push(src.clone());
            }
        }
        merged.source_sessions = sources;

        merged
    }

    pub async fn compact(&self, min_confidence: f32) {
        let to_remove: Vec<String> = self.patterns.iter()
            .filter(|e| e.confidence < min_confidence)
            .map(|e| e.key().clone())
            .collect();

        for key in to_remove {
            self.patterns.remove(&key);
        }

        debug!("🧠 Semantic memory: removed {} patterns below confidence threshold", to_remove.len());
    }
}

impl Default for SemanticMemory {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Memória procedural (Procedural Memory) — habilidades aprendidas.

use crate::types::ProceduralPattern;
use dashmap::DashMap;
use chrono::Utc;
use tracing::debug;

pub struct ProceduralMemory {
    patterns: DashMap<String, ProceduralPattern>,
}

impl ProceduralMemory {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            patterns: DashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    pub async fn store_pattern(&self, pattern: &ProceduralPattern) -> Result<(), MemoryError> {
        let mut p = pattern.clone();
        p.updated_at = Utc::now();

        // Se já existe, atualiza a taxa de sucesso
        if let Some(existing) = self.patterns.get(&pattern.id) {
            let combined_success = (existing.success_rate + p.success_rate) / 2.0;
            p.success_rate = combined_success;

            let mut sources = existing.source_sessions.clone();
            for src in &p.source_sessions {
                if !sources.contains(src) {
                    sources.push(src.clone());
                }
            }
            p.source_sessions = sources;
        }

        self.patterns.insert(pattern.id.clone(), p);
        debug!("🧠 Procedural memory: stored pattern '{}'", pattern.id);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn get_pattern(&self, id: &str) -> Option<ProceduralPattern> {
        self.patterns.get(id).map(|p| p.clone())
    }

    pub async fn get_patterns(&self) -> Vec<ProceduralPattern> {
        self.patterns.iter().map(|e| e.clone()).collect()
    }

    pub async fn get_by_name(&self, name: &str) -> Vec<ProceduralPattern> {
        self.patterns.iter()
            .filter(|e| e.name.contains(name))
            .map(|e| e.clone())
            .collect()
    }

    pub async fn get_best(&self, limit: usize) -> Vec<ProceduralPattern> {
        let mut all: Vec<ProceduralPattern> = self.patterns.iter()
            .map(|e| e.clone())
            .collect();
        all.sort_by(|a, b| b.success_rate.partial_cmp(&a.success_rate).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));
        all.truncate(limit);
        all
    }

    pub async fn compact(&self, min_success_rate: f32) {
        let to_remove: Vec<String> = self.patterns.iter()
            .filter(|e| e.success_rate < min_success_rate)
            .map(|e| e.key().clone())
            .collect();

        for key in to_remove {
            self.patterns.remove(&key);
        }

        debug!("🧠 Procedural memory: removed {} patterns below success threshold", to_remove.len());
    }
}

impl Default for ProceduralMemory {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Universal Model com ciclo de três fases e memória de quatro camadas.

use crate::error::UniversalError;
use crate::types::*;
use crate::config::UniversalConfig;
use crate::neural::NeuralEngine;
use crate::reasoning::CausalReasoner;
use crate::agentic::AgenticEngine;
use crate::memory::LongTermMemory;
use crate::tools::ToolRegistry;
use crate::session_evaluator::SessionEvaluator;
use crate::reflector_agent::ReflectorAgent;
use crate::memory_v2::EvolutionaryMemoryV2;
use Arkhe_identity::Did;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;
use tracing::{info, debug};

pub struct UniversalModel {
    neural: Arc<RwLock<NeuralEngine>>,
    reasoner: Arc<RwLock<CausalReasoner>>,
    agentic: Arc<RwLock<AgenticEngine>>,
    memory: Arc<RwLock<LongTermMemory>>,
    tools: Arc<RwLock<ToolRegistry>>,
    state: Arc<RwLock<ModelState>>,
    agent_did: Did,

    // Novos componentes
    evaluator: Arc<SessionEvaluator>,
    reflector: Arc<ReflectorAgent>,
    memory_v2: Arc<EvolutionaryMemoryV2>,
}

impl UniversalModel {
    pub async fn new(config: UniversalConfig, agent_did: Did) -> Result<Self, UniversalError> {
        info!("🚀 Initializing Universal Model with cognitive cycle...");

        // ... inicialização existente ...

        // Inicializa memória V2
        let memory_v2 = Arc::new(EvolutionaryMemoryV2::new());

        // Inicializa avaliador
        let evaluator = Arc::new(SessionEvaluator::new());

        // Inicializa agente de reflexão
        let reflector = Arc::new(ReflectorAgent::new(
            memory_v2.clone(),
            neural_engine.clone(),
        ));

        Ok(Self {
            // ... campos existentes ...
            evaluator,
            reflector,
            memory_v2,
        })
    }

    /// Ciclo completo: Execução → Reflexão → Aprendizado
    pub async fn process_with_reflection(&self, input: UniversalInput) -> Result<UniversalOutput, UniversalError> {
        // 1. EXECUÇÃO: processa a entrada
        let trajectory_id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
        let mut trajectory = SessionTrajectory {
            id: trajectory_id.clone(),
            agent_did: self.agent_did.to_string(),
            turns: Vec::new(),
            artifacts: Vec::new(),
            start_time: chrono::Utc::now(),
            end_time: None,
            metadata: Default::default(),
        };

        // Processa o input e coleta a trajetória
        let output = self.process_internal(&input, &mut trajectory).await?;

        // Marca o fim da trajetória
        trajectory.end_time = Some(chrono::Utc::now());

        // 2. REFLEXÃO: analisa a trajetória
        let reflection = self.reflector.reflect(&trajectory).await?;

        // 3. APRENDIZADO: consolida padrões na memória
        self.consolidate_learning(&reflection).await?;

        // 4. Atualiza a memória de trabalho com o resultado
        self.memory_v2.working.insert(
            &trajectory_id,
            &format!("Sessão concluída. Score: {:.0}%", reflection.evaluation.overall_score * 100.0),
            reflection.evaluation.overall_score,
        );

        Ok(output)
    }

    async fn process_internal(
        &self,
        input: UniversalInput,
        trajectory: &mut SessionTrajectory,
    ) -> Result<UniversalOutput, UniversalError> {
        // Execução normal com coleta de turnos
        // ...
        Ok(UniversalOutput::default())
    }

    async fn consolidate_learning(&self, reflection: &ReflectionReport) -> Result<(), UniversalError> {
        // Consolida padrões na memória semântica
        for pattern in &reflection.causal_patterns {
            self.memory_v2.store_causal_pattern(pattern).await?;
        }

        // Consolida padrões na memória procedural
        for pattern in &reflection.procedural_patterns {
            self.memory_v2.store_procedural_pattern(pattern).await?;
        }

        // Armazena na memória episódica
        self.memory_v2.store_episode(
            &reflection.session_id,
            reflection.evaluation.overall_score,
            &reflection.evaluation.summary,
        ).await?;

        Ok(())
    }
}
```
